prs.title: fix(coding-agent): honor saved trust decision when project has no trust-requiring resources
prs.body:
## Problem

`ctx.isProjectTrusted()` returns `true` for a project with an explicit "Do not trust" decision saved in `~/.pi/agent/trust.json`, as long as the project has no trust-requiring resources.

In `createRuntime` (`packages/coding-agent/src/main.ts`), the trust-store lookup sat behind an `||` short-circuit:

```ts
(!hasTrustRequiringResources || trustStore.get(cwd) === true)
```

With no trust-requiring resources the store was never consulted, so a saved `false` was ignored and `projectTrusted` became `true`. Extensions honoring trust decisions (per #5523) then re-injected content such as `AGENTS.md` that the user had explicitly declined.

## Fix

Consult the explicit saved decision before the no-resources default:

```ts
cachedProjectTrust ?? parsed.projectTrustOverride ?? trustStore.get(cwd) ?? !hasTrustRequiringResources
```

(`ProjectTrustStore.get` returns `boolean | null`, so `??` chaining is safe.) The deferred-resolution path (`shouldResolveProjectTrust`) is untouched: with trust-requiring resources and no cached decision/override, trust still resolves later as before. Also added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.

## Verification

- New regression tests in `packages/coding-agent/test/main-project-trust.test.ts` (6 cases): saved `false`/`true`/no-entry with no trust-requiring resources, plus deferred resolution preserved with resources for all three saved states. All 6 pass.
- Negative check: against the pre-fix code, the saved-`false` case fails as expected (5 pass), confirming the test pins the fix.
- Neighboring trust suites (`trust-selector`, `trust-manager`): 12/12 pass.
- `npm run check` (biome, pinned deps, tsc --noEmit, etc.): clean.

Closes #10947

prs.body:
With this PR, we stop  rendering every option.
Instead, we render a centered, clamped window of up to 10 options and  show `(selection/total)` when the list overflows.

This keeps the selected option visible in long extension-provided lists without changing navigation, keybindings, callbacks, countdowns, or short-list rendering.

Fixes #6688.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

The change is localized to `ExtensionSelectorComponent.updateList()` and can be reverted without migration or persisted-state concerns.

**Blast Radius:** Low

Only extension selectors with more than 10 options change appearance; they now render a window and position indicator instead of every option.

issues.body:
## Problem

#13918 (merged as `53a24a5ddf`) bounds the tenant-guard waits behind #13800. A held guard now answers `tenant_guard_contended` instead of freezing other Sessions. Its review left 14 non-blocking suggestions with no follow-up:

- **R1-15.** The author deferred it on purpose, because the dedupe should collapse every copy of the fixture in one test-only change.
- **13 round-2 suggestions.** The review bot deferred these in [review 5540652544](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13918#pullrequestreview-5540652544). Only a truncated one-line title survives for each.

I reconstructed each suggestion from the code at `e1ba36ad4b`, the commit that round reviewed, and re-checked it against main `5929e276ed`.

- 12 still apply, some more widely than the bot said.
- 1 rested on a wrong premise (section D).
- 3 are about behavior, not wording: lanes the design calls bounded still have unbounded waits (section A).

Line references are to `5929e276ed`. Java paths are under `packages/managed-agent-server/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/` unless shown in full. All findings come from reading the code; none has been run against a database yet.

## Items

### A. Waits the design calls bounded that are still unbounded

1. **The publication producer and dispatch lanes take the placement guard unbounded.**
   - `producerBindingWithHashLocked` calls `lockOriginal` (`managedagent/store/ToolPublicationStore.java:214`) before its bounded `lockTenant` (`:229`).
   - On the native (non-CSI) branch, `lockOriginal` runs `JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository.lockPlacementDomain(target, tenantId)` (`:845`). That overload passes a timeout of 0.
   - So `publishSegment`, `publishResource`, `seal`, `prefix`, `finish` and `recoverOperation` (through `authorize`/`authorizeClaim`), and also `verifyDispatch`, wait on a held placement row for up to `innodb_lock_wait_timeout` (50 s). Their failure does not carry the name.
   - `e1ba36ad4b` has the same structure.
   - `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT#heldTenantGuardsBoundPublicationLaneEntries` calls `data.finish` only after the hold is released, so it does not cover this case.
   - **Fix:** take the placement through the bounded overload and add a held-guard witness. Otherwise, list these lanes under the design's Follow-ups (see item 8).
   - _Source: R2 deferred, `…wedge.zh-CN.md:335`._

2. **`lockSessionHead` bounds only the tenant row** (`managedagent/store/ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:124-140`).
   - After the bounded tenant-row lock (`:128`), `lockSessionRoot` (`:130`) and the head `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` (`:132-140`) run with no statement timeout, while the tenant row is held.
   - Since #13918, ordinary writers lock the root and head rows without the tenant row. A retention read (`ManagedSnapshotStore.java:508`), a put or `lockRetainedPublication` can therefore wait behind one Session's writer for up to `innodb_lock_wait_timeout` while it holds the tenant row. Meanwhile, other Sessions' bounded lanes answer `tenant_guard_contended`.
   - `namedRootDeadlock` names only deadlock victims (1213). A lock-wait timeout (1205) on the root row is rethrown without the name.
   - Exposure is small, because writer transactions are short.
   - **Fix:** bound the root and head waits as well, and map 1205 in `namedRootDeadlock`. Otherwise, narrow the comment at `:124-127` to the tenant row.
   - _Source: `ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:123`._

3. **The bound in `lockSessionHead` never fires at 8 call sites.**
   - Each of these sites already took the tenant row earlier in the same transaction, through the unbounded two-argument `lockTenant`.
   - InnoDB row locks are re-entrant, so the bounded re-acquire never waits. The real wait is the earlier call.

   | Bounded call (never waits) | Earlier unbounded `lockTenant` |
   | --- | --- |
   | `ManagedProjectionResourceCollector.java:92` | `:87` |
   | `ManagedProjectionResourceCollector.java:153` | `:149` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:346` | `:342` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:440` | `:436` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:510` | in `admitsLegacyProjection` (`:436`), same transaction |
   | `SessionResourceCollectionCollector.java:198` | `:193` |
   | `SessionResourceCollectionCollector.java:349` | `:347` |
   | `ManagedAgentStore.java:2943` (v1/v2 DELETE) | `:2936` |

   - All of these are background or lifecycle lanes, so no hot path regresses. The comment at `:124-127`, however, claims more than the code does.
   - **Fix:** make the first `lockTenant` bounded where the lane is meant to be bounded. Otherwise, say in the comment that the bound only matters to callers that do not hold the row yet.
   - _Source: `ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:125` (the bot counted 4 sites)._

### B. Design text that disagrees with the shipped code

Each of these applies to both `docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md` (EN) and `.zh-CN.md` (ZH). None of these passages changed between `e1ba36ad4b` and main.

4. **The evidence pointers do not lead to the evidence** (EN `:10-12`, `:21-22`; ZH `:10-11`, `:19`).
   - `docs/verification/13532-linux-h3/README.md` exists. No version of it contains "finding A2", the cross-Session freeze correlation, or recovery after clearing rows. It records a single `recoveryBlocked=true` on a foreground publication control.
   - The A2 narrative only appears in the body of #13800.
   - `.qwen/issues/issue-13800.md` is ignored by `.gitignore`, and the doc itself says so.
   - **Fix:** point to the #13800 body (or commit the report), and drop "(finding A2)".
   - _Source: `…wedge.md:10`._

5. **D2 and D4 describe a retry budget the client does not have** (EN `:241-249`, `:292-293`; ZH `:207-213`, `:248`).
   - D2 claims "server-side waits now ≤5 s, a 3-attempt retry fits in one client budget". Both halves are off:
     - One request can take several bounded acquisitions in turn. For example, `acquireWriter` takes placement and then the CAS row. The server-side wait can therefore approach 10 s.
     - The client retries `tenant_guard_contended` every 250 ms until the shared 30 s deadline, outside the 3-attempt cap (`packages/core/src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.ts:1436-1447`, counted separately as `guardRetries`).
   - D4's "No change to the store client's timeout/retry budgets" contradicts the client change #13918 made, and the doc's own 2026-10-16 revision note.
   - **Fix:** rewrite both to match the code.
   - _Source: `…wedge.md:233`._

6. **R3 says the publication commit lane is unaffected** (EN `:342-346`; ZH `:288-291`).
   - `heldTenantGuardsBoundPublicationLaneEntries` asserts the opposite: under a held placement, `admission.commitReceipt(...)` fails fast with `tenant_guard_contended`.
   - The receipt commit is handled by `ToolPublicationAdmissionStore.commitReceipt`, not `ToolPublicationStore`. Its "own locks" are the two tenant guards.
   - **Fix:** say the publication lanes are bounded and fail by name, and cite that witness.
   - _Source: `…wedge.zh-CN.md:271`._

7. **Validation step 4 and acceptance criterion 3 cannot be checked, and they expect the wrong outcome** (EN `:375-377`, `:388-390`; ZH `:314-315`, `:325-326`).
   - The driver under `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/` is ignored by `.gitignore`.
   - Both passages promise named-fast failures. Under a sustained hold, the shipped code behaves differently:
     - The client retries to its 30 s budget.
     - The daemon's open route then answers a generic 503 `managed_session_open_failed` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts:5839`), and the name appears only on stderr.
     - A turn settles as a plain `error`, because `namedStoreFailure` deliberately excludes `tenant_guard_contended` (`:364-375`).
   - This matches the rewritten G2, not these two passages.
   - **Fix:** commit the driver or cite committed evidence, and restate the expected outcome per G2.
   - _Source: `…wedge.zh-CN.md:296`._

8. **F2, the Status line and the D2 heading call the publication lanes bounded** (EN `:5-6`, `:115-117`, `:231`, `:414-425`; ZH `:198`, `:347-355`).
   - This is true for the apply, admission and receipt lanes and the lease opener.
   - It is not true for the producer and dispatch lanes in item 1, and Follow-ups does not list them.
   - Item 2's root and head waits are unbounded as well.
   - "Bounded" is also per statement: a lane that takes placement and then the CAS row can wait about 10 s.
   - **Fix:** after item 1 and item 2 are decided, narrow these passages or extend Follow-ups.
   - _Source: `…wedge.zh-CN.md:335`._

### C. Code and test hygiene

9. **`ensureSessionRoot` runs two statements that cannot do anything** (`managedagent/store/ManagedSessionStore.java:2864-2873`).
   - `lockSessionRoot` already upserts the root row with its keys (`INSERT … ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`) and locks it.
   - So `insertSessionRoot`'s `INSERT IGNORE` (`:2846-2862`) always hits a duplicate, and its result is discarded.
   - `materializeSessionRoot`'s `UPDATE … WHERE session_scope_key IS NULL` (`:2879`) always matches 0 rows.
   - The comment at `:2869` admits the insert never inserts.
   - The cost is two wasted round trips on every writer acquire.
   - **Fix:** keep `lockSessionRoot` plus the `ma_event_stream` `INSERT IGNORE`, and delete the rest.
   - _Source: `ManagedSessionStore.java:2856`._

10. **Two comments call the tenant CAS row "this entry's first acquisition"** (`managedagent/store/ToolPublicationStore.java:435-437` and `:1093-1096`).
    - `applyLocked` takes the bounded placement guard first, in `lockPublicationPlacement` (`:432`, whose own comment says placement is the first tenant-wide acquisition), and then runs `lockOriginal`.
    - The grant-lane callers of `lockTenant` (`:229`, `:1019`) also come after `lockOriginal`.
    - The bounds themselves can fire. Only the comments are wrong, and they contradict each other.
    - **Fix:** describe it as the first acquisition of the CAS row, after placement.
    - _Source: `ToolPublicationStore.java:441`._

11. **The lock-free CSI probe duplicates the locked slot/binding readers, and the two copies have already drifted** (`runtimebroker/JdbcCsiFilesRetirementGuard.java:232-273` vs `lockSlots` `:276-291` and `lockBindings` `:293-330`).
    - `hasCsiRuntimeMarker` re-implements the slot query and the binding-reference building, without the locking.
    - #14185 moved `lockSlots`/`lockBindings` to `ManagedSchemaProjection` column lists. The probe, which merged later, still uses the only two `SELECT *` literals left in managed-agent-server main sources (`:236`, `:240`).
    - If a future change to how slots reference bindings reaches only one copy, the probe answers "not CSI" where the locked path would fail closed. A CSI Session would then skip the tenant guards.
    - **Fix:** one shared reader with a locking flag, using the projections.
    - _Source: `JdbcCsiFilesRetirementGuard.java:230`._

12. **Two `recoveryReason` sites are still written by hand.**
    - `blockRecovery(session, storeFailure)` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts:391-397`) sets the reason on every block. The recovered-turn route and `:2025`/`:8650` use it.
    - The prompt route (`:6638-6655`) and the bare-load catch in `startHostedRecoveredTurn` (`:2873-2888`) still set `blocked` and assign the reason conditionally. That leaves 5 sites with 4 shapes.
    - The bot's "three-arm" ordering concern has no effect: `namedStoreFailure` can only return one string, so the order does not matter.
    - The real gap is that the hand-written sites never clear an earlier reason. The prompt route cannot reach that state. The bare-load catch can, in principle: the resident redrive (`:3969`) calls `startHostedRecoveredTurn` on a still-blocked Session, and a failure with a non-store cause would keep the old reason. This is inferred from the code, not run.
    - **Fix:** route both sites through `blockRecovery`, with one shared namer for the causes and the recorded `stopReason`.
    - _Source: `hosted-harness-session.ts:6406`._

13. **The commit-lane stopwatch in `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT#heldTenantGuardsDoNotWedgeUnrelatedSessions` starts late** (`packages/managed-agent-server/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/store/ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.java:200`).
    - The commit is submitted at `:190`, but `commitBefore` is taken after three other `get(30, SECONDS)` calls (`:193-195`).
    - So the 15 s ceiling only measures the leftover wait.
    - The other arms (`:218`, `:240`, `assertFastGuardFailure` `:687-702`) start the clock before they submit.
    - This loosens the check; it cannot make it flaky.
    - **Fix:** take the timestamp before the `:190` submit, and optionally time the other three calls too.
    - _Source: `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.java:198`._

14. **R1-15: the two bare-load tests duplicate about 210 lines of setup, and the same fixture appears elsewhere in the file.**
    - Both tests are in `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`, under describe `'Hosted Harness Runtime turn takeover'` (`:20592`):
      - `:21814`: `'preserves the named store failure on session status when automatic bare-load recovery cannot settle'`
      - `:22140`: `'preserves the named store failure computed by the turn when bare-load recovery cannot settle'`
    - Lines 11–221 of each test are identical: the manifest publish, the broker spies, the `publicationRequest` mock, the first app, the sink kill, `teamCall`/`batch`, the model mock, and the prompt and block wait.
    - What genuinely differs:
      - the `appendTransaction` predicate (`"turn.settled"` vs a one-shot `"message.committed"` + `"role":"assistant"`);
      - the counter;
      - the refused `promptId`;
      - a journal scan that only the second test has.
    - The it.each at `:32008` (`'answers a committed %s sibling before the bare-load resume of a publication Session'`) shares 194 of those setup lines. The pair is effectively its `task_create` row plus a journal fault.
    - The sink-kill injection recurs at `:29552`, `:31619`, `:31860` and `:32141`. The full call arrays recur at `:31468`, `:32178` and `:32404`.
    - Both tests also wrap themselves in `try { domainEnablement.childRun = true } finally { domainEnablement.childRun = true }`. This does nothing, because the default is already `true` (`:144`).
    - **Fix:** extract a describe-local helper that runs the crashed publication round and returns the second app's bare load. A sketch:

      ```ts
      crashPublicationRoundThenBareLoad({
        sibling?: 'task_create' | 'agent' | …,
      ```

### A. 设计称为有界、实际仍无界的等待

1. **publication 的 producer 车道和 dispatch 车道无界地获取 placement 守卫。**
   - `producerBindingWithHashLocked` 先调用 `lockOriginal`（`managedagent/store/ToolPublicationStore.java:214`），之后才调用有界的 `lockTenant`（`:229`）。
   - 在原生（非 CSI）分支上，`lockOriginal` 执行 `JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository.lockPlacementDomain(target, tenantId)`（`:845`）。这个重载传入的超时为 0。
   - 因此 `publishSegment`、`publishResource`、`seal`、`prefix`、`finish`、`recoverOperation`（经 `authorize`/`authorizeClaim`）以及 `verifyDispatch` 遇到被占用的 placement 行时，会一直等到 `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`（50 秒），失败也不带名称。
   - `e1ba36ad4b` 上的结构相同。
   - `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT#heldTenantGuardsBoundPublicationLaneEntries` 只在释放占用之后才调用 `data.finish`，覆盖不到这种情形。
   - **修法：** 改用有界重载获取 placement，并补一个占用守卫时的见证测试；否则把这些车道写进设计的 Follow-ups（见第 8 项）。
   - _来源：R2 延后，`…wedge.zh-CN.md:335`。_

2. **`lockSessionHead` 只给租户行设了上限**（`managedagent/store/ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:124-140`）。
   - 有界的租户行锁（`:128`）之后，`lockSessionRoot`（`:130`）和 head 的 `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`（`:132-140`）都没有语句超时，而且是在持有租户行时执行的。
   - #13918 之后，普通 writer 不取租户行就锁 root 和 head。所以保留读（`ManagedSnapshotStore.java:508`）、put 或 `lockRetainedPublication` 可能在持有租户行的状态下，排在某个 Session 的 writer 后面，最长等到 `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`。与此同时，其他 Session 的有界车道会返回 `tenant_guard_contended`。
   - `namedRootDeadlock` 只命名死锁牺牲者（1213）。root 行上的锁等待超时（1205）会被原样抛出，不带名称。
   - 由于 writer 事务都很短，实际暴露面不大。
   - **修法：** root 和 head 的等待也加上限，并在 `namedRootDeadlock` 中映射 1205；否则把 `:124-127` 的注释收窄到只说租户行。
   - _来源：`ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:123`。_

3. **`lockSessionHead` 里的上限在 8 个调用点永远不会生效。**
   - 这些调用点在同一事务里，已经先用无界的两参数 `lockTenant` 取过租户行。
   - InnoDB 行锁可重入，所以后面的有界再获取永远不会等待，真正的等待发生在前面那次调用。

   | 有界调用（不会等待） | 之前的无界 `lockTenant` |
   | --- | --- |
   | `ManagedProjectionResourceCollector.java:92` | `:87` |
   | `ManagedProjectionResourceCollector.java:153` | `:149` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:346` | `:342` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:440` | `:436` |
   | `ManagedToolResultStore.java:510` | 在 `admitsLegacyProjection`（`:436`）中，同一事务 |
   | `SessionResourceCollectionCollector.java:198` | `:193` |
   | `SessionResourceCollectionCollector.java:349` | `:347` |
   | `ManagedAgentStore.java:2943`（v1/v2 DELETE） | `:2936` |

   - 这些都是后台或生命周期车道，热路径不受影响，但 `:124-127` 的注释说得比代码做到的多。
   - **修法：** 在本应有界的车道上，把第一次 `lockTenant` 改为有界；否则在注释里说明，上限只对尚未持有该行的调用方有意义。
   - _来源：`ToolPublicationRetentionStore.java:125`（bot 只数出 4 处）。_

issues.body:
# fix(managed-agent): ≥8 concurrent Turns stall after the model answers on modest hardware (lock convoy in the store path)

## What happened?

Found by bisection with the new `--list-pagination` mode of
`scripts/run-managed-agent-server-e2e.ts` (full packaged stack), varying the
number of Sessions created at once on the same tenant:

| Concurrent Turns | macOS arm64 (M-series) | Linux aarch64 (Orange Pi 5, 8 cores) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | all complete | **all complete** |
| 8 | all complete | **all stall: 8/8 RUNNING, zero events after `turn.started` for 120+s** |
| 12 | all complete (~35 s) | **all stall identically** |

The stall shape on the rig, twice deterministically:

- all 8 Sessions admitted, all 8 Turns reach `turn.started`;
- all 8 model requests reach the (fake) provider and are answered instantly —
  so the model call is not the bottleneck;
- **zero** `message.delta`/completion commits follow: the pipeline between
  "model answered" and "journal commit" produces nothing for 120+ s;
- the coordinator logs `Managed Turn lease renewal failed …
  failure=CannotAcquireLockException` on the `-dispatch-lease` thread (3×).

So the Turns don't fail and don't finish — they wedge the same way
#13322 records for a held model stream, here triggered purely by concurrency.

## What did you expect to happen?

N concurrent Turns may be slower, but they must keep making progress and
settle; a lock in the store/dispatch path must not convoy every writer
behind one another until the InnoDB lock wait times out. If the intended
shape is a concurrency cap, the admission should queue Turns explicitly
instead of starting all of them into a stall.

## Client information

Packaged-stack E2E runner (`--list-pagination`, twelve Sessions), repo HEAD
`1cf80d46d0`. Rig: Orange Pi 5 (8× Cortex-A76/A55, 16 GB), Ubuntu 22.04,
MySQL 8.0.45, JDK 21. Compare: the same 12-Turn burst passes on macOS arm64
in ~35 s.

## Anything else we need to know?

Parent: #12380 / Stage G (#12952). Same-wedge family: #13322 (held stream),
#13327 (coordinator-only crash). The CannotAcquireLockException on dispatch
lease renewal is the only diagnostic surfaced; it may be a symptom (a Turn's
commit transaction holding the row the renewal wants) rather than the cause.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 发生了什么？

用 `--list-pagination` 模式的并发数二分定位（同一租户、整栈）：

| 并发 Turn 数 | macOS arm64 | Linux aarch64（Orange Pi 5，8 核） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | 全部完成 | **全部完成** |
| 8 | 全部完成 | **全部卡死：8/8 RUNNING，turn.started 后 120+ 秒零事件** |
| 12 | 全部完成（约 35s） | **同样全部卡死**（两次确定性复现） |

卡死形态：8 个 Session 全部准入、8 个 Turn 全部 turn.started；8 个模型请求都到达了
（fake）provider 并被即时应答——模型调用不是瓶颈；但之后**没有任何**
message.delta/完成落账，120+ 秒管线零产出；协调器在 -dispatch-lease 线程报
`CannotAcquireLockException`（租约续约失败，3 次）。Turn 不失败也不完成——
与 #13322 的挂起同族，只是触发源是并发。

## 期望行为

N 个并发 Turn 可以变慢，但必须持续推进并结算；store/dispatch 路径上的锁不能把
所有写者堵到 InnoDB 锁等待超时。若设计意图是并发上限，应在准入处显式排队，
而不是把所有 Turn 放进 stall。

</details>

issues.body:
## What would you like to be added?

#14434 was answered by two PRs, both merged:

- #14451 makes the store refuse a full tool publication reservation with its own code, naming the limit: 429 `managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted`, or 409 `managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted`.
- #14452 lets the Hosted Harness answer such a refused batch as not started, instead of blocking the Session.

From each PR's third audit round on, only Critical findings changed code. This issue gathers in one place, without duplicates, what both PRs deferred and the nits from their reviews, ordered by effect.

Each item names its source:

- #14451: [audit rounds and deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14451#issuecomment-6231479515), [triage verdict](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14451#issuecomment-6231691603);
- #14452: [audit rounds and deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6231479768), [triage verdict](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6231667280).

No later commit on main has changed this code, checked at `b3c5d3ed1e`.

### 1. Retry guidance the model can act on

1. **A batch that can never reserve is told to retry.** Two cases are both 429s:
   - A batch with more Shell and Monitor calls than `active-captures` cannot reserve at all.
   - A refusal caused by the same batch's own earlier reservations cannot clear while that batch waits.

   For both, the Harness answers "Retry after the running tools finish." and does not back off, so the model may repeat the batch every turn. The answer should tell these cases apart, for example by comparing the batch's reservations with the limit, and say to run fewer of those tools at once. _(#14451 and #14452 deferrals, #14452 triage verdict)_
2. **Calls that need no reservation get the same hint.** Agent, workflow, message, team and command calls in a refused batch get the publication limit's retry hint, although no limit applied to them. _(#14452)_
3. **No pacing signal.** The 429 carries no `Retry-After`. The Harness reserve loop makes three attempts 250 ms apart, so each refused call logs three WARN lines, with no rate limit. _(#14451)_

### 2. Making 409 and 429 predict correctly (`ToolPublicationStore.reserve`)

4. **A tenant-level 409 counts other Sessions' used bytes.** Those Sessions can retire and free their bytes while this Session lives. The reserve loop treats a 409 as final, so a retry that might have succeeded is never tried. The #14451 triage verdict named this the weakest inference in the split. _(#14451)_
5. **A request larger than a limit is reported as retention.** It answers 409 `retention_exhausted` and logs `retained=true`, although nothing is retained. Not retrying is right; the code and the log line are wrong. _(#14451)_
6. **Held bytes that nothing releases are classed as 429.** Examples:
   - a capture fenced during finish verification and then released by `releaseFailedFinish`;
   - the admission of a quarantined or receipt-less finished capture.

   The reverse also happens: `releaseFailedFinish` can lower used bytes, so a 409 can occasionally clear without collection. _(#14451)_
7. **`Capacity` does not check that the Session and tenant limits each fit one allocation**, and the execution-bytes limit still answers the generic 400. _(#14451)_

### 3. Harness answer path (`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`)

8. **Later executions get less of the settle poll's 30 s.** The deadline is shared across ids polled one after another, so later executions of a large batch get a shrinking window. It fails closed, but against a slow Broker a large batch leans toward blocking on recovery rather than being answered. _(#14452 review)_
9. **`settledNeverStarted` ignores the turn's abort signal**, for at most 30 s. The answer path does not call `signal.throwIfAborted()` afterwards; the next model stage checks it. _(#14452)_
10. **A slot can outlive its refusal.** These hold their slot until the grant expires:
    - a granted reservation whose close failed;
    - a timed-out reserve attempt that lands late. _(#14452)_
11. **A late inline misfit leaves a partial answer.** `answerUnstartedBatch` checks inline fit per call. If a later call does not fit, the earlier calls are already answered while the turn blocks. The interrupted-turn recovery dedups by `functionResponse.id`. _(#14452)_
12. **The v3 Shell "not started" answer writes no `tool.receipt` or `shellHistoryId`.** This matches how `settleParkedTurnCancelled` answers parked items. _(#14452)_
13. **A legacy execution is not checked for `cancelled`.** One that settled `success` after its cancel would be answered as not started. This is unreachable today, because cancelling a `prepared` execution settles it `cancelled`. Checking for it would stop the proof from depending on that Broker behavior. _(#14452)_

### 4. Code shape and logging (store)

14. `usedBytes(String column, String key)` concatenates the column name into its SQL. Both callers pass literals, but two constant queries would remove the pattern. _(#14451 review)_
15. On the `active_captures` limit, the WARN line uses `held` and `requested` for capture counts; on the other limits they are bytes. _(#14451 review)_
16. The WARN logs unsalted SHA-256 tenant and scope keys, as the rest of the module does. _(#14451)_

### 5. Test gaps

17. **Store, `ToolPublicationStoreTest`.** Not pinned:
    - the Session line's log arguments;
    - that the used-bytes queries run only on a byte refusal;
    - the 409/429 envelope at controller level;
    - the rollback of expired-capture fencing on refusal, a gap that predates #14451.

    The tests also build `ToolPublicationStore` by hand. _(#14451)_
18. **Harness, `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`.**
    - Three mutants (dropping the unknown, abandoned and deadline exits) die only from the vitest timeout, and their leaked polling disturbs later tests' counts.
    - Not pinned: the legacy pre-cancel `prepared` requirement; `status()` keeping `executionStatus` only for settled records; the suppressed log for an expected close failure; the 512-character slice.
    - The rig's `close_not_started` is looser than the real store.
    - The new tests wait through the real 2×250 ms reserve retries.

    _(#14452)_

## Why is this needed?

#14434 is closed. A full tenant or Session now answers its own code, and a refused batch no longer blocks the Session. What is left is the quality of that answer:

- Item 1 is the one that changes behavior. For some batch shapes the model is told to retry what cannot succeed, and nothing slows it down.
- Items 4–7 are where the 409/429 split predicts wrong. The Harness turns that split into "retry" or "retrying now will not succeed", so a wrong prediction misleads the model.
- The rest are robustness and test debt that the audits rated non-Critical.

## Additional context

- Merged: #14451 (`8e100eecdd`) and #14452 (`3547398d2b`). A maintainer re-verified the before and after independently on macOS with a real SSH runtime ([comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6233388840)).
- Rig that reproduces the refusal: the FG8d gate (`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`) on MySQL with `active-captures` lowered to 2 and the FG8d lease at 60 s.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 希望增加什么？

#14434 由两个 PR 解决，都已合入：

- #14451 让 store 在工具 publication 预留已满时回专用的 code，并写明是哪个上限：429 `managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted` 或 409 `managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted`。
- #14452 让 Hosted Harness 把这种被拒的批次答成"未启动"，而不是阻塞 Session。

两个 PR 从第 3 轮审计起都只有 Critical 发现才改代码。本 issue 把两个 PR 延后处理的问题和评审里的小意见去重后汇总到一处，按影响排序。

每一条都注明了出处：

- #14451：[审计轮次与延后项](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14451#issuecomment-6231479515)、[triage 结论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14451#issuecomment-6231691603)；
- #14452：[审计轮次与延后项](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6231479768)、[triage 结论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6231667280)。

截至 `b3c5d3ed1e`，main 上后续的提交都没有改动这部分代码。

### 1. 模型能照着做的重试提示

1. **永远预留不上的批次被告知重试。** 以下两种情况都回 429：
   - 一个批次里 Shell 和 Monitor 调用数超过 `active-captures`，根本不可能预留成功。
   - 拒绝是由同一批次自己先前的预留造成的，在该批次等待期间不可能消除。

   两种情况下 Harness 都答"Retry after the running tools finish."，而且不退避，模型可能每一轮都重复这个批次。答复应当区分这些情况（例如把批次的预留数与上限比较），并提示一次少跑几个这类工具。_（#14451 和 #14452 的延后项，#14452 triage 结论）_
2. **不需要预留的调用得到同样的提示。** 被拒批次里的 agent、workflow、message、team、command 调用也会收到 publication 上限的重试提示，尽管限额根本不涉及它们。_（#14452）_
3. **没有节奏信号。** 429 不带 `Retry-After`。Harness 的 reserve 循环间隔 250 毫秒尝试三次，所以每个被拒的调用都会打三条 WARN，且没有限流。_（#14451）_

### 2. 让 409 和 429 的判断更准（`ToolPublicationStore.reserve`）

4. **租户级 409 计入了其他 Session 的已用字节。** 那些 Session 可能在本 Session 存活期间退役并释放字节。reserve 循环把 409 当作终局，所以本来可能成功的重试永远不会发生。#14451 的 triage 结论认为这是这套划分里最弱的推断。_（#14451）_
5. **超过上限的单次请求被报成 retention。** 它回 409 `retention_exhausted`，日志记 `retained=true`，但其实什么都没保留。不重试是对的，code 和日志是错的。_（#14451）_
6. **没有任何操作会释放的已持有字节被归为 429。** 例如：
   - finish 校验期间被 fence、随后由 `releaseFailedFinish` 释放的 capture；
   - 被隔离或拿不到 receipt 的已 finish capture 的 admission。

   反过来也有：`releaseFailedFinish` 可能减少已用字节，所以 409 偶尔不经回收也会消除。_（#14451）_
7. **`Capacity` 不检查 Session 和租户上限是否各自至少能容纳一次分配**，execution-bytes 上限仍然回通用的 400。_（#14451）_

### 3. Harness 作答路径（`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`）

8. **靠后的执行分到的结算轮询时间更少。** 结算轮询的 30 秒截止时间由逐个轮询的 id 共用，大批次里靠后的执行得到的窗口越来越短。这是 fail closed 的，但遇到慢的 Broker 时，大批次更容易落到 recovery 阻塞，而不是被作答。_（#14452 评审）_
9. **`settledNeverStarted` 不响应 turn 的 abort 信号**，最长 30 秒。作答路径之后也不调用 `signal.throwIfAborted()`，由下一个模型阶段检查。_（#14452）_
10. **名额可能比拒绝活得久。** 以下两种都会占着名额直到 grant 过期：
    - 已获批但 close 失败的预留；
    - 超时后才迟到落地的 reserve 请求。_（#14452）_
11. **后面的调用放不进 inline 时会留下部分作答。** `answerUnstartedBatch` 逐个调用检查是否放得进 inline。如果后面某个调用放不下，前面的调用已经作答，而 turn 被阻塞。中断 turn 的恢复路径按 `functionResponse.id` 去重。_（#14452）_
12. **v3 Shell 的"未启动"答复不写 `tool.receipt`，也不写 `shellHistoryId`。** 这与 `settleParkedTurnCancelled` 答复停放项的方式一致。_（#14452）_
13. **legacy 执行没有校验 `cancelled`。** 如果它在 cancel 之后以 `success` 结算，会被答成未启动。这种情况目前不可达，因为 cancel 一个 `prepared` 执行一定会以 `cancelled` 结算。加上校验后，证明就不再依赖 Broker 的这一行为。_（#14452）_

### 4. 代码形态与日志（store）

14. `usedBytes(String column, String key)` 把列名拼进 SQL。两个调用方传的都是字面量，但改成两条常量查询就不会留下这种写法。_（#14451 评审）_
15. 在 `active_captures` 上限上，WARN 行的 `held` 和 `requested` 是 capture 数量；在其他上限上它们是字节数。_（#14451 评审）_
16. WARN 记录的是不加盐的 SHA-256 租户和 scope key，与模块其他地方一致。_（#14451）_

### 5. 测试缺口

17. **Store，`ToolPublicationStoreTest`。** 没有钉住的：
    - Session 那一行日志的参数；
    - 已用字节查询只在字节拒绝时才执行；
    - controller 层的 409/429 信封；
    - 拒绝时对过期 capture 的 fence 会被回滚（这个缺口在 #14451 之前就存在）。

    另外，测试里是手动构造 `ToolPublicationStore` 的。_（#14451）_
18. **Harness，`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`。**
    - 有三个变异体（去掉 unknown、abandoned 和截止时间三处退出）只能靠 vitest 超时杀掉，泄漏的轮询还会干扰后续测试的计数。
    - 没有钉住的：legacy 执行在 cancel 前必须是 `prepared`；`status()` 只对已结算记录保留 `executionStatus`；预期中 close 失败时不打日志；512 字符的截断。
    - 测试台的 `close_not_started` 比真实 store 宽松。
    - 新测试要等完真实的 2×250 毫秒 reserve 重试。

    _（#14452）_

## 为什么需要？

#14434 已关闭。租户或 Session 占满时现在会回专用的 code，被拒的批次也不再阻塞 Session。剩下的是答复本身的质量：

- 第 1 条是唯一会改变行为的。对某些形态的批次，模型会被要求重试一件不可能成功的事，而且没有任何东西让它放慢。
- 第 4–7 条是 409/429 划分判断错误的地方。Harness 会把这个划分转成"重试"或"现在重试不会成功"，所以判断错了就会误导模型。
- 其余是审计评为非 Critical 的健壮性问题和测试欠账。

## 补充信息

- 已合入：#14451（`8e100eecdd`）和 #14452（`3547398d2b`）。一位维护者在 macOS 上用真实 SSH runtime 独立复验了修复前后的行为（[评论](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14452#issuecomment-6233388840)）。
- 复现这种拒绝的环境：FG8d gate（`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`），MySQL，`active-captures` 降到 2，FG8d 的 lease 设为 60 秒。

</details>

issues.title: [H4f follow-up] Hosted Harness event stream heartbeat: bound idle half-open reads

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: category/core
labels.description: Core engine and logic

labels.name: scope/session-management
labels.description: Session state and persistence

labels.name: type/enhancement
labels.description: Non-bug improvement or optimization

labels.name: roadmap/session-management
labels.description: Roadmap: Session management features

issues.body:
## Problem

A Hosted Harness event stream that goes half-open is read forever. The Java control plane's Turn reader then never learns that the connection is gone. This happens when the Harness dies behind a network partition, or when its pod is replaced on another node.

- **The Harness sends no heartbeat on this stream.** `GET /session/:id/events` in `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts` (`:8305` on main `91385884eb`) pumps the journal every 250 ms and writes only when there are events. A Turn that is legitimately quiet, such as long model thinking or a slow tool, therefore sends nothing for as long as it lasts. Other SSE routes in the same server already send comment heartbeats: the generation route `routes/session.ts` writes `: heartbeat` every `GENERATION_HEARTBEAT_MS`, and `acp-http/sse-stream.ts` emits periodic comment heartbeats.
- **The Java client has no idle bound.** `HarnessEventStream` builds its `SseReader` with a no-op activity callback (`// This transport does not own an idle watchdog.`). The non-hosted `DaemonSessionClient` does have one (`scheduleIdleWatchdog`, driven by `sseIdleTimeout()`).
- **So the reader waits forever on a half-open connection.** `HarnessCoordinator.readStream` blocks in `stream.next()`, and nothing ends that read except a local close. Since #13877, a generation adoption closes the stale client and its streams, so a Harness restart that some later call notices does end the read. A partition with no generation change, or a restart no other call touches, still leaves the reader parked, and the Turn's coordinator wait with it.

## Evidence

- **Real stack (H4f acceptance, #13746):** a tap in front of the Harness kept the client side of every SSE stream open when the Harness was SIGKILLed. Thread dumps taken after the Harness came back showed the Turn readers still parked in `HarnessEventStream.next`.
- **What #13877 did and did not fix:** it made `close()` able to end such a read, and the re-run on that build recovered once the adoption closed the stale client. It did not add detection: until something closes the stream, the read stays blocked. The adopted decision below says the same: "#13877's close fix is not this watchdog's acceptance."

## Adopted policy

[#13302 item 2 decision](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13302#issuecomment-6117110640), recorded as decision 3 in #12380: connection heartbeat for transport liveness, plus separate, finite model/tool/Turn wait budgets.

- Heartbeats prove that the transport is alive. They do not prove business progress, and they do not extend an operation's deadline.
- A half-open read must be bounded. When the heartbeat bound expires, the reader surfaces a typed liveness outcome and enters the existing original-command cancellation and reconciliation path.
- A timeout alone never proves non-execution and never authorizes a replay. Ambiguous outcomes stay recovery-blocked.

This issue tracks the **heartbeat half** of that decision for the Hosted Harness event stream. The model/tool/Turn operation budgets stay with #13302 item 2.

## Scope

- **Harness:**
  - Emit an SSE comment heartbeat (`: heartbeat`) on `GET /session/:id/events` at a fixed cadence, including while no events flow.
  - Advertise it through a capability, so the client enables its bound only against a Harness that sends heartbeats. Without that, a client would kill every quiet stream from an older Harness during a rolling upgrade.
- **Java client (`HarnessEventStream` / `HostedHarnessClient`):**
  - Arm an idle bound when the capability is present. `SseReader`'s activity callback already fires for comment bytes, and comment frames are skipped, so heartbeats reset the bound without reaching consumers.
  - On expiry, close the stream and end the blocked read with a typed liveness failure, not a generic transport error. The closing step is lock-free since #13877.
- **Coordinator:** `HarnessCoordinator` treats the typed outcome as a transient stream failure. It re-attaches through the existing recovery path, never settles the Turn on suspicion, and the record decides as it does today.
- **Out of scope:**
  - model/tool/Turn operation budgets (#13302 item 2);
  - the non-hosted daemon client, which already has its watchdog;
  - parent-close child cancellation (#13875).

## What the implementation has to decide

- **Numbers:** the heartbeat cadence and the missed-heartbeat tolerance, documented from measured behavior on the target deployment, as the decision requires.
- **Capability:** the capability name and how its absence is handled during a rolling Harness upgrade.
- **Liveness outcome:** the typed outcome's shape, and where it is logged, so that operators can tell a liveness timeout from a server-ended stream or a protocol error.
- **Other Hosted streams:** whether any other long-lived Hosted Harness stream needs the same treatment. List them or rule them out explicitly.

## Acceptance probes

These follow the decision's validation list, on the packaged chain (Spring + Hosted Harness) with a tap that can hold the client side open after the Harness dies:

1. **Legitimate quiet work:** a Turn with no events for longer than the bound, such as a long model think or a slow tool, keeps its stream open, because heartbeats keep arriving.
2. **Idle half-open connection:** the Harness is SIGKILLed behind the tap with no restart and no other call. The reader ends within cadence × tolerance plus a small margin, with the typed outcome, and the Turn goes to recovery instead of hanging.
3. **Delayed heartbeat:** delays within tolerance never trip the bound, and a delay past it does.
4. **Cancellation during a blocked read:** a Turn cancel while the reader is blocked still settles through the original-command path.
5. **Lost replies:** no duplicate side effects after a liveness timeout. The record decides.
6. **Old Harness without the capability:** the client keeps today's behavior, with no bound and no false timeouts.

## References

- #13302 item 2 and its decision comment; #12380 decision 3.
- #13746 (H4f acceptance, finding 1); #13877 (lock-free close, bounded cancel attempts).
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts` (`GET /session/:id/events`), `routes/session.ts` (`GENERATION_HEARTBEAT_MS`), `acp-http/sse-stream.ts`.
- `packages/sdk-java/qwencode/.../HarnessEventStream.java`, `SseReader.java` (`ActivityInputStream`), `DaemonSessionClient.java` (`scheduleIdleWatchdog`).
- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/.../HarnessCoordinator.java` (`readStream`, `consumeStream`).
- `docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-task-cancel.md`, Follow-up work, row "Hosted stream idleness".

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 问题

Hosted Harness 的事件流一旦半开，就会被一直读下去，Java 控制面的 Turn 读线程永远不知道连接已经没了。Harness 在网络分区后死掉，或者 pod 被换到另一节点时，都会出现这种情况。

- **Harness 在这条流上不发心跳。** main `91385884eb` 上 `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts` 的 `GET /session/:id/events`（`:8305`）每 250 ms 轮询一次 journal，只在有事件时才写数据。所以一个正常安静的 Turn（模型长时间思考、工具执行慢）在整个过程中什么都不发。同一服务里的其他 SSE 路由已经在发注释心跳：生成路由 `routes/session.ts` 每隔 `GENERATION_HEARTBEAT_MS` 写一次 `: heartbeat`，`acp-http/sse-stream.ts` 也会周期性发送注释心跳。
- **Java 客户端没有空闲上限。** `HarnessEventStream` 构造 `SseReader` 时传入的是空的 activity 回调（`// This transport does not own an idle watchdog.`）。非 Hosted 的 `DaemonSessionClient` 是有看门狗的（`scheduleIdleWatchdog`，由 `sseIdleTimeout()` 驱动）。
- **所以读线程会在半开连接上一直等。** `HarnessCoordinator.readStream` 阻塞在 `stream.next()`，除了本地关闭，没有任何东西能结束这次读。自 #13877 起，代际接管会关闭旧客户端及其流，所以只要后续有调用发现了 Harness 重启，读就会结束。但如果是没有代际变化的分区，或者没有其他调用碰到的重启，读线程仍会停住，Turn 的 coordinator 等待也随之停住。

## 证据

- **真实栈（H4f 验收，#13746）：** Harness 前的 tap 在 Harness 被 SIGKILL 后保持每条 SSE 流的客户端一侧不断开。Harness 回来之后采的线程栈显示，Turn 读线程仍停在 `HarnessEventStream.next`。
- **#13877 修了什么、没修什么：** 它让 `close()` 能结束这种读，在该构建上重跑时，接管关闭旧客户端后就恢复了。但它没有加检测：在有东西关闭这条流之前，读会一直阻塞。下面已采纳的决策也写明："#13877 的 close 修复不能替代该 watchdog 的验收"。

## 已采纳的策略

[#13302 第 2 项决策](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13302#issuecomment-6117110640)，在 #12380 中记为决策 3：用连接心跳判断传输层存活，另设独立且有限的模型/工具/Turn 等待预算。

- 心跳证明传输层存活，不证明业务进展，也不延长操作截止时间。
- 半开读取必须有界。心跳上限到期时，读线程给出类型化的存活结果，进入现有的原命令取消与对账路径。
- 超时本身永远不能证明未执行，也不能授权重放；结果含糊时保持 recovery-blocked。

本 issue 跟踪该决策在 Hosted Harness 事件流上的**心跳那一半**。模型/工具/Turn 操作预算仍归 #13302 第 2 项。

## 范围

- **Harness：**
  - 在 `GET /session/:id/events` 上按固定周期发送 SSE 注释心跳（`: heartbeat`），没有事件时也要发。
  - 通过一个 capability 声明这一点，客户端只对会发心跳的 Harness 启用上限。否则在 Harness 滚动升级期间，客户端会把旧 Harness 上所有安静的流都判死。
- **Java 客户端（`HarnessEventStream` / `HostedHarnessClient`）：**
  - 存在该 capability 时启用空闲上限。`SseReader` 的 activity 回调本来就会因注释字节触发，注释帧也会被跳过，所以心跳能重置计时，又不会传给消费方。
  - 到期时关闭流，以类型化的存活失败结束阻塞的读，而不是一个笼统的传输错误。关闭这一步自 #13877 起已不需要读锁。
- **Coordinator：** `HarnessCoordinator` 把这个类型化结果当作暂时性的流失败，经由现有恢复路径重新挂接，绝不因怀疑而结算 Turn，结果仍由记录决定，与今天一致。
- **不在范围内：**
  - 模型/工具/Turn 操作预算（#13302 第 2 项）；
  - 非 Hosted 的 daemon 客户端，它已经有看门狗；
  - 父 Session 关闭时取消 child（#13875）。

## 实现需要决定的

- **数值：** 心跳周期与漏心跳容忍度，按决策要求依据目标部署的实测行为写明。
- **Capability：** capability 的名字，以及 Harness 滚动升级期间缺少它时如何处理。
- **存活结果：** 类型化结果的形态及其日志位置，让运维能区分存活超时、服务端结束流和协议错误。
- **其他 Hosted 流：** 其他长连接的 Hosted Harness 流是否也需要同样处理，逐一列出或明确排除。

## 验收探针

按照决策列出的验证项，在打包链路（Spring + Hosted Harness）上进行，Harness 前放一个能在 Harness 死后保持客户端一侧不断开的 tap：

1. **正常静默工作：** 一个超过上限时长都没有事件的 Turn（模型长时间思考、工具执行慢）保持流不断，因为心跳一直在到达。
2. **空闲半开连接：** 在 tap 后 SIGKILL Harness，不重启，也没有其他调用。读线程在"周期 × 容忍度 + 少量余量"内以类型化结果结束，Turn 进入恢复而不是挂住。
3. **心跳延迟：** 容忍范围内的延迟不会触发上限，超出则触发。
4. **阻塞读期间取消：** 读线程阻塞时发起 Turn 取消，仍能经由原命令路径结算。
5. **丢失应答：** 存活超时后没有重复副作用，由记录决定。
6. **不带该 capability 的旧 Harness：** 客户端保持今天的行为，不设上限，也不误判超时。

## 参考

- #13302 第 2 项及其决策评论；#12380 决策 3。
- #13746（H4f 验收，发现 1）；#13877（无锁关闭、有界的取消尝试）。
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.ts`（`GET /session/:id/events`）、`routes/session.ts`（`GENERATION_HEARTBEAT_MS`）、`acp-http/sse-stream.ts`。
- `packages/sdk-java/qwencode/.../HarnessEventStream.java`、`SseReader.java`（`ActivityInputStream`）、`DaemonSessionClient.java`（`scheduleIdleWatchdog`）。
- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/.../HarnessCoordinator.java`（`readStream`、`consumeStream`）。
- `docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-task-cancel.md`，后续工作中的"Hosted 流空闲"一行。

</details>

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

**FG10** — the Stage F fault-gate round for the `child_run` **`workflow`** kind, enabled by #13858.

Split out of **#14054**, which keeps the shared rationale, the coverage evidence and the umbrella index for FG8–FG10. This issue is the closeable tracker for FG10 alone. Sibling rounds: FG8 (`monitor_run` + background Shell), FG9 (`session_message` + `session_command`).

The workflow kind's failure mode is different from both siblings. It owns no OS process of its own the way FG8's capabilities do, and its effect does not land in another participant's journal the way FG9's does. **It executes deterministically in-process, under a pinned definition digest, and its distinctive risk is a wedged child turn** — a state where nothing crashed, nothing was lost, and the child simply can never make progress.

### The properties this round has to prove under fault

All four are stated in #13858 and are currently proved only by functional tests (`hosted-workflow-turn.test.ts`, `hosted-workflow-turn.integration.test.ts`, `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.workflow-child.test.ts`, `workflow-session-gate.test.ts`):

1. **The definition is pinned from revision 1** by the sha256 of its script bytes, and the digest is **re-verified before the child spends anything**, so a tampered copy never executes. Production sandbox: `packages/core/src/agents/runtime/workflow-sandbox.ts`; turn logic: `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.ts`, errors in `workflow-errors.ts`.
2. **Subagents are in-process**, running under `node:vm` with ordinary per-run caps — explicitly **not nested managed grandchildren**. So a crash of the parent takes every subagent with it, and there is no separate managed record to reconcile against.
3. **The launch block crosses a `sha256(JSON.stringify(prompt))` admission digest** between daemon and SDK. #13858 had to canonicalise the SDK's JSON digest substrate to byte-fidelity with `JSON.stringify`, pinned by Node-exported golden vectors, because fastjson2 rendered fractional numbers in Java scientific notation while ECMAScript uses plain notation — and **any fractional `args` value wedged the child's first Turn with a deterministic `invalid_hosted_prompt`**. That is the concrete precedent for what this round exists to keep pinned.
4. **The kind gate fires on every `child_run` revision commitment**, which is why #13858's four exit checks had to land together. A gate that only exercises the first commitment would miss every later one.

| Gate | Inject | Expect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG10a — digest integrity** | Alter the pinned script bytes between pinning and the pre-spend re-verification; replay a launch block whose `args` contain a fractional value; substitute a definition of the same length. | The tampered copy is refused **before any child spend**; the fractional-`args` launch is admitted byte-identically on both sides of the daemon boundary, never wedged; the refusal names the digest mismatch rather than surfacing as a generic admission error. |
| **FG10b — lost replies** | Drop or delay the reply to a workflow child's dispatch, to a subagent Turn commitment, and to a later `child_run` revision commitment, one at a time. | Each retry resolves through the original execution identity; the kind gate is re-checked on every commitment, not only the first; at most one workflow instance per launch. |
| **FG10c — store failures** | Reject a `child_run` revision commitment and the child's completion notification inside real transactions. | A failed commitment leaves the child blocked rather than silently advanced; the notification is not lost without the record saying so. |
| **FG10d — process crashes** | SIGKILL the Harness mid-workflow, with subagents in flight; SIGKILL after the last subagent returned but before the workflow's own settlement committed. | Because subagents are in-process, the record must settle as **unknown/blocked**, never as `failed` or `cancelled` — nothing observed the subagents' outcomes; cold load refuses the unsettled run; the pinned digest is not re-resolved from a later revision on reopen. |
| **FG10e — cancellation** | Cancel a running workflow with subagents in flight; drop the cancel reply; cancel after settlement. | An in-flight cancellation settles the parent and does not leave orphaned in-process subagents running under a cancelled record; a lost cancel reply resolves through the original operation; a post-settlement cancel is refused rather than re-opening the run. |
| **FG10f — notification and output delivery** | Drop the completion notification for a workflow child (`workflow` is in `CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES`, unlike the background `shell` kind); disconnect the SSE streams mid-workflow and resume. | The notification is delivered at most once and its loss is visible in the record; the replayed sequence has no duplicates and no gaps. |

**FG10a and FG10d are the two this round specifically owes.** FG10a because the digest re-verification is the only thing standing between a pinned definition and a substituted one, and its failure is silent by design — a mismatch refuses, it does not crash. FG10d because the in-process subagent model means there is no independent witness to consult after a crash, which is exactly the situation where a record is most likely to be settled dishonestly.

### Why is this needed?

The workflow kind is the newest of the three enabled `child_run` kinds and the only one whose execution is deterministic and digest-pinned. That combination makes its faults quiet: a wedged turn produces no crash, no lost reply and no storage error, only a child that never progresses. The fractional-`args` wedge that #13858 fixed was found by implementation, not by a test that would have caught the next such mismatch.

A fault round is also what keeps property 3 honest across languages. The golden vectors pin the digest substrate today; FG10a is what proves the pinning survives a lost or replayed launch rather than only a matched one.

### Additional context

Part of #12380, Stage F, under the umbrella **#14054**. Precedent: #12748 (FG1–FG4), #12804 (FG5), #12872 (FG6), #13802 (FG7, delivered by #13839).

Code under test: **#13858** (the workflow child runtime, which enabled the kind and canonicalised the digest substrate), **#13754** / **#13743** (the workflow record contract the runtime commits against).

Constraint to carry into the fixtures: `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS` is `['child_agent', 'shell', 'workflow']` and `CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES` is `['child_agent', 'workflow']` — a background `shell` run is not a child Session and never posts an acceptance notification, so FG10f's notification cases do not apply to FG8's capability and should not be duplicated here.

Sequencing: land after **FG8** and after **#14147** (`extract the shared helpers duplicated across the hosted gates`, `status/blocked`). Main CI is red (#14023, #14005, #13995) and the Hosted fork budget is under repair (#14148); opening all three rounds at once would spend the same constrained budget three times simultaneously.

Out of scope, per #13858's own deferrals: saved or referenced workflows, script-level resume, and nested managed grandchildren. Also out of scope: legacy Workflow tool behaviour, which #13858 did not change.

Verification note: the `workflow` kind's presence in `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS`, `CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES`, the production file paths `packages/core/src/agents/runtime/workflow-sandbox.ts`, `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.ts` and `workflow-errors.ts`, the four existing functional test files, and the states of #14147 / #14148 / #14023 / #14005 / #13995 were all read at `main` = `ce75a117a5` (contract v1.46.0) on 2026-10-14. The digest-substrate and in-process-subagent properties are quoted from #13858's description rather than re-derived from source; re-verify both against the current implementation before writing FG10a and FG10d.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

### 希望增加什么？

**FG10** —— 为 `child_run` 的 **`workflow`** kind 补 Stage F 故障门禁轮次，该 kind 由 #13858 启用。

从 **#14054** 拆出；后者保留共同论证、覆盖证据与 FG8–FG10 的伞形索引。本 issue 是 FG10 单独的可关闭跟踪者。兄弟轮次：FG8（`monitor_run` + 后台 Shell）、FG9（`session_message` + `session_command`）。

workflow kind 的失效形态与两个兄弟都不同。它不像 FG8 的能力那样拥有自己的 OS 进程，也不像 FG9 那样把副作用落进另一个参与者的 journal。**它在进程内确定性执行、受一个被 pin 住的定义摘要约束，而它特有的风险是 child turn 被楔死** —— 一种没有崩溃、没有丢失、child 却永远无法前进的状态。

### 本轮必须在故障下证明的性质

四条都陈述于 #13858，且目前只由功能测试证明（`hosted-workflow-turn.test.ts`、`hosted-workflow-turn.integration.test.ts`、`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.workflow-child.test.ts`、`workflow-session-gate.test.ts`）：

1. **定义从 revision 1 被 pin 住**，用其脚本字节的 sha256，且该摘要在 **child 花费任何东西之前被重验**，所以一份被篡改的副本永不执行。生产沙箱：`packages/core/src/agents/runtime/workflow-sandbox.ts`；turn 逻辑：`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.ts`，错误在 `workflow-errors.ts`。
2. **子 agent 在进程内**，跑在 `node:vm` 下、受普通的每 run 上限约束 —— 明确**不是嵌套的 managed 孙代**。所以父进程崩溃会带走每一个子 agent，而没有一份独立的 managed 记录可供对账。
3. **launch block 要跨 daemon 与 SDK 走一个 `sha256(JSON.stringify(prompt))` 准入摘要**。#13858 不得不把 SDK 的 JSON digest 底座规范化为与 `JSON.stringify` 字节保真、由 Node 导出的 golden vectors 钉住，因为 fastjson2 用 Java 科学计数法渲染 fractional numbers，而 ECMAScript 用普通记法 —— 于是**任何 fractional `args` 值都会以确定性的 `invalid_hosted_prompt` 楔死 child 的第一个 Turn**。这正是本轮存在的理由的具体先例。
4. **kind 门禁在每一次 `child_run` revision 提交时都会触发**，这也是 #13858 的四项出口检查必须一起落地的原因。一道只跑首次提交的门禁会漏掉之后每一次。

| 门禁 | 注入 | 期望 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG10a — 摘要完整性** | 在 pin 与花费前重验之间改动被 pin 的脚本字节；重放一个 `args` 含 fractional 值的 launch block；替换一份长度相同的定义。 | 被篡改的副本在**任何 child 花费之前**被拒绝；fractional-`args` 的 launch 在 daemon 边界两侧被逐字节相同地准入，绝不被楔死；拒绝要指名摘要不匹配，而不是以一个泛化准入错误浮出。 |
| **FG10b — 应答丢失** | 逐一丢弃或延迟一次 workflow child 派发、一次子 agent Turn 提交、一次较晚的 `child_run` revision 提交的应答。 | 每次重试都通过原执行身份解决；kind 门禁在每次提交都被重查，而不只是首次；每次 launch 最多一个 workflow 实例。 |
| **FG10c — 存储故障** | 在真实事务里拒绝一次 `child_run` revision 提交与 child 的完成通知。 | 提交失败让 child 保持阻塞而不是被静默推进；通知的丢失不会在记录里无痕。 |
| **FG10d — 进程崩溃** | 在 workflow 中途、子 agent 在飞时 SIGKILL Harness；在最后一个子 agent 已返回但 workflow 自身结算尚未提交时 SIGKILL。 | 由于子 agent 在进程内，记录必须结算为 **unknown/blocked**，绝不是 `failed` 或 `cancelled` —— 没有任何东西观测到那些子 agent 的结果；冷加载拒绝未结算的 run；重开时被 pin 的摘要不会从较晚的 revision 被重新解析。 |
| **FG10e — 取消** | 取消一个子 agent 在飞的运行中 workflow；丢弃取消的应答；在结算之后取消。 | 在飞取消会结算父级，且不会把孤立的进程内子 agent 留在一条已取消的记录下继续运行；丢失的取消应答通过原 operation 解决；结算后的取消被拒绝，而不是把该 run 重新打开。 |
| **FG10f — 通知与输出投递** | 丢弃一个 workflow child 的完成通知（`workflow` 在 `CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES` 里，而后台 `shell` kind 不在）；在 workflow 中途断开 SSE 流再续传。 | 通知最多投递一次，且其丢失在记录里可见；重放的序列不重复、不缺失。 |

**FG10a 与 FG10d 是本轮特别欠的两道。** FG10a 是因为摘要重验是「一份被 pin 的定义」与「一份被替换的定义」之间唯一的东西，而它的失效在设计上是静默的 —— 不匹配会拒绝，不会崩溃。FG10d 是因为进程内子 agent 模型意味着崩溃之后没有任何独立见证者可询问，而这正是一条记录最可能被不诚实地结算的情形。

### 为什么需要？

workflow kind 是三个已启用 `child_run` kind 里最新的一个，也是唯一一个执行既确定性又受摘要 pin 约束的。这个组合使它的故障很安静：一次被楔死的 turn 不产生崩溃、不产生丢失的应答、不产生存储错误，只产生一个永不前进的 child。#13858 修掉的 fractional-`args` 楔死是被实现过程发现的，不是被一道本可以抓到下一次同类不匹配的测试发现的。

一轮故障门禁也是让性质 3 在跨语言上保持诚实的东西。golden vectors 今天钉住了 digest 底座；FG10a 才证明这个钉住能挺过一次丢失或重放的 launch，而不只是挺过一次匹配的 launch。

### 补充信息

属于 #12380，F 阶段，在伞形 **#14054** 下。先例：#12748（FG1–FG4）、#12804（FG5）、#12872（FG6）、#13802（FG7，由 #13839 交付）。

被测代码：**#13858**（workflow child 运行时，启用了该 kind 并规范化了 digest 底座）、**#13754** / **#13743**（该运行时据以提交的 workflow 记录契约）。

要带进夹具的约束：`MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS` 是 `['child_agent', 'shell', 'workflow']`，而 `CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES` 是 `['child_agent', 'workflow']` —— 一次后台 `shell` run 不是 child Session、从不投递接受通知，所以 FG10f 的通知用例不适用于 FG8 的能力，也不应在此重复。

排序：排在 **FG8** 之后、以及 **#14147**（`extract the shared helpers duplicated across the hosted gates`，`status/blocked`）之后。主干 CI 是红的（#14023、#14005、#13995），Hosted fork 预算正在修（#14148）；三轮同时开会把同一份受限预算一次花三遍。

不在范围内（按 #13858 自己的延后项）：已保存或被引用的 workflow、脚本级 resume、嵌套的 managed 孙代。同样不在范围内：legacy Workflow tool 行为 —— #13858 没有改变它。

核实说明：`workflow` kind 在 `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS` 中的存在、`CHILD_NOTIFICATION_SOURCES`、生产文件路径 `packages/core/src/agents/runtime/workflow-sandbox.ts`、`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.ts` 与 `workflow-errors.ts`、四个既有功能测试文件，以及 #14147 / #14148 / #14023 / #14005 / #13995 的状态，均已于 2026-10-14 在 `main` = `ce75a117a5`（契约 v1.46.0）上读取。digest 底座与进程内子 agent 这两条性质引自 #13858 的描述而非从源码重新推导；写 FG10a 与 FG10d 之前请对着当前实现再验一次。

</details>

issues.title: test(managed-agent): HostedBackgroundPublicationGate's wedge driver parses a half-written wire line

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/core
labels.description: Core engine and logic

issues.body:
## Summary

`HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen` failed on the **Hosted process fault gates** lane. The failure comes from the test driver, not from an assertion about the system under test: `readWire` parsed a line that was still being written. The investigation is still in progress; this issue records what is known so far.

## Where

- Run: [SDK Java (full) / Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39041987043/job/117425416050), step "Verify Hosted admission gates" (1 of 2 tests failed).
- Commit: `2143d16f07`, the final head of #14475.

```
[ERROR] HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen -- Time elapsed: 8.028 s <<< FAILURE!
org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError:
[Driver output:
WEDGE_DRIVER_FAILURE SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON at position 436 (line 1 column 437)
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at <anonymous> (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:565:27)
    at Array.map (<anonymous>)
    at readWire (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:565:8)
    at async <anonymous> (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:1037:26)
    at async waitUntil (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-harness-process.ts:27:12)
    at async detachedArmOf (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:1036:7)
```

## What is known

- `readWire` is polled from `waitUntil` while the process under test is still appending to the wire file. A parse error at the end of a line fits a reader that sees a partially written last line, and it aborts the whole driver instead of retrying on the next poll. This is an inference from the stack and is not yet confirmed in the code.
- The same test failed before, in #14190 and #14192 (both closed 2026-10-15).
- This lane is red on `main` too: at `910a2909a7` ([run 39042781121](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39042781121)) the failing test was `HostedExtensionsIT.publishedExtensionsSurviveHarnessReplacementCancellationAndCloseOnMySql`, a different test.
- #14475 does not touch the wedge driver or the background publication path.

## Next

Confirm how `readWire` reads the file. If the cause is a partial last line, skip an unterminated last line, or treat a parse failure as "not yet", so that `waitUntil` retries instead of failing the gate.
