issues.body:
<!-- codex:14487:review-followups-r2 -->
## Problem

The normal private CSI Hosted file extraction in #14487 has accumulated several review passes. Keep the landing change focused on confirmed correctness fixes and track the remaining regression, diagnostics and cleanup suggestions here, following AGENTS.md guidance to avoid expanding a PR through repeated review rounds. These items are not a claim that current guards are absent or that maintainer architecture approval has been given.

## Follow-up work

- [ ] [R2-3](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252153) The URL assertion interpolates `key.sessionId` raw while the implementation interpolates `encodeURIComponent(key.sessionId)`, and the fixture session id is a plain UUID, so the new path-segment encoding guard has no witness — all ten cases in this file stay green if it is deleted. **Failure scenario:** `hosted-csi-file-history.ts:41-45` builds a *relative* reference (`/internal/runtime-broker/v1/tool-sessions/${encodeURIComponent(key.sessionId)}/control`) against the resolved broker origin.
  The private attachment route accepts UUID session IDs; encoding remains in place. Add a lower-level escaped-segment regression in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-4](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252156) The only wire-level test of `requestHostedCsiHistory` asserts the fetch init with `toMatchObject`, which ignores extra properties, so the implementation's `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000)` deadline is never observed by any test.
  The actual request retains its 30-second AbortSignal deadline. Add a falsifiable deadline/signal-presence regression in the follow-up; no unbounded transport was introduced.

- [ ] [R2-5](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252158) Neither matrix has a refusing case for the envelope version pins — `body['protocolVersion'] !== 1` (packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-csi-file-history.ts:92), `result['protocolVersion'] !== 2` (:107) and `result['managedCsi'] !== 'managed-csi/2'` (:108); only their accepting side is pinned, incidentally, by the success fixture.
  All three protocol-version guards remain present. Add separate negative version-pin cases in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-6](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252161) The drift matrix's only scope case varies `workspaceId`, so two of the three legs of the caller-key scope gate in `requestHostedCsiHistory` — `original.context['tenantId'] !== key.tenantId` (packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-csi-file-history.ts:123) and `original.identity['sessionId'] !== key.sessionId` (:122) — have no witness anywhere in the suite.
  Caller tenant/workspace/session comparisons remain present. Expand independent scope-drift cases in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-7](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252162) `requestHostedCsiHistory` takes no caller signal, so a cancelled turn or a server shutdown cannot interrupt an in-flight history request; the tool turn now issues up to three of them per batch.
  History reads have a 30-second deadline. Threading caller cancellation, including attach and uncertain prepare semantics, is a bounded lifecycle improvement for the follow-up, not a newly unbounded wait.

- [ ] [R2-8](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252165) This file's private `closed()` decides key-set equality by comma-joining, so a body with fewer keys whose name absorbs a comma passes a check it should fail; the sibling helper in `managed-csi-file-history-protocol.ts` (which this file already imports from) compares the sorted arrays with `isDeepStrictEqual`.
  The comma-join helper is weaker than exact array equality, but every omitted named field is subsequently required and the reviewer probe still rejected the malformed response. Tighten keyset comparison and test it in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-9](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252168) The new attach-time ordering — bind, commit the empty observation, only then expose `owner.session` with `files` — plus the added `clearInterval(owner.timer)` failure path have no test witness anywhere in the diff; no test drives `initialize()` to success.
  Add committed bind/attach-ordering tests in the follow-up. Existing owned daemon checks cover successful attachment, but are not a substitute for committed repository regressions.

- [ ] [R2-10](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252172) The only test named for uncertain *file* outcomes constructs the session without `files`, so `toolTurn` is never built and no file path runs — it pins the generic catch-clause rethrow and nothing about the file wiring it is named for.
  The unit case covers rethrow classification, not a real file dispatch. Clarify that seam and add file-wired coverage in the follow-up; actual Hosted SQL execution remains separately exercised.

- [ ] [R2-11](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252176) The real inline-capacity predicate handed to `HostedCsiToolTurn` is never executed on its refusing branch by any test; every witness injects a mock, so the guard's actual measurement is unpinned. (Distinct from C1 above, which claims the production BEHAVIOUR on that path is wrong; this claims the real predicate is untested.)
  Add a direct real-ChatRecord capacity predicate witness in the follow-up. Existing result-size and message-fit unit controls cover distinct seams and should not be overstated.

- [ ] [R2-13](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252181) The UTF-16 well-formedness probe in `acceptedCsiToolInput` reads as a discarded no-op and has no test on either side, so the TS/Java refusal-reason parity it exists to preserve is unpinned.
  The intent comment was already added in a48281fa8, after the reviewed b2189696 head. Keep the current UTF-16 rejection and add TS/Java lone-surrogate parity controls in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-14](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252184) `acceptedCsiToolInput` re-derives, by hand and per tool name, the required/optional key sets and numeric bounds that the same turn already advertises as authoritative `parametersJsonSchema`, and nothing pins the two lists together.
  The current fixed three-tool declarations and input validator agree. Defer declaration-parity/schema reuse work; do not widen this extraction to new tool names.

- [ ] [R2-15](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252186) The shared fetch stub inspects only the URL pathname and the request body, so no test in this file pins the internal credential or any transport option that `HostedCsiToolTurn.request()` sets.
  Transport headers and redirect policy remain intact. Pin their actual values in the fetch test seam in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-16](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252191) The shared `:prepare` mock echoes the request's `inputBytesBase64` / `toolDefinitionBytesBase64` verbatim into `members`, and no test in the file ever corrupts either field, so the two byte-fidelity conditions in `verifyBatch` — plus its duplicate-`executionCallId`/duplicate-`callId` and member-`state` whitelist branches — are never reached on their refusing side.
  Add independent tampered input/definition bytes and duplicate/unknown-member cases in the follow-up; the production byte and identity checks stay enforced.

- [ ] [R2-17](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252193) Every fixture in the file aliases `parts[i].functionCall.args` to the *same object* as `calls[i].args`, so the args leg of `execute()`'s `Original CSI function identity differs.` guard — the only leg that can fire in production — is unfalsifiable by any test here.
  Use independently cloned streamed args and a changed-args control in the follow-up. The real producer still deep-compares values before reservation.

- [ ] [R2-18](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252196) The loop that strips `additionalProperties` from the `read_file`/`edit` declarations mutates a discarded object, so it does nothing — yet it reads as a deliberate loosening of the strict CLI↔Java declaration-parity gate the same test asserts twice.
  The declaration mutation affects a returned clone, not captured wire bytes. Clarify or remove this test-only no-op in the follow-up; no production declaration divergence was observed.

- [ ] [R2-19](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252197) No test in the file ever reads the `/executions:prepare` body's three execution-identity fields — `idempotencyKey`, `toolCallId`, `turnId` — although the broker's admission gate re-derives and compares each one.
  The real broker still checks idempotency key, tool-call ID and turn ID. Add external-oracle unit wire assertions in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-20](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252200) The test named "exact input bytes" only asserts `payload.input.file_path`; every other payload assertion is self-referential, so a reserved payload that drops or mangles any other argument passes green.
  Pin complete normalized payloads, including empty strings, zero and false, in the follow-up rather than treating digest self-consistency as full input fidelity.

- [ ] [R2-21](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252202) The mixed-batch test pins the post-work history commit's ordering against dispatch but leaves the pre-dispatch ordering of the worker backup preparation (`prepare` request + `prepared` commit) completely unwitnessed, although the design doc mandates it.
  Pre-dispatch prepared-history order remains enforced by real SQL admission and the producer. Add a direct local ordering assertion in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-22](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252204) The second disjunct `path.includes('execute')` is dead code: no route in this broker's vocabulary contains that substring, because `execution`/`executions` never contain `execute`. The whole guarantee rests on `includes('start')` alone.
  Remove the unreachable execute-route disjunct or use exact :start matching in the follow-up; the active start assertion remains.

- [ ] [R2-23](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252206) The read-only batch's only file-history assertion is structurally incapable of failing — `resume.fileHistoryRef` is a constant `null` everywhere in the codebase — so the documented "Read-only calls need no mutation preparation" exclusion has no falsifiable witness in this new test file.
  Strengthen the read-only test to assert no history RPC/domain record in the follow-up. The checkpoint field being null is not sufficient evidence by itself.

- [ ] [R2-24](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252209) The broker-fault `it.each` injects only a *short* batch and a *non-prepared* member; nothing in the suite exercises `verifyBatch`'s duplicate-member guards (`ids.has(id)` / `calls.has(callId)`, hosted-csi-tool-turn.ts:460, 472, 474), which are the only check that catches a repeated member when the member count still matches the reservation count.
  Add equal-length duplicate-member negative cases in the follow-up. Production duplicate identity guards remain.

- [ ] [R2-25](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252210) The test is named "refuses a %s batch **before dispatch**", but its three assertions are equally satisfied whether the refusal happens before or after the durable file-history block — and the `batch()` fixture contains `write_file` + `edit`, so `paths.size > 0` and that block would run if the checks moved below it.
  Pin absence of history RPC/domain commits on incomplete or non-prepared membership in the follow-up.

- [ ] [R2-26](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252211) The only caller-owned-cancel witness for the CSI tool turn asserts HTTP route order and mock call counts but never reads the durable session state, so a durable continuation committed for a batch that was never dispatched keeps this test green.
  Assert the cancellation durable-state boundary in the follow-up; current production sequencing remains reservation, history preparation, intent, then await-runtime.

- [ ] [R2-27](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252212) `verifyBatch`'s runtime-binding/generation identity check — the one that keeps dispatch inside the admitted runtime — is never exercised on its refusing branch by any test.
  Add binding/generation drift controls in the follow-up. Runtime binding and generation checks are still present before dispatch.

- [ ] [R2-28](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252215) `calls.length === 0` is the only condition that keeps the new atomic-final-output block off a *tool* round, and no test drives a turn with two consecutive tool rounds while `completeFinalOutput` is supplied — so the guard this diff adds is unwitnessed.
  Add consecutive valid tool-round coverage with atomic-final-output enabled in the follow-up; the calls.length === 0 guard remains.

- [ ] [R2-29](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252218) The new wrap makes every post-tool-round failure on the private CSI surface travel the caller's *silent* early-rethrow branch, so the underlying cause's message is written to no log and reaches no client — the operator is left with a generic code and a permanently blocked Session.
  Defer recovery-cause diagnostic improvements to the follow-up with explicit sanitization and tenant-detail handling; do not expose causes in HTTP bodies.

- [ ] [R2-30](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252220) `csiHistoryContentDigest` hand-rolls a third TypeScript copy of the canonical-JSON encoder that is the byte-exact counterpart of Java's `CsiNativeActivationProof.canonical`, instead of reusing `managedSessionJsonDigest`, which is already exported from the very module this file imports from.
  Defer canonical-digest helper reuse/parity tests. Current encoders agree and the real producer-to-Java admission remains the independent semantic check.

- [ ] [R2-32](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252224) The diff deletes `boolean pending = false; … pending |= !item.path("consumed").booleanValue(); … require(pending);` from the `finalOutput` branch of `attempt()`, so the native reader no longer enforces "commit the final assistant body before marking file results consumed" — a journal whose results were consumed first is now admitted, and no test in either language pins the newly accepted case.
  The all-consumed checkpoint can legitimately precede a new all-refused model batch, so restoring require(pending) would reject that continuation. Document and test this branch in the follow-up; final-output-before-consumption remains a producer invariant checked by actual SQL journal revisions.

- [ ] [R2-33](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252226) The only test that drives the real Hosted producer through SQL admission in a plain `mvn test` (no MySQL) skips itself — rather than fails — when the CLI `dist/` is absent, and it is the sole witness for several cross-language pairings this diff introduces.
  Follow up on missing-JS-build skip policy. This run has built artifacts and executes the actual producer gate, so no skip is being counted as coverage.

- [ ] [R2-34](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252229) `refusalChecks` is a new result field this diff adds to `csi-sql-worker-acceptance.mjs` (L947, `refusalChecks: checks.length`), and this is its only read site in the repo — but it is read with the weakest available predicate, so the sole Java gate over the new hosted refusal block cannot detect losing either of the two cases it exists to witness.
  Tighten the count in the follow-up using the actual two-turn loop: two authentication refusals per turn produce four checks, not the proposed two. Existing evidence reports four.

- [ ] [R2-35](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252232) The "late refusal after dispatch" assertion is inert: it re-refuses `invalidCall`, whose id is already in `refusedFunctionIds`, so the duplicate guard throws no matter whether the dispatch-ordering guard it is meant to witness exists.
  Add an unrefused late-refusal control in the follow-up so the dispatch guard is isolated from duplicate-ID rejection.

- [ ] [R2-36](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252233) The PR's only witness that a partially-refused batch can still dispatch replays the fixture intent at the *pre-refusal* journal position, presenting a `(previousSequence, prefix)` pair the real writer can never produce.
  Correct the derived test replay sequence/revision in the follow-up. The new real Hosted SQL mixed-batch regression uses genuine journal positions and does not rely on that helper.

- [ ] [R2-37](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252236) No case exercises the `call.name().equals(text(response, "name"))` clause of the refusal admission, so a refusal whose declared tool name does not match the call it answers is an unwitnessed branch of a fail-closed validator.
  Add wrong-name refusal proof controls in the follow-up; production name and deterministic-reason comparisons remain.

- [ ] [R2-38](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252239) The two assertions that carry `acceptsAtomicFinalOutputWithoutInventingRuntimeWork`'s named invariant ("without inventing runtime work") are restatements of the input prefix and are structurally incapable of failing, so the invariant is unwitnessed in this class. The same shape appears in the sibling new test `CsiNativeReadContinuationProofTest.java:46-47` (`assertEquals(0, after.intents().size()); assertEquals(0, after.receipts().size());`).
  Add receipt-bearing carry-forward assertions in the follow-up. Empty-prefix assertions cover that case only and are not evidence of preservation of nonempty runtime state.

- [ ] [R2-40](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252245) The new hosted branch pushes a different record shape into the same `invocations` ledger array the non-hosted path fills, and its `continue` skips the only assertion that ties that array to minted SQL grants — so the acceptance evidence's `invocations` key means two unrelated things depending on the mode, and is unasserted in the mode this PR adds.
  Clarify the Hosted-vs-standalone invocation evidence shapes or add grant correspondence in the follow-up. The current shared SQL check independently requires all four settled granted executions.

- [ ] [R2-41](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252248) `.at(-1)` does not select the current turn's grant — the fixture returns `executions` `ORDER BY execution_call_id`, so the "last" row is the lexicographically largest UUID, i.e. an arbitrary one of the grants that already exist.
  Select a current-turn grant by delta in the follow-up. The existing token/lease checks are generic authentication checks; the aggregate four-grant assertion still detects a missing second turn.

- [ ] [R2-42](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487#discussion_r4305252251) Both new hosted refusal checks are decided by generic auth middleware before the request body is parsed, so the 20 lines the branch spends building `grant`/`request`/`issued`/`workingBefore` are inert and the three refusals that actually reach the worker's `execute` handler are not reproduced for hosted-minted grants. **Failure scenario:** `packages/cli/src/serve/managed-csi-file-worker.ts:194-210` builds `middleware = [managedRuntimeNoStore, authorizeManagedRuntime(boot.context), nameManagedRuntimeIncarnation(...), express.json({...})]` and registers `/execute` with `...middleware` (line 516-518).
  Add authenticated wrong-owner/context/subject handler cases in the follow-up. Current wrong-token/lease checks validate middleware, and are not claimed as native grant semantic refusal coverage.

## Scope and validation

Keep original private CSI ownership and all tenant, writer, activation, runtime-binding, exact-byte and receipt guards. Do not include replacement writers, cold recovery, physical retirement or public CSI enablement. Each accepted test improvement should fail on its intended mutation and use an independent oracle. Any behavioral change needs reproduce-first validation, bilingual design updates when nontrivial, affected package checks and appropriate real-consumer gates; fixtures do not qualify deployed Linux CSI. Evaluate the finite-capacity graceful-degradation proposal separately rather than dropping required snapshots or evidence.

Related to #13526; follows #14081 and #14487. This issue does not close the cumulative proposal.

issues.body:
## What would you like to be added?

Close the items that the managed child Workspace slices of #13753 deferred. From each PR's third audit round on, only Critical findings changed code. Everything else was recorded in that PR's thread; this issue gathers it in one place, without duplicates, and drops what later commits fixed. Items settled after the list was numbered are struck through rather than removed, so item numbers cited elsewhere stay valid. #14058, which settled item 21, adds section 9.

| Tag | Source |
| --- | --- |
| I1 | #13781 (child Workspace capability): [review reply](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13781#issuecomment-6093676421) and [audit rounds](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13781#issuecomment-6093676622) |
| I2-n | #13841 (`worktree` admission): item n of its [deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13841#issuecomment-6097633289) |
| FU-n | #13872 (I2 follow-up): item n of its [deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13872#issuecomment-6103739378) |
| R1-n | #13872's round-1 review findings that its review-fix commit `97f0c33847` left open |
| I3-n | #14265 (`snapshot` children): item n of its [deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14265#issuecomment-6185683455) |
| F21 … | #14058 (item 21's fix): findings deferred in its [round-4](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14058#issuecomment-6207490601) and [round-5](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14058#issuecomment-6215588822) follow-ups, named as there (R5-2 is round 5's second finding; R3 and R4 are points of those rounds' summaries) |

Line numbers are from `main` at `726e8d77f7`; sections 8 and 9 cite none. Items marked *unverified* were reasoned out by an auditor but never reproduced. Child Workspaces are off by default (`child-workspaces-enabled`), so none of these affects a deployment that has not turned them on. Snapshots need a second switch, `child-snapshots-enabled`, which startup refuses without the first.

### 1. Documentation

1. **Done in #14265.** ~~Decisions 5 and 8 of the I2 design still say the relay never discards a completed child's work unpinned. `97f0c33847` added an exception: a give-up on a row whose child was never bound (a lost creation answer) discards instead of merging (`ChildResultRelay.java:1390`). Sync both languages of `docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-child-worktree-admission{,.zh-CN}.md`.~~ (Non-blocking notes in the #13872 reviews.)

### 2. Settlement and the merge wait (`ChildResultRelay`)

2. **The merge wait has no bound** (I2 design open question 3). A give-up of a run whose merge was asked now waits for it too. (I2-11, FU-3)
3. **Settled (#14411).** ~~A host without the close capability holds a failure, a stop or a give-up of a run whose merge was asked, looking again every 5 minutes, instead of settling on time with a close debt. Only a mixed-config cluster reaches this.~~ Confirmed, and ruled out by #14411's rule. A merge asked and still owed holds those arms on every host, because the result carries the merge's outcome; only how often the row is looked at again depends on the host. A replica with child Workspaces on must run the durable local-process Broker, which can close a child, so it looks again on the heartbeat; only a replica with the switch off waits 5 minutes, and #14411 requires every replica to set the switch alike. With the switch off on every replica, such a run waits until it is turned on again or its parent closes, as I2 open question 3 already states; that is item 2's unbounded wait. (FU-1)
4. **The scan gap.** A parent that closes in the few seconds between a child's task Turn completing and the relay's next look still discards the work unpinned. (FU-2)
5. A cascade's `close_scope` settles a run `cancelled` while a merge that was already running lands; the closing parent's model is not told. Predates I2. (FU-6)
6. The settled-failed branch (`settledAlready`, `ChildResultRelay.java:1000`) does not wait for an asked merge. Only runs failed by an older binary or another writer reach it. (FU-7)
7. A background (`sent`) worktree run that fails after its task completed merges with no notification; background failures have no notification today. (FU-8)
8. The relay reads only `latestTurn`: a later wake Turn that fails before the relay sees the completed one leads to a discard. *Unverified* whether child Sessions get wake Turns in that window. (I2-7)
9. The parent-not-active branch opens a locking `requestFinish` on every pass, even for discarded rows. A creation answer lost after a finish request retries until the give-up, and the comment at `ChildResultRelay.java:486` ("a replay answers before this check") overstates. (I2-9)
10. The early merge's guard tests `childSessionId != null`, not the row's state. A failed `closeChild` advances a `creating` row with the child id, so the lost-creation wedge could in theory recur; it needs a message turn on an unattached child, which no route delivers today. (FU-14)
11. A merge request on a `blocked` row whose discard cleared its request gets `child_workspace_not_ready` and loops through defer and give-up. Only legacy rows reach it. (FU-11)
12. Cost: while a child runs message turns, the child Workspace scan claims its `ready` + `merge` row every 5 s. *Unverified*: a closed child's journal activity may add one `MESSAGE_TURN_WAIT_MS` wait. (FU-13, FU-15)

### 3. Pin and discard (`ChildWorkspaceService`)

13. One sequence loses the pin: the pin is taken but its `advance` fails, then the next attempt's `result()` fails non-retryably while the worktree is still readable. The discard then runs without keeping the result, and its sweep removes the pin. Hard to reach. (FU-10)
14. A `discard_pinned` discard runs the I1 ref sweep: the child's branches on its checked-out line go, their content stays under the result pin, and intermediate commits become unreachable. (FU-9)
15. A retryable pin failure delays the discard by up to about 10 minutes, bounded by the retries. (FU-12)

### 4. Model-facing text

16. "The child's changes did not land" can be wrong when a merge's write landed, fully or partly, before the row ended `blocked`: the row cannot tell a block before the write from one after it. (I2-4)
17. A child can end its own result with a forged `[child workspace] …` line. The real line is always last, folded or not, but the two are not delimited. (I2-5)

### 5. Rolling upgrade and mixed configuration

Checked against `main` at `b4614845f0`. #14069 replaced the database with a fresh 32-table baseline that takes no in-place upgrade, and #13781, #13841 and #13872 all predate it, so a replica without them cannot share today's database rows. The version-mix halves below are therefore unreachable. What remains is replicas of one version that set `child-workspaces-enabled` differently; when it is on, startup already requires the Broker that can close Workspace Sessions (I2 decision 2). #14411 states the rule that rules this out in I2 decision 2: every control-plane replica sets `child-workspaces-enabled` alike. Item 3 needs the same mixed configuration and is settled with it.

18. **Settled (#14069, #14411).** ~~An older relay replica that claims a worktree run creates it `shared`. In a mixed-config cluster, a relay without the capability fails worktree launches as `creation_failed`.~~ The first half is unreachable since #14069, and a relay now fails a mode it does not know instead of running it shared. The second half is intended (`childWorkspaceReady`, pinned by `ChildResultRelayTest`) and needs replicas that disagree on the switch, which #14411's rule rules out. (I2-8)
19. **Settled (#14069).** ~~An older replica overwrites `discard_pinned` with `discard`, runs a `ready` row's `discard_pinned` as an unpinned discard, and does not scan `blocked` or `conflicted` rows carrying `discard_pinned`.~~ Unreachable since #14069: each needs a replica from before #13872. (FU-4)
20. **Settled (#14411).** ~~A replica without child Workspace steps writes its 5-minute `next_retry_at` on the shared relay row, delaying a capable replica by up to 5 minutes.~~ Confirmed within one version: `awaitMerge` takes `CLOSE_DEBT_IDLE_MS` unless the replica can both close and run the steps. The merge itself still runs on a capable replica; only committing the result waits. It needs replicas that disagree on the switch, which #14411's rule rules out. (FU-5)

### 6. Control-plane Git (`ChildWorktreeGit`)

21. **Fixed in #14058.** ~~The parent's untracked file can be deleted (*unverified*): `snapshotTree` plus a child commit of `git rm --cached X`, with X ignored, makes the merge delete the parent's untracked X. Verify first.~~ Reproduced, together with staged files and uncommitted edits of committed files; such a deletion now ends `conflicted`. Its deferrals are section 9. (I2-10)
22. A parent working tree holding an embedded repository with no commit makes `git add -A` fail; the preparation retries 16 times and ends `blocked`, not `failed`. (I1)
23. The merge patch is read into memory up to the 256 MiB output bound; a larger change ends `blocked` with its result pinned. (I1)
24. An embedded repository's gitfile that points outside the root can expose that repository's HEAD id as a gitlink in the snapshot. (I1)
25. A crash between writing `<id>.refs.partial` and renaming it leaves the partial file behind. (I1)
26. `create` does not clear a stale registration for a missing directory before `worktree add`. Predates I1. (I1)
27. Rare sweep edges, each needing a contrived interleaving: a commit on the child's line after its result was pinned (only a parent tool turn writing in the reserved path makes one), and a pinned result whose `result_commit` was never recorded before a terminal failure. (I1)

### 7. Tests and code clarity

28. The kill tests rely on orphans being reaped; in a container whose PID 1 never reaps, they fail. CI runs on VMs. (I1)
29. No test pins the `FOR UPDATE` ordering between a child creation and a finish: it needs two transactions interleaved at a precise point, which H2 cannot hold reliably. Belongs in the MySQL lane. (I1)
30. Two `gitdir` guards in `forgetWorktree` have no test. (I1)
31. `ChildResultRelayTest`'s default `requestFinish` answer models the recorded-request and `discard_pinned` rules but none of the store's refusals (`child_workspace_not_ready` for a merge on a row that is not ready, `child_workspace_conflict` for a merge over a discard). (R1-20, partly addressed)
32. `childWorkspaceFinished` (`ChildResultRelay.java:720`) reads as a predicate but records a finish request, and `settledAlready` drops its answer (`:1000`). A name that says it records, or a separate predicate, would make the one dropped call site read as intended. (R1-6)

### 8. Snapshot children (I3)

Rollout. Decision 2 of `docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-child-snapshot.md` documents the procedure for each of these. #14432 checked all four against the code and corrected the procedure. Nothing enforces it, because nothing records which replicas run which version.

33. **Settled (#14432).** ~~Snapshots are safe only once every control-plane replica runs #14265. An older replica creates a pending snapshot run as a shared writer, and `child-snapshots-enabled` is the only guard.~~ Confirmed, and bounded: a server from before #14265 refuses to start on a database that a server from #14316 on has migrated, so only replicas still running from before the upgrade can claim such a run. The switch, off by default and turned on once every replica runs #14265, stays the guard; #14432 states the bound in decision 2. (I3-1)
34. **Fixed in #14432.** ~~An older relay can record a merge on a snapshot row, and the current scan runs it. That is usually a no-op, because the child could not write. As defense in depth, the scan step could treat a snapshot's merge as a discard.~~ The scan now starts a merge recorded on a snapshot row as a discard. A merge that an older replica's scan already started still runs on. (I3-2)
35. **Settled (#14432).** ~~A `qwen serve` rolled back below #14265 refuses the read profile, so recovery of a storage that still holds a snapshot child Session aborts. The procedure says to let those Sessions close first.~~ Worse than stated: recovery checks every Session of the storage, closed ones included, so closing does not help. An older CLI cannot be changed, so #14432 corrects decision 2 instead: rolling the CLI back below #14265 gives up Workspace recovery of the storages that hold a snapshot child Session. (I3-3)
36. **Settled (#14432).** ~~A Turn that started before the switch went off keeps its capability. The procedure says to wait for running Turns before checking for unsettled snapshot runs.~~ Confirmed and intended: a replica's Session attachments do not survive its restart, so the next Turn loads with the switch off, and the procedure's wait for running Turns is accurate. (I3-4)

Behaviour:

37. **Settled (#14440).** ~~Hooks: a design question. Since #14319 a snapshot child inherits its agent definition's hook catalog. A `PreToolUse` hook may still ask, and a hook command runs against the copy, which is discarded. With hooks present, the turn also skips #14059's step-3 fast path, as `files/1` with hooks does. Decide whether a snapshot child should take hooks.~~ Hooks are kept. A child Session copies its parent's agent definition, so a snapshot child runs the parent's hook catalog, which is operator policy. Dropping it would let the model escape a `PreToolUse` deny on `read_file` or `glob` by choosing `isolation: "snapshot"`. Decision 4 of the snapshot design now records this and its costs, none particular to snapshots. One correction to the claim above: only what a hook writes within the copy is discarded, because a hook is not isolated. Decision 8 now limits its step-3 promise to Sessions with neither hooks nor MCP. (I3-11)
38. **Skills.** A snapshot child gets no Skills: `66baabbfb6` drops the catalog for read-profile Sessions, because the profile declares no `skill` tool. Declaring `skill` on the read profile would keep it read-only, but it widens the profile and its recovery paths. (I3-13)
39. The refusal for a running snapshot promises that a later message continues it. On a host that has since stopped serving snapshots, that continuation is refused as `(workspace_mode)`. (I3-6)
40. `LoadHarnessSession.withChildWorkspaces(boolean)` resets the snapshot flag. Every caller uses the two-argument form today. (I3-5)

Tests and docs:

41. **Fixed in #14459.** ~~Approval's `globProfile` wiring has no turn-level test; only the predicates are pinned. Pointing the getter back at `isHostedWorkspaceSearchProfile`, or at a constant, leaves every `serve` test green. A turn test should run a read-profile `glob` under `default` with no Action, and still ask before an MCP tool named `glob` on `files/1`. The `/2` profiles had the same gap before #14265.~~ The turn test now does both. Pointing the getter at `isHostedWorkspaceSearchProfile`, `true` or `false` turns it red. (I3-7)
42. **Fixed in #14459.** ~~The Skills test covers create only. A regression that drops the catalog on create but keeps it on load would pass.~~ A read-profile Session loaded from its stored definition is now tested too; dropping the catalog on create only turns that test red. (I3-12)
43. **Fixed in #14459.** ~~`hostedApprovalAsks` still names its parameter `searchProfile`.~~ It is now `globProfile`, the value every caller passes. (I3-8)
44. **Fixed in #14459.** ~~The team test's two new host shapes pin only the refusal text; only the capable-host case pins that nothing commits.~~ Both now pin that the refusal launches no child and adds no member, as the capable-host case does. (I3-9)
45. **Settled (#14450).** ~~The step-3 acceptance paragraph of `docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.md` still asks for a next-Turn Write on a newer generation, which a read profile cannot do, and states no read-profile acceptance.~~ That paragraph now states one. A read-profile Session is a snapshot child's: it takes no messages, and the relay closes it once its result is delivered, so the ordinary flow gives it no next Turn. Its acceptance ends with the run instead: the resumed answer settles the task Turn and reaches the parent as the child's result, the child Session closes with physical worker retirement, and its copy is discarded. The new-tool refusal is exercised with a Read or Glob. (I3-10)

### 9. The deletion guard (#14058, `ChildWorktreeGit`)

Since #14058, a deletion in a clean merge lands only when the parent's `HEAD` holds the deleted content at that path or the merge writes it at another path. Otherwise the row ends `conflicted`, and a resumed write ends `blocked`. Each item below errs toward a conflict or a block, never toward a deletion.

Behaviour:

46. **The check refuses two shapes that lose nothing.** Identical content the parent holds at a path the merge leaves alone (a duplicated `LICENSE` or `index.ts`), and an empty file (a `.keep` marker), both end `conflicted`, so none of the child's other edits land. Widening it takes a scoped `ls-tree` lookup and an empty-blob allowance that does not hardcode the SHA-1 id, and content may count as kept only if it stays reachable after the base pin goes. Decision 5 of the I1 design states today's conservatism. (F21 R5-2)
47. A refused deletion reaches the model as a plain "merge conflicted at <path>", with no reason. A reason field would change the receipt and the model-facing line. (F21 R4)
48. A tracked file the child untracks (`git rm --cached`) still lands as a deletion of the parent's working copy. Nothing is lost, because `HEAD` keeps the content and `git restore` brings it back; keeping the file on disk would change the content-based merge. (F21 R3)

Cost, both under the storage maintenance hold:

49. `unkept` runs `rev-parse` and a whole-tree `diff-tree P HEAD` for every merge that deletes something. Scoping the diff to the deleted paths needs `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1`: without it a child-chosen name with a leading `:` reads as pathspec magic, matches nothing, and exempts the deletion. `diff-tree` refuses `--pathspec-from-file`, so long lists need chunking. (F21 R5-3)
50. **Fixed in #14462.** ~~`apply` computes `unkept` even when a resumed write owes nothing, so a no-op resume spawns Git processes whose answer is unused, and a transient fault there can end the row `blocked`. Guard the loop with the same `if (!toWrite.isEmpty())` as the write below it.~~ The probe now runs only when the write owes something. A test fails the probe's `diff-tree` and requires a resume that owes nothing to complete without running it; moving the loop back out of the guard turns that test red. (F21 R5-4)

Tests:

51. **Fixed in #14462.** ~~No test discriminates `apply`'s `toWrite.containsKey(path)` narrowing: throwing for every path `unkept` returns survives the suite. The discriminating case is a deletion that landed before a crash, then a parent commit that untracks the content, then a resume that must complete; the mutant ends it `blocked`.~~ A test now covers that case: the resume completes on the remaining edit. Throwing for every path `unkept` returns turns it red. (F21 R5-5)
52. **Fixed in #14462.** ~~No test reaches the equality arm of `keeps`: reducing it to `change == null` survives the suite. A mode-only difference at a deleted path (the parent commits `chmod +x` without changing content) discriminates it; the mutant ends that merge `conflicted`.~~ A test now covers a parent `chmod +x` at a deleted path: the deletion lands. Reducing `keeps` to `change == null` turns it red. (F21 R2-3)

## Why is this needed?

Child Workspaces are off by default, and turning them on is the step these items guard: items 1–4 and section 5 decide what an operator must know before enabling them, and item 21 was a possible loss of the parent's files (fixed in #14058). Items 33–36 do the same for `child-snapshots-enabled` (settled in #14432), and item 37 was a design question (settled in #14440: a snapshot child keeps its hooks). The rest keeps the I1–I3 state machine honest as later work builds on the same relay and admission code.

Suggested order:
- ~~item 1 and a check of item 21 first~~ (done in #14265 and #14058);
- ~~section 5's rule stated in the I2 design before any multi-replica deployment enables child Workspaces~~ (done in #14411: every replica sets `child-workspaces-enabled` alike); ~~items 33–36 before a multi-replica deployment enables snapshots~~ (done in #14432);
- ~~a decision on item 37~~ (done in #14440: hooks are kept);
- the rest as the code is next touched.

## Additional context

Each PR's thread has the audit rounds, the held invariants and the reasoning behind each deferral. #13872's review-fix commit `97f0c33847` already settled its round-1 Criticals (R1-1, R1-19) and the suggestions R1-3, R1-4, R1-5, R1-7, R1-8, R1-9, R1-10, R1-11 and R1-21, so they are not repeated here. #14265's review-fix commits `57c7009339` and `3d4b963283` settled its review findings. The one exception is R1-3 (fold the mode read into the locking read), which was declined in its thread because it would invert the lock order against a child Workspace transition. Neither is repeated here. #14058 settled item 21; the Suggestions it deferred past its fifth review round are section 9.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 希望增加什么?

收尾 #13753 的 managed child Workspace 各切片留下的延后项。每个 PR 从第 3 轮审计起只有 Critical 才改代码，其余都记在各自 PR 的讨论里。本 issue 把它们集中到一处、去掉重复，并剔除之后的提交已经修掉的项。列表编号之后才处理掉的项用删除线标出而不移除，这样别处引用的编号仍然有效。处理第 21 项的 #14058 新增了第 9 节。

| 标记 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| I1 | #13781（child Workspace 能力）：[评审回复](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13781#issuecomment-6093676421)与[审计轮次](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13781#issuecomment-6093676622) |
| I2-n | #13841（`worktree` 准入）：其[延后清单](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13841#issuecomment-6097633289)第 n 项 |
| FU-n | #13872（I2 跟进）：其[延后清单](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13872#issuecomment-6103739378)第 n 项 |
| R1-n | #13872 第 1 轮评审中，评审修复提交 `97f0c33847` 未处理的发现 |
| I3-n | #14265（`snapshot` child）：其[延后清单](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14265#issuecomment-6185683455)第 n 项 |
| F21 … | #14058（第 21 项的修复）：其[第 4 轮](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14058#issuecomment-6207490601)与[第 5 轮](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14058#issuecomment-6215588822)跟进中延后的发现，沿用那里的名称（R5-2 即第 5 轮第 2 个发现；R3、R4 是这两轮总结中的条目） |

行号基于 `main` 的 `726e8d77f7`；第 8、9 节不引用行号。标为“未验证”的项是审计员推理得出、但从未复现的。child Workspace 默认关闭（`child-workspaces-enabled`），没有开启的部署不受这些问题影响。快照还需要第二个开关 `child-snapshots-enabled`，单独开启它时启动会被拒绝。

### 1. 文档

1. **已在 #14265 完成。** ~~I2 设计的决策 5 与 8 仍写着 relay 从不在未 pin 的情况下丢弃已完成 child 的工作。`97f0c33847` 加了一个例外：child 从未绑定的行（创建应答丢失）在放弃时改为丢弃而不是合并（`ChildResultRelay.java:1390`）。需要同步 `docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-child-worktree-admission{,.zh-CN}.md` 的中英文说明。~~（#13872 评审中的非阻塞意见）

### 2. 结算与合并等待（`ChildResultRelay`）

2. **合并等待没有上限**（I2 设计开放问题 3）。已请求合并的 run 的放弃现在也要等它。（I2-11、FU-3）

### 9. 删除守卫（#14058，`ChildWorktreeGit`）

自 #14058 起，干净合并中的删除只有在父的 `HEAD` 在该路径持有被删除的内容，或合并把它写到其他路径时才会落地；否则行以 `conflicted` 结束，续做的写入以 `blocked` 结束。下面每一项都偏向冲突或阻塞，绝不偏向删除。

行为：

46. **检查会拒绝两种其实不丢任何东西的情形。** 父在合并未改动的另一路径上持有相同内容（重复的 `LICENSE` 或 `index.ts`），以及空文件（`.keep` 标记），都以 `conflicted` 结束，child 的其他改动也就都不落地。放宽检查需要一次限定范围的 `ls-tree` 查找，以及不写死 SHA-1 id 的空 blob 豁免；只有在 base pin 删除后仍可达的内容才能算作保有。I1 设计的决策 5 写明了目前的保守做法。（F21 R5-2）
47. 被拒绝的删除传给模型时只是一行“merge conflicted at <path>”，不带原因。加原因字段会改变回执和给模型看的那一行。（F21 R4）
48. child 解除跟踪（`git rm --cached`）一个已跟踪文件时，仍会作为删除落地到父的工作树。内容并未丢失，因为 `HEAD` 仍保有它，`git restore` 即可恢复；要让文件留在磁盘上，就得改变基于内容的合并。（F21 R3）

开销（两者都在 storage 维护 hold 之下）：

49. 只要合并删除了内容，`unkept` 就会运行 `rev-parse` 和整棵树的 `diff-tree P HEAD`。把 diff 限定到被删除的路径需要 `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1`：否则 child 选的、以 `:` 开头的名字会被当作 pathspec magic，什么也匹配不到，从而豁免了这次删除。`diff-tree` 不接受 `--pathspec-from-file`，路径多时需要分批。（F21 R5-3）
50. **已在 #14462 修复。** ~~续做的写入即使什么都不欠，`apply` 也会计算 `unkept`，于是一次空操作的续做也会启动结果用不上的 Git 进程，那里的瞬时故障还可能让行以 `blocked` 结束。给这个循环加上与下方写入相同的 `if (!toWrite.isEmpty())`。~~ 现在只有写入确有所欠时才运行这次探测。有测试让探测用的 `diff-tree` 失败，并要求什么都不欠的续做不运行它也能完成；把循环挪回守卫之外，该测试会失败。（F21 R5-4）

测试：

51. **已在 #14462 修复。** ~~没有测试能区分 `apply` 中 `toWrite.containsKey(path)` 这层收窄：对 `unkept` 返回的每个路径都抛错，整个测试套件仍然通过。能区分它的用例是：删除在崩溃前已落地，随后父提交了解除跟踪该内容的改动，然后续做必须完成；变异体会让它以 `blocked` 结束。~~ 现在有测试覆盖这个用例：续做在剩下的编辑上完成。对 `unkept` 返回的每个路径都抛错，该测试会失败。（F21 R5-5）

## 为什么需要?

child Workspace 默认关闭，而开启它正是这些项要守住的一步：第 1–4 项与第 5 节决定运维在开启前必须知道什么，第 21 项曾可能导致父的文件丢失（已在 #14058 修复）。第 33–36 项对 `child-snapshots-enabled` 起同样的作用（已由 #14432 处理），第 37 项曾是待定的设计问题（已由 #14440 处理：snapshot child 保留 hooks）。其余各项让 I1–I3 的状态机保持可靠，因为后续工作要建在同一套 relay 与准入代码上。

- 其余在下次改到相关代码时处理。

各 PR 的讨论中有审计轮次、已守住的不变量，以及每个延后项的理由。#13872 的评审修复提交 `97f0c33847` 已处理其第 1 轮的 Critical（R1-1、R1-19）以及建议 R1-3、R1-4、R1-5、R1-7、R1-8、R1-9、R1-10、R1-11、R1-21，这里不再重复。#14265 的评审修复提交 `57c7009339` 与 `3d4b963283` 已处理其评审发现。唯一的例外是 R1-3（把模式读取并入加锁读取），已在其讨论中拒绝，因为它会与 child Workspace 状态转换形成相反的加锁顺序。两者这里都不再重复。#14058 处理了第 21 项，它在第 5 轮评审之后延后的 Suggestion 收在第 9 节。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG13c Hook owner-restart fault gates (#14449)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This adds the FG13c owner-restart fault gates for the Hosted command-Hook domain, the first slice of the FG13 round tracked by #14449. A managed command Hook is a decision gate with a process behind it: the command runs in the Runtime worker's delegated cgroup v2 unit, and its receipt lives in that worker's memory. The gates therefore kill the packaged Harness, the durable worker, and the Hook command for real, and pin what the platform does next against JDBC, process and cgroup ground truth.

The rig is a Hook-only definition on the `hosted-workspace-files/1` profile, with no MCP server in the definition, so Hooks do not ride MCP's owner. Every reload in this rig mints a fresh owner, which is the path under test: recovery has to reach the record's own `runtimeSessionId`, not the current activation.

The slice covers three cells: a Harness SIGKILL while a Hook holds with a live descendant (the replacement load answers the interrupted call; a new prompt is refused with 409 while the command still holds; the Session is then re-attached to the replacement and the operation is read through the authenticated Harness status route, which asks the record's original `runtimeSessionId` and settles it from that worker's receipt, with exactly one physical call); a worker SIGKILL while a Hook holds (the record must stay `recovery_blocked`/`outcome_unknown`, the Session must stay open, and the generation must not be re-minted); and a SIGKILL of the Hook command itself (the `failClosed` policy must turn it into a block and the tool must never run).

Two decisions the issue asked for are recorded in the design: the Spring/Broker restart is out of this slice because the embedded broker shares the test JVM with the JDBC and cgroup observers, the same reason FG8c excluded it; and the orphaned Hook unit after a worker SIGKILL is asserted as the accepted H2 limit and then killed by teardown, not reclaimed by the product.

## Why it's needed

The delivery ledger and #13129 both say the Hook-specific Broker/Runtime-owner restart matrix was never run. #14357's packaged acceptance covers the happy path, a Harness kill between turns, cancellation and close, but never a crash while a Hook is in flight. Since a Hook's outcome decides whether a tool runs, an honest unknown is the whole safety contract; this slice is the first test that pins it against real process deaths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane. The new class runs in the shared failsafe fork. The three cases are independent fixtures, so each boots its own Spring, packaged Harness and durable worker under the delegated cgroup v2 root.

For the mutation witnesses, each case must go red before merge. For the Harness-kill cell, make both `executionBroker` and `lookup` use the current owner instead of the record's own `runtimeSessionId`; the record can no longer settle from the original receipt. For the worker-kill cell, remove the `recovery_blocked` commit before the `HostedHookRecoveryRequiredError`; the record then stays `running`. For the command-kill cell, make `failClosed` pass a non-success outcome through; the block assertion fails.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS only covers Java test compilation, Checkstyle and the CI meta-test; the class is `@EnabledOnOs(LINUX)` and needs MySQL 8.4 plus a delegated cgroup v2 root, so the lane run is the evidence this PR is waiting on. Windows is out of scope, as the issue records.

### Environment (optional)

Local: JDK 21, `mvn -o -DskipTests test-compile`, `mvn -o checkstyle:check`, `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` (36 passed) and Prettier all pass. The integration lane was not run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the three cells are unverified until the Linux lane runs, and the class's healthy runtime is budgeted at 300 s conservatively until that run measures it. The fork moves from 4174 s to 4784 s, the Verify step to 95 minutes and the job ceiling to 190 minutes so the shared fork keeps its stall headroom.
- Not validated / out of scope: FG13a, FG13b, FG13d, FG13e and FG13f; Spring/Broker restart; local non-managed Hooks; Windows/macOS; #13133's design items; snapshot-child Hook policy (#14440); prompt-Hook provider faults beyond the crash row.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Test and CI-budget files only.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-hook-fault-gates-c.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-hook-fault-gates-c.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #14449.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为 Hosted 命令 Hook 域补上 FG13c 的 owner 重启故障门禁，这是 #14449 跟踪的 FG13 轮次的第一个切片。托管命令 Hook 是背后有进程的决策门：命令跑在 Runtime worker 的委派 cgroup v2 单元里，回执存在该 worker 的内存中。因此门禁会真实杀掉打包 Harness、durable worker 与 Hook 命令本身，并以 JDBC、进程与 cgroup 事实钉住平台接下来的行为。

测试装置使用 `hosted-workspace-files/1` profile 上只含 Hook 的定义，定义里没有 MCP server，因此 Hook 不跟随 MCP 的 owner。该装置里每次重载都会新建 owner，这正是被测路径：恢复必须到达记录自身的 `runtimeSessionId`，而不是当前 activation。

本切片覆盖三格：Hook 带存活后代保持运行时 SIGKILL Harness（替换者的 load 必须用原 worker 的回执结算，且恰好一次物理调用）；Hook 持有时 SIGKILL worker（记录必须停在 `recovery_blocked`/`outcome_unknown`，Session 保持打开，generation 不被重铸）；SIGKILL Hook 命令本身（`failClosed` 策略必须把它变成阻断，工具绝不运行）。

Issue 要求先做的两个决定已写入设计：本切片不包含 Spring/Broker 重启，因为内嵌 Broker 与 JDBC、cgroup 观察者同处测试 JVM，FG8c 也出于同样理由排除；worker SIGKILL 后的孤儿 Hook 单元按 H2 已接受的限制被断言，随后由测试清理杀掉，而不是要求产品回收。

## 为什么需要

交付台账与 #13129 都写明 Hook 专属的 Broker/Runtime-owner 重启矩阵从未跑过。#14357 的打包验收覆盖了正常路径、两个 turn 之间杀 Harness、取消与关闭，但从未覆盖 Hook 进行中的崩溃。Hook 的结果决定工具是否运行，因此"诚实的未知"就是整个安全契约；本切片是第一个用真实进程死亡钉住它的测试。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 车道。新类在共享的 failsafe fork 中运行。三个用例是独立夹具，各自启动自己的 Spring、打包 Harness 与 durable worker，位于委派的 cgroup v2 根下。

变异见证必须在合入前各自变红。对杀 Harness 的格子，让 `executionBroker` 与 `lookup` 都改用当前 owner 而不是记录自身的 `runtimeSessionId`，记录就无法从原回执结算。对杀 worker 的格子，删除抛出 `HostedHookRecoveryRequiredError` 之前的 `recovery_blocked` 提交，记录会停在 `running`。对杀命令的格子，让 `failClosed` 放行非成功结果，阻断断言失败。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A —— 仅测试改动，无用户可见行为。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

macOS 只覆盖 Java 测试编译、Checkstyle 与 CI 元测试；该类是 `@EnabledOnOs(LINUX)`，需要 MySQL 8.4 与委派 cgroup v2 根，因此车道运行才是本 PR 等待的证据。Windows 与本轮无关，issue 已注明。

### 环境（可选）

本机：JDK 21，`mvn -o -DskipTests test-compile`、`mvn -o checkstyle:check`、`npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`（36 通过）与 Prettier 均通过。集成车道未在本机运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：三格在 Linux 车道运行前未验证；在车道测量之前，该类的健康耗时保守地按 300 s 计入预算。共享 fork 从 4174 s 移到 4784 s，Verify 步骤到 95 分钟、job 上限到 190 分钟，以保留卡住时的余量。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：FG13a、FG13b、FG13d、FG13e、FG13f；Spring/Broker 重启；本地非托管 Hook；Windows/macOS；#13133 的设计项；snapshot 子会话 Hook 策略（#14440）；prompt Hook 的 provider 故障（崩溃行之外）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。仅测试与 CI 预算文件。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep daemon recovery waits re-driven
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Treats the daemon's `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` refusal as a self-clearing wait in the Managed Session lifecycle coordinator instead of a hook refusal. The operation stays pending, its attempts stay budget-exempt, and past the retry budget it is published as `recovery_blocked` with the daemon's own code so the recovery scan keeps re-driving it until the daemon settles the prompt it owed. Four timing-sensitive tests are deflaked: the Hosted close gets the dispatch backoff's own window (150s), the fault-gate listener allocates ports below the OS ephemeral range, the action lease-renewal test uses a 3s lease with a 4s renewal interval, and the SSE stall test is sized against a 1200ms idle budget. The E2E freeze loop now waits up to 5s for open InnoDB transactions to drain.

## Why it's needed

A full-tier run showed a second close refused with 503 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` for about 36 seconds while the daemon settled a previous prompt. The coordinator classified that refusal as a hook refusal and published the row `RECOVERY_BLOCKED`, after which every later attempt failed locally, so a state the daemon could still clear became terminal; the test's 40-second window also ended in the middle of the 32s backoff. Together with three timing flakes (a port stolen from the ephemeral range, a renewal starved by a loaded runner, an SSE answer scheduled late), these were the remaining red classes in the Java gate's full tier.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm the new parameterized unit test covers both sides of the budget: below it, a daemon recovery refusal reschedules budget-exempt; at or past it, the row is published `recovery_blocked` with `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required`, never `failed`, never `completed`.
- Full-tier Hosted ITs need the Java fixture and MySQL, which this machine cannot run (no Docker/MySQL); CI covers `HostedExtensionsIT` in the full tier, and the fault-gate and E2E script changes run in their respective lanes.
- A reviewer can reproduce the coordinator behavior with the commands below; the SSE test documents the 1200ms budget against the 650ms answer window.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible change). Local test output:

```text
OperationRetryTerminalStateTest   Tests run: 75, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
ManagedActionsTest (lease case)   Tests run: 1,  Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
HostedHarnessClientTest (SSE)     Tests run: 1,  Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
mvn -DskipTests verify            BUILD SUCCESS (checkstyle 0, SpotBugs 0)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Maven 3.10 with a local JDK; no MySQL/Docker, so the Hosted ITs were not run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a daemon recovery state that never clears now keeps the close pending (published `recovery_blocked` with the daemon's own code past the budget) instead of failing it. The recovery scan keeps re-driving the row, so the operation resumes once the daemon settles its debt; the behavior is visible in the operation record either way.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Hosted ITs and fault-gate lanes were not run locally; they are covered by the full-tier CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14392

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 Managed Session 生命周期协调器里，把 daemon 返回的 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` 拒绝视为可自行清除的等待，而不是 hook 拒绝。操作保持 pending，其重试不计入预算；超过预算后以 daemon 自己的错误码发布为 `recovery_blocked`，恢复扫描会继续重驱动它，直到 daemon 结清此前欠下的 prompt。同时去掉四个时序敏感测试的抖动：Hosted close 的等待窗口放宽到 dispatch 退避的上限（150 秒），fault-gate 监听端口改为在系统临时端口范围以下分配，action 租约续期测试改用 3 秒租约和 4 秒续期间隔，SSE 停顿测试按 1200ms 空闲预算设定；E2E 冻结循环现在最多等待 5 秒让未结的 InnoDB 事务排空。

## 为什么需要

一次 full tier 运行中，第二次 close 被 503 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` 拒绝了约 36 秒（daemon 正在结清上一个 prompt）。协调器把它当成 hook 拒绝，把操作发布为 `RECOVERY_BLOCKED`，之后每次尝试都在本地失败，于是一个 daemon 本来还能清除的状态变成了终态；测试的 40 秒窗口也在 32 秒退避中间结束。加上另外三个时序抖动（端口被临时端口范围抢走、续期在负载高的 runner 上被饿死、SSE 应答被推迟），这些就是 Java gate full tier 剩余的红灯类别。

## 评审测试计划

确认新增的参数化单测覆盖预算两侧：未超预算时按预算豁免重排；达到或超过预算时以 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` 发布为 `recovery_blocked`，绝不 `failed`，绝不 `completed`。full tier 的 Hosted IT 需要 Java fixture 和 MySQL，本机没有 Docker/MySQL，由 CI 覆盖 `HostedExtensionsIT`；fault-gate 与 E2E 脚本改动在各自 lane 运行。本地结果为：`OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` 75/75、`ManagedActionsTest` 租约用例 1/1、`HostedHarnessClientTest` SSE 用例 1/1，`mvn -DskipTests verify` 通过（checkstyle、SpotBugs 均为 0）。

## 风险与范围

主要风险：如果 daemon 的恢复状态一直不消除，close 会持续等待（超预算后以 daemon 自己的错误码发布为 `recovery_blocked`），而不是失败；恢复扫描会继续重驱动，daemon 结清后操作恢复。未在本地验证 Hosted IT 和 fault-gate lane，由 full tier CI 覆盖。无破坏性变更或迁移事项。

关联 #14392。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): hold every Hosted IT class to the shared fork budget (#14148)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Holds every `Hosted*IT` class to the shared Hosted failsafe fork budget, instead of the seven classes the guard named one by one.

- **Every class is read.** The guard in `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` now finds every class that the `hosted-harness-mysql` profile's `**/Hosted*IT.java` include picks up, in any package. That is nineteen classes today. The list is pinned, so a new class goes red here until the same diff adds its runtime to `hostedForkHealthySeconds`.
- **Per-ceiling rule for all of them.** Each case's `@Timeout` plus the healthy runtime must fit inside the fork timeout. This is the rule the FG7–FG10 letters were already held to. `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` and `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT` keep their stricter summed rule, because one regression stalls every case in them at once.
- **Every case has a ceiling.** A case with no `@Timeout` can stall until failsafe kills the fork. Two classes had none, so they get one sized from their own waits:
  - `HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT` gets 180 s; its reader replay waits at most 120 s.
  - `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` gets 120 s; every wait in it is bounded in seconds.
- **The allowance cites a lane measurement.** The comment beside `hostedForkHealthySeconds` now records that the nineteen classes ran 3085 s on run 39087108383. The allowance is 3874 s.
- The Spring-context check in the same file reuses the new class discovery.

No existing ceiling changes, and neither does the fork timeout, the step timeout or the allowance.

## Why it's needed

#14148 found two gaps in this guard.

1. **The healthy-runtime figure was stale.** It was 650 s against a fork that measured about 1350 s. The FG8–FG10 rounds have since fixed this: each one composed its class into the allowance, which is now 3874 s. The lane measurement above shows the allowance covers the real fork.
2. **The guard skipped most classes.** This is still true on `main`. Only seven of the nineteen classes are read. The other twelve include the five 600 s ceilings #14148 listed (`HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` ×3, `HostedChannelProcessCrashIT`, `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT`). A raised ceiling or a new class in any of them stays green, and the first sign is a fork killed mid-run on `main`, where the classes after the kill never report (#13780). That is how #14125 found the problem.

This PR closes the second gap and records the evidence for the first, so #14148 can close. FG11's tracker (#14446) is marked blocked on #14148. The FG12 and FG13 trackers (#14447, #14449) note that it bounds what their rounds can add to the lane. Each of those rounds will add a class to this fork.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npm run test:scripts -- scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` → 48 tests pass. Seventeen of them are the new per-class rows; the two summed rows run as before.
2. Mutations, each restored afterwards:
   - Raise one `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` ceiling from 600 to 700. Only `keeps each HostedChannelFaultGatesIT ceiling inside the shared fork budget` goes red. On `main`, the same mutation leaves all 35 tests of the file green.
   - Remove the new `@Timeout(180)` from `HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT`. Only that class's row goes red.
   - Add a `store/HostedProbeIT.java` with one timed case. Only `budgets every Hosted*IT class the shared fork runs` goes red.
3. The two classes that gained a ceiling still pass. Locally, on JDK 21 under `-Phosted-harness-mysql` with checkstyle: `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` took 4.5 s and `HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT` 0.3 s.
4. The 3085 s figure comes from the Verify step log of [job 117555953024](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39087108383/job/117555953024). It is the time from the first `Running …Hosted*IT` line (01:46:34Z) to the last class's `Tests run:` line (02:37:59Z). All nineteen classes ran and passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, test infrastructure only.

| Mutation | `main` guard | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` ceiling 600 → 700 | 35/35 green | red at that class's row |
| A case without `@Timeout` | green | red at that class's row |
| A new `Hosted*IT` class | green | red at the pinned list |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, Node from the repository toolchain, JDK 21, and MySQL 8.4 for the two ITs.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** The pinned class list adds a step for anyone adding a `Hosted*IT` class: they edit this test in the same diff. That is intended, because the fork has been killed on `main` before when that step was missed. The per-ceiling rule leaves 610 s for a single stall (4484 − 3874). The largest ceiling today is 600 s, so a future 600 s+ ceiling has to raise the fork, which is what the rule is for.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - Lifecycle methods (`@BeforeAll`/`@AfterAll`) carry no `@Timeout` and are not read. Their time is part of each class's healthy runtime; `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT`, for one, ran 403 s against its 240 s case ceiling.
  - A class-level `@Timeout` would fail the one-ceiling-per-case count; none exists, and the guard would ask for per-case ceilings.
  - Splitting the fork (direction 3 in #14148) is not attempted.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** None.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14148. Related: #14446 (FG11, marked blocked on #14148), #14447 (FG12) and #14449 (FG13).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让每个 `Hosted*IT` 类都受共享 Hosted failsafe fork 预算的约束，而不是只约束守卫逐个点名的七个类。

- **读取每一个类。** `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 里的守卫现在会找出 `hosted-harness-mysql` profile 的 `**/Hosted*IT.java` include 会选中的每一个类，不论在哪个包里。目前共十九个。类列表被钉住，所以新增类会在这里变红，直到同一个 diff 把它的运行时长加进 `hostedForkHealthySeconds`。
- **全部套用逐上限规则。** 每个 case 的 `@Timeout` 加上健康运行时长必须放得进 fork 超时。FG7–FG10 各字母原本就受这条规则约束。`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` 和 `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT` 保留更严格的求和规则，因为一次回归会让其中所有 case 同时卡住。
- **每个 case 都有上限。** 没有 `@Timeout` 的 case 可能一直卡到 failsafe 杀掉 fork。原来有两个类没有，现在按它们自身的等待时长补上：
  - `HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT` 设为 180 s，它的 reader 重放最多等待 120 s。
  - `HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` 设为 120 s，其中每个等待都以秒为界。
- **额度旁注明 lane 实测值。** `hostedForkHealthySeconds` 旁的注释现在记录了十九个类在 run 39087108383 上跑了 3085 s，额度是 3874 s。
- 同一文件里的 Spring context 检查复用新的类发现逻辑。

已有的上限都没有改动，fork 超时、step 超时和额度也没有改动。

## 为什么需要

#14148 发现这个守卫有两个缺口。

1. **健康运行时长的数字过时了。** 当时是 650 s，而 fork 实测约 1350 s。FG8–FG10 各轮已经修好了这一点：每一轮都把自己的类计入额度，额度现在是 3874 s。上面的 lane 实测值说明额度覆盖得住真实的 fork。
2. **守卫跳过了大多数类。** 这一点在 `main` 上仍然成立。十九个类里只读了七个。另外十二个里包括 #14148 列出的五个 600 s 上限（`HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` ×3、`HostedChannelProcessCrashIT`、`HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT`）。其中任何一个类调高上限或新增一个类，守卫都保持绿色，第一个信号是 `main` 上 fork 中途被杀，被杀之后的类都不会出报告（#13780）。#14125 就是这样发现问题的。

本 PR 补上第二个缺口，并为第一个缺口留下证据，这样 #14148 就可以关闭。FG11 的 tracker（#14446）被标为阻塞在 #14148 上。FG12 和 FG13 的 tracker（#14447、#14449）写明它限定了这两轮能往 lane 里加多少。这几轮都会往这个 fork 里加类。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `npm run test:scripts -- scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` → 48 个测试通过。其中十七个是新的逐类行，两个求和行照旧运行。
2. 变异（每次之后都已还原）：
   - 把 `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` 的一个上限从 600 调到 700。只有 `keeps each HostedChannelFaultGatesIT ceiling inside the shared fork budget` 变红。同样的变异在 `main` 上，该文件 35 个测试全绿。
   - 去掉 `HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT` 新加的 `@Timeout(180)`。只有该类那一行变红。
   - 新增一个带一个限时 case 的 `store/HostedProbeIT.java`。只有 `budgets every Hosted*IT class the shared fork runs` 变红。
3. 补了上限的两个类仍然通过。本地在 JDK 21 下以 `-Phosted-harness-mysql` 运行并开启 checkstyle：`HostedWorkspaceRecoveryWorkerIT` 用时 4.5 s，`HostedCommittedEventLineReplayIT` 用时 0.3 s。
4. 3085 s 取自 [job 117555953024](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39087108383/job/117555953024) 的 Verify step 日志，是从第一行 `Running …Hosted*IT`（01:46:34Z）到最后一个类的 `Tests run:` 行（02:37:59Z）的时长。十九个类全部运行并通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A，仅测试基础设施。

| 变异 | `main` 的守卫 | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT` 上限 600 → 700 | 35/35 全绿 | 该类那一行变红 |
| 一个没有 `@Timeout` 的 case | 绿 | 该类那一行变红 |
| 新增一个 `Hosted*IT` 类 | 绿 | 钉住的列表变红 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，Node 使用仓库工具链，JDK 21，两个 IT 使用 MySQL 8.4。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** 钉住的类列表给新增 `Hosted*IT` 类的人多了一步：要在同一个 diff 里改这个测试。这是有意为之，因为以前漏掉这一步时，`main` 上的 fork 被杀过。逐上限规则给单次卡住留了 610 s（4484 − 3874）。目前最大的上限是 600 s，所以将来超过 600 s 的上限必须先调高 fork，这正是这条规则的用意。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 生命周期方法（`@BeforeAll`/`@AfterAll`）不带 `@Timeout`，守卫也不读它们。它们的耗时算在各类的健康运行时长里；例如 `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` 跑了 403 s，而它唯一 case 的上限是 240 s。
  - 类级 `@Timeout` 会让"每个 case 一个上限"的计数失败；目前没有这种用法，守卫会要求改成逐 case 的上限。
  - 没有尝试拆分 fork（#14148 中的方向 3）。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14148。相关：#14446（FG11，被标为阻塞在 #14148 上）、#14447（FG12）和 #14449（FG13）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): recover receipt-complete private CSI file turns
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows a successor Hosted owner to finish one original private CSI file turn after every execution and immutable receipt is durable, but before the final original tool checkpoint is resolved. After both old leases expire, SQL qualifies the complete original history and execution inventory before claiming a newer writer and installing the next activation. Recovery retains original message identities, repairs only missing messages and checkpoint resolutions, and resumes inference with every original tool response, including deterministic refusals. File operations are not repeated.

## Why it's needed

The original Hosted file path can leave completed file effects and durable receipts behind when its owner stops before recording the final result message. Repeating a write is unsafe, while the existing caller rejects every successor writer. This extracts the first receipt-complete recovery cut from cumulative #13526, following #14487, while preserving that PR's refusal, capacity, cancellation and atomic final-output fixes.

This PR is stacked on `codex/csi-hosted-files` so its review diff contains only the recovery increment. Merge #14487 first; its outstanding capacity-policy ruling remains a prerequisite.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Interrupt an original private file turn after all original results and receipts settle but before its last result message/checkpoint resolution. While the old leases are live, a successor must be refused without changing stored state. After natural database expiry, the successor should preserve the original Runtime, worker, binding, files, backups, grants and results, install the next activation, reuse original result-message identities and finish one model continuation without another file dispatch.

Verify that a refused call between accepted calls remains in durable history and reaches the model with its original function ID and provider order. Repeating receipt repair must add no message or effect. Changed prompts, missing or changed evidence, UNKNOWN/cancelled execution and incomplete authorization must refuse. An acquired writer that stops before installing an activation must not publish; a later qualified claim may skip that unused writer generation while installing exactly the next activation epoch. Exact old-command replay, renewal and publication must refuse after takeover.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The ready installed global CLI returns 404 for the private route. A separate baseline transport probe reaches the actual attachment initializer and observes its generation-2 refusal before restore, publication, file or inference I/O; this is a CLI observation, not a SQL baseline reproduction. The extracted candidate passes the bounded receipt repair and connected SQL continuation checks recorded in the separate E2E report.

Passed locally: root build/typecheck/bundle; five focused CLI files (56 tests), including the final affected 23-test rerun; 37 focused Java proof tests; two connected Hosted/H2 cases; three real MySQL 8.4 integration cases; and an independent actual private attachment probe. Formatting/lint/design links and two complete diff self-audits pass. Full Java verification is still running; matching ordinary Hosted/fault regressions are queued. Complete local `/review` is unavailable because this host lacks its required native Workflow executor, so this remains a Draft requiring maintainer architecture review.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | Local build, unit/H2/MySQL checks and owned loopback fixtures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Native CSI/deployed chain not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.14.0, JDK 21 and disposable MySQL 8.4.11. Model and transport endpoints are owned loopback fixtures. The real Hosted producer, Java SQL consumer, Broker and file worker run with explicit placement/mount facades. An injected owner stop and reopened authority are not evidence of an OS-process-crash matrix or deployed Linux CSI provenance.

## Risk & Scope

- Writer takeover crosses CLI and durable Java admission and requires maintainer architecture review. The existing authenticated private route and original READY Runtime are the only entry; no public selector or new recovery credential is added.
- This is the first receipt-complete cut only. The final tool resolution clears the native pending batch, so later cuts, missing-receipt reconstruction, committed final-output recovery, replacement workers, physical retirement, release, unpublication and volume reuse remain separate work.
- No schema or deployment changes. Existing 64 KiB durable-body and complete-history capacity checks remain; no evidence is truncated to make recovery succeed.
- Synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-cold-receipt-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-18-private-csi-receipt-recovery.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-cold-receipt-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-18-private-csi-receipt-recovery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #13526. Depends on #14487; neither cumulative K2 nor its tracker is closed by this slice.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

允许后继 Hosted owner 在全部执行和不可变回执已持久化、但最后一次原工具检查点尚未 resolve 时，完成一个原私有 CSI 文件 Turn。两个旧租约过期后，SQL 先校验完整原始历史及执行清单，再取得更高 writer generation 并安装下一个 activation。恢复保留原消息身份，只补缺失消息和检查点 resolve，将包括确定性拒绝在内的全部原工具响应交给模型继续运行，不重复文件操作。

## 原因

原 Hosted 文件调用方可能在最后结果消息落盘前停止，留下已完成的文件效果和持久回执。重复写入不安全，而现有调用方拒绝所有后继 writer。本次接续 #14487，从累计 #13526 拆出首个回执完整恢复断点，并保留前一个 PR 的拒绝、容量、取消及最终输出原子提交修复。

本 PR 叠在 `codex/csi-hosted-files` 上，评审 diff 只包含恢复增量。应先合并 #14487；其待决容量策略仍是前置条件。

## 审阅验证计划

### 如何验证

在全部原始结果和回执已结算、最后结果消息或检查点尚未 resolve 时，中断原私有文件 Turn。旧租约仍有效时，后继必须被拒绝，存储状态不变。数据库自然过期后，后继应保留原 Runtime、worker、binding、文件、备份、grant 及结果，安装下一个 activation，复用原结果消息身份，只完成一次模型续跑，不再派发文件操作。

确认合法调用之间被拒绝的调用仍保存在历史中，并以原函数 ID 和 provider 顺序送达模型。重复修复回执不应新增消息或效果。改变 prompt、缺失或改变证据、UNKNOWN/已取消执行及不完整授权均应拒绝。取得 writer 后、安装 activation 前停止的 claim 不能发布；后续获准 claim 可以跳过未使用的 writer generation，但只能安装下一个 activation epoch。接管后，完全相同的旧命令重放、续租及发布均须拒绝。

### 证据（前后）

全局 CLI 达到 ready 后仍对私有路由返回 404。独立基线传输探针进入真实接入初始化代码，观察到 generation 2 在 restore、发布、文件或推理 I/O 前被拒绝；这是 CLI 观察，不是 SQL 基线复现。拆分候选通过了独立 E2E 报告所记录的有界回执修复及连通 SQL 续跑检查。

本地已通过 root build/typecheck/bundle、五个 CLI 定向测试文件（56 项，修正测试参数后受影响的 23 项也已重跑通过）、37 项 Java proof 定向测试、两项连通 Hosted/H2、三项真实 MySQL 8.4 集成，以及独立真实私有接入探针。格式/lint/设计链接及两轮完整 diff 自审通过。Java 全模块验证仍在运行，对应普通 Hosted/fault 回归已排队。本机缺少所需原生 Workflow 执行工具，完整本地 `/review` 不可用，因此保持 Draft，仍需维护者架构评审。

### 已验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | 本地构建、单元/H2/MySQL 检查及自有 loopback fixture |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | 原生 CSI/部署链未在本地验证 |

### 环境

使用 Node 22.14.0、JDK 21 及一次性 MySQL 8.4.11。模型和传输端点均为自有 loopback fixture。真实 Hosted producer、Java SQL consumer、Broker 和文件 worker 使用明确标注的 placement/mount facade。注入 owner 停止并重开 authority，不代表 OS 进程崩溃矩阵或已部署 Linux CSI 来源验收。

## 风险与范围

- Writer 接管跨越 CLI 和持久 Java 准入，需要维护者架构评审。入口仅为已有认证私有路由及原 READY Runtime，没有新增公开选择器或恢复凭据。
- 仅包含首个回执完整断点。最后一次工具 resolve 会清除原生 pending batch，因此后续断点、缺失回执重建、已提交最终输出恢复、替代 worker、物理退役、释放、卸载和卷复用继续独立处理。
- 不改 schema 或部署。保留已有 64 KiB 持久 body 和完整历史容量检查，不通过截断证据让恢复成功。
- 同步设计：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-cold-receipt-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-18-private-csi-receipt-recovery.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-cold-receipt-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-18-private-csi-receipt-recovery.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联事项

关联 #13526，依赖 #14487。本切片不关闭完整 K2 或其 tracker。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep runtime MCP state and permission sync honest
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes the three review findings from the merged registration PR.

The Bridge now clears its record of runtime-added MCP servers when the live child that held them is replaced, so a retired channel stops forcing every later session onto Legacy.

A propagated permission change now diffs each settings scope's own rule set instead of the merged view, which carried workspace rules into the User pass and applied them to every session. The live permission-manager sync can run in a strict mode, and the workspace-change path uses it: if a live session rejects a rule, the change is not acknowledged and the Bridge keeps the channel quarantined.

A tightening settings change that a reload skipped is also not acknowledged, from the earlier audit fix.

## Why it's needed

Each of these could leave a session running under stale MCP or permission state while the Bridge believed the new revision had been applied. The acknowledgement is the fence that decides whether the channel is quarantined, so it must not be returned on a partial apply.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the three changed paths and confirm each failure now prevents the acknowledgement instead of being swallowed. Run the focused serve and ACP suites; add a runtime-MCP add followed by a channel retirement and confirm `hasRuntimeMcpServers()` returns false.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface change. Local evidence: `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit`, Prettier.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a strict sync makes a broken permission manager quarantine the channel instead of silently diverging.
- Not validated / out of scope: end-to-end quarantine behaviour; the residuals listed on the registration PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14483, #12737

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复已合入的注册 PR 上的三条评审意见。

Bridge 在持有运行时添加型 MCP 服务器的子进程被替换时清空记录，避免退役通道让后续所有会话永久留在 Legacy。

传播权限变更时改为按各 scope 自己的规则集做 diff，而不是合并视图——合并视图会把 workspace 规则带进 User 那一次调用，从而作用到所有会话。存活权限管理器同步支持严格模式，工作区变更路径启用它：任一存活会话拒绝规则时不回执，Bridge 保持通道隔离。

更早的审计修复也保留：收紧型 settings 变更若被重载跳过会话，同样不回执。

## 为什么需要

否则会话可能在旧 MCP 或旧权限状态下继续运行，而 Bridge 认为新版本已生效。回执决定通道是否被隔离，不能在部分应用时返回。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

阅读三处改动，确认每种失败现在都阻止回执而不是被吞掉。运行 serve 与 ACP 的聚焦套件；构造「添加运行时 MCP → 退役通道」，确认 `hasRuntimeMcpServers()` 返回 false。

### 证据（改动前后）

不适用——无用户可见变化。本地证据：`npm run build`、`tsc --noEmit`、Prettier。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：严格同步会让损坏的权限管理器触发通道隔离，而不是静默偏离。
- 未验证／超出范围：端到端隔离行为；注册 PR 已列的残留项。
- 破坏性变更：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14483, #12737

</details>
