auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(managed-agent): keep runtime MCP state and permission sync honest

Clear the recorded runtime-MCP names when the live child that held them is
replaced, so a retired channel does not keep every later session on Legacy.

Diff each settings scope's own rule set when a permission change is
propagated: the merged view carries workspace rules into the User pass, which
then applies them to every session. Make the sync strict for a propagated
change and fail the acknowledgement when a live session rejects a rule, so
the Bridge keeps the channel quarantined instead of lifting the fence.

Refs #14483

(cherry picked from commit 3439ca9da9)

* test(acp-bridge): pin that an added runtime MCP server is observed

The paired selector reads hasRuntimeMcpServers() before it lets a session
select Managed. Pin that a successful workspace-level runtime add is visible
to the bridge.

Refs #14488

* fix(managed-agent): diff the effective permission set for workspace changes

The live permission manager keeps the scopes' rules merged, without provenance. Diffing each scope separately can remove a rule another scope still provides: clearing a workspace deny while the user scope also denies it would make read_file runnable again, and the acknowledgement would hide it. Diff the effective set instead, and keep the workspace filter on the apply.

Refs #14488

* fix(managed-agent): carry the permission scope through a workspace change

A single SettingScope.Workspace pass filtered user-scope deltas out of sessions admitted at another root, such as a worktree session, while still acknowledging the change. Carry the written scope in the change payload and use it to pick the audience: User reaches every live session, Workspace keeps the workspace filter. The content still comes from the effective merged set, so a rule another scope provides is never removed.

Refs #14488

* test(acp-bridge): include the permission scope in the propagated payload

The workspace-change payload now carries the written scope, so the exact assertion in the paired-engine test must include it. This also fixes the failing Test (ubuntu) lane on the same head.

Refs #14488

* test(cli): include the permission scope in the propagated payload

The workspace-change payload now carries the written scope. Update the CLI paired-engine assertion to include it, alongside the acp-bridge one.

Refs #14488

prs.title: fix(web-shell): do not persist rejected daemon URL credentials
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It prevents a rejected daemon override from persisting its URL fragment credential under the page origin's storage key.

## Why it's needed

When a daemon override is rejected, the fragment credential belongs to the rejected target and must not be reassigned to the page origin. The escape-hatch navigation now discards that credential instead of making it available to the page-origin daemon.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open a web-shell URL with a rejected `?daemon=` override and a `#token=...` fragment, then use the return-to-local escape hatch. Confirm that the page-origin token key remains empty and navigation clears the fragment without placing the credential in the destination URL. The focused regression test covers this behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a credential-storage behavior change with no visual change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — validated with the web-shell unit test suite and static checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Users following a rejected daemon override may need to enter a credential again instead of having the URL fragment carried into the page-origin session.
- Not validated / out of scope: Browser-level navigation and the full repository preflight require upstream execution; macOS and Windows were not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12040

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

阻止被拒绝的 daemon 覆盖将 URL fragment 中的凭据持久化到页面 origin 的存储键下。

## 为什么需要

当 daemon 覆盖被拒绝时，fragment 中的凭据属于被拒绝的目标，不能重新分配给页面 origin。现在通过返回本地工作区的逃生路径导航时会丢弃该凭据，而不会让页面 origin 的 daemon 使用它。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

打开带有被拒绝的 `?daemon=` 覆盖和 `#token=...` fragment 的 web-shell URL，然后使用返回本地工作区的逃生路径。确认页面 origin 的 token 键仍为空，并且导航会清除 fragment，而不会把凭据放进目标 URL。聚焦回归测试覆盖了这一行为。

### 证据（修复前与修复后）

不适用——这是凭据存储行为变更，没有视觉变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

不适用——已通过 web-shell 单元测试和静态检查验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 取舍：使用被拒绝 daemon 覆盖的用户可能需要再次输入凭据，而不是让 URL fragment 中的凭据进入页面 origin 的会话。
- 未验证 / 范围外：浏览器级导航和完整仓库 preflight 需要上游执行；本地未测试 macOS 与 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12040

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG12a MCP reply-loss fault gates (#14447)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the FG12a fault gate for the Hosted MCP control path: three lost-reply cases that drop the reply to a `mcp-configure` replacement, a `resource_read` `mcp-invoke`, and a `prompt_get` `mcp-invoke`, one at a time. Every retry must resolve through a status lookup on the original operation id, never a second configure or invoke. The gate runs a packaged Harness, a durable worker, a real stdio MCP server, a real MySQL schema and a Broker-fronting proxy that forwards the upstream request, reads the answer, then closes the connection without writing a response. The wire sequence at the proxy is the primary witness; each case first proves its own injection fired.

This is the first slice of the FG12 round in #14447. The cancel/release/owner-ack/tool-start cases and FG12b–f remain on the tracker.

## Why it's needed

Hosted MCP recovery is layered: the Harness looks up instead of resending, the Runtime joins a repeated id, and the Broker refuses stale generations. A resend can therefore hide a second physical effect, and the existing unit suite (with a mocked Broker) cannot see the wire. This gate pins the no-resend property on the real stack and provides the proxy and injection seam the later FG12 letters will reuse.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the class against a disposable MySQL 8.x with the packaged CLI built (`npm run bundle`):

```
mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql failsafe:integration-test \
  -Dit.test=HostedMcpReplyLossIT \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= \
  -Dnode.executable=$(which node) \
  -Dqwen.cli.entry=$PWD/../../dist/cli.js
```

Expected: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`. The evidence under `packages/managed-agent-server/target/fg12-cases/fg12a/<tenant>/` shows one `mcp-configure` followed by an `mcp-status`, both with the replacement operation id, and the configure entry marked `dropped=true`; the resource and prompt invokes each show one `mcp-invoke` plus a lookup and exactly one fixture effect.

Mutation witness: change `dispatch()`'s fallback in the Hosted MCP session from the status lookup to a second `broker.control()`, re-bundle, and rerun. The proxy then records two `mcp-configure` controls and the gate fails with `Expected size: 1 but was: 2`. Restoring the source and re-bundling returns it green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for TUI. Local runs: green `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (5.5 s) and the mutation run red with `Expected size: 1 but was: 2`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS was tested with JDK 21 and MariaDB 10.11; the Linux lane is the target for the hosted MySQL run and was not run locally.

### Environment (optional)

Local `dist/cli.js` from `npm run bundle`, a throw-away MariaDB data directory, and the packaged `serve --profile hosted-harness` process.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate adds one Hosted integration class and a new Broker proxy fixture; the shared failsafe fork budget moves from 4353 s to 4368 s and the healthy sum from 3743 s to 3758 s, pinned in the CI meta-test.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Linux hosted lane itself, cancel/release/owner-ack and MCP tool-start reply loss, and all of FG12b–f.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test-only apart from the CI budget and the bilingual design doc.

Design docs, in both languages: [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-fault-gates-a.md) and [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-fault-gates-a.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #14447 (Stage F FG12; umbrella #14054). This slice does not close the tracker.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 Hosted MCP 控制路径补上 FG12a 故障门禁：三个应答丢失 case，分别丢弃 `mcp-configure` 替换、`resource_read` 的 `mcp-invoke`、以及 `prompt_get` 的 `mcp-invoke` 的应答，每次只丢一个。每次重试都必须通过原 operation id 的 status 查询解决，绝不能再发一次 configure 或 invoke。门禁运行打包 Harness、durable worker、真实 stdio MCP server、真实 MySQL schema，以及一个 Broker 前置代理：先转发上游请求、读完应答，然后不写响应直接关闭连接。代理上的线上序列是主见证；每个 case 先自证注入确实命中。

这是 #14447 中 FG12 轮次的第一个切片。cancel/release/owner-ack/tool-start 以及 FG12b–f 仍留在 tracker。

## 为什么需要

Hosted MCP 的恢复有多层防护：Harness 查询而不重发，Runtime 合并重复 id，Broker 拒绝过期 generation。因此重发可能掩盖第二次物理副作用，而现有单测用 mock Broker，看不到线上序列。本门禁在真实栈上钉住“不重发”性质，并为后续 FG12 字母提供可复用的代理与注入接缝。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

用一次性 MySQL 8.x、先构建打包 CLI（`npm run bundle`），运行：

```
mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql failsafe:integration-test \
  -Dit.test=HostedMcpReplyLossIT \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password= \
  -Dnode.executable=$(which node) \
  -Dqwen.cli.entry=$PWD/../../dist/cli.js
```

期望：`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`。`packages/managed-agent-server/target/fg12-cases/fg12a/<tenant>/` 下的证据显示：一次 `mcp-configure` 后跟一次 `mcp-status`，两者都带替换的 operation id，且 configure 条目 `dropped=true`；resource 与 prompt 的 invoke 各自只有一次 `mcp-invoke`、一次查询、以及 fixture 恰好一次副作用。

变异见证：把 Hosted MCP 会话里 `dispatch()` 的回退从 status 查询改成第二次 `broker.control()`，重新打包并复跑。代理会记录两次 `mcp-configure`，门禁以 `Expected size: 1 but was: 2` 失败。还原源码并重新打包后复绿。

### 证据（前后对比）

TUI 不适用。本机运行：绿 `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`（5.5 s）；变异 run 红，报 `Expected size: 1 but was: 2`。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

macOS 上使用 JDK 21 + MariaDB 10.11 验证；Linux hosted MySQL 车道是目标环境，本机未运行。

### 环境（可选）

本机 `npm run bundle` 产物 `dist/cli.js`、临时 MariaDB 数据目录，以及打包的 `serve --profile hosted-harness` 进程。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：新增一个 Hosted 集成类与一个 Broker 代理夹具；共享 failsafe fork 预算由 4353 s 移到 4368 s，healthy 和由 3743 s 移到 3758 s，并在 CI 元测试中钉住。
- 未验证/超出范围：Linux hosted 车道本身、cancel/release/owner-ack 与 MCP 工具调用的应答丢失、以及 FG12b–f 全部。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；除 CI 预算与双语言设计文档外均为测试。

设计文档双语言链接：[英文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-fault-gates-a.md) 与 [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-fault-gates-a.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 issue

引用 #14447（Stage F FG12；伞形 #14054）。本切片不关闭 tracker。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add approval mode allowlist
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an optional approval-mode allowlist through `ui.allowedApprovalModes` in settings.json and the host `allowedApprovalModes` Prop. An explicit Prop overrides settings, including `[]`; leaving both unset preserves all four choices. The dropdown, approval dialog, custom composer footer and Shift+Tab cycle use the same normalized list, including split and side-task composers.

Each workspace session reads its own workspace settings. Unknown values, duplicates and `plan` are filtered out while retaining the built-in order. An empty list disables execution-mode selection and cycling; a singleton avoids redundant requests. A hidden current mode is still displayed accurately and is never changed automatically. Plan remains independent.

## Why it's needed

Embedded hosts and workspace owners currently cannot hide individual approval choices. Filtering only the main dropdown would leave other entry points inconsistent, and reading primary-workspace settings for a secondary session would produce different choices between main and split views.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Without configuration, confirm all four execution modes remain visible and Shift+Tab cycles through them.
2. Set `ui.allowedApprovalModes` to `["default", "auto"]`: the dropdown and `/approval-mode` dialog should offer exactly those modes, and Shift+Tab should alternate between them.
3. Supply host `allowedApprovalModes` as `["default", "yolo"]`, then `[]`: the host list should override settings in the main composer, split panes and side-task panel. The empty list should disable the picker and make cycling a no-op.
4. Use different primary and secondary workspace lists, then open the same secondary session in main and split views: both should use the secondary list. Change settings or host Props and confirm choices update consistently.
5. Restore a session whose current mode is excluded: its actual mode should remain displayed until an allowed mode is selected. Plan entry/exit should continue to work independently.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: all four choices were always offered; hosts and settings could not filter them. After: the browser-rendered dropdown and dialog below both show only `default` and `auto` supplied by host Props.

![Allowlisted dropdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/menu.png)

![Allowlisted approval dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/dialog.png)

The built standalone UI also shows only secondary-workspace `auto` in the split pane when primary allows only `default`:

![Secondary workspace split picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/split-workspace.png)

All screenshots were captured through browser E2E and visually inspected. Daemon API/SSE responses are simulated; the split screenshot uses actual bundled HTML/assets served by `node dist/cli.js`. Separate real-daemon checks confirmed settings.json values through both settings endpoints. Screenshots do not establish real backend session operations or authorization enforcement. Images are stored on an independent fork asset branch and pinned to a fixed commit, outside the implementation branch.

Validation passed at `153fcc9535` after merging main `a8eb74fdf5`: frozen-lockfile dependency installation and patches; root build, typecheck and bundle; 1,226 App tests; 605 component/Managed/StreamingStatus tests; three source Chromium cases and two built-artifact cases. The allowlist and upstream Tokens/second setting coexist. Screenshots above were recaptured and visually inspected. Original feature verification also covered the default cycle, empty/singleton lists, Plan, side tasks and real settings.json projection, as detailed in the separate E2E reports. GitHub reports no merge conflict; the new CI run is pending.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS local worktree; Vitest and Chromium/Playwright; isolated built CLI daemon for settings checks and static serving; simulated daemon transport for browser interaction; no model requests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: settings load asynchronously; until available, the UI uses the default four-mode list. Existing backend permission rules remain authoritative.
- Not validated / out of scope: backend permission enforcement, real multi-workspace session/tool operations, and local Windows/Linux execution.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; all four choices remain the default. This is presentation customization rather than a security policy.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/153fcc9535c9b24f208428969064db5bee7f4c0c/docs/design/web-shell-approval-mode-allowlist.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/153fcc9535c9b24f208428969064db5bee7f4c0c/docs/design/web-shell-approval-mode-allowlist.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

通过 settings.json 中的 `ui.allowedApprovalModes` 和宿主 `allowedApprovalModes` Prop 增加可选审批模式白名单。显式传入的 Prop 覆盖设置，包括 `[]`；两者均未配置时仍显示全部四种。下拉菜单、审批弹窗、自定义输入区底栏和 Shift+Tab 切换使用同一份规范化列表，分屏和侧边任务输入区同样受控。

工作区会话读取所属工作区的设置。忽略未知值、重复值及 `plan`，保留内置顺序。空列表禁用执行模式选择和循环切换；单项列表避免重复请求。被隐藏的当前模式仍如实显示，不会自动改变。Plan 保持独立。

## 为什么需要

嵌入宿主和工作区使用者目前无法隐藏单独的审批选项。只过滤主下拉菜单会导致其他入口不一致；为次工作区会话读取主工作区设置，则会让同一会话在主视图与分屏中显示不同选项。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 不配置时，确认仍显示全部四种执行模式，Shift+Tab 可循环切换。
2. 将 `ui.allowedApprovalModes` 设为 `["default", "auto"]`：下拉菜单和 `/approval-mode` 弹窗应仅提供这两种，Shift+Tab 在两者间循环。
3. 将宿主 `allowedApprovalModes` 依次设为 `["default", "yolo"]` 和 `[]`：主输入区、分屏和侧边任务面板均应由宿主列表覆盖设置。空列表应禁用选择器，快捷键不执行切换。
4. 为主工作区与次工作区配置不同列表，再将同一次工作区会话分别放在主视图与分屏：两者均应使用次工作区列表。修改设置或宿主 Props，确认选项同步更新。
5. 恢复当前模式已被排除的会话：在选择允许的模式之前，应继续显示真实模式。Plan 的进入和退出应保持独立可用。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：始终提供全部四种，宿主和设置无法过滤。之后：以下浏览器实际渲染的下拉菜单和弹窗均仅显示宿主 Props 提供的 `default` 与 `auto`。

![白名单下拉菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/menu.png)

![白名单审批弹窗](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/dialog.png)

主工作区仅允许 `default` 时，打包后的独立 UI 分屏仍仅显示所属次工作区允许的 `auto`：

![次工作区分屏选择器](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/3acfb7837db7d01cd2df8e6436f9805fe6b9bc3f/approval-mode-allowlist/split-workspace.png)

合入 main 的 `a8eb74fdf5` 后，`153fcc9535` 验证通过：冻结锁文件依赖安装及补丁应用；全仓构建、类型检查和打包；App 1,226 项；组件/Managed/StreamingStatus 605 项；源码 Chromium 3 项及构建产物 2 项。白名单与上游 Tokens/秒设置同时保留。上方截图已重新捕获并目视检查。原功能验证还覆盖默认循环、空/单项列表、Plan、侧边任务及真实 settings.json 接口投影，详见独立 E2E 报告。GitHub 已确认无合并冲突，新一轮 CI 待完成。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: feat(cli): paste clipboard text with Ctrl+V on Linux
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On Linux, `Ctrl+V` now reads the clipboard's **text** when the clipboard holds no image. Previously the only clipboard reader in the TUI was the image path, so pressing `Ctrl+V` with text or a link on the clipboard either printed "未找到受支持的剪贴板工具" (no supported clipboard tool found) or did nothing at all, and users had to fall back to their terminal's own paste binding.

Reads are driven by what the clipboard itself reports. `wl-paste --list-types` (Wayland) and the `TARGETS` atom (X11) are enumerated, and each reported name is classified from the standards rather than from a list of types this code has heard of: ICCCM's text atoms (`TEXT`, `STRING`, `UTF8_STRING`) plus `text/plain` are the preferred read, any other `text/*` the source lists is the fallback, and ICCCM's selection bookkeeping properties (`TARGETS`, `MULTIPLE`, `SAVE_TARGETS`, `DELETE`, `INCR`, `TIMESTAMP`, `VERSION`) are never requested. Each read asks for the exact name the tool reported, so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name rather than a guessed one.

A paste too large for the input buffer is still collapsed into a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, but on both collapse routes — `Ctrl+V` read through the clipboard tool, and a large bracketed paste from the terminal — its expanded form is now described to the model: attributed to the clipboard, given the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them, and closed from outside so a forged end marker inside the pasted data cannot promote what follows it. Shell mode is the exception, because there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded and run. Selections are normalised to LF line endings, which a `text/uri-list` never has on its own. Anything the clipboard tool cannot answer — no display server, tool missing, spawn failure, timeout, empty or whitespace-only selection — resolves to "nothing to paste" instead of an error. macOS and Windows behavior is untouched.

## Why it's needed

Reported in our user group: on Ubuntu, pasting text into the input box was impossible via `Ctrl+V` — the client only tried to read an image, and when none was found it told the user to install `wl-clipboard`, which does not help with text at all. The same gesture already handles images and file paths, so text is the missing branch of an existing feature rather than a new surface.

## Review round 1

The first cut read the clipboard from inside the image branch with hardcoded per-tool type names, and its tests only proved that a stubbed spawn returned its stub. Addressed as follows:

- **Structure**: `Ctrl+V` is one dispatcher (`handleClipboardPaste`) that resolves an image into an attachment and everything else into text; the insert path is its own callback. This also fixed a real defect in the first cut, which read `buffer` and `nextLargePastePlaceholder` without declaring them as dependencies.
- **Type handling**: the per-tool candidate lists are gone. Enumeration and a single type table decide what is readable, and each read asks for the exact name the tool reported (so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name, not a guessed one).
- **Provenance**: a collapsed paste is submitted inside `<clipboard-paste>` markers with a trailing line stating it came from the clipboard and must be treated as untrusted data — on both collapse routes, since a large bracketed paste from the terminal is no more the user's own writing than a selection read back through `wl-paste`. Shell mode is the deliberate exception: there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded to history and executed, so it stays raw, and the existing shell-history case pins that carve-out. The markers are provenance for the model, not a sandbox — content can contain a closing marker, which is why the note says "treat as data" rather than claiming containment.
- **Tests**: the clipboard is now simulated as a tool that lists its types and answers reads per type, and each case asserts both the result and the exact sequence of types requested. Coverage is one table: a charset-parameterised text offer, text preferred over a co-offered URI list, a CRLF URI list, X11 atoms mapped to text without `TARGETS` ever being read back as content, fallthrough to the next atom when the first is empty, an image-only clipboard requesting nothing, unknown types requesting nothing, and a whitespace-only selection. The simulator is withdrawn after each case because the file's `beforeEach` clears call history but not implementations.

## Review round 2

- **Was the hand-written type table sound?** No, and it is gone. It carried rows no standard defines — `UNICODE` (an XFT-era atom) and a bare `uri-list` — and it named `text/uri-list` explicitly when the enumeration already says what is offered. Classification now comes from the names the standards define: ICCCM's three text atoms plus `text/plain` are the preferred tier, any other `text/*` is the fallback tier, and ICCCM's bookkeeping properties are excluded by name. Nothing is requested that the clipboard did not list.
- **Verified against a real clipboard?** Not possible from this environment, and I am not going to imply otherwise: the authoring machine is macOS arm64 with no `wl-paste`, `xclip`, `xsel`, `xvfb-run` or container runtime available, and the reader is Linux-only by design, so no live Wayland/X11 enumeration can be produced here. What I could check locally is that no other part of this repository maintains a clipboard type list to borrow (it does not — `getWlPasteImageTypes`'s `image/png`/`image/bmp` pair was the only one, and it is kept as-is). A real `wl-paste --list-types` and `xclip -t TARGETS -o` dump from an Ubuntu session would be worth attaching to this PR; the tier rule is written so that any such dump is accepted without code changes.
- **Why `text/uri-list` at all?** It is no longer a case in the code — it falls out of the `text/*` fallback tier, which is the general rule rather than a named exception. The reason a fallback tier exists is that a source may list nothing but a non-plain `text/*` type, and without the tier `Ctrl+V` would silently do nothing there. The visible trade-off is that a selection offered only as `text/html` now pastes markup instead of nothing; that is stated in a test case rather than hidden.
- **The description was too thin.** Rewritten along injection-defence lines: it attributes the block to the clipboard and says the user may not have read it; it gives the content the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them; it keeps telling the model to act on pasted material that matches the user's actual request, because refusing pasted content would defeat the feature; it names the shapes it must not swallow (a system message, a permission or policy change, a confirmation the user gave); and it closes the block from outside, so a forged `</clipboard-paste>` inside the data cannot promote whatever follows it. One case pins those properties.

## Final diff

- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts`: `readStdout()` (buffered stdout, timeout kill, empty string for anything that is not a successful read), `classifyClipboardType()` over the ICCCM text and bookkeeping sets, `listClipboardTypes()` on top of the Wayland/X11 enumeration, and `readClipboardText()` which requests only listed types — plain tier first — and normalises line endings. The wl-paste enumeration the image path already had is generalised into `listWlPasteTypes()` with one cache, and the image filter reads from that same list, so a single `Ctrl+V` costs one enumeration.
- `packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx`: `handleClipboardImage` becomes `handleClipboardPaste` — image resolves to an attachment, anything else to text — with the insert path split into `insertClipboardText`. `describeClipboardPaste()` frames a collapsed paste for the model and is applied on both collapse routes, skipped in shell mode.
- Tests: 9 table cases driving a clipboard that lists its types and answers reads per type, plus 4 component cases (text paste, collapsed paste described on submit, image wins over text, and the description's own properties).

## Evidence

<details>
<summary>Verification</summary>

Verified by unit tests rather than a live screenshot — this change needs a Wayland/X11 session, which the authoring environment does not have:

```
npx vitest run src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.test.ts        → 70 passed
npx vitest run src/ui/components/InputPrompt.test.tsx     → 230 passed, 1 skipped
npx eslint <4 changed files>                              → clean
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (packages/cli)          → 172 errors, identical to
                                                             the same count on the
                                                             pre-change tree; none in
                                                             the changed files
```

</details>

## Contribution & Risk

- **Type**: Contribution Type 3 — optimization / user-facing feature
- **Scope**: Only `packages/cli/src/ui` (TUI input handling). No core, auth, provider, config, tools, or service modules; no daemon or channel code.
- **Linked Issues**: N/A — reported directly by users in the group chat; no GitHub issue filed.
- [x] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), the code of conduct, and the PR instructions.
- [x] I have searched open PRs for a similar change and confirmed none exists.
- [ ] Not applicable — this PR does not change or add any UI component.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): delete selected message groups from session history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds grouped message deletion to Web Shell. The message action row keeps Copy and an overflow menu; Delete selects the current prompt and its complete reply group, with linked checkboxes and optional non-contiguous earlier groups. Reply selection stays beside the Processed header when present, including after expanding thoughts or tools.

Deletion removes the selected original records from JSONL and retained raw compression context, refreshes live model context and connected clients, and preserves every existing summary unchanged. Slash-command display groups can be removed without undoing command effects or files; frontend-only commands retain their position and identity across reloads and recovery.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell cannot currently remove arbitrary conversation groups. Rewind removes a suffix and retains abandoned history, so it does not satisfy physical deletion of selected turns. Users also need consistent behavior when deleting the only group, working around compression checkpoints, or recovering from stale snapshots and partially completed requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In an idle local daemon session, open a user message's overflow menu and choose Delete messages. The current prompt/reply group should be selected; toggling either checkbox must toggle the group. Select an earlier group while leaving a middle group unselected, confirm, and verify only the chosen groups disappear after reload and in other connected clients.
2. Expand thoughts/tools and verify a reply group still has one checkbox beside Processed, or beside its first reply when no status header exists. Run a local display command between turns; deleting another group must preserve the command's order and identity. Repeat at narrow viewport width and with keyboard/touch menu interaction.
3. Delete the only/all groups and continue the same session. Inspect persisted history and reopen the session: selected originals and paired tool records must remain absent, while files and command effects remain unchanged.
4. Compress a conversation, then delete groups before and after compression. Existing summaries must remain identical; only selected retained raw context should change later model input. A full compression followed by fast compression must retain the summary boundary and allow safe deletion.
5. Change history from another client while a selection is open. A conflict must clear stale selection and explain re-selection without automatically resubmitting deletion. A busy session must refuse deletion. If persistence succeeds but context installation fails, deleted identities must still reach the originator, its UI must reconcile, and further prompts must explicitly require reopening. Failed reloads must retain unselected local commands.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there is no grouped physical-deletion action. After: the captured states below show the overflow action, linked non-contiguous selection, and the retained middle group after deletion.

**All screenshots use a simulated daemon HTTP/SSE backend and were visually inspected. They demonstrate UI behavior; actual JSONL/model-context verification was performed separately against a real daemon and ACP process with a deterministic local model.** Images are stored only in an independent fork asset branch and pinned to commit `70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8`.

UI screenshots refreshed after merging main `87dcc4a7` and applying review fixes; these captures still use simulated daemon responses.

Overflow menu:

![Web Shell message action menu (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/menu.png)

Linked non-contiguous group selection:

![Linked group selection (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/selection.png)

After deleting the first and third groups, the middle group remains:

![Unselected middle group retained (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/after-deletion.png)

[Narrow viewport selection screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/mobile-selection.png) · [Bilingual evidence notes](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/README.md)

Review recovery evidence (simulated daemon):

![Unsupported saved-history deletion explanation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/unsupported.png)

[Disabled confirmation during a peer turn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/busy-confirm.png) · [Selection cleared after peer deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/peer-selection.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22; build, bundle, typecheck, focused unit tests and browser/backend E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local worktree development and bundled runtime; Chromium Playwright with simulated daemon responses for UI/error recovery, and isolated real daemon/ACP/JSONL with a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible model for persistence and model-context checks. The latest deletion browser suite passed 24/24 cases, including the review regressions. A separate E2E report comment records the validation layers and results.

## Risk & Scope

- Physical deletion is irreversible. Existing summaries may still contain information from deleted originals by design; summary text is never regenerated or edited.
- Scope is ordinary local daemon sessions. Managed authoritative storage, SSH workspaces and the hosted harness profile do not support this operation. Ambiguous legacy compression identities fail closed.
- Busy sessions are rejected. A failure after persistence keeps prompt admission closed until the session is reopened; it cannot continue with stale model context.
- This feature touches transcript persistence and cross-package session contracts; maintainer review is requested. It introduces no dependency or history migration and preserves normal append/resume behavior.
- Local verification did not cover Windows, Linux or live external model providers.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.zh-CN.md). Both versions include matching decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 Web Shell 添加整组消息删除。消息操作栏保留复制和更多操作菜单；删除会默认选择当前提问及完整回复组，checkbox 联动，并允许非连续选择更早的组。有「已处理」栏时，回复选择框放在其左侧，展开思考或工具后仍保持一个。

删除会从 JSONL 和压缩检查点保留的原文上下文中移除所选原始记录，刷新当前模型上下文和连接客户端，全部已有摘要保持不变。斜杠命令展示组可以删除，但不回滚命令效果或文件；仅存在前端的命令在重新加载及失败恢复期间保留原有位置和身份。

## 为什么需要

Web Shell 目前不能移除任意对话组。回退会删除后缀并保留废弃历史，无法满足所选轮次的物理删除。删除唯一组、跨压缩检查点删除，以及从过期快照和部分完成的请求中恢复，也需要一致的行为。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 在空闲的本地 daemon 会话中，打开用户消息的更多操作菜单并选择删除消息。当前提问与回复组应默认选中；切换任一 checkbox 都必须联动整组。另选一个更早的组，保留中间组，确认后验证仅所选组消失，重新加载和其他连接客户端中也保持一致。
2. 展开思考与工具，验证每个回复组仍只有一个 checkbox，位于「已处理」旁；没有状态栏时位于首条回复旁。在两轮之间执行前端展示命令，删除其他组后命令顺序与身份必须保留。再验证窄视口及键盘、触屏菜单交互。
3. 删除唯一组或全部组，再继续当前会话。检查持久化历史并重新打开会话：所选原文和配对工具记录仍应不存在，文件及命令效果保持不变。
4. 压缩会话后，分别删除压缩前后的组。已有摘要必须完全相同；只有所选、仍保留的原文上下文会改变后续模型输入。正常压缩后再快速压缩，仍必须保留摘要边界并允许安全删除。
5. 选择期间由另一客户端改变历史。冲突必须清除旧选择并提示重新选择，不能自动重发删除。会话忙碌时必须拒绝删除。若持久化成功而上下文安装失败，已删除身份仍必须返回发起方，界面必须对账，后续发送明确要求重新打开会话。重新加载失败时必须保留未选本地命令。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前没有整组物理删除入口。修改后的截图展示更多操作入口、联动的非连续选择，以及删除后保留的中间组。

**所有截图使用模拟 daemon HTTP/SSE 后端，并经过目视检查，只证明 UI 行为；真实 JSONL 和模型上下文验证另行使用真实 daemon、ACP 进程及确定性的本地模型完成。** 图片仅存于 fork 的独立素材分支，链接固定到 commit `70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8`。

已在合并 main `87dcc4a7` 并修复 review 问题后重新捕获并目视检查以下 UI 截图，仍使用模拟 daemon 响应。

对应截图：[更多操作菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/menu.png)、[联动的非连续整组选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/selection.png)、[删除第一与第三组后保留中间组](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/after-deletion.png)、[窄视口选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/mobile-selection.png)。[中英文证据说明](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/README.md)。

本轮恢复证据（模拟 daemon）：[不支持删除的明确提示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/unsupported.png)、[他端轮次期间禁用确认](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/busy-confirm.png)、[他端删除后清空选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/peer-selection.png)。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22；build、bundle、typecheck、定向单测及浏览器/后端 E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未验证 |

### 验证环境

本地 worktree 开发和打包运行时；UI 与错误恢复使用 Chromium Playwright 和模拟 daemon 响应；持久化与模型上下文使用隔离的真实 daemon/ACP/JSONL 以及确定性的本地 OpenAI 兼容模型。最新删除浏览器用例 24/24 通过，包含本轮 review 回归。独立 E2E 报告评论记录了验证层级与结果。

## 风险与范围

- 物理删除不可撤销。按照设计，已有摘要可能仍包含已删除原文的信息；不会重新生成或修改摘要文字。
- 仅支持普通本地 daemon 会话。Managed 权威存储、SSH 工作区和 hosted harness profile 不支持该操作；旧压缩记录归属不明确时安全拒绝。
- 会话忙碌时拒绝删除。持久化后失败时保持发送门禁关闭，直至重新打开会话，不能继续使用旧模型上下文。
- 该功能涉及转录持久化和跨包会话契约，请维护者审阅。不新增依赖或历史迁移，保留正常追加与恢复行为。
- 本地未验证 Windows、Linux 或真实外部模型供应商。

prs.title: fix(cli): hold pre-runtime /acp WebSocket upgrades instead of falling through to a 406 (#13995)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A fast-path `qwen serve` boot (any invocation without `--open`) listens with a deferred runtime: the HTTP server accepts connections before the runtime app — and therefore the ACP WebSocket transport — exists, and the `upgrade` listener is only registered once the deferred runtime finishes. An `/acp` WebSocket upgrade that arrives in that boot window finds no `upgrade` listener, so Node routes it to Express as a plain GET; the delegating app holds it until the runtime is ready and then forwards it to the SSE `GET /acp` handler, which answers a misleading `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`. The first WebSocket connection to a freshly booted daemon therefore always failed.

This PR installs a pre-listen `upgrade` guard on the primary server. While the ACP transport is not yet attached, the guard holds the upgrade — mirroring the hold the delegating app already gives REST requests during the same window — lets it trigger the deferred runtime start (the same start-on-request behavior a REST request gets), and replays queued upgrades once the transport attaches. Replayed upgrades go through the real listener, so authentication, origin checks, and path routing are unchanged. Once no transport can still arrive (runtime settled without one, startup failed, or the daemon is shutting down), the gate closes and late upgrades get a retryable `503` with `Retry-After: 1`, matching the not-ready postures elsewhere on this surface.

## Why it's needed

Main CI run 38267397252 (commit `14cc19b4bdc8`) failed the `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` shard on `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` and `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot` (#13995). The client-MCP failure reproduces deterministically outside CI: with vitest retries disabled it failed 8/8 with `Unexpected server response: 406`, because the test connects to `/acp` immediately after the daemon prints `listening on`. Vitest's `retry: 2` usually masked the window (a retry lands after the transport attaches), until a loaded docker-leg shard widened it past the retry spacing. Beyond the tests, any real client that opens a socket right after daemon boot — desktop app, web shell, SDK — hit the same bogus 406 instead of simply connecting.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` — the full serve suite passes (501 tests), including the two new witnesses: an `/acp` upgrade arriving in the deferred boot window is held and completes with wire status `101` (and itself forces the deferred runtime up), and a failed runtime start answers a held upgrade with a retryable `503`.
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` — with retries disabled, both previously failing suites pass; before this change the discovery test failed every first attempt with `Unexpected server response: 406`.
3. Sanity-check the window by hand: `node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t` and immediately open a WebSocket to `/acp` — the socket connects after the brief runtime start instead of erroring with 406.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon transport change; no UI). Wire-level behavior for a boot-window `/acp` upgrade: before — `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`; after — `101 Switching Protocols` once the runtime attaches, or a retryable `503` if the runtime can no longer start.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux container; E2E run with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` (Docker unavailable here, so the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg was not reproducible locally and remains the CI-side gate).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guard holds early upgrades until the deferred runtime attaches, so a client that connects during the boot window sees a short connect delay (bounded by the runtime startup timeout) instead of an immediate error — this matches the existing REST behavior during the same window.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact `sandbox:docker` CI leg (no Docker in the authoring environment); the channel-workers test did not reproduce locally, but its flow is REST-first and the fix removes the boot-window WS failure class for every path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A boot-window `/acp` upgrade that previously failed with 406 now upgrades (101) once the runtime attaches, or receives `503` + `Retry-After` if the runtime cannot start.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13995

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

fast-path `qwen serve` 启动(任何不带 `--open` 的调用)会推迟运行时的构建:HTTP server 在 runtime app —— 也就是 ACP WebSocket 传输层 —— 存在之前就开始接受连接,`upgrade` 监听器直到被推迟的 runtime 完成时才注册。在这个启动窗口内到达的 `/acp` WebSocket upgrade 找不到 `upgrade` 监听器,于是 Node 把它当作普通 GET 交给 Express;delegating app 会把这个 GET 挂起直到 runtime 就绪,再转发给 SSE 的 `GET /acp` 处理器,后者返回误导性的 `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`。因此,新建的 daemon 上的第一个 WebSocket 连接总是失败。

本 PR 在主 server 上、listen 之前安装了一个 `upgrade` 守卫。在 ACP 传输层注册之前,守卫会挂起 upgrade —— 与 delegating app 在同一窗口期对 REST 请求的挂起行为一致 —— 并让它触发被推迟的 runtime 启动(与 REST 请求获得的按需启动行为一致),然后在传输层注册后重放队列中的 upgrade。重放的 upgrade 会经过真正的监听器,因此认证、Origin 检查和路径路由完全不变。一旦不可能再有传输层到来(runtime 已就绪但未注册、启动失败、或 daemon 正在关闭),门闩关闭,后来的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503` 并带 `Retry-After: 1`,与该接口其他未就绪场景的处理姿态一致。

## 为什么需要

Main CI 运行 38267397252(提交 `14cc19b4bdc8`)在 `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker` 分片上失败,涉及 `qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts > discovers a client-hosted tool end-to-end via the ACP child` 和 `qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts > controls a real mock-plugin worker after a channel-less boot`(#13995)。client-MCP 的失败在 CI 之外可以确定性复现:禁用 vitest 重试时 8 次运行 8 次失败,报错 `Unexpected server response: 406`,因为该测试在 daemon 打印 `listening on` 后立即连接 `/acp`。Vitest 的 `retry: 2` 通常掩盖了这个窗口(重试到来时传输层已注册),直到某个高负载的 docker 分片把窗口拉得比重试间隔还长。除测试外,任何在 daemon 启动后立即建立连接的真实客户端 —— 桌面应用、web shell、SDK —— 都会遇到同样的错误 406,而不是正常连接。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts` —— 整个 serve 套件通过(501 个测试),包括两个新见证测试:在 deferred 启动窗口期到达的 `/acp` upgrade 会被挂起并以 `101` 完成升级(且该 upgrade 本身会触发 deferred runtime 启动);runtime 启动失败时,被挂起的 upgrade 会收到可重试的 `503`。
2. `cd integration-tests && npx cross-env QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/qwen-serve-channel-workers.test.ts cli/qwen-serve-client-mcp.test.ts --retry=0` —— 禁用重试时,两个此前失败的套件都能通过;修复前,discovery 测试的首次尝试每次都因 `Unexpected server response: 406` 失败。
3. 手工验证窗口行为:`node dist/cli.js serve --port 0 --token t`,然后立即建立到 `/acp` 的 WebSocket —— 连接会在短暂的 runtime 启动后成功,而不是报 406。

### 前后对比证据

N/A(daemon 传输层变更,无 UI)。启动窗口内 `/acp` upgrade 的线上行为:修复前 —— `406 Accept header must include text/event-stream`;修复后 —— runtime 注册后 `101 Switching Protocols`,若 runtime 无法启动则可重试的 `503`。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

本地 Linux 容器;E2E 以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 运行(本环境无 Docker,无法在本地复现与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支,该分支仍由 CI 把关)。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:守卫会把早期 upgrade 挂起到 deferred runtime 注册为止,因此在启动窗口内连接的客户端会看到短暂的连接延迟(上限为 runtime 启动超时),而不是立即报错 —— 这与同一窗口期内 REST 请求的既有行为一致。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内:与 CI 完全一致的 `sandbox:docker` 分支(编写环境无 Docker);channel-workers 测试未在本地复现,但其流程以 REST 为先,且本次修复为所有路径消除了启动窗口期的 WS 失败类别。

prs.title: fix(core): widen the agent workspace lock retry budget (#14028)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the cross-process workspace lock's acquisition retry budget from 10 retries (5–100ms randomized exponential backoff, ~0.65–1.3s worst case) to 30 retries (~5s worst case), matching the budget the Agent Board lock already uses for the same two-tier locking pattern. Everything else about the lock is unchanged: the in-process mutex still serializes same-process writers, and stale-lock breaking (`stale: 10_000`) still recovers a dead holder's lock after 10 seconds.

## Why it's needed

`main` CI failed on `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` (#14028). The test spawns two child processes that each perform 8 read-modify-write roster updates under the store's file lock. On an oversubscribed CI host, one holder's critical section — an fsync-bound atomic JSON write — can outlast the ~1s retry budget, so the competing process exhausted its retries, exited with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`, and failed the test. CI's `--retry=2` does not help because every attempt on a badly placed host hits the same contention. I reproduced this locally: pinned to 2 CPUs with CPU and fsync competitors, the pre-fix code failed 6 of 30 rounds with ELOCKED; with this change, 30 of 30 rounds passed. A longer wait is strictly safer here: the lock guards a low-frequency roster/registry store, so waiting a few seconds for a slow live holder is always preferable to erroring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the change is confined to the workspace store's lock options and that the concurrency test passes: run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts` and expect 1 passed test. To observe the original failure mode, revert the one-line change (`retries: 30` back to `10`) and run the same test on a heavily loaded machine (or pinned to few CPUs with competing load): the worker processes intermittently exit 1 with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`. With the fix, the waiters simply wait out the slow holder instead of erroring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible behavior change; the observable difference is CI stability under host contention: before, 6/30 contended probe rounds failed with ELOCKED; after, 0/30 failed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under `packages/core` (vitest), plus a local contention harness pinning the test scenario to 2 CPUs with busy CPU/fsync competitors.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a waiter now holds on for up to ~5s (was ~1s) before failing lock acquisition when a live holder is slow; a dead holder's lock is still broken after 10s via the unchanged stale detection, so crash recovery latency is unaffected.
- Not validated / out-of-scope: macOS and Windows lanes (left to CI; the change is a platform-independent timing budget). A deeper hardening — aborting a transaction whose lock is compromised mid-flight instead of only warning — is deliberately out of scope for this flake fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14028

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将跨进程 workspace 锁的获取重试预算从 10 次(5–100ms 随机指数退避,最坏约 0.65–1.3 秒)提高到 30 次(最坏约 5 秒),与 Agent Board 锁在相同双层锁模式下已有的预算一致。锁的其他行为完全不变:进程内互斥锁仍然串行化同进程写入者,过期锁打破机制(`stale: 10_000`)仍然会在 10 秒后回收已崩溃持锁者留下的锁。

## 为什么需要

`main` 分支 CI 在 `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` 上失败(#14028)。该测试派生两个子进程,各自在存储的文件锁下执行 8 次 roster 读-改-写更新。在超额订阅的 CI 主机上,持锁者的一次临界区——带 fsync 的原子 JSON 写入——可能超过约 1 秒的重试预算,导致竞争进程重试耗尽后以 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held` 退出,测试失败。CI 的 `--retry=2` 帮不上忙,因为在被调度到繁忙主机时,每次尝试都会遇到同样的争用。我已在本地复现:固定到 2 个 CPU 并加入 CPU 与 fsync 竞争负载时,修复前的代码在 30 轮中有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;应用本改动后,30 轮全部通过。此处更长的等待严格更安全:该锁守护的是低频的 roster/注册表存储,为一个缓慢的活跃持锁者多等几秒永远优于直接报错。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认改动仅限于 workspace 存储的锁参数,且并发测试通过:运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts`,预期 1 个测试通过。若要观察原始失败模式,可将这一行改动回退(`retries: 30` 改回 `10`),并在负载较重的机器上(或绑定到少量 CPU 并施加竞争负载)运行同一测试:worker 进程会间歇性地以退出码 1 失败,报 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`。应用修复后,等待者会等待缓慢的持锁者完成,而不是报错。

### 前后对照证据

N/A(无用户可见的行为变化;可观察的差异是主机争用下的 CI 稳定性:修复前,30 轮带载探测有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;修复后,30 轮无一失败)。

### 已测试平台

|     系统    |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

`packages/core` 下的单元测试(vitest),以及一个将测试场景固定到 2 个 CPU 并施加 CPU/fsync 竞争负载的本地争用 harness。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:当活跃持锁者较慢时,等待者现在最多坚持约 5 秒(原来约 1 秒)才会放弃锁获取;已崩溃持锁者的锁仍会通过未改动的过期检测在 10 秒后被打破,因此崩溃恢复延迟不受影响。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:macOS 与 Windows 通道(交由 CI 覆盖;本改动是平台无关的计时预算)。更深一层的加固——在锁中途被夺时中止事务而不是仅告警——刻意不纳入本次抖动修复的范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14028

prs.title: test(managed-agent): Measure the post-commit gate as per-round growth (#14197)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Changes the MQ2 post-commit latency gate in `EventTransportBrokerGate` to compare the flag-on and flag-off arms as the per-round growth at p95, instead of comparing the p95 order statistics of two independent sample distributions. The arms are interleaved on one thread, so machine-wide noise on a shared CI runner lands on both arms of a round and cancels; a real regression — the event transport adding work to every committing-thread publish — shifts every round's delta and still fails the one-millisecond budget. The journal hand-off keeps its absolute 20 ms p95 budget, and the `target/event-transport-latency.json` record keeps the on/off figures with the delta added for forensics. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

The gate failed on main (#14197) less than two hours after it landed in #14109, on a commit that does not touch the event-transport path. The measured work per arm is tens of microseconds, so on the shared two-core CI runners scheduler preemption and GC jitter dominate the samples, and a whole-millisecond budget over a difference of two order statistics trips on timing noise alone. The rocketmq-client-java 5.1.0 sources confirm both production paths hand off asynchronously (a bounded-queue offer for the public transport, a non-blocking gRPC enqueue for the journal wire), so the fix belongs in the test's statistic, not in the product.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start the gate broker with `scripts/rocketmq-lite-broker.sh start` (with the CI's `RMQ_EXTRA_GROUPS`/`RMQ_NORMAL_TOPIC`/`RMQ_NORMAL_GROUPS` settings), then run `mvn -f packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Pevent-transport-broker-gates -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.endpoints=127.0.0.1:18081 -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.topic=qwen-managed-events -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.normal-topic=qwen-managed-events-normal clean verify`. Expected: all seven gate rows pass and `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/target/event-transport-latency.json` reports `publishP95Micros.delta` and `hubDeliveryP95Micros.delta` far under 1000 µs. The EventTransport broker gates job on this PR is the authoritative check on a shared runner.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test-only change; no user-visible behavior). Before: `thePostCommitPathDoesNotRegress` asserted `p95(on) <= p95(off) + 1ms` and flaked on main. After: it asserts `p95(per-round on-minus-off) <= 1ms`; run three times locally (uncontended, original code under 2-core CPU contention, fixed code under the same contention) with all seven tests green each time and the delta p95 at 26–31 µs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Temurin JDK 21 (tests) / 17 (broker), RocketMQ 5.5.1 single-node cluster from `scripts/rocketmq-lite-broker.sh`, Maven 3.9.11.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate's statistic changes from a difference of two p95 estimates to the p95 of per-round growth; both implement the design doc's "may not grow by a millisecond at p95", and a uniform per-round cost still fails deterministically.
- Not validated / out of scope: the original flake was not reproduced on demand (one contended run of the original code passed — it is a tail-probability failure); the journal hand-off's absolute 20 ms budget is unchanged; no production behavior changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14197

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 `EventTransportBrokerGate` 中 MQ2 提交后延迟门禁的比较方式,从"两个独立样本分布各自的 p95 次序统计量之差"改为"逐轮增长量的 p95"。两臂在同一线程上交替执行,共享 CI 运行器上的整机噪声会落在同一轮的两臂上从而相互抵消;而真正的回归——event transport 给每一次提交线程 publish 都增加工作量——会使每轮 delta 整体平移,仍然触发 1 毫秒预算。journal 交接保留原有的 20ms 绝对 p95 预算;`target/event-transport-latency.json` 保留 on/off 数据并新增 delta 以供排查。不改动任何生产代码。

## 为什么需要

该门禁在 #14109 合入后不到两小时就在 main 上失败(#14197),而失败的提交并未改动 event-transport 相关路径。每臂单次测量只有几十微秒,在共享的双核 CI 运行器上,调度抢占和 GC 抖动主导了样本,对两个次序统计量之差设 1 毫秒预算会被纯计时噪声触发。查阅 rocketmq-client-java 5.1.0 源码可确认两条生产路径都是异步交接(公开 transport 是一次有界队列 offer,journal 线是一次非阻塞 gRPC 入队),因此修复应落在测试的统计方法上,而不是产品上。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

用 `scripts/rocketmq-lite-broker.sh start` 启动门禁 broker(带上 CI 的 `RMQ_EXTRA_GROUPS`/`RMQ_NORMAL_TOPIC`/`RMQ_NORMAL_GROUPS` 设置),然后运行 `mvn -f packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Pevent-transport-broker-gates -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.endpoints=127.0.0.1:18081 -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.topic=qwen-managed-events -Dqwen.gate.rocketmq.normal-topic=qwen-managed-events-normal clean verify`。预期:全部七条门禁行通过,且 `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/target/event-transport-latency.json` 中 `publishP95Micros.delta` 和 `hubDeliveryP95Micros.delta` 远低于 1000 µs。本 PR 的 EventTransport broker gates CI 任务是共享运行器上的权威验证。

### 前后对比证据

N/A(纯测试改动,无用户可见行为)。修复前:`thePostCommitPathDoesNotRegress` 断言 `p95(on) <= p95(off) + 1ms`,在 main 上抖动失败。修复后:断言 `p95(逐轮 on 减 off) <= 1ms`;本地共运行三次(无争用、原始代码双核 CPU 争用、修复后代码同样争用),每次七条测试全部通过,delta p95 为 26–31 µs。

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

Fixes #11553
