prs.title: feat(runtime): develop cumulative K2 CSI runtime and retirement
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Continues the private K2 CSI retirement implementation while preserving ordinary Workspace behavior from main `3547398d2`. The resident Workspace first release is separate and merged as #14340. Logical close still does not authorize physical release or cross-Workspace volume reuse.

The cumulative implementation includes bounded application settlement and native cut/finalization, immutable physical-progress plans and normal deletion attempts, paired sandbox/worker pre-execution births, protected service inputs, and offline image/policy/installation byte association. Runtime identity/2 compares both service roles with independent installation metadata. Source/7 now persists both actual byte observations and the original kubelet/registrar identities; publication must match the original ARM kubelet. Java derives mandatory expectations from separately reviewed metadata and validates them before persistence and again on restored reads. Old journals and Node configurations lacking these fields refuse without conversion.

The source/shim creator channel also retains the original process leader’s user/mount namespace descriptors. Existing peer checks compare retained and currently named kernel objects between the original process checks, require the supported initial-user invariant, and refuse changed or unavailable objects. This guard is a native implementation candidate verified by compilation only; its deployment permissions and runtime behavior remain unverified.

The runtime, CSI backend, kubelet and registrar now also retain the original proc directory and user/mount namespace descriptors, compare the actual executable path and enforced label with the protected host target, and refuse lost or changed peers. The gateway retains its original namespace pair and checks the leader and current locked request thread at the existing control boundaries. The gateway policy adds only the two fixed namespace read leaves. These are sampled guards, not proof about every thread or the interval between observations.

The service checks now read effective unit properties over the retained original systemd connection, and the gateway checks selected effective CRI settings over its original containerd connection before serving and at both control boundaries. A generator/consumer mismatch is also fixed: the existing K2 handler and custom shim path now use the builtin runc options type expected by the actual readers. These are sampled guards with permanent refusal after failure; they do not establish installation or final release authority.

The installation checks now also compare the overlay plugin's reported actual root with the independently validated protected target directory. The read uses the same original connection and shared verification deadline, refuses the pinned upstream proxy shape and permanently closes after a failed observation. Root metadata equality does not establish filesystem or mount identity.

## Why it's needed

A logical Session close or mount handback cannot establish that the original container has stopped and that its volume is safe for another owner. K2 must preserve the original birth, installed inputs and ownership chain before accepting stop/unpublish evidence or releasing storage.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Ordinary Session/storage/mount-handback behavior should retain main’s semantics. Published V1–V8 bytes remain intact; the unchanged private extension uses V9. Incompatible private catalogs, SSH operations in this private CSI subset, partial receipts and unexpected ownership changes must refuse.
2. New source records should require both complete role observations and the original ARM frontend pair. A consistently substituted later caller must still fail; matching record shape alone must not supply installation or release authority.
3. Independently changed metadata must refuse against the original observed identity. Frontend expectation mismatch must fail before SQL; successful saved configuration and all original evidence prefixes must survive a fresh store read byte for byte.
4. Offline stages must preserve exact input/hash associations and role boundaries without opening referenced credentials or executing a parser during data tests. Namespace loss must use the existing error/Lost/block path; an already durable earlier prefix must remain intact rather than being rewritten.
5. Protocol UNPUBLISHED, metadata consistency, namespace checks and logical close must leave physical release, later-cycle reservation and public CSI selection closed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Root build/typecheck passed. The current source/7 slice passed 205 explicitly selected Java JSON/H2/Mockito tests plus Checkstyle/SpotBugs, and 15 portable Go artifactset groups. An independently compiled copy passed the same 205 tests, 20 additional structured data/SQL observations and 13 identical Go/Java pair vectors. These observation counts are not additional full test counts. Source/6’s original 75,909 bytes remain unchanged and are rejected by the new reader; the explicit synthetic source/7 fixture is accepted. Independent frontend mismatches made zero JDBC calls; configuration and three saved prefixes survived restart unchanged.

Six source/shim/assembler outputs compiled for Linux amd64/arm64 after the namespace change and were never executed. That guard has no native runtime acceptance. The independent data exporter’s initial serialization failure and root’s earlier fixture/style failures remain recorded separately; only their corrected runs are green. Synthetic metadata and journals provide no installation qualification.

The host-peer continuation separately passed 16 portable artifactset groups (77 cases including subcases), all six actual Linux compile targets, and repository build/typecheck. Its 66 frozen inputs matched without source drift; two full increment self-audits were clean. The native FD/namespace/label path and loaded policy were not executed or qualified. No Java or SQL logic changed in this continuation, and earlier 205-case Java evidence remains attached to its exact earlier candidate.

The effective-service increment passed 5 portable groups (112 cases including subcases) and retained the 16 artifactset groups (77 cases). The CRI increment passed 7 portable groups (153 cases); an independent test engineer decoded the actual generated TOML constant and called the pinned upstream options producer and Any roundtrip, confirming the fixed type and the old-type negative. Both increments passed their six actual Linux compile targets without executing outputs, root build/typecheck, two whole-increment self-audits and independent static inspection; the CRI fix also passed bundle. Its 81 frozen inputs and complete staged diff matched the reviewed candidate. Native service/config behavior and target vendor startup remain unaccepted; unchanged earlier Java evidence is not a new Java run.

The snapshotter-root continuation passed 10 CRI groups (178 cases including subcases) and 16 artifactset groups (83 cases); independent count=1 verification passed the same 26 groups/261 cases. Six actual Linux outputs compiled and were never executed; root build/typecheck/bundle, six-document formatting, 32 local links, two full increment self-audits and independent static inspection passed. All 83 frozen inputs and the complete reviewed diff matched. These are data/compile/static results, with no target PluginInfo, filesystem/mount or installation qualification and no new Java/SQL acceptance.

Earlier main-merge, application, image and policy evidence remains bound to its exact original candidates, as reported in prior PR comments. It does not transfer qualification to the current binaries. No complete current Java/native/Hosted/MySQL or physical-reuse suite has run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | Selected ordinary data/H2/mock tests, repository build/typecheck and static checks |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux amd64/arm64 | Cross-compilation only; current native installation not tested |

## Risk & Scope

This remains a cumulative Draft touching core and multiple packages; maintainer architecture review and a shipping review verdict are outstanding. Complete installation provenance, qualification of the effective runtime/unit guards, LSM/host-actor containment and exclusive CSI evidence remain unfinished. Final physical authority, the atomic four-row release, complete released-credential replay and safe later-cycle reuse are still missing code and acceptance; the existing refusal fence remains.

Source/gateway must be deployed as a matching pair. Source/6 and old Node JSON are not upgraded; use the original binary for old private histories. No database repair, positive-evidence backfill or transfer of old ACK qualification is provided. This continuation created no cloud resources.

Synchronized designs: snapshotter root [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-k2-snapshotter-root.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-k2-snapshotter-root.zh-CN.md); host peer continuity [English](docs/design/2026-10-17-k2-host-peer-continuity.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-17-k2-host-peer-continuity.zh-CN.md); installed-byte journal [English](docs/design/2026-10-17-k2-installed-byte-journal.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-17-k2-installed-byte-journal.zh-CN.md); birth and namespace candidate [English](docs/design/2026-10-16-k2-pre-exec-birth.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-16-k2-pre-exec-birth.zh-CN.md); canonical schema [English](docs/design/k2-canonical-schema-port.md) / [中文](docs/design/k2-canonical-schema-port.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13395. Resident first release: #14340. Full K2 remains open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

继续私有 K2 CSI 退役实现，同时保留主干 `3547398d2` 的普通 Workspace 行为。常驻 Workspace 首版已单独拆分并作为 #14340 合入。逻辑关闭仍不能授权物理释放或跨 Workspace 卷复用。

累计实现包含有界应用结算、原生 cut/finalization、不可变物理进度计划及正常删除尝试、配对 sandbox/worker 首次执行前出生、受保护服务输入，以及离线镜像/策略/安装字节关联。Runtime identity/2 将两个服务角色与独立安装元数据比较。source/7 现持久记录两份实际字节观察和原 kubelet/registrar 身份，发布必须匹配 ARM 原 kubelet。Java 从独立已审元数据形成必填期待值，在持久保存前及恢复读取时核对。旧日志及缺字段 Node 配置拒绝，不转换。

source/shim 创建通道另持原 process leader 的 user/mount namespace 描述符，在原进程检查之间比较 held 及当前命名内核对象，要求支持范围内初始 user 不变量，对象变化或不可用即拒绝。这是仅经过编译的原生实现候选，实际部署权限和运行时行为尚未验收。

runtime、CSI backend、kubelet、registrar 另持原 proc 目录和 user/mount namespace 描述符，将实际 executable 路径及 enforce label 与受保护宿主 target 比较，原 peer 丢失或改变即拒绝。gateway 保留原 namespace 对，在既有 control 边界核 leader 与当前锁定请求线程；gateway 策略只增加两个固定 namespace 只读叶子。这些属于采样守卫，不证明全部线程或两次观察间隔。

服务检查现通过持续持有的原 systemd 连接读取生效 unit 属性；gateway 在服务启动前及每次 control 两侧，通过原 containerd 连接核对选定生效 CRI 配置。同时修正 generator/consumer 类型不匹配：既有 K2 handler 和 custom shim 路径现选用实际读端要求的 builtin runc options 类型。这些属于失败后永久拒绝的采样守卫，不形成安装或最终释放 authority。

安装检查另将 overlay plugin 报告的实际 root 与独立校验的受保护目标目录比较。读取复用同一原连接和验证期限，拒绝固定上游 proxy 形状，观察失败后永久关闭当前 guard。根目录 metadata 相等不代表文件系统或挂载身份已获证明。

## 原因

逻辑 Session 关闭或挂载交还不能证明原容器已停止、卷可交给另一所有者。K2 必须先保持原始出生、安装输入及归属链，才能接受停止/卸载证据或释放存储。

## 审阅验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 普通 Session、存储及挂载交还保持主干语义。已发布 V1–V8 字节不变，原私有增量顺延为 V9。不兼容私有 catalog、此私有 CSI 子集内 SSH 操作、不完整回执和意外归属变化应拒绝。
2. 新来源记录必须包含两份完整角色观察和 ARM 原 frontend pair。即使后续 caller 一致替换，也须拒绝；记录结构匹配不能授予安装或释放权限。
3. 独立元数据变化应与原观察身份不符并拒绝。Frontend 期待值不匹配须在 SQL 前失败；正常保存的配置和全部原始证据前缀须由新 store 实例逐字节读回。
4. 离线阶段应保持准确输入/哈希关联和角色边界，普通数据测试不打开引用凭据、不执行 parser。Namespace 丢失应沿原错误/Lost/block 处理，保留此前已持久前缀，不改写历史。
5. 协议 UNPUBLISHED、元数据一致、namespace 检查和逻辑关闭均不能开启物理释放、后续占用或公开 CSI 选择。

### 证据（前后）

Root build/typecheck 通过。当前 source/7 增量205项明确选定 Java JSON/H2/Mockito 及 Checkstyle/SpotBugs 通过，15个可移植 Go artifactset 顶层组通过。独立源编译副本同205项通过，另20条结构化数据/SQL观察和13组相同 Go/Java pair 向量符合预期；这些观察项数不是额外完整测试数量。原 source/6 的75,909字节保持原样且被新读端拒绝，明确 synthetic 的 source/7 fixture 接受。独立 frontend 失配没有调用 JDBC；完整配置及三份已保存前缀重启后字节不变。

prs.title: fix(cli): Make interactive questions answerable from standard ACP hosts
prs.body:
## What this PR does The interactive question tool (`ask_user_question`) is projected onto the Agent Client Protocol as a permission request, but the real per-question choices only ever travelled in a Qwen-specific metadata field that the protocol tells conforming clients to ignore. A standard ACP host therefore rendered a raw JSON payload, and the user could not actually answer: the single visible button submitted an empty answer. This PR makes the question answerable everywhere by projecting the question text and every choice into the standard tool-call content, and — for clients that do not opt in to the Qwen question payload — by offering real per-choice options in the permission request, exactly like an ordinary approval prompt, with the answer recovered from the option the user picks. Clients that do understand the Qwen payload keep their existing rich flow unchanged. ## Why it's needed Today the question tool is unusable through any ACP host that does not implement Qwen's private contract: the user sees "Raw Input", and even pressing the one available button returns nothing, because the answer was read from a response field the protocol does not define. This is the bug reported in the linked issue. The fix also has to avoid regressing the Qwen-owned surfaces — the VS Code companion, the web shell, channel cards, the daemon bridge, and the voice client — all of which consume the rich payload today. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify A reviewer can confirm the behavior with the focused test suites; no IDE is required: ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` Expected outcomes to check in the tests: - With the capability absent, a single question produces one option per choice, followed by `Other…` and `Cancel`; picking one returns the matching label. - With the capability advertised (as the in-repo Qwen clients do), the generic `Submit`/`Cancel` pair is preserved. - A multi-question request is not flattened — the questions and choices still appear as readable content. - The question text and every choice are present in the standard tool-call content regardless of capability. ### Evidence (Before & After) Zed end-to-end, same prompt (one question, two options: `Day.js` / `date-fns`). **Before** — the question arrives as a raw JSON payload and the only actions are `Submit` and `Cancel`; submitting returns nothing, so the tool reports "No valid answers were provided.". **After** — the question is readable and every choice is a real selectable option, alongside `Other…` and `Cancel`. **After, round-trip** — picking `Day.js` is delivered to the model as the answer, and the agent continues with it. Focused suites and checks: ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment (optional) Unit tests and type checks, plus a Zed end-to-end run against a local build of this branch (Zed custom agent launching `--acp`). No sandbox was used. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the new flat option list only applies when a client does not advertise the Qwen question capability, so the blast radius is limited to non-Qwen ACP hosts. The content projection is additive and ignored by clients that render their own question card. - Not validated / out of scope: a multi-question request (2–4 questions) is intentionally not flattened, because the protocol has no multi-form primitive and interleaving choices from different questions would be ambiguous; those questions are shown as text and remain fully answerable only from the Qwen-compatible surfaces. `multiSelect` questions degrade to a single choice. Sequential per-question permission requests are not implemented. The Zed run above covers a single, single-select question; the multi-question and `multiSelect` cases were not exercised in Zed. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the Qwen-owned clients, which keep the same option set. One behaviour change for third-party ACP hosts and external harnesses that auto-approve by selecting the first `allow_once` option: on a flattened question that is now the first choice, where it previously hit `proceed_once` and produced a visible "No valid answers were provided." — worth a release note. ## Linked Issues Fixes #11361 Design document (both language versions): - [English](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)
中文说明 ## What this PR does（本 PR 做了什么） 交互式提问工具（`ask_user_question`）目前被投影为 Agent Client Protocol 的一次权限请求，但真正的逐题选项只通过 Qwen 专有的元数据字段传递，而协议要求符合规范的客户端忽略该字段。因此标准 ACP 宿主只能渲染原始 JSON，用户实际上无法作答：唯一可见的按钮提交的是空答案。本 PR 让问题在所有宿主上都能作答：始终把问题文本与每个选项投影进标准工具调用内容；对于未声明支持 Qwen 问题载荷的客户端，直接在权限请求中给出真实的逐选项选项（与普通审批提示完全一致），并从用户所选的选项恢复答案。理解 Qwen 载荷的客户端保持原有丰富流程不变。 ## Why it's needed（为什么需要） 目前，任何未实现 Qwen 私有契约的 ACP 宿主都无法使用该提问工具：用户看到的是 "Raw Input"，而且即使按下唯一可用的按钮也不会返回任何内容，因为答案是从协议未定义的响应字段读取的。这正是所链接 issue 报告的问题。该修复还必须避免回退 Qwen 自有界面——VS Code 伴侣、Web Shell、渠道卡片、daemon bridge 以及语音客户端——它们目前消费的是丰富载荷。 ## Reviewer Test Plan（评审测试计划） ### How to verify（如何验证） 评审者可用聚焦测试套件确认行为，无需 IDE： ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` 测试中应确认的结果： - 未声明能力时，单个问题为每个选项给出一个选项，其后是 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`；选择其一即返回对应标签。 - 声明能力时（仓库内 Qwen 客户端即如此），保留通用的 `Submit`/`Cancel` 按钮对。 - 多问题请求不会被扁平化——问题与选项仍以可读内容呈现。 - 无论能力如何，问题文本与每个选项都出现在标准工具调用内容中。 ### Evidence (Before & After)（证据） Zed 端到端，同一提示词（一个问题，两个选项：`Day.js` / `date-fns`）。 **Before**——问题以原始 JSON 形式到达，仅有的操作是 `Submit` 与 `Cancel`；提交后不会返回任何内容，因此工具报告 "No valid answers were provided."。 **After**——问题可读，每个选项都是真正可选的选项，另有 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`。 **After，往返**——选择 `Day.js` 会作为答案传回模型，agent 随之继续。 聚焦测试套件与检查： ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on（测试平台） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment（环境） 单元测试与类型检查，外加使用本分支本地构建的 Zed 端到端运行（Zed 自定义 agent 启动 `--acp`）。未使用 sandbox。 ## Risk & Scope（风险与范围） - 主要风险或取舍：新的扁平选项列表仅在客户端未声明 Qwen 问题能力时生效，影响范围限于非 Qwen 的 ACP 宿主。内容投影为增量改动，会渲染自有问题卡片的客户端会忽略它。 - 未验证 / 范围之外：多问题请求（2–4 个问题）有意不扁平化，因为协议没有多表单原语，把不同问题的选项交错会产生歧义；这些问题以文本呈现，且仅在 Qwen 兼容界面中可完整作答。`multiSelect` 问题降级为单选。未实现逐题顺序权限请求。上文的 Zed 运行仅覆盖单个单选问题；多问题与 `multiSelect` 情形未在 Zed 中验证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 Qwen 自有客户端无破坏性，选项集合保持不变。对通过「选择第一个 `allow_once` 选项」自动批准的第三方 ACP 宿主与外部测试框架：扁平化问题现在会把该第一个选项记录为答案，而此前会命中 `proceed_once` 并产生可见的 "No valid answers were provided."——建议在 release notes 中说明。 ## Linked Issues（关联 Issue） Fixes #11361 设计文档（中英双版本）： - [英文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: test(integration-tests): parse only complete wire rows in the hosted wedge driver
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The hosted recovery-blocked wedge driver now reads its wire log only up to the last newline. A row that is still being appended is left for the next poll instead of being handed to `JSON.parse`. This is a test-driver change only; no product code changes.

## Why it's needed

The driver records every proxied store call by appending one JSON row per call to its wire file, and the same driver polls that file through `waitUntil` while proxied requests are still in flight. `appendFile` is not atomic with respect to a concurrent `readFile`, so a read can end in the middle of a row. The old reader split the whole text and parsed every non-empty line, so a half-written last row threw `SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON` and aborted the driver, which failed the gate even though the system under test behaved correctly.

That is what failed `HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen` on the Hosted process fault gates lane ([job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39041987043/job/117425416050)):

```
WEDGE_DRIVER_FAILURE SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON at position 436 (line 1 column 437)
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at readWire (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:565:8)
    at async waitUntil (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-harness-process.ts:27:12)
    at async detachedArmOf (integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts:1036:7)
```

`HostedRecoveryWedgeGate` runs the same driver, so it had the same exposure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Read `readWire` in `integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts`: it slices the text at `lastIndexOf('\n') + 1` before splitting, so only newline-terminated rows are parsed. `wire()` always writes a row followed by `\n`, so a finished append is never dropped; a partial tail becomes visible on the next poll.
2. The race can be reproduced outside the gate with a small Node script that appends rows of the same shape (`JSON.stringify({ t, ... }) + '\n'`, 400 to 700 bytes) with `appendFile` while a loop reads the file with `readFile` and parses it both ways.
3. In CI, the Hosted process fault gates lane runs both gates in the `SDK Java (full)` tier.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Local probe, 20,000 appended rows read concurrently (Node 24, Linux x86_64):

| Run | Reads | Reads ending mid-row | Old reader threw | New reader threw |
| :-: | :---: | :------------------: | :--------------: | :--------------: |
| 1 | 2040 | 14 | 14 | 0 |
| 2 | 2152 | 10 | 10 | 0 |

Every read that ended mid-row made the old reader throw; the new reader parsed every read.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

Standalone Node probe plus `prettier` and `eslint` on the changed file. The Java gates themselves were not run locally; they run on the CI full tier.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a read now skips a row that is still being appended. The store proxy finishes appending its `store-end` row before it relays the reply, so a row whose effect the driver has already observed is always complete; only a request still in flight can be cut, and the next poll sees it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other failures on the same full run (#14494, the MariaDB lane's `400 runtime_broker_invalid_request`) and the unrelated red lanes on `main` are not addressed here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14495

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

hosted recovery-blocked wedge 测试驱动读取 wire 日志时，只读到最后一个换行符为止。还没写完的那一行留给下一次轮询，不再交给 `JSON.parse`。本 PR 只改测试驱动，不改产品代码。

## 为什么需要

驱动每代理一次 store 调用，就向 wire 文件追加一行 JSON；同一个驱动又在代理请求仍在进行时通过 `waitUntil` 轮询这个文件。`appendFile` 相对并发的 `readFile` 不是原子的，读到的内容可能停在某一行的中间。旧的读取逻辑把整段文本切行并解析所有非空行，于是写到一半的最后一行会抛出 `SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON`，直接中止驱动。被测系统本身没有问题，但门禁失败了。

Hosted process fault gates 这条 lane 上 `HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen` 的失败就是这个原因（[job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39041987043/job/117425416050)），堆栈见上文英文部分。

`HostedRecoveryWedgeGate` 使用同一个驱动，也有同样的风险。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 查看 `integration-tests/helpers/hosted-recovery-blocked-wedge-driver.ts` 中的 `readWire`：切行之前先按 `lastIndexOf('\n') + 1` 截断文本，所以只解析以换行结尾的行。`wire()` 每次写入都以 `\n` 结尾，已经写完的行不会被丢掉；写到一半的末尾会在下一次轮询时出现。
2. 可以在门禁之外用一个小的 Node 脚本复现这个竞争：用 `appendFile` 追加同样形状的行（`JSON.stringify({ t, ... }) + '\n'`，400 到 700 字节），同时循环用 `readFile` 读取文件，并用新旧两种方式解析。
3. CI 中，Hosted process fault gates lane 在 `SDK Java (full)` 层级运行这两个门禁。

### 证据（修复前后）

本地探针，并发读取的同时追加 20,000 行（Node 24，Linux x86_64）：

| 轮次 | 读取次数 | 读到半行的次数 | 旧逻辑抛错 | 新逻辑抛错 |
| :-: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | 2040 | 14 | 14 | 0 |
| 2 | 2152 | 10 | 10 | 0 |

每次读到半行，旧逻辑都会抛错；新逻辑全部解析成功。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

独立的 Node 探针，加上对改动文件运行的 `prettier` 和 `eslint`。Java 门禁本身没有在本地运行，由 CI 的 full 层级运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：读取时会跳过一行仍在追加中的数据。store 代理先写完 `store-end` 行再转发响应，所以驱动已经观察到效果的那一行总是完整的；只有仍在进行中的请求可能被截断，下一次轮询会看到它。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：同一次 full 运行中的其他失败（#14494，MariaDB lane 上的 `400 runtime_broker_invalid_request`）以及 `main` 上其他无关的红色 lane，本 PR 不处理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14495

prs.title: test(core): witness the sealed Managed commit-proof clause
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the missing test witness for the sealed-Managed arm of the session-writer lock-record validator. A sealed Managed record whose commit proof is corrupt is now pinned as *not a seal*: acquiring the writer fails closed on a malformed lock, leaving the corrupt record on disk for diagnosis, instead of recognising it as a genuine seal that a certified takeover would then be handed.

The new cases corrupt only the commit proof of an otherwise valid sealed record, so the clause under test is the only thing that can reject it. Rejected: a fractional sequence, a textual sequence, a negative sequence, an absent sequence, a 63-character hash, an uppercase hash, a non-hex hash, and an array-wrapped hash (only the string guard rejects that last one — an array stringifies to the same 64 hex characters the pattern accepts). A companion case pins the lower bound as `>= 0` rather than `> 0`: sequence 0 stays a genuine seal, so a plain acquire conflicts and a certified one is handed the proof.

## Why it's needed

That clause is the only thing standing between a corrupt commit proof and a certified takeover receiving it, and nothing pinned it. As reported on the linked issue, mutating any one of its four checks left all 552 deterministic lease/authority/assembly/managed-session-log/sessionService/HTTP-store/engine tests green, and a real daemon archived the corrupted seal. The maintainer scoped the witness to a follow-up; this is that follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the suite that owns the file:

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/session-writer-lease.test.ts
```

Expected: 128 passed, 2 skipped. The nine new cases live in the existing `managed lock schema 3` block.

The witnesses are load-bearing, not decorative. Delete any one of the four checks in the commit-proof validator and at least one new case turns red — measured locally, restoring the source afterwards:

| mutation applied to the validator | new cases that fail |

prs.title: fix(sdk-java): keep the snapshot flag when a load copy restates child Workspaces (#13905 item 40)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Java SDK's request for loading a Hosted Harness session has two ways to state that the control plane serves child Workspaces. One also takes the snapshot capability. The other took only the child Workspace flag and set snapshots to off, so calling it on a copy that already served snapshots silently turned them off. Every other copy of the load request keeps the snapshot flag.

The shorter form now keeps the snapshot flag the copy already carries. Turning child Workspaces off still drops both flags, and turning them back on does not restore snapshots, as with the longer form.

## Why it's needed

This is item 40 of #13905, deferred from #14265's third review round. No caller in the control plane uses the shorter form today; each one passes both values. A future caller that restated child Workspaces on a copy, for example after a lifecycle copy, would lose snapshots with no error. The Hosted side would then treat that host as one that serves no snapshots, and stop offering the model a snapshot child.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Hosted Harness client tests in the Java SDK module: `mvn test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest`. The snapshot capability test now also checks four things:

- restating child Workspaces on a copy that serves snapshots keeps them;
- the same holds after a lifecycle copy;
- turning child Workspaces off drops both flags;
- turning them back on afterwards does not bring snapshots back.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: with the old setter restored and the new assertions kept, the test fails with `expected: <true> but was: <null>` at the first new assertion.
- After: the test passes. The module's full build passes too: 388 tests, 0 failures, 9 skipped, plus Checkstyle.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the shorter form no longer turns snapshots off on a copy that carries them. A caller that relied on it for that must pass both values. No caller in this repository does.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run, since the control plane does not call the shorter form. Item 39, the snapshot refusal's promise on a host that has since stopped serving snapshots, is separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for this repository. An outside user of the SDK that turned snapshots off through the shorter form must now pass both values.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13905. This settles item 40; the issue stays open for the remaining items.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Java SDK 中加载 Hosted Harness session 的请求，有两种方式声明控制面提供 child Workspace。一种同时接收 snapshot 能力；另一种只接收 child Workspace 开关，并把 snapshot 设为关闭，所以在已提供 snapshot 的副本上调用它，会悄无声息地关掉 snapshot。加载请求的其他所有副本方法都会保留 snapshot 标志。

现在较短的那种形式会保留副本已带有的 snapshot 标志。关闭 child Workspace 仍会同时去掉两个标志，之后再打开也不会恢复 snapshot，与较长的形式一致。

## 为什么需要

这是 #13905 的第 40 项，来自 #14265 第 3 轮评审的延后项。目前控制面没有任何调用方使用较短的形式，每处都传入两个值。但将来若有调用方在某个副本上（例如生命周期副本之后）重新声明 child Workspace，就会在没有任何报错的情况下丢掉 snapshot。Hosted 端随后会把该主机当作不提供 snapshot 的主机，不再向模型提供 snapshot child。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 Java SDK 模块中运行 Hosted Harness client 测试：`mvn test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest`。snapshot 能力测试现在额外检查四点：

- 在提供 snapshot 的副本上重新声明 child Workspace，snapshot 保留；
- 经过生命周期副本后同样保留；
- 关闭 child Workspace 会同时去掉两个标志；
- 之后再打开也不会恢复 snapshot。

### 证据（前后对比）

- 修复前：恢复旧的写法、保留新断言，测试在第一条新断言处失败：`expected: <true> but was: <null>`。
- 修复后：测试通过。模块的完整构建也通过：388 个测试，0 失败，9 个跳过，以及 Checkstyle。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

不适用，仅单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：较短的形式不再能在带有 snapshot 的副本上关闭 snapshot。依赖它来关闭的调用方需要改为传入两个值。本仓库中没有这样的调用方。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有做端到端运行，因为控制面不调用较短的形式。第 39 项（snapshot 拒绝提示在主机已停止提供 snapshot 时的承诺）是另一个问题。

Refs #13905。本 PR 处理第 40 项；该 issue 继续保持打开，处理其余各项。

prs.title: fix(extension): persist CDP reconnect backoff across service worker restarts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the CDP tunnel's reconnect backoff from in-memory state into `chrome.storage.session`, so the ladder survives MV3 service-worker restarts, and consults it from all three reconnect entry points: the live timer, the 30s keepalive alarm, and a cold `start()`. The backoff cap goes from 30s to 5 minutes.

## Why it's needed

The old ladder was in-memory only, but Chrome kills an idle MV3 worker after ~30s and the pending timer and delay state die with it. Each keepalive alarm then woke a fresh worker whose top-level `start()` retried immediately. Against a daemon that rejects the WebSocket upgrade, e.g. an extension origin missing from `--allow-origin`, that loop fired every 10–30s forever and logged ~4,000–6,000 rejection lines per day in the user's journal (#13966). With the ladder persisted, repeated rejections now space out exponentially up to one attempt per 5 minutes, and recovery is still instant once the daemon accepts a handshake (the state clears on the first successful `onopen`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/chrome-extension && npm test`: 149/149 pass, including the new `src/daemon/reconnect-backoff.test.ts` (5 cases: ladder doubling and cap, escalation across calls, config-change reset, `isBackingOff` expiry, clear-on-success).
2. `npm run typecheck` is clean and `npm run build` bundles the new module into `dist/extension/background/service-worker.js`.
3. Manual sanity (optional): load the unpacked extension with a `qwen serve` daemon that lacks the extension origin in `--allow-origin`, watch `chrome://extensions` service-worker logs. Reconnect attempts should space 1s, 2s, 4s … rather than a flat retry every alarm tick. I did not run the real-Chrome pass myself; see below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change). Before, from the issue: daemon logs a `WebSocket upgrade rejected` line every ~10–30s indefinitely. After: attempts double from 1s up to a 5-minute cap, persisted across worker restarts.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, and production build all run. Windows/Linux: not run locally; the change uses only cross-platform extension APIs (`chrome.storage.session`, `chrome.alarms`).

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and build under the repo's Node/npm workspace. No live daemon used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a dropped *healthy* tunnel now shares the same persisted ladder, so a long-unreachable daemon is retried at most every 5 minutes instead of every 30s. That is the intended spam reduction; a freshly fixed daemon is picked up within minutes, and any successful open resets the ladder to 1s.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real-Chrome run against a rejecting daemon (no Chrome on this machine with the extension sideloaded); the reporter's other ask, a settings toggle to disable autoconnect entirely, is left for a follow-up since the 5-minute cap already removes the log-spam harm.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `chrome.storage.session` needs no new permission (`storage` is already declared) and clears on browser restart.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13966

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 CDP 隧道的重连退避从内存状态挪到 `chrome.storage.session`，让退避阶梯在 MV3 service worker 重启后仍然保留，并在全部三个重连入口（存活 worker 的定时器、30 秒 keepalive 闹钟、冷启动的 `start()`）统一查询它。退避上限从 30 秒提高到 5 分钟。

## 为什么需要

旧的退避阶梯只存在于内存，但 Chrome 会在 MV3 worker 空闲约 30 秒后把它杀掉，挂起的定时器和延迟状态一起丢失。之后每次 keepalive 闹钟唤醒一个全新的 worker，其顶层 `start()` 会立即重试。当 daemon 拒绝 WebSocket 升级时（例如扩展 origin 不在 `--allow-origin` 里），这个循环每 10–30 秒触发一次、永不停止，每天在用户 journal 里刷约 4000–6000 行拒绝日志（见 #13966）。阶梯持久化之后，连续被拒绝时重试间隔按指数拉大，封顶每 5 分钟一次；而一旦 daemon 正常接受握手，恢复仍然是即时的（第一次成功 `onopen` 就清空状态）。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/chrome-extension && npm test`：149/149 通过，包括新增的 `src/daemon/reconnect-backoff.test.ts`（5 个用例：阶梯倍增与封顶、跨调用递增、配置变更重置、`isBackingOff` 过期语义、成功后清零）。
2. `npm run typecheck` 干净，`npm run build` 能把新模块打进 `dist/extension/background/service-worker.js`。
3. 手动抽查（可选）：以未加 `--allow-origin` 的 `qwen serve` 加载未打包扩展，观察 `chrome://extensions` 的 service worker 日志，重连间隔应为 1s、2s、4s…… 而不是每个闹钟周期平铺一次。我本人没跑真实 Chrome 环节，见下。

### 前后对比证据

无（无 UI 改动）。修复前（来自 issue）：daemon 每约 10–30 秒打一行 `WebSocket upgrade rejected`，永不停止。修复后：重试间隔从 1 秒指数倍增到 5 分钟封顶，且跨 worker 重启保持。

### 测试平台

macOS 已跑单测、typecheck、生产构建；Windows/Linux 未本地跑，但改动只用跨平台扩展 API（`chrome.storage.session`、`chrome.alarms`）。

### 环境（可选）

仓库自带 Node/npm workspace 下跑单测与构建，未使用真实 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：原本健康的隧道掉线后也共用同一条持久化阶梯，daemon 长期不可达时最多每 5 分钟重试一次（原来是 30 秒）。这正是本 PR 要的降噪效果；daemon 恢复后几分钟内就会被接上，任何一次成功 open 都会把阶梯重置回 1 秒。
- 未验证/不在范围：没有对着拒绝握手的 daemon 做真实 Chrome 验证（本机没有 sideload 该扩展的 Chrome）；issue 里另一个诉求（提供彻底关闭自动连接的开关）留待后续，因为 5 分钟封顶已经消除了日志刷屏的实际伤害。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。`chrome.storage.session` 不需要新权限（`storage` 已声明），浏览器重启即清空。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13966

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG8a/b/d monitor_run and background-shell fault gates (#14163)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the Stage F fault gates FG8a (lost replies), FG8b (store failures) and FG8d (cancellation and drain), plus the deferred FG8e `cursor-expired-resync` case — slice 2 of #14163, stacked on #14120 (FG8e/f) and following its shape: a real packaged Harness, an in-JVM Spring control plane with its embedded Runtime Broker, a real MySQL, and JDBC ground truth for every assertion. FG8a proves a dropped reply never mints a second execution identity; FG8b proves a real store failure blocks honestly and then lands exactly once with a byte-identical prefix; FG8d proves cancellation and the routine/drain release split settle from physical evidence only. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

#14163 is the closeable FG8 tracker after #14120 delivered FG8e/f; its remaining scope was FG8a–FG8d. FG8c stays deferred behind #13986 (still in review). The far-side prerequisites #14021 and #13918 merged meanwhile, so slice 2 no longer gates a moving contract. The design doc (both languages) marks slice 1 delivered and pins every slice-2 wire point against the merged tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The `hosted-harness-mysql` lane runs the new letters automatically (the `Hosted*IT` include plus the failsafe-report check enforce it ran). Locally the focused profile runs them against a real MySQL with a delegated cgroup v2 root — the gates are Linux-only because the supervised processes need `cgroup.kill`, same class as slice 1:

```
mvn -Phosted-monitor-run-gates \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry="$PWD/dist/cli.js" \
  -Dmysql.url=jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/hosted_harness_test \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=hosted-fixture \
  clean verify checkstyle:check
```

Per-letter selectors: `-Dqwen.fg8a.case=dispatch-reply`, `-Dqwen.fg8b.case=manifest-commit`, `-Dqwen.fg8d.case=drain-release`, `-Dqwen.fg8e.case=cursor-expired-resync`.

Expected: all five letters green. Every case first asserts its fault really fired — the proxy drop counters, the `FG8B_<case>` marker riding the failed commit, the cancel answers, the replay-floor readback — then the ground truth: one `:process` row and at most one physical process per dispatch; the parked monitor record settling from real exit evidence; store failure blocking with zero OS effects, then one honest landing with a byte-identical prefix; cancellation pressing `stopRequested: true` and settling `cancelled`/`stop_requested`, never a fabricated `exited`; an expired cursor getting one `agent.session.resync_required` frame and no fabricated replay. The slice-2 mutations (design doc, items 2 and 7–12) each turn their gate red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (integration tests; no user-visible surface).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Lane shape identical to slice 1: `QWEN_MANAGED_HOOK_CGROUP_ROOT` at the delegated cgroup v2 root the job creates.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the lane budgets were sized for two letters (~310 s inside the 1800 s fork healthy allowance); five letters need the dispatched run's measurement and, if it moves, `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` pins it in a follow-up commit before the stack merges (the per-ceiling relation 600 s + healthy ≤ fork holds meanwhile). The diff also reorders the two classes' import blocks to what the module's checkstyle gate expects — the violations pre-date the slice and would otherwise red the lane after green letters.
- Not validated / out of scope: FG8c (deferred behind #13986), the mutation-witness runs for items 2 and 7–12 (recorded with the lane evidence once dispatched), and the #13339-adjacent flakes the design declares out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — test-only, on top of slice 1's driver and probe.

Design docs: [English](../blob/HEAD/docs/design/2026-10-13-monitor-run-fault-gates.md) · [简体中文](../blob/HEAD/docs/design/2026-10-13-monitor-run-fault-gates.zh-CN.md) — complete and synchronized through the slice-2 markers.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14163 (slice 2 of the FG8 round; FG8c remains tracked there behind #13986)
Refs #14120 (the base this stacks on; lands after it)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

新增 Stage F 故障门禁 FG8a（应答丢失）、FG8b（存储故障）与 FG8d（取消与 drain），外加暂缓的 FG8e `cursor-expired-resync` 用例 —— #14163 的切片 2，堆叠在 #14120（FG8e/f）之上并沿用其形态：真实打包的 Harness、内嵌 Runtime Broker 的 in-JVM Spring 控制面、真实 MySQL，全部断言以 JDBC 地面真值收口。FG8a 证明一条丢失的应答绝不会铸出第二个执行身份；FG8b 证明一次真实的存储故障先诚实阻塞、然后恰好诚实落库一次且前缀逐字节相同；FG8d 证明取消与 routine/drain 释放拆分只凭物理证据结算。不改任何生产代码。

## 为什么需要

#14163 是 #14120 交付 FG8e/f 之后 FG8 的可关闭跟踪 issue，剩余范围是 FG8a–FG8d。FG8c 因 #13986（仍在评审）顺延。两个远端前置 #14021 与 #13918 期间均已合入，切片 2 不再钉正在动的契约。设计文档（双语）标记切片 1 已交付，并对着合入后的树钉住切片 2 的每个 wire 点。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

`hosted-harness-mysql` lane 自动运行新字母（`Hosted*IT` include 加 failsafe 报告核查强制其执行）。本地用聚焦 profile 对真实 MySQL 加一个委派的 cgroup v2 根运行（命令同英文版）。按字母选择器同英文版。

预期：五个字母全绿。每个用例先断言故障确实点火 —— 代理 drop 计数、随失败提交同行的 `FG8B_<case>` 标记、cancel 应答、重放地板回读 —— 再核对地面真值：每次派发恰一行 `:process`、至多一个物理进程；park 的 monitor 记录只凭真实退出证据结算；存储故障时零 OS 副作用阻塞、随后恰一次诚实落库且前缀逐字节相同；取消按下 `stopRequested: true` 并结算 `cancelled`/`stop_requested`，绝不伪造 `exited`；过期游标得到一帧 `agent.session.resync_required` 且无伪造重放。切片 2 的变异检查（第 2 条与 7–12 条）各自会把对应门禁打红。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A（集成测试；无用户可见表面）。

### 测试平台

macOS N/A；Windows N/A；Linux ✅（门禁按构造只在 Linux 上成立）。

### 环境（可选）

lane 形态与切片 1 相同：`QWEN_MANAGED_HOOK_CGROUP_ROOT` 指向作业创建的委派 cgroup v2 根。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：lane 预算当初按两个字母实测（1800 s fork 内约 310 s）；五个字母需要 dispatch 实测值，如有移动则 `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 在堆叠合入前的后续提交里钉住新数值（每个字母 600 s 上限 + 健康时长 ≤ fork 的关系保持不变）。本 diff 还把两个类的 import 块重排到模块 checkstyle 要求的布局（违例早于本切片存在，不修则绿字母之后整条 lane 会红在 checkstyle）。
- 未验证 / 出界：FG8c（因 #13986 顺延）、第 2 条与 7–12 条的变异见证跑批（随 dispatch 后的 lane 证据一并记录），以及设计声明出界的 #13339 相邻 flake。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无 —— 仅测试，叠加在切片 1 的 driver 与 probe 之上。

设计文档：[English](../blob/HEAD/docs/design/2026-10-13-monitor-run-fault-gates.md) · [简体中文](../blob/HEAD/docs/design/2026-10-13-monitor-run-fault-gates.zh-CN.md) —— 随切片 2 标记完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14163（FG8 轮的切片 2；FG8c 继续由该 issue 在 #13986 之后跟踪）
Refs #14120（本 PR 的堆叠基线；排在其后合入）

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep a crash-blocked workflow run unknown and honestly notified, gated by FG10d (#14165)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds FG10d, the last FG10 letter (#14165): the process-crash fault gate for the `child_run` `workflow` kind. It runs on the coordinator-owned fixture of `HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT`, now merged after #14387's fix (#14461). The gate also found two production defects in the honest-settlement path #14461 added, and review found a third that the first fix widened; this PR fixes all three.

**FG10d** SIGKILLs the packaged Harness under an attached workflow run, after the lead's own Turn settled, and then starts a cold Harness. It covers two windows:

- `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight`: the run's `agent()` request is held at the model, and the kill aborts it;
- `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement`: the subagent has answered, and the child Turn's `settleTurn` commit is swallowed at the store, so the kill lands before the settlement ever leaves the wire.

In both windows the run is never re-executed and never settled as if its outcome had been observed:

- one `agent()` dispatch, and no Turn result reading `completed`;
- the Turn stays `RUNNING`, marked `hosted_workflow_recovery_blocked`, and the restarted Harness refuses the child's load with `hosted_turn_recovery_required`;
- the record settles `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown` / `runtime_lost`, with no result, and its pinned digest is unchanged;
- the ledger reads `unknown`, and the lead gets exactly one `<status>blocked</status>` notification.

**Fixes found by the gate and its review:**

1. **A close debt rewrote the walk's classification.** When the host cannot close the child's Workspace Session, the relay retains a close debt. `ChildResultRelayStore.advance(close_debt)` then wrote the walk `done` and the `CHILD_RESULT` row `delivered`, whatever the arm had proved. Both the recovery-blocked arm and the relay's give-up chain intend `unknown`; their runs read as a delivered result instead. The debt now parks under the walk's own classification (`retainCloseDebt`), as the closed arm's `classify` already does. The other close-debt callers keep `done`.
2. **The blocked notification described the running revision.** `settleRecoveryBlocked` rendered the parent's notification from the record it replaces. Under `<status>blocked</status>`, the result line therefore read "Workflow child run running (unknown).". It now renders the blocked revision it commits.
3. **An `unknown` child start held its parent's resource collection forever** (found in review). `SessionResourceCollectionCollector` holds a retired parent's resources while a `CHILD_SESSION_START` walk is not `done`/`orphaned`, but `unknown` is just as terminal: the relay's discovery page and claim exclude it, and nothing rewrites it. The hold therefore had no release wherever the close is admitted at once, and fix 1 carried it to hosts without close capability. The collector now treats `unknown` as terminal. An owed close rides its own `CHILD_SESSION_CLOSE` row and reads no parent resource, so it does not hold collection either, as for a `done` walk before.

`retainCloseDebt` also refuses a `CHILD_SESSION_CLOSE` row itself, rather than relying on its callers.

The fixture gains a `SWALLOW` disposition on the store proxy (never forward; answer 503 once released) and a `killHarness` helper. The Hosted fork's healthy allowance composes 3743 + 131 = 3874 s, so the fork moves 4353→4484 s; the Verify step's 90 minutes and the job's 185 still cover it.

The bilingual relay design gains FG10d's section: cases, mechanics, the three fixes and four mutations. The a+d design's FG10d section and its scope decisions now point there.

## Why it's needed

FG10d is the letter the round specifically owes: a Harness crash leaves no independent witness to a workflow's in-process subagents, so this is where a record is most likely to settle dishonestly. Its first version found #14387. On the fixed path, the record itself settled honestly, but two of its outward faces did not:

- the ledger called a run that delivered nothing "delivered";
- the parent was told "blocked", with a result line saying "running".

Making the ledger honest then exposed the collector's missing `unknown`: a run nobody witnessed must not pin its parent's resources forever either.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Build and bundle the CLI, and install the sibling Java SDK.
2. Run the `hosted-workflow-gates` profile (or the Hosted lane) against a disposable MySQL 8.4 schema with `-Dit.test=HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT`. Expect five letters and zero failures. `-Dit.test='HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT#fg10d*' -Dqwen.fg10d.case=…` runs one case.
3. Unit tests: `ChildResultRelayStoreTest`, `ChildResultRelayTest` and `SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest` (managed-agent-server), and `hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts` (cli).

The fault-fired witnesses:

- the held `agent()` request's abort (a failed keepalive write) in the in-flight case;
- `swallowing settle-swallow` once in the store-proxy log, and its command never passing through;
- the Harness process exit before the cold start.

To see the gate's teeth, apply any slice-3 mutation listed in the design and run its case alone.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — probes on main in both windows, and the gate with each fix reverted (mutations 3 and 4 below):

- `CHILD_RESULT` row `delivered/pending/pending` for the blocked run;
- notification `<result>` reading `Workflow child run running (unknown).`.

After: both cases green.

Local results:

- FG10d alone: 79.5 s, both cases green.
- The full five-letter class, three runs green: 246.1 s, 246.1 s, 246.8 s (FG10d ~65 s, the other letters unchanged).

Mutations, each run against its case alone, each source restored and the gate green again:

- The coordinator no longer recognizes a workflow Turn (every #14461 refusal arm off) → `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight` red at the mark. The drive stays on the generic retry path, and the record never settles.
- The relay ignores the mark → `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight` red; the record stays `running`.
- The close debt classifies every walk `done` (relay fix reverted) → `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement` red: `delivered/pending/pending`.
- The blocked line renders the running revision (Harness fix reverted, bundle patched) → `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement` red at the notification.

Each fix's unit tests go red with that fix reverted:

- `retainsACloseDebtUnderTheWalksOwnClassification`;
- `aBlockedRunWithoutCloseRetainsTheDebtUnderUnknown`;
- `aGiveUpWithoutCloseSupportRetainsItsCloseDebt` (red when only the give-up arm's no-close path passes `done`);
- `aHostWithoutCloseSettlesAndRetainsTheCloseDebt`;
- `tells a background child's parent the run is blocked, not running`;
- `aChildStartHoldsCollectionOnlyUntilTheRelayClassifiesIt`, whose `unknown` case is red with the collector line reverted.

Other checks:

- The module's surefire suite after merging main (which brings #14501's fix for `SessionRowLockOrderTest`, #14500): 4584 tests, the only one not passing being `WorkspaceStorageGuardTest`'s birth-time flake (from #14442), which passed on rerun. Checkstyle 0, SpotBugs 0.
- After the review fixes: FG10d alone green again on MySQL 8.4 (71.3 s), and the three review mutations (collector line reverted, give-up no-close arm passing `done`, the new `retainCloseDebt` guard removed) each red at exactly its test.
- The meta-tests that read the lane definitions: 9 files, 434 passed, 1 skipped.
- `hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts`, `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.workflow-child.test.ts` and `hosted-member-chain.test.ts`: all green.
- ESLint and Prettier: clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The class needs coordinator-owned workspace execution, which is Linux-only, as the lane is. The unit tests are platform-neutral.

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, JDK 21 (Zulu 21.0.10), Maven 3.9, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6 in a throw-away container; the CI lane is MySQL 8.4 on ubuntu-latest.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:**
  - Production change 1 alters what a retained close debt writes for an `unknown` walk:
    - it now writes `unknown` (it wrote `done`), and the `CHILD_RESULT` row becomes `unknown/…` (it was `delivered/…`);
    - this is the classification the arm already wrote when the close is admitted at once (that path's `classify` also stamps `completed_at`, which the close-debt write never did and nothing reads on these rows).
  - Production change 3 lets session resource collection proceed past a `CHILD_SESSION_START` walk classified `unknown`. Before, such a parent was held forever with `child_start_unresolved` on hosts that close at once; a walk still in flight still holds it.
  - `done` walks are unaffected, and so are the other close-debt callers (parent not active, settled-cancelled record).
  - Production change 2 only changes the notification's result text.
  - The shared Hosted fork grows by ~131 s of budgeted healthy runtime, composed onto main's current values. The job ceiling is the post-#14467 value (185).
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - No PR lane runs the Hosted gates (`sdk-java.yml` has no `pull_request` trigger).
  - The two other close-debt callers' classification is unchanged.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

Design documents (English and Chinese, synchronized):

- `docs/design/2026-10-17-workflow-relay-fault-gates.md` (`.zh-CN.md`);
- `docs/design/2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.md` (`.zh-CN.md`).

## Linked Issues

Ref #14165 — FG10d, the last letter; with it every FG10 letter is delivered. Follows #14387 / #14461.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

新增 FG10d，即 #14165 的最后一个 FG10 字母：为 `child_run` `workflow` kind 补上进程崩溃故障门禁。它放在 `HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT` 由 coordinator 持有 lead 的夹具上，#14387 的修复（#14461）合入之后落地。门禁还在 #14461 新增的诚实结算路径上发现了两个生产缺陷，评审又发现了被第一处修复扩大的第三个；本 PR 三个一并修复。

**FG10d** 在 lead 自己的 Turn 结算之后、workflow 运行处于 attached 状态时 SIGKILL 打包 Harness，然后冷启动一个新的 Harness。覆盖两个窗口：

- `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight`：运行的 `agent()` 请求被扣在模型处，kill 中止了它；
- `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement`：子 agent 已作答，子 Turn 的 `settleTurn` 提交在 store 处被吞掉，所以 kill 落在结算离开网络之前。

两个窗口下，运行都绝不会被重新执行，也绝不会被当作结果已被观察到而结算：

- 只有一次 `agent()` 派发，也没有任何 Turn 结果读作 `completed`；
- Turn 保持 `RUNNING` 并带 `hosted_workflow_recovery_blocked` 标记，重启后的 Harness 以 `hosted_turn_recovery_required` 拒绝子 Session 的加载；
- 记录结算为 `recovery_blocked` / `outcome_unknown` / `runtime_lost`，没有结果，钉住的 digest 不变；
- ledger 读到 `unknown`，lead 恰好收到一条 `<status>blocked</status>` 通知。

**门禁及其评审发现并修复的问题：**

1. **close debt 改写了流程的归类。** host 无法关闭子 Workspace Session 时，relay 会保留一笔 close debt。此时 `ChildResultRelayStore.advance(close_debt)` 不管该分支证明了什么，都把流程写成 `done`、把 `CHILD_RESULT` 行写成 `delivered`。恢复阻断分支和 relay 放弃链路想要的都是 `unknown`，它们的运行却读成了一个已投递的结果。现在 debt 以流程自己的归类停放（`retainCloseDebt`），与已关闭分支的 `classify` 一致；其余 close-debt 调用点仍写 `done`。
2. **阻断通知描述的是运行中的 revision。** `settleRecoveryBlocked` 用它所替换的记录生成 parent 的通知，所以在 `<status>blocked</status>` 之下，结果行写着 "Workflow child run running (unknown)."。现在它用自己提交的阻断 revision 生成。
3. **`unknown` 的子启动永久扣住父 Session 的资源回收**（评审发现）。`SessionResourceCollectionCollector` 在 `CHILD_SESSION_START` 流程不是 `done`/`orphaned` 时扣住已退役父 Session 的资源，但 `unknown` 同样是终态：relay 的发现查询和 claim 都排除它，也没有任何代码会再改写它。所以凡是 close 能立即受理的地方，这个扣住都没有释放口，而修复 1 又把它带到了没有 close 能力的 host 上。现在 collector 把 `unknown` 当作终态。欠下的 close 走它自己的 `CHILD_SESSION_CLOSE` 行，不读父 Session 的任何资源，所以也不扣住回收，与此前 `done` 流程一致。

`retainCloseDebt` 也改为自己拒绝 `CHILD_SESSION_CLOSE` 行，而不是依赖调用方。

夹具方面，store proxy 新增 `SWALLOW` 处置（从不转发，被释放后回 503），并新增 `killHarness` helper。Hosted fork 的健康配额叠加为 3743 + 131 = 3874 s，fork 因此 4353→4484 s；Verify 步骤的 90 分钟和 job 的 185 分钟仍然够用。

双语 relay 设计新增 FG10d 一节：用例、机制、三处修复和四个变异。a+d 设计的 FG10d 一节及其范围决策改为指向那里。

## Why it's needed

FG10d 是这一轮专门欠下的字母：Harness 崩溃后，workflow 进程内的子 agent 没有任何独立见证，所以这里是记录最容易不诚实结算的地方。它的第一版发现了 #14387。在修复后的路径上，记录本身结算得诚实，但它对外的两面不诚实：

- ledger 把一个什么都没交付的运行称作"已投递"；
- parent 被告知"阻断"，结果行却写着"运行中"。

让 ledger 变诚实之后，collector 漏掉 `unknown` 的问题也暴露出来：一个无人见证的运行同样不能永久扣住父 Session 的资源。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 构建并打包 CLI，安装兄弟 Java SDK。
2. 对一次性 MySQL 8.4 schema 运行 `hosted-workflow-gates` profile（或 Hosted 车道），带 `-Dit.test=HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT`。预期五个字母、零失败。`-Dit.test='HostedWorkflowRelayFaultGatesIT#fg10d*' -Dqwen.fg10d.case=…` 只跑单个用例。
3. 单测：`ChildResultRelayStoreTest`、`ChildResultRelayTest`、`SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest`（managed-agent-server），以及 `hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts`（cli）。

故障点火见证：

- 在飞用例中，被扣住的 `agent()` 请求被中止（keepalive 写入失败）；
- store-proxy 日志中出现一次 `swallowing settle-swallow`，且被吞的命令从未被转发；
- 冷启动之前 Harness 进程已退出。

要看门禁的牙齿，可应用设计文档列出的任一第 3 片变异，并单独运行其用例。

### Evidence (Before & After)

修复前——在 main 上两个窗口的探针结果，以及撤掉各修复后的门禁（下文第 3、4 个变异）：

- 被阻断运行的 `CHILD_RESULT` 行为 `delivered/pending/pending`；
- 通知的 `<result>` 写着 `Workflow child run running (unknown).`。

修复后：两个用例全绿。

本地结果：

- 单独运行 FG10d：79.5 s，两个用例全绿。
- 五字母全类三次运行全绿：246.1 s、246.1 s、246.8 s（FG10d 约 65 s，其余字母不变）。

变异（每个只对其用例运行；每次源码都已还原、门禁复绿）：

- coordinator 不再识别 workflow Turn（#14461 的每个拒绝分支都失效）→ `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight` 红在标记上；驱动停留在通用重试路径上，记录从未结算。
- relay 忽略标记 → `kill-mid-workflow-subagents-in-flight` 红，记录停在 `running`。
- close debt 把每条流程都写成 `done`（撤掉 relay 修复）→ `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement` 红：`delivered/pending/pending`。
- 阻断通知用运行中的 revision 生成（撤掉 Harness 修复，修补 bundle）→ `kill-after-last-subagent-before-settlement` 红在通知上。

每处修复的单测在撤掉对应修复后都会变红：

- `retainsACloseDebtUnderTheWalksOwnClassification`；
- `aBlockedRunWithoutCloseRetainsTheDebtUnderUnknown`；
- `aGiveUpWithoutCloseSupportRetainsItsCloseDebt`（只把放弃分支的无 close 路径改传 `done` 时变红）；
- `aHostWithoutCloseSettlesAndRetainsTheCloseDebt`；
- `tells a background child's parent the run is blocked, not running`；
- `aChildStartHoldsCollectionOnlyUntilTheRelayClassifiesIt`，撤掉 collector 那一行后其 `unknown` 用例变红。

其他检查：

- merge main 之后（带上 #14501 对 `SessionRowLockOrderTest`（#14500）的修复）的模块 surefire：4584 个测试，唯一未通过的是 `WorkspaceStorageGuardTest` 的 birth-time flake（源自 #14442），重跑通过。Checkstyle 0，SpotBugs 0。
- 评审修复之后：FG10d 单独在 MySQL 8.4 上再次全绿（71.3 s）；三个评审变异（撤掉 collector 那一行、放弃分支的无 close 路径改传 `done`、去掉新的 `retainCloseDebt` 保护）各自只在对应的测试上变红。
- 读取车道定义的元测试：9 个文件，434 通过、1 跳过。
- `hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts`、`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.workflow-child.test.ts`、`hosted-member-chain.test.ts`：全绿。
- ESLint 与 Prettier：干净。

### Tested on

macOS N/A；Windows N/A；Linux ✅。本类需要由 coordinator 持有的 workspace 执行，只能在 Linux 上运行，与车道一致；单测与平台无关。

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64、JDK 21（Zulu 21.0.10）、Maven 3.9、Node 22、一次性容器中的 MySQL 8.4.6；CI 车道为 ubuntu-latest 上的 MySQL 8.4。

## Risk & Scope

- **主要风险或取舍：**
  - 生产改动 1 改变了 `unknown` 流程在保留 close debt 时写入的内容：
    - 现在写 `unknown`（原来写 `done`），`CHILD_RESULT` 行变为 `unknown/…`（原来是 `delivered/…`）；
    - 这与 close 能立即受理时该分支本来写入的归类相同（那条路径的 `classify` 还会写 `completed_at`，close-debt 写入从来不写，这些行上也没有读取方）。
  - 生产改动 3 让会话资源回收不再被归类为 `unknown` 的 `CHILD_SESSION_START` 流程挡住。此前在能立即 close 的 host 上，这样的父 Session 会以 `child_start_unresolved` 被永久扣住；仍在进行中的流程照旧会扣住。
  - `done` 流程不受影响，其余 close-debt 调用点（parent 不活跃、记录已结算为 cancelled）也不受影响。
  - 生产改动 2 只改变通知的结果文本。
  - 共享 Hosted fork 的预算健康时长增加约 131 s，叠加在 main 当前值之上；job 上限沿用 #14467 之后的 185。
- **未验证 / 不在范围：**
  - PR 车道不运行 Hosted 门禁（`sdk-java.yml` 没有 `pull_request` 触发器）。
  - 另外两个 close-debt 调用点的归类保持不变。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移注记：** 无。

设计文档（中英文已同步）：

- `docs/design/2026-10-17-workflow-relay-fault-gates.md`（`.zh-CN.md`）；
- `docs/design/2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.md`（`.zh-CN.md`）。

## Linked Issues

Ref #14165 —— FG10d，最后一个字母；有了它，FG10 的每个字母都已交付。承接 #14387 / #14461。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(managed-agent): keep a crash-blocked workflow run unknown and honestly notified, gated by FG10d (#14165) (#14506)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(managed-agent): keep a crash-blocked workflow run unknown and honestly notified, gated by FG10d (#14165)

FG10d, the last FG10 letter, SIGKILLs the packaged Harness under an
attached workflow run, with its agent() request in flight and with its
work done but the child Turn's settlement swallowed at the store, then
starts a cold one. The run must never be re-executed or settled as if
observed: the Turn parks marked hosted_workflow_recovery_blocked, the
cold load refuses, and the record settles recovery_blocked over
outcome_unknown with one blocked notification to the lead.

The gate found two defects in that honest-settlement path:

- A retained close debt wrote the walk done and its CHILD_RESULT row
  delivered whatever the arm proved, so the unknown the recovery-blocked
  arm and the give-up chain intend read as a delivered result wherever
  the host cannot close the child at once. The debt now parks under the
  walk's own classification (retainCloseDebt), as classify does.
- settleRecoveryBlocked rendered the parent's notification from the
  record it replaces, so under <status>blocked</status> the result line
  read "run running (unknown)". It now renders the blocked revision.

The store proxy gains a SWALLOW disposition and the class a killHarness
helper. The Hosted fork's healthy allowance composes 3743 + 131 = 3874 s
and the fork moves 4353 -> 4484 s; the Verify step and job ceiling hold.
The relay design gains FG10d's section; the a+d design points at it.

* fix(managed-agent): release a parent whose child walk retired unknown, and sweep FG10d's review nits (#14165)

Session resource collection held a retired parent while a CHILD_SESSION_START
walk was not done/orphaned, but the relay's `unknown` is just as terminal and
is never rewritten, so the hold had no release; the close-debt fix carried it
to hosts without close capability. The collector now treats `unknown` as
terminal; an owed close rides its own CHILD_SESSION_CLOSE row and reads no
parent resource.

Also: pin the give-up arm's no-close classification, refuse a close row in
retainCloseDebt itself, correct the give-up javadoc and test comment that
still described the old either/or, and sweep the stale four-letter and
FG10d-selector text in the IT header, the CI comment and both designs.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): bound half-open Hosted event streams behind a keepalive capability (#14135)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR completes #14135 by bounding a half-open Hosted Harness event stream. #13314 already shipped the mechanism: a 15-second keepalive comment on the Harness's events route, and a 45-second idle watchdog in the Java stream. This PR closes the gaps the issue still listed:

- **Capability gate.** The Harness advertises its keepalive as `event-keepalive/1` in `hostedHarness.features`. The Java client arms the idle bound only against a Harness that advertises it. An older Harness is silent through every quiet phase of a healthy Turn, so during a rolling upgrade the bound would have aborted those streams again and again. Against such a Harness the read now stays unbounded, as it was before the keepalive.
- **Typed outcome.** The abort is now `HostedHarnessStreamIdleException`, a `DaemonTransportException` that carries the bound, instead of a generic transport error. The coordinator treats it like any transient stream failure: it schedules a retry, and the retry re-attaches and resumes from the recorded cursor. The silence alone never settles or cancels the Turn. The retry log line names the class, so an operator can tell a liveness timeout from a reset socket or from a Harness that ended the stream early.
- **Tighter detection.** The watchdog now checks every tenth of the bound instead of every half. An abort lands 45 to 49.5 seconds after the last byte, instead of up to 67.5 seconds.
- **Packaged-chain gate.** `HostedEventStreamLivenessIT` runs the issue's probes on Spring + MySQL + the packaged Harness, with a TCP relay between them that can hold the events connection half-open after a SIGKILL or stall it while the Harness lives. It joins the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane; the shared fork budget grows from 4484 s to 4924 s, and the Verify step and job ceilings follow.
- **Decisions recorded.** A design note (EN + zh-CN) records the four decisions the issue asked for: numbers, capability, outcome shape, and other Hosted streams. Both languages of the H4f follow-up row now point at it.

## Why it's needed

The H4f real-stack acceptance (#13746, finding 1) caught Turn readers parked in `HarnessEventStream.next` on half-open streams. #13314 made such a read end eventually, but it had no rolling-upgrade guard, no typed outcome, and no packaged-chain evidence. The adopted policy (#13302 item 2, #12380 decision 3) requires a bounded half-open read that surfaces a typed liveness outcome and enters the existing reconciliation path, without ever replaying.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit tests:

```bash
(cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode && mvn test -Dtest='HostedHarnessClientTest,HarnessEventStreamCloseTest')
(cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn test -Dtest='HarnessCoordinatorTest,HostedEventStreamRelayTest')
(cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-contract.test.ts)
npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js
```

Packaged chain (MySQL 8.4 and a bundled CLI):

```bash
npm run build && npm run bundle
(cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode && mvn install -DskipTests)
cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql \
  -Dqwen.node="$(command -v node)" -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" \
  -Dqwen.cli.entry="$PWD/../../dist/cli.js" \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/hosted?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=... \
  -Dit.test=HostedEventStreamLivenessIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false verify
```

`HostedEventStreamLivenessIT` on the shipped numbers (15 s keepalive, 45 s bound), Linux x86_64 + MySQL 8.4.6:

| Probe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| A quiet 55 s Turn | Keepalive gaps at the relay: 14,999 to 15,000 ms. No idle retry, one stream, `retry_count` 0, the model called once. |
| SIGKILL behind a half-open relay | The idle retry fired 48.0 s (48,017 to 48,044 ms) after the last byte reached Spring, inside the 45–49.5 s window. `retry_count` ≥ 1. A JDK thread dump, which lists the virtual threads Turn readers run on, shows the reader parked in `HarnessEventStream.next` before the kill and gone after the retry. |
| Cancel during a quiet read | The Turn settles as `CANCELLED` through the cancel command, with no idle retry. |
| A stalled stream, Harness alive | One idle retry and one re-attach, then the model is released. The model ran once, there is one `turn.completed`, and the Turn is `COMPLETED`. |

The class passed in all five runs, four on JDK 25 and one on JDK 21, and took 214.4 to 215.0 s. The fifth run was on the review fixes merged with main (`8ea0511044`). That is ~440 s budgeted at 2× in the shared fork.

**Negative control.** With an SDK whose watchdog never arms, the half-open probe fails with `idle retry timed out` after 84.5 s. An earlier version of the gate closed Spring before the relay. Against the same mutant, Spring's close then waited forever for the reader parked on the held stream, so the fork hung until failsafe killed it 72 minutes later. That is the original finding, reproduced on the packaged chain. The gate now resets the relay first, so a regression fails the gate instead of hanging the lane.

**Gate self-checks.**

- With the reader probe on `Thread.getAllStackTraces()`, which leaves out virtual threads, the half-open probe fails its precondition with `parked reader timed out`.
- `HostedEventStreamRelayTest` pins the relay's framing of requests and keepalives split across TCP reads. Against the first relay it fails both where a POST body names the events route and where the request line and the Host port are split. With keepalives matched per read, it fails at the split keepalive.

**SDK mutations.** Each one fails exactly the named test:

| Mutation | Failing test |
| --- | --- |
| Arm the watchdog without the capability | `aHarnessWithoutKeepalivesKeepsTheReadUnbounded` |
| Half-bound tick | `anIdleAbortLandsInsideThePublishedWindow` (abort at 3000 ms of a 2000 ms bound) |
| Untyped exception on the parked read | `anIdlePeerFailsTheStreamWithinTheIdleBudget` |
| Untyped exception for a late caller | `anIdlePeerFailsTheStreamWithinTheIdleBudget` |
| Untyped exception on the buffered-frame path | `HarnessEventStreamCloseTest.anIdleAbortRacingABufferedFrameReportsTheIdleTimeout` |

`HarnessCoordinatorTest.anIdleStreamRetriesTheAdmittedTurnWithoutSettlingIt` is a characterization test. The coordinator needed no change, because the typed outcome takes the existing transient branch. The test pins that branch, so a later change that settles or cancels the Turn on silence fails it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, no UI change. The before and after evidence is the negative control, the mutation table and the packaged-chain measurements above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, JDK 25 and JDK 21 (the lane's version), MySQL 8.4.6 in Docker, packaged CLI from `npm run build && npm run bundle`.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** a Harness that does not advertise `event-keepalive/1` gets no bound. That is today's pre-keepalive behavior: only a close ends a half-open read there. Every Harness built from this change advertises it.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - the model, tool and Turn operation budgets (#13302 item 2);
  - the non-hosted `DaemonSessionClient`, which keeps its own watchdog;
  - a server property for the bound (the SDK default stays);
  - macOS and Windows runs of the packaged gate.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. No contract version, schema or public REST API change. The Java SDK gains one public class, `HostedHarnessStreamIdleException`; it extends `DaemonTransportException`, so existing catch blocks still match.

Design note: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-hosted-event-stream-heartbeat/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-event-stream-liveness.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-hosted-event-stream-heartbeat/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-event-stream-liveness.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14135. Refs #13314, #13302, #13746, #13877.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 完成 #14135：给半开的 Hosted Harness 事件流加上界。机制本身 #13314 已经交付：Harness 事件路由上每 15 秒一条 keepalive 注释，Java 流上一个 45 秒的空闲看门狗。本 PR 补上 issue 里还列着的缺口：

- **Capability 门控。** Harness 在 `hostedHarness.features` 中以 `event-keepalive/1` 声明 keepalive。Java 客户端只对声明了它的 Harness 启用空闲上限。旧 Harness 在健康 Turn 的每个安静阶段都不发字节，滚动升级期间上限会一次次中止这些流。对这样的 Harness，读取现在保持无上限，与 keepalive 之前一致。
- **类型化结果。** 中止现在抛出 `HostedHarnessStreamIdleException`，它是携带上限值的 `DaemonTransportException`，不再是笼统的传输错误。Coordinator 把它当作普通的暂时性流失败：安排重试，重试重新挂接并从记录的游标续读。静默本身永远不会结算或取消 Turn。重试日志里写着异常类名，运维可以把存活超时与被重置的连接、提前结束流的 Harness 区分开。
- **更紧的检测。** 看门狗改为每十分之一个上限检查一次，不再是每半个。中止落在最后一个字节之后 45 到 49.5 秒，而不是最多 67.5 秒。
- **打包链路门禁。** `HostedEventStreamLivenessIT` 在 Spring + MySQL + 打包的 Harness 上跑 issue 里的探针，二者之间是一个 TCP relay：可以在 SIGKILL 之后让事件连接保持半开，也可以在 Harness 存活时让它停滞。它加入 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道；共享 fork 预算从 4484 秒增至 4924 秒，Verify 步骤与 job 上限随之调整。
- **决策落档。** 一份设计文档（英文 + 简体中文）记录 issue 要求的四项决策：数值、capability、结果形态和其他 Hosted 流。H4f 后续行的中英两版都已指向它。

## 为什么需要

H4f 真实栈验收（#13746 发现 1）发现 Turn 读线程停在半开流的 `HarnessEventStream.next` 上。#13314 让这样的读最终会结束，但没有滚动升级保护、没有类型化结果，也没有打包链路上的证据。已采纳的策略（#13302 第 2 项、#12380 决策 3）要求半开读有上限，暴露类型化的存活结果，并进入现有的对账路径，永不重放。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

单元测试与打包链路的命令见上方英文部分。

`HostedEventStreamLivenessIT` 使用发布时的数值（15 秒 keepalive、45 秒上限），环境为 Linux x86_64 + MySQL 8.4.6：

| 探针 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 安静 55 秒的 Turn | relay 处的 keepalive 间隔：14,999 到 15,000 ms。没有空闲重试，只有一条流，`retry_count` 为 0，模型只调用一次。 |
| 半开 relay 后 SIGKILL | 最后一个字节到达 Spring 之后 48.0 秒（48,017 到 48,044 ms）触发空闲重试，落在 45–49.5 秒窗口内。`retry_count` ≥ 1。JDK 线程转储会列出 Turn 读线程所在的虚拟线程：kill 之前转储显示读线程停在 `HarnessEventStream.next`，重试之后它已消失。 |
| 安静读取期间取消 | Turn 经由取消命令结算为 `CANCELLED`，没有空闲重试。 |
| Harness 存活但流停滞 | 一次空闲重试、一次重新挂接，之后放行模型。模型只运行一次，只有一条 `turn.completed`，Turn 为 `COMPLETED`。 |

整个类在五次运行中都通过（JDK 25 四次、JDK 21 一次），耗时 214.4 到 215.0 秒。第五次运行基于评审修复合入 main 之后的提交（`8ea0511044`）。在共享 fork 中按 2 倍预算约 440 秒。

**负对照。** 换上看门狗永不启用的 SDK 后，半开探针在 84.5 秒时以 `idle retry timed out` 失败。门禁的早期版本先关 Spring 再关 relay。面对同一变异，Spring 关闭时会一直等待停在被扣住的流上的读线程，fork 一直挂到 72 分钟后被 failsafe 杀掉。这就是原始问题在打包链路上的复现。门禁现在先重置 relay，所以回归会让门禁失败，而不是挂住车道。

**门禁自检。**

- 读线程探针改回 `Thread.getAllStackTraces()` 时，它看不到虚拟线程，半开探针在前置检查处以 `parked reader timed out` 失败。
- `HostedEventStreamRelayTest` 固定了 relay 对跨 TCP read 拆开的请求和 keepalive 的分帧。换上最初的 relay，它在 POST body 冒充事件路由处、请求行与 Host 端口被拆开处都会失败；keepalive 改为按单次 read 匹配时，它在被拆开的 keepalive 处失败。

**SDK 变异。** 每个变异都恰好让点名的测试失败：

| 变异 | 失败的测试 |
| --- | --- |
| 不看 capability 就启用看门狗 | `aHarnessWithoutKeepalivesKeepsTheReadUnbounded` |
| 改回半个上限的检查间隔 | `anIdleAbortLandsInsideThePublishedWindow`（2000 ms 上限在 3000 ms 时中止） |
| 停住的读抛出非类型化异常 | `anIdlePeerFailsTheStreamWithinTheIdleBudget` |
| 后到的调用方收到非类型化异常 | `anIdlePeerFailsTheStreamWithinTheIdleBudget` |
| 缓冲帧路径抛出非类型化异常 | `HarnessEventStreamCloseTest.anIdleAbortRacingABufferedFrameReportsTheIdleTimeout` |

`HarnessCoordinatorTest.anIdleStreamRetriesTheAdmittedTurnWithoutSettlingIt` 是特征测试。Coordinator 无需改动，因为类型化结果走的就是现有的暂时性分支。该测试把这个分支固定下来，之后若有改动在静默时结算或取消 Turn，它就会失败。

### 前后对比证据

不适用，没有 UI 变更。前后对比证据就是上面的负对照、变异表和打包链路实测。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，JDK 25 与 JDK 21（车道所用版本），Docker 中的 MySQL 8.4.6，打包 CLI 来自 `npm run build && npm run bundle`。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** 没有声明 `event-keepalive/1` 的 Harness 得不到上限。这就是 keepalive 之前的现状：那里只有关闭才能结束半开读。由本变更构建的 Harness 都会声明它。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 模型、工具与 Turn 的操作预算（#13302 第 2 项）；
  - 非 Hosted 的 `DaemonSessionClient`，它保留自己的看门狗；
  - 给上限新增服务端属性（沿用 SDK 默认值）；
  - 打包门禁在 macOS 与 Windows 上的运行。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。没有契约版本、schema 或公开 REST API 变更。Java SDK 新增一个公开类 `HostedHarnessStreamIdleException`，它继承 `DaemonTransportException`，现有的 catch 块仍然匹配。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-hosted-event-stream-heartbeat/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-event-stream-liveness.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-hosted-event-stream-heartbeat/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-event-stream-liveness.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14135. Refs #13314, #13302, #13746, #13877.

</details>

prs.title: fix(runtime): deliver bounded provider images and PDFs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables bounded image and PDF delivery through the existing managed runtime provider protocol. Each prepared file read uses its own image/PDF capability snapshot for both the tool description and actual content delivery. Supported images use the existing safe image handling; PDFs can return native bytes, extracted text, or rendered pages as appropriate. Execution workers remain independent of model initialization and do not inherit Omni media uploads. Audio and video remain disabled for this provider profile.

Media reads enforce an aggregate 768 KiB base64 ceiling and a 896 KiB complete tool-result ceiling within the existing 1 MiB response envelope. Oversized reads settle as explicit `FILE_TOO_LARGE` tool errors. Accepted media-bearing results retain their content, captions, and display across execution and settled status/cancel observations; response fitting may remove progress or auxiliary Hook details while preserving Hook stop decisions. PDF cancellation propagates through page counting, extraction, and rendering, and waits for child-process exit and renderer cleanup.

Adds regression coverage and integration fixtures for capability isolation, byte boundaries, media validation, chunked Java transport, lost replies, and Broker restart recovery. Updates the provider-control design and dependency notices. The public Hosted raw file loop remains outside this change.

## Why it's needed

The provider worker has no content generator. Previously, its declared media capabilities influenced the tool description, but actual file reads consulted content-generator modalities, so supported images and native PDF bytes could remain unavailable. Oversized responses could also replace inline media with a generic text stub after the Runtime had already retained the original result, producing inconsistent observations of the same invocation.

Using the prepared capability snapshot for delivery and applying media limits before settlement allows provider integrations to receive actual workspace media or an explicit bounded error while retaining consistent execution evidence.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Prepare reads of real PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files with image support enabled, disabled, and omitted, including concurrent invocations and Sessions. Enabled reads should return decodable image content with the expected MIME and dimensions; disabled or omitted support should return the existing unsupported-image response without inline bytes. An inherited Omni opt-in must not cause uploads.
2. Read a small PDF with native PDF support enabled and no page range: its decoded bytes should match the workspace document. With a page range or native PDF support disabled, confirm text-first behavior and image rendering when extraction fails and image support is enabled. Explicit ranges must not silently lose pages; an implicit rendered prefix must announce omitted pages.
3. Exercise exact media boundaries and one-byte-over cases. A native PDF of 576 KiB can meet the 768 KiB base64 ceiling if the complete result also fits; one decoded byte over must return a settled `FILE_TOO_LARGE` error. Include escaped and multibyte metadata in the 896 KiB result calculation. Text, SVG, notebook content, and text-only PDF results should retain their existing handling.
4. Compare accepted tool results across execution and settled status/cancel responses, including large progress and Hook payloads. Media, captions, and display must remain identical, Hook stop decisions must survive fitting, and malformed MIME/base64 or unadmitted media must fail explicitly. Change the source file after settlement and confirm observations do not reread it.
5. With functioning Poppler tools, cancel page counting, text extraction, and rendering after the child starts. Cancellation must propagate without starting another fallback, and the owned child and rendering directory must be cleaned up.
6. After obtaining a successful build and bundle, run the added Java/MySQL provider-media integration scenario with an isolated MySQL instance. Verify the original seven-field provider reference, correct outbound media bytes and tool-call correlation at the deterministic Chat Completions fixture, exactly one physical execution after lost start/execute replies, unchanged persisted results after Broker restart, and released ownership. Treat native PDF handling through Responses as the documented unsupported case. These are proposed checks; the Java/MySQL scenario has not been run in this session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No before/after screenshots, recordings, or end-to-end media-delivery logs were provided. The implementation and added assertions describe the expected behavior; they do not establish deployment acceptance. The following local validation ran during the immediately preceding commit workflow on 2026-10-07; no tests were rerun while drafting this description:

- From `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts src/tools/read-file.test.ts src/utils/fileUtils.test.ts src/utils/inline-media.test.ts src/utils/pdf.test.ts src/utils/pdf.poppler.test.ts` — 6 test files passed, with 455 tests passed and 4 real-Poppler tests skipped.
