prs.title: test(managed-agent): parse only complete rows in the wedge driver wire
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The blocked-wedge integration driver now parses only newline-terminated rows from its wire file. A read that lands while the driver is still appending a row skips the unterminated tail and lets the next poll pick the row up whole, instead of aborting the driver on a half-written JSON fragment. The parse sits in a side-effect-free helper so a unit test can pin it; the driver keeps only the `ENOENT`-tolerant read.

## Why it's needed

`HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen` failed on the Hosted process fault gates lane with `WEDGE_DRIVER_FAILURE SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON` raised from the wire reader, not from an assertion about the system under test (#14495). The driver writes each wire row with a single `appendFile` of `JSON.stringify(row) + '\n'`, while `waitUntil` keeps polling the reader in the same process. When a read lands during an append, the file ends with a partially written row, the reader passed that fragment to `JSON.parse`, and the parse error aborted the whole driver. Every row the writer emits ends with a newline, so an unterminated tail is always a row still being written; dropping it only defers that row to the next poll. A genuinely malformed complete row still throws, so real corruption remains loud.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reproduce the reader against the two inputs that matter: a file whose last row is complete and one whose last row is still being appended.

```js
const half = '{"i":0,"pad":"aaa"}\n{"i":1,"pa';
const oldRead = (t) => t.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
const newRead = (t) => t.slice(0, t.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1).split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
oldRead(half); // throws SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON
newRead(half); // returns 1 row, no throw
```

Expected after the change: the `newRead` shape is what the driver uses. Empty input, a file with no newline yet, and a single terminated row all behave as "no complete rows", "no complete rows", and "one row" respectively. Then confirm the full gate locally with `npm run build && npm run bundle`, MySQL 8.4, and `HostedBackgroundPublicationGate`. Hosted fault lanes are skipped on PR events: the pull-request gate asks for the `fast` tier, and this job runs only outside it. The nightly `sdk-java.yml` schedule runs them at the default `full` tier, so `gh workflow run sdk-java.yml --ref <branch>` is the on-demand way to get that result before merge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, with a half-written last row: `SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON at position 436`, matching the stack in #14495. After: one complete row parsed, tail ignored. A synthetic concurrent append/read probe on this machine did not hit the partial-tail window in 1808 reads (Node 22, narrow window), so the deterministic half-line case above is the direct witness; #14495 records 14 partial tails in 2040 reads on Node 24.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️   |

macOS: reader semantics probe, `eslint`, `prettier --check`, and `tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json` (no diagnostics in the changed file; the remaining errors sit in unrelated files — missing symbols from a stale `packages/channels/email/dist` and a `minimatch` type mismatch). Linux: the gate lane was not run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a row becomes visible on the first poll after its append completes, which `waitUntil` already tolerates; a complete-but-malformed row still throws, so the reader does not silently swallow corruption.
- Not validated / out of scope: the failing Java gate was not executed locally (needs MySQL and the hosted harness). Other drivers that parse transaction bytes are unaffected because they read committed records, not a live append target. The helper's unit test is collected by `vitest run --root ./integration-tests` (the post-merge/nightly E2E lane), not by the no-AK lane's explicit list.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14495

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

recovery-blocked wedge 驱动的 wire 读取器现在只解析以换行结尾的完整行。如果一次读取正好落在驱动追加某一行的过程中，读取器会跳过尚未写完的尾部，由下一次轮询把该行完整读入，而不是因为半截 JSON 让整个驱动以 `WEDGE_DRIVER_FAILURE` 退出。解析逻辑抽到无副作用的辅助模块，便于单测钉住；驱动只保留对 `ENOENT` 的容错读取。

## 为什么需要它

`HostedBackgroundPublicationGate.backgroundAndMonitorReservesAnswerOpen` 在 Hosted process fault gates 车道失败，报错是 wire 读取器抛出的 `WEDGE_DRIVER_FAILURE SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON`，不是对被测算系统的断言失败（#14495）。驱动用一次 `appendFile` 写入整行 `JSON.stringify(row) + '\n'`，而同进程里的 `waitUntil` 一直在轮询读取器。当读取正好落在一次追加过程中，文件末尾是写了一半的行，读取器把这个片段交给 `JSON.parse`，解析异常直接终止了整个驱动。写入的每一行都以换行结尾，所以未终止的尾部一定是还在写入的那一行；丢掉它只是把该行推迟到下一次轮询。真正写成完整但内容损坏的行仍然会抛错，因此真实的损坏仍然会显式失败。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

用两种输入复现读取器：最后一行已写完，以及最后一行仍在追加。

```js
const half = '{"i":0,"pad":"aaa"}\n{"i":1,"pa';
const oldRead = (t) => t.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
const newRead = (t) => t.slice(0, t.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1).split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
oldRead(half); // 抛出 SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON
newRead(half); // 返回 1 行，不抛错
```

改动后预期的行为就是 `newRead` 这一形态。空输入、尚无换行的文件、以及只有一行且已终止的文件，分别得到「零个完整行」「零个完整行」「一行」。随后可在本地用 `npm run build && npm run bundle`、MySQL 8.4 与 `HostedBackgroundPublicationGate` 复核整条门禁。Hosted 故障车道在 PR 事件上会被跳过：PR 门禁只要 `fast` 档，该 job 只在非 fast 档运行。夜间 `sdk-java.yml` schedule 以默认 `full` 档运行全部 lane，因此在合并前要用 `gh workflow run sdk-java.yml --ref <branch>` 手动触发来拿到该结果。

### 证据（Before & After）

改动前，喂入写了一半的尾行：`SyntaxError: Unterminated string in JSON at position 436`，与 #14495 的堆栈一致。改动后：解析出 1 个完整行，尾部被忽略。本机用合成并发追加/读取探针跑了 1808 次读取，没有撞上该窗口（Node 22，窗口很窄），所以上面的确定性半行用例是直接见证；#14495 记录了 Node 24 下 2040 次读取中 14 次读到半行。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

macOS：读取器语义探针、`eslint`、`prettier --check`、`tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json`（改动文件无诊断；其余报错都在无关文件里：`packages/channels/email/dist` 陈旧导致缺少导出符号，以及一处 `minimatch` 类型不匹配）。Linux：本机未运行该门禁车道。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：该行在其追加完成后的一次轮询即可见，`waitUntil` 本来就容忍这一点；完整但内容损坏的行仍然抛错，不会静默吞掉损坏。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有在本地执行失败的 Java 门禁（需要 MySQL 与 hosted harness）。其他解析事务字节的驱动不受影响，因为它们读的是已提交记录，不是实时追加目标。该辅助模块的单测由 `vitest run --root ./integration-tests`（合并后/夜间的 E2E 车道）收集，不在 no-AK 车道的显式清单里。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14495

prs.title: fix(ci): Retry transient Maven transfer failures before autofix
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Recognize transient Maven artifact-transfer failures from failed-step logs and route infrastructure-only first attempts through the existing one-time rerun. Preserve normal issue reporting for compiler/test failures, mixed failures, incomplete evidence, repeated failures, and failed rerun dispatch.

## Why it's needed

A failed Maven command normally produces only a generic exit-code annotation. The actual download error appears in its logs, so annotation-only detection sends temporary repository outages to the code-repair queue.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use a local Maven mirror returning HTTP 503 to generate a real transfer failure. With a generic exit-code annotation and run attempt 1, confirm that the workflow reruns the failed jobs without creating an autofix issue.
2. Confirm that compiler/test errors, mixed network/code failures, missing logs, and HTTP 401/404 failures still create an issue.
3. Confirm that attempt 2 creates an issue, and that a failed rerun dispatch falls back to issue creation.
4. Confirm that non-main and pull-request triggering runs are skipped.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI screenshots.

Before: a real Maven HTTP 503 produced `infra_only=false` and selected autofix issue creation.

After: the same failure produces `infra_only=true` and selects one rerun. Negative controls retain normal reporting.

Validation passed: 126 focused tests on each platform, 22 workflow-script scenarios on each platform, and 24 complete workflow scenarios through act in Docker Linux. Local build, bundle, typecheck, changed-file lint, and formatting checks also passed.

prs.title: fix(serve): answer a batch the publication limit refused instead of blocking the Session
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the store refuses a batch's tool publication reservation with one of its limit codes, the Harness can now answer the batch and let the turn go on, instead of blocking the Session on recovery. The codes are `429 managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted` and `409 managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted`, added by #14451.

The refusal can only arrive while the batch is still being reserved, before any of its calls runs. The Harness answers only with proof that none of them started and none can start:

- Every reserved execution read `prepared` from the Broker before its cancel (so it was never dispatched), the cancel succeeded, and it then read `settled` within 30 s.
- A publication (v3) execution must settle with the Broker's own `not_started` result. A legacy execution settles `cancelled`.
- A background Shell's record still needs the #13801 proof: a confirmed close or the absence of its process-ledger row.
- A Monitor whose close was not confirmed settles on the Broker's not-started record, the execution half of what `close_not_started` checks.
- Any record that fails to settle keeps the turn blocked.

With that proof, each call is answered `This call was not started: <store message>.`, followed by "Retry after the running tools finish." for the 429, or for the 409 a note that retained output keeps the limit full and a retry will not succeed now. The answer commits before its await_runtime item resolves, in the order Runtime results use. File history is settled as for a finished batch, and the turn continues. Without that proof, and for every other failure, the turn waits for recovery as before; a comment at the throw now says why.

`HostedWorkspaceBroker.status()` also returns a settled record's `executionStatus`; the existing callers read only `state`.

## Why it's needed

In #14434 the Harness reacted to any failure after the batch's dispatch committed, including a capacity refusal, by cancelling, proving what it could, and then always throwing `HostedToolRecoveryRequiredError`. The Session was then blocked (`409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`) for a tool call that never ran, until a recovery path lifted the block. A full tenant cost the Session its next turn, and the model never learned why.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` covers the following.

Answered as not started:

- a capacity-refused foreground Shell. It asserts the answer text, `executionStatus: 'not_started'`, the order (reserve ×3, close, tool_result, resolve), the settled item, and that `finish()` succeeds afterwards;
- a retention-refused Shell (one reserve, no retry);
- a background Shell with process-ledger proof;
- a Monitor;
- a mixed batch of two Shells, a read_file refused before dispatch (which keeps its own answer) and an Edit. Every reservation is closed and the file history ends with no pending turn.

Still recovery-blocked:

- a non-limit 429 or 409, or a limit code under another status;
- a limit refusal raised after calls may run;
- an execution past `prepared`, unreadable before or after its cancel, gone, unknown or abandoned after it;
- a v3 execution that settled with another result;
- a failed cancel (no waiting);
- a window that closes (`cancel_requested` or `prepared` past 30 s);
- a later execution without proof;
- a background Shell or Monitor whose record does not settle;
- an answer that cannot be stored inline.

Each blocked case asserts the Broker read count, so none passes only through a timeout.

Results:

- `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`: 282 pass. `hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts`: 52 pass.
- All of `packages/cli/src/serve` on the rebased branch: 346 files, 15378 passed, 75 skipped.
- `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` are clean.
- Mutation testing killed every proof condition, the `executing` guard, the status/code match, the resolve-after-commit order, the `uncertain` reset, the file-history settle, the error wrapping and the Monitor settle by assertion. The deferred list names the few that survive.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both runs used the same rig: the FG8d gate (`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`) on MySQL 8.4.6 with a delegated cgroup v2 root, with `active-captures` lowered from 4 to 2 and the FG8d lease set back to 60 s. That is the #14434 repro: case 4, `cancel-reply-lost`, finds both slots held.

- **Before** (main):
  - `Tool publication close was not confirmed: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
  - `Settled never-started background child run … from durable process-ledger absence.`
  - `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
  - The turn never settled (`modelCalls=1`).
- **After** (#14451 + this PR):
  - `Settled never-started background child run … from durable process-ledger absence.`
  - `Tool publication refused batch … before any call started: Tool publication reservation refused at the active_captures limit`
  - `harness:turn_settled` and `settleTurn` committed. The model was called again with the answer (`modelCalls=2`).
  - The child run ended `failed` / `not_started_proven` (`start_failed`), and the Broker execution `SETTLED` / `not_started`. No recovery block.

The gate case itself still fails in both runs, because its choreography expects the run to start. Here the refusal is the point.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Vitest suites in a pnpm worktree; the gate run used a bundled CLI, a private MySQL 8.4.6 container and a delegated cgroup v2 root.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: answering a dispatched call as not started is safe only with the proof above, so the proof errs toward recovery. A batch that lacks it, for any reason, stays blocked exactly as before.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The v3 Shell answer writes no `tool.receipt`, matching how recovery answers parked items.
  - The 30 s settle poll does not watch the turn's abort signal (a `prepared` cancel settles at once).
  - The Harness does not back off: the model may retry each turn until capacity frees.
  - A granted reservation whose close fails holds its slot until its grant expires.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Without #14451 the store never sends these codes and nothing changes. Merge #14451 first.

Audit: three rounds of paired undirected and adversarial audits, in which the auditors ran tests and mutants, plus a composition round after the rebase. The rounds and the deferred findings are in a PR comment.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14434 (together with #14451).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当 store 以限额 code 拒绝一个批次的工具 publication 预留时，Harness 现在可以对这一批作答并让 turn 继续，而不是让 Session 阻塞在 recovery 上。这两个 code 是 #14451 新增的 `429 managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted` 和 `409 managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted`。

这种拒绝只会在批次还在预留时到达，那时批次里的任何调用都还没运行。Harness 只有在证明它们都没启动、也不可能再启动时才作答：

- 每个已预留的执行在 cancel 之前从 Broker 读到 `prepared`（说明从未 dispatch），cancel 成功，之后在 30 秒内读到 `settled`。
- publication（v3）执行必须以 Broker 自己的 `not_started` 结果结算。legacy 执行结算为 `cancelled`。
- 后台 Shell 的记录仍然需要 #13801 的证明：close 被确认，或者它的 process-ledger 行不存在。
- close 未被确认的 Monitor，凭 Broker 的未启动记录结算，也就是 `close_not_started` 所检查内容中执行那一半。
- 只要有记录结算失败，turn 就保持阻塞。

有了这些证明，每个调用都会得到答复 `This call was not started: <store message>.`：429 后面接 "Retry after the running tools finish."，409 则说明已保留的输出占满了该上限、现在重试不会成功。答复先提交，然后才 resolve 它的 await_runtime 项，顺序和 Runtime 结果一致。file history 按已完成的批次结算，turn 继续进行。拿不到这些证明，以及其他任何失败，turn 都像以前一样等待 recovery；抛异常的地方现在加了注释说明原因。

`HostedWorkspaceBroker.status()` 另外返回已结算记录的 `executionStatus`；现有调用方只读 `state`。

## 为什么需要

在 #14434 中，批次的 dispatch 提交之后出现任何失败，包括容量拒绝，Harness 都会取消、尽量证明，然后无条件抛出 `HostedToolRecoveryRequiredError`。于是 Session 被阻塞（`409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`），原因却是一个从未运行的工具调用，直到某条 recovery 路径解除阻塞为止。租户一满，Session 就失去下一轮，模型也始终不知道原因。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` 覆盖了以下情况。

以"未启动"作答的：

- 容量被拒的前台 Shell。断言了答复文本、`executionStatus: 'not_started'`、调用顺序（reserve ×3、close、tool_result、resolve）、已结算的项，以及之后 `finish()` 能成功；
- 因 retention 被拒的 Shell（只 reserve 一次，不重试）；
- 有 process-ledger 证明的后台 Shell；
- Monitor；
- 混合批次：两个 Shell、一个在 dispatch 前就被拒的 read_file（保留它自己的答复）和一个 Edit。每个预留都被 close，file history 最终没有待处理的 turn。

仍然阻塞在 recovery 上的：

- 非限额的 429 或 409，或者限额 code 配上了别的状态码；
- 调用可能已经运行之后才出现的限额拒绝；
- 执行已越过 `prepared`，cancel 前或后读不到，cancel 后消失、状态未知或被放弃；
- v3 执行以其他结果结算；
- cancel 失败（不再等待）；
- 等待窗口到期（超过 30 秒仍是 `cancel_requested` 或 `prepared`）；
- 后面某个执行缺少证明；
- 后台 Shell 或 Monitor 的记录结算失败；
- 答复无法 inline 存储。

每个阻塞用例都断言了 Broker 的读取次数，所以没有用例是靠超时通过的。

结果：

- `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`：282 个通过。`hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts`：52 个通过。
- rebase 后的分支上，整个 `packages/cli/src/serve`：346 个文件，15378 个通过，75 个跳过。
- `tsc --noEmit` 和 `eslint` 都干净。
- 变异测试中，每个证明条件、`executing` 守卫、状态码/code 匹配、先提交后 resolve 的顺序、`uncertain` 复位、file history 结算、错误包装和 Monitor 结算的变异，都被断言杀掉。少数存活的列在延后清单里。

### 证据（前后对比）

两次运行用的是同一套环境：FG8d gate（`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`），MySQL 8.4.6，委派的 cgroup v2 root，`active-captures` 从 4 降到 2，FG8d 的 lease 改回 60 秒。这就是 #14434 的复现方式：第 4 个用例 `cancel-reply-lost` 遇到两个名额都被占着。

- **修复前**（main）：
  - `Tool publication close was not confirmed: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
  - `Settled never-started background child run … from durable process-ledger absence.`
  - `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
  - turn 一直没有结算（`modelCalls=1`）。
- **修复后**（#14451 + 本 PR）：
  - `Settled never-started background child run … from durable process-ledger absence.`
  - `Tool publication refused batch … before any call started: Tool publication reservation refused at the active_captures limit`
  - `harness:turn_settled` 和 `settleTurn` 都已提交。模型带着答复被再次调用（`modelCalls=2`）。
  - 子 run 以 `failed` / `not_started_proven`（`start_failed`）结束，Broker 上的执行为 `SETTLED` / `not_started`。没有 recovery 阻塞。

两次运行里 gate 用例本身都失败，因为它的编排要求 run 必须启动。这里要验证的正是拒绝本身。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

在 pnpm worktree 中跑 Vitest 套件；gate 运行用了打包好的 CLI、私有的 MySQL 8.4.6 容器和委派的 cgroup v2 root。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：只有具备上述证明，把已 dispatch 的调用答成未启动才是安全的，所以证明条件宁可偏向 recovery。缺少证明的批次，不论原因，都和以前一样保持阻塞。
- 未验证或不在范围内：
  - v3 Shell 的答复不写 `tool.receipt`，与 recovery 对停放项的答复方式一致。
  - 30 秒的结算轮询不响应 turn 的 abort 信号（对 `prepared` 的 cancel 会立即结算）。
  - Harness 不做退避：在容量释放之前，模型可能每一轮都重试。
  - 已获批但 close 失败的预留，会一直占着名额，直到它的 grant 过期。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无。没有 #14451 时 store 不会发出这些 code，行为不变。请先合入 #14451。

审计：三轮配对的无方向审计和对抗审计，审计员都跑了测试和变异测试；rebase 之后又做了一轮组合审计。各轮情况和延后处理的发现写在 PR 评论里。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14434（与 #14451 一起）。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): answer a full tool publication reservation with its own code
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the store refuses a tool publication reservation because the tenant byte limit, the Session byte limit or the active-capture limit is full, it now answers with a code of its own instead of the generic `400 invalid_request`. It names the limit in the error envelope (`limit`: `tenant_bytes`, `session_bytes` or `active_captures`) and in the message (`Tool publication reservation refused at the <limit> limit`), and logs one WARN line with what it weighed: the limit, the class, the tenant and Session scope keys, and the held, used, requested and allowed bytes.

The status says whether the refusal can clear while the Session lives:

- `409 managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted` when used bytes alone fill a byte limit, whichever limit failed first. Only the Session's retirement and the collection of its output free used bytes, so retrying soon cannot succeed.
- `429 managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted` for every other refusal. Open captures give back what they hold beyond their used bytes when they finish, are fenced, expire or are referenced, and they leave the active count.

Which reservations are accepted is unchanged; only a refusal's status, code, message and log line change. The FG8d note and its design doc (both languages) now say the Harness *logged* the old refusal as "The request is invalid.".

## Why it's needed

In #14434 a full tenant answered the same 400 "The request is invalid." as a malformed request. The Harness log and its retry logic could not tell a capacity limit from a contract violation, and the cause was visible only through the internal-refusal WARN added by #14391. The Harness change that answers such a refused batch instead of blocking the Session (#14452) needs to tell these refusals apart and to know whether a retry can help.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `ToolPublicationStoreTest` (H2) pins:
  - each limit's status, code, message and `limit`;
  - that a byte limit is named before the capture limit;
  - that the tenant limit charges the tenant-wide sums and the Session limit the Session's own;
  - that a 409 needs used bytes alone to fill the limit: one used byte on either side of the boundary; a finished but unreferenced capture's unused admission does not count as retained; another Session's used bytes do not fill this Session's limit; a retained Session limit wins over a retryable tenant one;
  - the concurrent-reservation outcome;
  - the WARN line.
- `mvn -o -Dtest=ToolPublicationStoreTest test`: 144 pass. Full module unit suite on the rebased branch: 4438 run, 0 failures, 21 skipped. Both Checkstyle executions report 0 violations.
- Mutation testing of the changed lines killed every comparison, sum scope, used-bytes column, check order, status/code/details change and the tenant/active log arguments. The survivors are the Session line's log arguments, the placement of the two used-bytes queries, and one equivalent mutant (dropping `state <> 'NOT_STARTED'`, where used bytes are always 0).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Both runs used the same rig: the FG8d gate (`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`) on MySQL 8.4.6 with a delegated cgroup v2 root, with `active-captures` lowered from 4 to 2 and the FG8d lease set back to 60 s. That is the #14434 repro: case 4, `cancel-reply-lost`, finds both slots held.

- **Before** (main):
  - The server logged `Managed Agent refused an internal request: POST …/grants (ContractViolationException at ToolPublicationContract.require:441 < …)`.
  - The Harness logged `Tool publication close was not confirmed: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.` and then `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
- **After** (this PR + #14452):
  - The server logged `Tool publication reservation refused limit=active_captures retained=false tenant=… scope=… held=… used=… requested=… allowed=…` three times, because the Harness retries a 429.
  - The Harness answered the batch; see #14452.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven offline, H2 unit suite; a private MySQL 8.4.6 container and a delegated cgroup v2 root for the gate run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the 409/429 split is a prediction from the byte accounting.
  - Held but unused bytes that nothing releases are classed as 429 (rare: a capture fenced during finish verification, a quarantined or receipt-less finished capture).
  - A tenant-level 409 counts other Sessions' used bytes, which their retirement can free while this Session lives.
  - A single request larger than a limit is a 409, which is right for retrying but named as retention.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The MariaDB and Hosted CI lanes run in CI.
  - The HTTP envelope goes through the generic `ApiException` handler (no new controller test).
  - The execution-bytes limit (a request larger than one capture may be) still answers 400.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the reservation's refusal changes from 400 to 409/429 with new codes. The only caller is the Harness: its reserve loop retries a 429 twice and fails a 409 at once, then takes the same path as before until #14452.

Audit: four rounds of paired undirected and adversarial audits, in which the auditors ran tests and mutants, plus a composition round after the rebase. The rounds and the deferred findings are in a PR comment.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14434. The Harness half, #14452, closes it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当租户字节上限、Session 字节上限或活跃 capture 上限已满，store 拒绝工具 publication 预留时，不再回通用的 `400 invalid_request`，而是回专用的 code。错误信封里用 `limit`（`tenant_bytes`、`session_bytes` 或 `active_captures`）标明是哪个上限，message 里也写明（`Tool publication reservation refused at the <limit> limit`）。同时打一条 WARN，记录判断依据：上限、分类、租户和 Session 的 scope key，以及 held、used、requested、allowed 字节数。

状态码表示这次拒绝能否在 Session 存活期间自行消除：

- `409 managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted`：已用字节单独就占满某个字节上限，不论先失败的是哪个上限。已用字节只有在 Session 退役、其输出被回收后才释放，所以短时间内重试不会成功。
- `429 managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted`：其余所有拒绝。打开着的 capture 在 finish、被 fence、过期或被引用时，会交还超出已用字节的部分，也会退出活跃计数。

哪些预留会被接受没有任何变化，变的只是拒绝时的状态码、code、message 和日志。FG8d 的注释及其设计文档（中英文）改为说明当时 Harness 把旧的拒绝*记录为* "The request is invalid."。

## 为什么需要

在 #14434 中，租户已满时返回的 400 "The request is invalid." 和格式错误的请求一模一样，Harness 的日志和重试逻辑都分不清是容量上限还是契约违规，原因只能靠 #14391 新增的内部拒绝 WARN 才看得到。让 Harness 对这种被拒批次作答、而不是阻塞 Session 的那个改动（#14452），需要区分这些拒绝，并知道重试是否有用。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `ToolPublicationStoreTest`（H2）钉住了：
  - 每个上限的状态码、code、message 和 `limit`；
  - 字节上限先于 capture 上限被报出；
  - 租户上限按整个租户的总量计算，Session 上限按该 Session 自己的总量计算；
  - 只有已用字节单独占满上限才回 409：边界两侧各差一个已用字节；已 finish 但未被引用的 capture，其未用的 admission 不算已保留；另一个 Session 的已用字节不会占满本 Session 的上限；Session 上限被已保留字节占满时，优先于租户上限的可重试结果；
  - 并发预留的结果；
  - WARN 日志行。
- `mvn -o -Dtest=ToolPublicationStoreTest test`：144 个通过。rebase 后的分支上，模块完整单元套件 4438 个，0 失败，21 个跳过。两套 Checkstyle 都是 0 违规。
- 对改动行做了变异测试：所有比较、求和范围、已用字节列、检查顺序、状态码/code/details 的改动，以及租户和活跃 capture 两行日志的参数，都被杀掉了。存活的是 Session 那一行日志的参数、两次已用字节查询的位置，以及一个等价变异（去掉 `state <> 'NOT_STARTED'`，这类行的已用字节恒为 0）。

### 证据（前后对比）

两次运行用的是同一套环境：FG8d gate（`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8dCancellationAndDrainSettleHonestlyOnMySql`），MySQL 8.4.6，委派的 cgroup v2 root，`active-captures` 从 4 降到 2，FG8d 的 lease 改回 60 秒。这就是 #14434 的复现方式：第 4 个用例 `cancel-reply-lost` 遇到两个名额都被占着。

- **修复前**（main）：
  - 服务端记录 `Managed Agent refused an internal request: POST …/grants (ContractViolationException at ToolPublicationContract.require:441 < …)`。
  - Harness 先记录 `Tool publication close was not confirmed: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`，再记录 `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`
- **修复后**（本 PR + #14452）：
  - 服务端记录了三次 `Tool publication reservation refused limit=active_captures retained=false tenant=… scope=… held=… used=… requested=… allowed=…`，因为 Harness 会重试 429。
  - Harness 对这一批作了答复，见 #14452。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21，Maven 离线，H2 单元套件；gate 运行用了私有的 MySQL 8.4.6 容器和委派的 cgroup v2 root。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：409/429 的划分是根据字节核算做出的预测。
  - 没有任何操作会释放的、已持有但未使用的字节，会被归为 429（少见：finish 校验期间被 fence 的 capture，被隔离或拿不到 receipt 的已 finish capture）。
  - 租户级的 409 计入了其他 Session 的已用字节，这些 Session 退役后，即使本 Session 还活着也可能释放。
  - 单次请求本身就超过某个上限时回 409：就重试而言这是对的，但名字叫 retention。
- 未验证或不在范围内：
  - MariaDB 和 Hosted 的 CI 通道在 CI 里跑。
  - HTTP 信封走通用的 `ApiException` handler（没有新增 controller 测试）。
  - execution-bytes 上限（单次请求超过一个 capture 允许的大小）仍然返回 400。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：预留被拒时从 400 变为 409/429，并带新的 code。唯一的调用方是 Harness：它的 reserve 循环对 429 重试两次、对 409 立即失败，之后走的路径和以前一样，直到 #14452 合入。

审计：四轮配对的无方向审计和对抗审计，审计员都跑了测试和变异测试；rebase 之后又做了一轮组合审计。各轮情况和延后处理的发现写在 PR 评论里。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14434。由 Harness 侧的 #14452 关闭它。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(managed-agent): answer a full tool publication reservation with its own code (#14451)
auto_merge.commit_message:
A reservation refused at the tenant byte, Session byte or active-capture
limit answered the generic 400 invalid_request, so the Harness logged
only "The request is invalid." and could not tell a full tenant from a
malformed request. The store now names the limit in the error envelope
(`limit`) and in the message, and the status says whether the refusal
can clear while the Session lives:

- 409 managed_tool_publication_retention_exhausted when used bytes alone
  fill a byte limit, whichever limit failed first. Only the Session's
  retirement and the collection of its output free used bytes.
- 429 managed_tool_publication_capacity_exhausted for every other
  refusal: open captures give back what they hold beyond their used
  bytes when they finish, are fenced, expire or are referenced, and
  leave the active count.

Each refusal logs one WARN line with the limit, its class, the tenant
and Session scope keys, and the held, used, requested and allowed bytes.
The FG8d note and its design doc now say the Harness logged the old
refusal as "The request is invalid.".

Refs #14434

prs.title: fix(cli): resolve the /auth strings at render time, not at import time
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`/auth` no longer paints a half-translated dialog. Every string the auth dialogs render is now resolved when it is painted rather than while the module graph is being imported.

The eager module-scope constants in both parity implementations (`MAIN_ITEMS`, `PROTOCOL_ITEMS`, and the two navigation hints) become small thunks that call `t()` on demand. `VIEW_TITLES` is converted the same way so the two constant classes agree, but that half is a behaviour-preserving refactor: at this PR's merge base it was already a `Record<string, () => string>` invoked during render, so it carried no user-visible defect. That is the same shape `providerToItem` and `getStepLabel` in the same files already use.

## Why it's needed

Module-scope `t()` calls run at import time, and `initializeI18n()` is awaited later in the entry module. Whatever dictionary happens to be loaded when the module is first imported is what those constants keep forever. A zh-locale user opening `/auth` therefore saw the provider sub-menu titles translated (those call `t()` at render time) while the main view title and the navigation hints stayed in the import-time locale — half the dialog in Chinese, half in English, with no way to correct it short of a restart.

This is the remaining leg of the class the stacked credential PR closed for one constant; the sub-menu *items* were already translated before it because `providerToItem` calls `t()` per render.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two suites that own these dialogs:

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/auth/AuthDialog.test.tsx
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/dialogs-auth.test.tsx
```

A reviewer can also confirm by hand: set the locale to Chinese, open `/auth`, and check that the main view title reads `连接服务商` rather than `Connect a Provider`. Before the change the title stayed English even though the sub-menu title one keystroke away was already Chinese.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Two new pins were added to `AuthDialog.test.tsx`. They are deliberately **keystroke-free and ungated**, because the keystroke assertions elsewhere in that file sit behind `itWhenTuiInputReliable`, which skips under `CI=true` — a gated pin would never run where it matters.

`AuthDialog locale resolution > resolves the main view title at render time, not at import time` renders the dialog in English, then switches the locale to Chinese and renders again without remounting the module, asserting the title follows the locale in force at render time.

Mutation check: freezing the titles at import time (`const __FROZEN = getViewTitles()` used by the render path) makes both new pins fail with `expected '┌────…' to contain '连接服务商'`; restoring the thunk makes them pass. The pins therefore track the fix, not the refactor.

```
✓ src/ui/auth/AuthDialog.test.tsx (29 tests | 20 skipped) 351ms
    Tests  9 passed | 20 skipped (29)
✓ src/ui/opentui/dialogs-auth.test.tsx (46 tests) 510ms
    Tests  46 passed (46)
npx eslint <the three files>            → clean
npx prettier --check <the three files>  → clean
```

The OpenTUI suite is version-sensitive (it fakes the renderer hooks), so the transformation was additionally verified for behaviour preservation on the baseline tree: applying the identical textual transformation to the pre-change `dialogs-auth.tsx` keeps all 46 OpenTUI tests green, i.e. the change only moves *when* `t()` runs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

Both suites above plus `eslint` and `prettier` were run on Windows. The change is locale resolution and render-time evaluation only; it contains no platform-specific code.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only, no dev server or sandbox runtime involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the constants are now re-created per render instead of once per module load. They are three small array/object literals and two strings, and `providerToItem` already rebuilt a similar object per item per render, so the cost is negligible; the benefit is that a locale change is picked up without a restart.
- Not validated / out of scope: `MODELS_*` in `dialogs-auth.tsx` is intentionally left eager. Its keys have no zh entry today, and that region is hoisted specifically so the region budget measures the same strings the step paints; converting it would need a size-budget pass of its own.
- Not validated / out of scope: the OpenTUI suite could not be run against the post-change file in the environment used for this change (its fakes lag the current source); behaviour preservation was established on the baseline tree instead, as described above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14328 — this closes the actionable set described there (`MAIN_ITEMS` labels/descriptions plus the two navigation hints). `VIEW_TITLES` is converted here as well, but only as a consistency refactor: it was already invoked at render time at this PR's merge base, so it was not a user-visible defect and this PR does not claim to fix one. It deliberately does not use a closing keyword: `MODELS_*` and the `itWhenTuiInputReliable` gating question raised in the same issue are out of scope here.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`/auth` 不再渲染出「半翻译」的对话框。认证对话框渲染的每一个字符串，现在都在**绘制时**解析，而不是在模块被导入时解析。

两个对等实现里模块级的常量（`MAIN_ITEMS`、`PROTOCOL_ITEMS`，以及两条导航提示）改成按需调用 `t()` 的小函数（thunk）。`VIEW_TITLES` 也一并改成同样写法，让两类常量统一，但这一半属于行为等价的重构：在本 PR 的 merge base 上它已经是 `Record<string, () => string>`、在渲染期调用，并不携带用户可见缺陷。这与同文件里 `providerToItem`、`getStepLabel` 已有的写法一致。

## 为什么需要

模块级的 `t()` 调用发生在导入期，而 `initializeI18n()` 在入口模块里是更晚才被 await 的。模块第一次被导入时恰好加载了哪份字典，这些常量就会永远保留哪份。因此中文用户在打开 `/auth` 时会看到：服务商子菜单标题是中文（那些在渲染时调用 `t()`），而主视图标题和导航提示仍是导入时的语言——半个对话框中文、半个英文，且只能靠重启修正。

这是堆叠凭据 PR 只修掉其中一个常量的那一类问题里剩下的部分；子菜单**条目**在此之前就已经是翻译好的，因为 `providerToItem` 每次渲染都会调用 `t()`。

## 评审验证方式

运行拥有这两个对话框的两套测试：

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/auth/AuthDialog.test.tsx
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/dialogs-auth.test.tsx
```

也可以手工确认：把语言设为中文，打开 `/auth`，主视图标题应显示 `连接服务商` 而不是 `Connect a Provider`。改动前，即使相隔一次按键的子菜单标题已是中文，该标题仍保持英文。

## 证据（改动前 / 改动后）

在 `AuthDialog.test.tsx` 中新增了两条断言。它们刻意**不需要按键、也不被门控**，因为该文件里其他依赖按键的断言位于 `itWhenTuiInputReliable` 之后，在 `CI=true` 下会被跳过——被门控的断言在最需要它的地方根本不会运行。

`AuthDialog locale resolution > resolves the main view title at render time, not at import time` 先用英文渲染对话框，再切换语言为中文并重新渲染（不重新加载模块），断言标题跟随渲染时生效的语言。

变异校验：把标题在导入期冻结（渲染路径改用 `const __FROZEN = getViewTitles()`）会让两条新断言都以 `expected '┌────…' to contain '连接服务商'` 失败；恢复成 thunk 后通过。也就是说这两条断言锁定的是修复本身，而不是重构。

```
✓ src/ui/auth/AuthDialog.test.tsx (29 tests | 20 skipped) 351ms
    Tests  9 passed | 20 skipped (29)
✓ src/ui/opentui/dialogs-auth.test.tsx (46 tests) 510ms
    Tests  46 passed (46)
npx eslint <三个文件>            → 干净
npx prettier --check <三个文件>  → 干净
```

OpenTUI 那套测试对版本敏感（它伪造了渲染器 hook），所以另外在基线树上验证了变换的行为保持性：把完全相同的文本变换应用到改动前的 `dialogs-auth.tsx`，46 条 OpenTUI 测试全绿——说明本次改动只是改变了 `t()` 执行的**时机**。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：常量现在每次渲染重新构造，而不是每次模块加载构造一次。它们是三个小的数组/对象字面量和两个字符串，而 `providerToItem` 本来每次渲染、每个条目都会重建一个类似对象，开销可忽略；换来的是切换语言无需重启即可生效。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：`dialogs-auth.tsx` 里的 `MODELS_*` 有意保持模块级求值。它的键目前没有中文条目，而且该区域被特意提升出来，是为了让「区域预算」度量与步骤绘制的字符串一致；改动它需要单独做一次尺寸预算评估。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：在当前环境里无法对改动后的文件运行 OpenTUI 那套测试（它的伪造 hook 落后于当前源码）；因此改为在基线树上证明行为保持性，如上所述。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14328 —— 本 PR 关闭了其中描述的可行动集合（`MAIN_ITEMS` 的标签与描述，加两条导航提示）。`VIEW_TITLES` 也一并做了转换，但仅属写法统一：在本 PR 的 merge base 上它已经在渲染期调用，并非用户可见缺陷，本 PR 也不声称修复了这样一个缺陷。这里刻意不使用自动关闭关键字：同一 issue 中提到的 `MODELS_*` 与 `itWhenTuiInputReliable` 门控问题不在本 PR 范围内。

</details>

prs.title: docs(troubleshooting): add workaround for TUI flicker in web-based terminals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a troubleshooting entry for TUI flickering/tearing in web-based terminals (for example Alibaba Cloud Workbench), documenting the confirmed cause and the verified workaround (`ui.useTerminalBuffer: false`, optionally `ui.mouseTracking: false`). Docs only — no code changes.

## Why it's needed

Issue #8659 reports continuous flicker/tearing when Qwen Code runs in browser-based terminals. @doudouOUC confirmed the cause in the thread: `shouldUseVirtualViewport()` cannot distinguish web terminals (`TERM=xterm` on a TTY, no `COLORTERM`, no `TERM_PROGRAM`), so Virtualized History activates by default and its full-screen ANSI repaints overwhelm high-latency web terminals. The fix direction agreed in the thread is "docs + startup hint first, auto-detection later". This PR delivers the docs half so affected users can find the workaround today; the startup hint and auto-detection need a detection-heuristic design discussion (missing `COLORTERM` + `TERM_PROGRAM` alone false-positives on ordinary SSH xterm sessions) and are proposed as a follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Docs-only change. Confirm the new entry renders correctly in `docs/users/support/troubleshooting.md` (placed next to the other terminal-behavior entries: tmux trackpad, right-click/mouse tracking). The workaround itself was verified by the reporter in #8659: setting `ui.useTerminalBuffer: false` switches rendering to the append-only Static path and resolves the flicker in Alibaba Cloud Workbench.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — docs change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Alibaba Cloud Workbench (browser-based terminal), TERM=xterm, no COLORTERM/TERM_PROGRAM — the environment from the original report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none identified; documentation only, workaround wording follows the maintainer's confirmed analysis in #8659.
- Not validated / out of scope: the startup hint and web-terminal auto-detection/fallback (needs design discussion on reliable detection signals; offered as follow-up).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Part of #8659

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

为「基于 Web 的终端（如阿里云 Workbench）中 TUI 闪烁/撕裂」问题新增一条 troubleshooting 文档，记录已确认的原因和已验证的解决方案（`ui.useTerminalBuffer: false`，可选 `ui.mouseTracking: false`）。纯文档改动，无代码变更。

## 为什么需要

Issue #8659 报告在浏览器终端中运行时 Qwen Code 持续闪屏/撕裂。@doudouOUC 在讨论中确认了原因：`shouldUseVirtualViewport()` 无法识别 web 终端（TTY 上 `TERM=xterm`、无 `COLORTERM`、无 `TERM_PROGRAM`），导致 Virtualized History 默认启用，其全屏 ANSI 重绘超出高延迟 web 终端的处理能力。讨论中商定的修复方向是「先文档 + 启动提示，自动检测后续再做」。本 PR 先交付文档部分，让受影响用户今天就能找到解决方案；启动提示与自动检测需要先讨论检测启发式（仅凭缺少 `COLORTERM` + `TERM_PROGRAM` 会在普通 SSH xterm 会话上误报），建议作为后续 PR。

## 审阅者测试计划

验证方式：纯文档改动。确认 `docs/users/support/troubleshooting.md` 中新条目渲染正常（与 tmux 滚轮、右键/鼠标追踪等其他终端行为条目放在一起）。解决方案本身已由 #8659 报告者验证：设置 `ui.useTerminalBuffer: false` 后渲染切换到 append-only Static 路径，阿里云 Workbench 中闪烁消失。

前后对比：N/A — 文档改动。

测试系统：Linux ✅（macOS/Windows N/A）。

环境：阿里云 Workbench（浏览器终端），TERM=xterm，无 COLORTERM/TERM_PROGRAM —— 与原始报告一致。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：未发现；纯文档，措辞遵循 maintainer 在 #8659 中确认的分析。
- 未验证/超出范围：启动提示与 web 终端自动检测回退（需先讨论可靠的检测信号，愿作为后续 PR 跟进）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #8659（不自动关闭，自动检测部分待后续）

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): run private CSI file turns through Hosted Harness
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enables original private CSI Sessions to run `read_file`, `write_file`, and `edit` through the Hosted Harness after #14081. File mutations require durable backup preparation before dispatch; complete tool outcomes and history are retained, and the final model response is committed together with its attempt receipt before results are marked consumed. A checkpoint command now derives its identity and digest from the state actually committed after any intervening activation renewal.

## Why it's needed

The private file worker, retained-history backend, and native SQL admission are already on main, while the Hosted caller currently supports text turns only. This extracts the normal original-owner file path from cumulative #13526 so it can be reviewed independently of replacement-owner recovery and physical retirement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Attach an already provisioned READY private CSI Session with its operator credentials. Confirm that only the three file tools are advertised and that a read/write turn followed by a read/edit turn preserves the original writer generation, activation epoch, Runtime binding, complete function identities, and file preimages. The model must receive the persisted results, produce one final assistant response, and leave the normal continuation settled.

Retry an identical prompt and expect the same terminal receipt with no new model request or file execution. Confirm that budget directives and unsupported inputs are refused, and that an uncertain reservation, execution response, or oversized complete tool outcome blocks further work while retaining evidence. Plain text and chunked long replies must continue to work. Local shutdown must join entered work without releasing the remote Runtime or claiming physical cleanup.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The installed global CLI cannot enter this private route (authenticated attachment returns 404). A separately built main accepts text turns and rejects file calls with no tool declarations. The extracted candidate completes all three tools through the packaged daemon using owned HTTP fixtures, and the actual Hosted producer is also checked against the Java SQL/Broker/worker consumer with explicit placement and mount facades. Detailed results and boundaries are in the separate E2E report comment.

The latest review fix is validated at `92ae662492ff11db247ef3509f1095f632caf238`: root build/bundle, 27 focused Java tests and JDK 21 full-module verification pass with 4,585 tests, zero failures/errors and 18 environment-dependent skips, including both Checkstyle executions and high-confidence SpotBugs. The real Hosted producer also passes H2 and disposable MySQL 8.4 SQL/Broker/worker acceptance with a refused root write followed by admitted read/write, then a normal read/edit turn. The same new regression failed reservation before the fix; the independent native-reader reproduction now accepts the surviving call while still rejecting three identity-tamper controls. A packaged-daemon happy-path control passes 18/18 assertions. Detailed evidence is recorded per commit in the separate validation comments; earlier extraction results are not presented as reruns of this update. The complete local `/review` workflow remains unavailable because this Codex host lacks its required Workflow tool; no local automated verdict or maintainer architecture approval is claimed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local build, focused tests and owned fixtures |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Native CSI/deployed chain not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 22.14.0 and JDK 21. The model and remote transport endpoints are owned loopback fixtures. SQL acceptance uses the real Java consumer; the mount/placement facade does not establish native Linux mount provenance.

## Risk & Scope

- Shared model-attempt and checkpoint changes cross CLI/Core boundaries and need maintainer architectural review. This is a feature extraction, and the production diff exceeds the 1,000-line advisory threshold.
- Limited to the original READY Session, writer generation 1 and activation epoch 1, with the existing private capability digest. No public CSI admission, replacement writer, cold recovery, cut/finalize, remote sealing, physical retirement, release, unpublication, or volume reuse is introduced.
- Native Java admission now validates receipt-less deterministic refusals, preserves mixed-batch identity across refusal progress, and accepts atomic final-output evidence. These durable admission changes also require Managed Agent Server maintainer review. There are no schema or deployment changes. Existing remote resource retention and its cost remain unchanged pending the separate retirement work.
- Synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-hosted-files/docs/design/2026-10-17-private-csi-hosted-files.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-hosted-files/docs/design/2026-10-17-private-csi-hosted-files.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #13526. Follows merged #14081; does not close the cumulative PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 变更

在 #14081 之后，为原私有 CSI Session 接入 Hosted Harness 的 `read_file`、`write_file` 和 `edit`。文件修改派发前必须持久保存备份准备；完整工具结果与历史均被保留，最终模型回复与其 attempt 回执一并提交后，才将结果标记为已消费。检查点命令根据实际提交的状态分配身份和摘要，避免 activation 续租插队造成不一致。

### 动机

主干已有私有文件 worker、保留历史的 backend 和原生 SQL 准入，但 Hosted 调用方目前只能执行文本 Turn。本次从累计 #13526 中拆出原 owner 的正常文件链，供独立评审；替代 owner 恢复和物理退役继续单独处理。

### 评审验证

使用 operator 凭据接入预先创建且处于 READY 的私有 CSI Session。确认只声明三个文件工具，先读写、再读和编辑，原 writer generation、activation epoch、Runtime binding、完整函数身份与文件原像保持正确。模型应收到已持久保存的结果、产生一份最终 assistant 回复，并完成正常 continuation。

准确重试同一 prompt，应返回相同终态回执，且不再调用模型或执行文件操作。budget directive 与未支持输入应被拒绝；reservation、执行回包不确定或完整工具结果超限时，应阻止后续工作并保留证据。普通文本与分块长回复仍应可用。本地停止应等待已进入的工作，不释放远端 Runtime，也不宣称物理清理完成。

### 前后证据

全局安装 CLI 无法进入该私有路由，认证 attachment 返回 404。另行构建的主干允许文本 Turn，无工具声明并拒绝文件调用。本次候选通过自有 HTTP fixture 驱动打包后的 daemon，跑通三个工具；还将实际 Hosted producer 接到 Java SQL/Broker/worker consumer，明确标注 placement 和 mount facade。详细结果与边界见独立 E2E 报告评论。

本轮修复在 `92ae662492ff11db247ef3509f1095f632caf238` 上完成验证：root build/bundle、27 项聚焦 Java 测试，以及 JDK 21 全模块验证通过，共 4,585 项测试、零失败和错误，18 项按环境条件跳过；两项 Checkstyle 和高置信度 SpotBugs 检查均通过。真实 Hosted producer 还通过 H2 与一次性 MySQL 8.4 SQL/Broker/worker 验收：同批次先拒绝根目录写入、再准入读写，随后正常完成读与编辑。相同新增回归在修复前预约失败；独立 native-reader 复现现已允许合法剩余调用，同时继续拒绝三种身份篡改对照。打包 daemon 正常链路通过 18/18 项断言。独立验证评论按提交记录详细证据，较早的拆分结果不作为本轮重跑结果。当前 Codex 仍缺少完整本地 `/review` 所需的 Workflow 工具，没有宣称本地自动评审 verdict 或维护者架构批准。

### 本地环境

macOS 已执行构建、聚焦测试和自有 fixture；Windows 未在本地测试；Linux 原生 CSI/部署链未在本地测试。使用 Node 22.14.0 和 JDK 21，模型与远端传输端点为自有 loopback fixture。SQL 验收使用真实 Java consumer；mount/placement facade 不能证明 Linux 原生挂载来源。

### 风险与范围

共享 model-attempt 与检查点变更跨越 CLI/Core，需要维护者架构评审。本次属于功能拆分，生产 diff 超过 1,000 行提示阈值。仅支持原 READY Session、writer generation 1、activation epoch 1 和既有私有 capability digest。不引入公开 CSI 准入、替代 writer、冷恢复、cut/finalize、远端 seal、物理退役、释放、卸载或卷复用。原生 Java 准入增加无 Runtime 回执的确定性拒绝校验、保留混合批次在拒绝进度变化后的身份，并接受原子最终输出证据；这些持久化准入变更还需要 Managed Agent Server 维护者评审。没有 schema 或部署变更。远端资源保留及其费用保持现状，等待单独的退役工作。

设计文档的[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-hosted-files/docs/design/2026-10-17-private-csi-hosted-files.md)和[中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/csi-hosted-files/docs/design/2026-10-17-private-csi-hosted-files.zh-CN.md)完整同步。关联 #13526，接续已合并的 #14081，不关闭累计 PR。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): preserve rotated credential keys during operator recovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lets operator recovery read the same active and previous Runtime credential keys as the control plane. Successful key-ring construction reports the resolved active/configured IDs, and missing-key errors identify the requested ID. Diagnostics JSON-escape IDs and never include secret values. Missing-key labels cannot turn an internal error into a false Broker-closed response.

## Why it's needed

After key rotation, recovery already binds the previous-key map but discards it when constructing its credential protector. An operator can therefore supply the documented keys and still fail to read a pre-rotation binding. The generic missing-key message also hides relaxed-binding mistakes. This fixes both deferred findings from #14317 without changing credential selection, ciphertext, recovery authorization or physical-stop fences.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use the existing Linux/MySQL operator-recovery scenario with a distinct new active key and the old key in the bound map. Inspect, prepare and complete must read the old binding, preserve its original provision-seed ciphertext/key ID, release only the verified original holder and permit a subsequent Session. Omitting the old key must still refuse recovery. Check one startup ID summary and an unavailable-key error with spaces, quotes, controls and non-ASCII IDs; key material, ciphertext and tokens must remain absent. A missing key with a configured ID containing `closed` must remain a generic 500 response; an actually closed Broker must still return 503.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Source-level before: the maintenance entry constructed a single-key protector even after Spring had bound the old keys. The existing real-process regression now supplies a different active ID/key plus the old map, so the previous code fails its first old-key seed read. This integration scenario has not yet been executed.

A remote JDK 21 harness compiled and ran the four complete unchanged candidate protector classes with existing fastjson2/SLF4J/Logback jars: 14/14 assertions passed. It covered old-key reads, active-key writes, context/key/tamper refusal, one constructor INFO summary, safely escaped requested/active/configured IDs, and secret-free malformed/absent/short-key diagnostics. This did not execute Spring recovery binding or the Hosted scenario.

A separate real JDK HTTP probe exercised the exact production error-mapping methods: before the mapping fix, changing a configured ID to `ring-closed-2026` turned the same missing-key error from 500 into false 503 `runtime_broker_closed`. After the fix, both ordinary and `closed` IDs return generic 500, while a truly closed Broker remains 503; response bodies omit every key ID. Before ran on remote Linux/JDK 21; after ran on remote Darwin/JDK 21 because Linux SSH timed out before execution. This verifies the platform-independent mapping and transport, not full service routing.

Consolidated local review and ponytail found no blocking issue. The complete static review gate passed for this exact candidate; full module and Hosted acceptance remain unverified. Changed documentation passed formatting and reference checks; the patch passed whitespace checks. No local build was run. Full module, real Spring subprocess, Linux/MySQL, Hosted acceptance and screenshots remain unverified.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Remote JDK 21: actual protector classes, 14/14 passed, and three actual HTTP mapping cases passed; full server unverified |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | Before-only HTTP regression reproduced on remote Linux/JDK 21; full recovery/MySQL and Linux after verification unexecuted |

### Environment (optional)

Existing remote macmini JDK 21 and a checksum-verified temporary Linux JDK 21 cache, with existing dependency jars staged only into temporary remote directories. No deployment or service configuration changes.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: logs now expose non-secret key IDs to operators. All ID-bearing diagnostics use JSON escaping; key bytes, maps containing secret values, plaintext, ciphertext and tokens are excluded.
- Not validated / out of scope: full module and physical recovery acceptance remain unverified. CSI/migration environment-variable entries retain their single-pair contract; no new map protocol, startup database scan or automatic re-encryption is introduced.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; active-key-only configuration and persisted ciphertext remain compatible. Keep every previous key until no stored reference needs it.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/110b6325612861897dd039fe379013745ac28f97/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/110b6325612861897dd039fe379013745ac28f97/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14408

Refs #12380

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

让 operator recovery 与控制面读取相同的 active/previous Runtime 凭据密钥。密钥环成功构造后记录解析后的 active/configured IDs，密钥缺失错误给出 requested ID。诊断通过 JSON 转义 ID，绝不包含 secret 值。缺密钥诊断中的标识不能将内部错误误报为 Broker 已关闭。

## 修改原因

密钥轮换后，恢复入口已经绑定 previous-key 映射，却在构造 protector 时丢弃它。因此即便运维人员配置了文档要求的旧密钥，仍可能无法读取轮换前的 binding。通用密钥缺失错误也掩盖了宽松绑定造成的键名变化。本次解决 #14317 延后的两个 finding，保持密钥选择、密文、恢复授权及物理停止围栏不变。

## 评审验证计划

### 验证方式

在现有 Linux/MySQL operator-recovery 场景中配置不同的新 active ID/密钥，并把旧密钥放入已绑定映射。inspect、prepare、complete 应读取旧 binding，保持原 provision-seed 密文/key ID 不变，只释放经过验证的原 holder，并允许后续 Session 使用 Workspace。缺少旧密钥时应继续拒绝恢复。使用带空格、引号、控制字符及非 ASCII 字符的 ID 检查启动摘要与密钥不可用错误；不得出现密钥材料、密文或 token。配置 ID 含 `closed` 时，缺密钥错误应保持通用 500；真正关闭 Broker 时仍应返回 503。

### 修改前后证据

源码层面的修改前行为：Spring 已绑定旧密钥，维护入口仍只构造单密钥 protector。现有真实子进程回归现在传入不同的新 active ID/密钥和旧密钥映射，旧代码会在首次读取旧密钥 seed 时失败。此集成场景尚未执行。

远程 JDK 21 检查编译并运行了四个完整且未修改的候选 protector 类，使用本机已有 fastjson2/SLF4J/Logback 依赖，14/14 断言通过。覆盖旧密钥读取、active key 写入、context/key/篡改拒绝、一次构造 INFO 摘要、安全转义的 requested/active/configured IDs，以及不包含 secret 的格式错误/缺失/过短密钥诊断。该检查没有执行 Spring 恢复绑定或 Hosted 场景。

另一个真实 JDK HTTP 检查运行了精确提取的生产错误映射方法：修改映射前，仅将配置 ID 改为 `ring-closed-2026`，就会把相同缺密钥错误从 500 误报为 503 `runtime_broker_closed`。修复后，普通 ID 与含 `closed` 的 ID 均返回通用 500，真正关闭 Broker 时仍为 503，响应正文不包含任何 key ID。Before 在远程 Linux/JDK 21 执行；After 因 Linux SSH 在执行前超时，改用远程 Darwin/JDK 21。此证据验证平台无关的错误映射与 HTTP 传输，没有覆盖完整服务路由。

本地集中 review 与 ponytail 检查未发现阻塞问题。当前精确候选的完整静态 gate 已通过；完整模块与 Hosted 验收仍未验证。变更文档的格式与引用检查、补丁空白检查通过，没有运行本地 build。完整模块、真实 Spring 子进程、Linux/MySQL、Hosted 验收和截图仍未验证。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | 远程 JDK 21：实际 protector 类 14/14 通过，另有三个真实 HTTP 映射场景通过；完整服务未验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 远程 Linux/JDK 21 复现了 Before HTTP 回归；完整恢复/MySQL 及 Linux After 均未执行 |

### 环境

使用现有远程 macmini/JDK 21，以及经过官方校验的临时 Linux/JDK 21 缓存，仅将已有依赖 jar 放入远程临时目录。没有修改部署或服务配置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：日志会向运维人员展示非 secret key ID；所有包含 ID 的诊断均采用 JSON 转义，排除密钥字节、含 secret 值的 map、明文、密文和 token。
- 未验证及范围外内容：完整模块和物理恢复验收仍未验证。CSI/迁移环境变量入口保留单密钥契约，没有新增映射协议、启动数据库扫描或自动重加密。
- 不兼容变更与迁移：无；保持仅 active key 配置及既有密文兼容。旧密钥需保留到持久化引用清空。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/110b6325612861897dd039fe379013745ac28f97/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/110b6325612861897dd039fe379013745ac28f97/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14408

Refs #12380

</details>

prs.title: fix(channels/base): strip zero-ink code points from display projections
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Widens the invisible-character class that channel display projections are scrubbed through, so a projection built entirely from zero-ink code points now collapses to visible whitespace instead of passing through untouched. The set is derived from Unicode properties rather than a hand-maintained enumeration, matching the precedent the repo already uses when sanitizing git remotes, plus two explicit additions for code points that are not Default_Ignorable yet still render as nothing.

## Why it's needed

The class covered the C1 control block, `Cf`, and the variation selectors, which left a real hole: a Hangul filler (U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FFA0), a braille blank (U+2800), or a lone surrogate survived unchanged. Attacker-influenced text could therefore render as an apparently empty line while still carrying chosen bytes.

This came out of review on #13748, where the equivalent declaration-path class was widened but this older worker-path copy was out of that PR's footprint. A reviewer independently re-verified the gap against main and added a useful constraint: the display projection only replaces, it has no blankness gate, so nothing downstream collapses the result either. The same reviewer cautioned against copying the declaration path's neutralize-then-trim shape here, because that would change existing behaviour for legitimate multi-line and whitespace-bearing text; this PR follows that guidance and changes only the character class.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the sanitizer suite for the channel base package:

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/sanitize.test.ts
```

Against the unchanged class the four new cases fail (`4 failed | 50 passed`); with this change all 54 pass.

The case worth reading closely is the regression guard: stripping a lone surrogate must not shred a well-formed surrogate pair. Because the class matches by code point under the `u` flag, an intact pair never lands in the surrogate term — that is now asserted explicitly instead of being left to chance. Existing cases covering brackets, multi-line structure, and the code-point truncation cap are unchanged and still pass, which is the evidence that legitimate text is unaffected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible UI change; this is an internal sanitization class.

Before (new cases against the unchanged class):

```
Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  4 failed | 50 passed (54)
```

After:

```
✓ src/sanitize.test.ts (54 tests) 66ms
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  54 passed (54)
```

Package typecheck, ESLint and Prettier all clean on the two touched files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the class is shared by several sanitizers, so anything newly matched becomes a space (or is removed at the call sites that replace with empty). Default_Ignorable code points are zero-ink by definition; probes over ASCII, multi-line text, brackets/tabs, CJK, Hangul, Arabic and astral emoji showed byte-identical output before and after, so the widening does not touch legitimate content.
- Not validated / out of scope: the second deferred item filed on the same issue — a lone surrogate surviving turn-text truncation — whose honest fix sits in core recording services. It is deliberately left for its own change rather than bundled here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The exported constant keeps its name and semantics; only the matched set grows.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13913 — this covers the first of its two deferred review findings. No closing keyword, because the second item stays open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

放宽了 channel display 投影所经过的不可见字符集，使得完全由「零墨迹」码点构成的投影现在会塌缩成可见空白，而不是原样穿过。该字符集改为从 Unicode 属性派生，而不是手工维护的枚举，与仓库里清洗 git remote 时已有的写法保持一致；另外显式补了两个码点——它们不属于 Default_Ignorable，但同样渲染为无物。

## 为什么需要

原来的字符集覆盖了 C1 控制块、`Cf` 和变体选择符，留下一个真实缺口：谚文填充符（U+3164、U+115F、U+1160、U+FFA0）、盲文空白（U+2800）或孤立代理项都会原样保留。因此攻击者可影响的文本可以渲染成一行看起来空白的内容，同时仍携带其选定的字节。

这个问题出自 #13748 的 review：当时对应的 declaration 路径字符集已被放宽，而这份更早的 worker 路径副本不在那个 PR 的改动范围内。一位 reviewer 独立对照 main 复核了该缺口，并补充了一个有用的约束：display 投影只做替换、没有 blankness 判定，所以下游也不会有任何东西把结果塌缩掉。同一位 reviewer 也提醒不要把 declaration 路径「先中和再 trim」的形态照搬过来，因为那会改变合法多行/含空白文本的既有行为；本 PR 遵循该建议，只改字符集本身。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

运行 channel base 包的清洗测试：

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/sanitize.test.ts
```

在未改动的字符集上，四个新用例会失败（`4 failed | 50 passed`）；打上本 PR 后 54 个全部通过。

最值得细看的是那条回归保护用例：剥掉孤立代理项时不能把成对的代理项（即 emoji）拆碎。因为字符集在 `u` 标志下按码点匹配，完整的代理对永远不会落进孤立代理项那一项——这一点现在被显式断言，而不再靠运气。覆盖方括号、多行结构、按码点截断上限的既有用例保持不变且仍通过，这正是「合法文本不受影响」的证据。

### 前后证据

N/A —— 无用户可见的 UI 变化；这是一个内部清洗字符集。

改动前（新用例跑在未改动的字符集上）：

```
Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  4 failed | 50 passed (54)
```

改动后：

```
✓ src/sanitize.test.ts (54 tests) 66ms
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  54 passed (54)
```

两个改动文件的包级 typecheck、ESLint、Prettier 均干净。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 仅单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：该字符集被多个清洗函数共用，所以新匹配到的字符会变成空格（在替换为空串的调用点则被移除）。Default_Ignorable 码点按定义就是零墨迹的；对 ASCII、多行文本、方括号/制表符、CJK、谚文、阿拉伯文和 astral emoji 的探针在改动前后输出逐字节相同，说明放宽不会碰到合法内容。
- 未验证/范围外：同一 issue 上的第二条 deferred 项——turn 文本截断后残留孤立代理项——其真正的修复位于 core 的记录服务里，刻意留给独立改动，不在本 PR 捆绑。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。导出常量的名字与语义不变，只是匹配集合变大。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13913 的一部分——本 PR 覆盖其两条 deferred review finding 中的第一条。不使用自动关闭关键字，因为第二条仍然开放。

prs.title: fix(cli): reject discontinued Qwen OAuth model selections
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Rejects typed selections of discontinued non-runtime Qwen OAuth models and shows the same guidance as the model picker.

## Why it's needed

Refs #12376. Typed model selection could otherwise reach a misleading expired-credentials error even though the Qwen OAuth free tier is unavailable. Deliberately not a closing keyword: this closes the `/model` entry point, but the same message stays reachable from the ~8 other `requireCachedCredentials` call sites listed in the review, so the issue is narrowed rather than fully fixed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
$ cd packages/cli
$ npx vitest run src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  123 passed (123)
```

Reverting only the source half (`packages/cli/src/ui/commands/modelCommand.ts` back to its parent commit) and re-running the same file fails exactly one test — `modelCommand > rejects typed non-runtime Qwen OAuth selections` — so the new coverage pins the change rather than merely passing alongside it.

That test now pins the guard's *position* too. Its fixture previously returned a registry that already contained the selected id, so `availableModels.some(...)` passed and the test stayed green whether the guard sat before or after the availability lookup — the ordering the test's own comment declares was never asserted. It returns a registry without `qwen-max` and asserts the lookup is never reached:

```
# mutation: hoist `getAvailableModelsForAuthType` above the guard
$ npx vitest run src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts
# Tests  1 failed | 122 passed (123)
#   × modelCommand > rejects typed non-runtime Qwen OAuth selections
```

Without that ordering the fixture would take the "not available for auth type" branch instead of the discontinued-tier one, which is exactly the misleading outcome the guard exists to prevent.

By hand: run `/model qwen-max(qwen-oauth)` from a session using another provider. Confirm the command reports that Qwen OAuth is discontinued, without switching or persisting the selected model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a typed non-runtime Qwen OAuth selection proceeded to the expired-credentials path (`use /auth to re-authenticate`). After: it is rejected before model switching, with the discontinuation guidance the picker already shows.

```
$ npx vitest run src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts          # with the change
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  123 passed (123)

$ git show <parent>:packages/cli/src/ui/commands/modelCommand.ts > packages/cli/src/ui/commands/modelCommand.ts
$ npx vitest run src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts          # source reverted
# FAIL  src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts > modelCommand > rejects typed non-runtime Qwen OAuth selections
# Test Files  1 failed (1)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js v24.18.0, `vitest` run from `packages/cli`. Unit tests only; macOS and Linux are left to CI.

Provenance, since this is a re-submission: it is the same change previously submitted as #12594, rebased onto current `main` (`fce50611b6`) and opened fresh because GitHub blocks reopening a PR whose head branch was rewritten. The added/removed lines are byte-identical to the head `d7d6745b84` that the [maintainer local deep verification comment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12594#issuecomment-5997466916) judged merge-ready (235 scripted assertions, 0 unexpected failures); the only delta is the two non-blocking comment-correction items from that review round, now applied — the guard's reachable case is named as `coder-model(qwen-oauth)` instead of the legacy-`modelProviders` theory. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against `main` @ `fce50611b6` is conflict-free, and `packages/cli/src/ui/commands/modelCommand.ts` still carries no discontinued-Qwen-OAuth guard on upstream `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: runtime Qwen OAuth selections remain allowed, so existing cached-token sessions retain their established behaviour.
- Not validated / out of scope: end-to-end login flows, and non-Windows platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: typed non-runtime Qwen OAuth selections now fail with the existing discontinuation guidance instead of proceeding.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12376

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

拒绝手动选择已停止服务的非运行时 Qwen OAuth 模型，并显示与模型选择器一致的指引。

## 为什么需要

关联 #12376。否则手动输入的模型选择会走到一条误导性的"凭证已过期"报错，而实际上 Qwen OAuth 免费额度已不可用。这里刻意不使用关闭关键字：本 PR 关掉的是 `/model` 这个入口，但评审列出的另外约 8 个 `requireCachedCredentials` 调用点仍可触达同一条消息，因此该 issue 是被收窄而非完全修复。

$ npx vitest run src/ui/commands/modelCommand.test.ts          # 还原源码

```

Two web shell token formatters now switch to `M` at 999,950 instead of 1,000,000, so a count that rounds up to a million reads `1.0M` instead of `1000.0k` or `1000k tokens`. This covers the context card, goal strip, workflow view, turn token counts and subagent tool rows.

## Why it's needed

The formatters picked the unit before rounding, so 999,950 to 999,999 tokens showed `1000.0k`. This is the web shell side of the rollover fixed for the CLI in #13231.

### How to verify

```
× formatContextTokens > moves to M when rounding reaches a million
  → expected '1000.0k' to be '1.0M'
× formatTokenCount > moves to M when rounding reaches a million
  → expected '1000k tokens' to be '1.0M tokens'

prs.title: fix(web-shell): wrap long lines in tool-card diff instead of per-line scrollbars
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Long lines in the Web Shell tool-card diff (WriteFile / Edit) now wrap inside the diff line instead of rendering each as its own horizontally scrollable strip, so a diff with long comment lines or paths reads top-to-bottom without per-line scrollbars.

## Why it's needed

The diff content was rendered with `white-space: pre` and `overflow-x: auto`, which kept every line on one line and gave each one its own horizontal scroller. Any line longer than the card width was clipped and only readable by scrolling that specific line. Switching to wrapping preserves intra-line spacing and indentation while letting the block-level vertical scroll (`.lines { max-height: 400px }`) remain the only scroll surface. A `min-width: 0` is added so the flex item can actually shrink and wrap; `overflow-wrap: anywhere` covers unbreakable tokens such as long paths and URLs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run Qwen Code in Web Shell mode (`qwen serve` or Qwen Code Desktop) and trigger a WriteFile or Edit tool call whose added content includes lines longer than the card width (e.g. a script with ~150-character comment lines). Confirm the long lines wrap and no per-line horizontal scrollbars appear; line numbers and +/- markers stay in place, and the diff still scrolls vertically past 400px.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: each long line is a clipped horizontal strip with its own scrollbar. After: lines wrap within the content column.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |        |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅    |
|  🐧 Linux  |        |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (CSS-only change; verified by reading the rendered diff view).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: long lines now wrap, which increases the visual height of the diff; the existing max-height vertical scroll bounds this.
- Not validated / out of scope: TUI (terminal) diff rendering, which uses a different surface.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13248

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的变更

Web Shell 工具卡片（WriteFile / Edit）中的 diff 长行现在会在行内换行，而不是每一行各自成为一个带水平滚动条的条带，因此包含长注释或长路径的 diff 可以从上到下顺畅阅读，不再出现逐行水平滚动条。

## 为什么需要

diff 内容此前使用 `white-space: pre` 与 `overflow-x: auto` 渲染，导致每行保持单行且各自拥有独立的水平滚动条。任何超出卡片宽度的行都会被截断，只能通过单独滚动该行来阅读。改为自动换行后，仍保留行内空格与缩进，并让原有的块级垂直滚动（`.lines { max-height: 400px }`）成为唯一的滚动面。新增 `min-width: 0` 使 flex 子项能够真正收缩并换行；`overflow-wrap: anywhere` 覆盖长路径、URL 等不可断开的片段。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 Web Shell 模式下运行 Qwen Code（`qwen serve` 或 Qwen Code Desktop），触发一次 WriteFile 或 Edit 工具调用，使新增内容包含超过卡片宽度的行（例如含有约 150 个字符注释行的脚本）。确认长行发生换行、不再出现逐行水平滚动条；行号与 +/- 标记保持原位；超过 400px 高度的 diff 仍可垂直滚动。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：每条长行都是被截断、带各自滚动条的水平条带。修改后：行在内容列内换行显示。

|  🐧 Linux  |      |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：长行换行会增加 diff 的视觉高度，但现有的 max-height 垂直滚动已经限制了这一点。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：TUI（终端）中的 diff 渲染，其使用的是不同的展示面。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

Fixes #13248

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve slash highlighting in user messages
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Slash tokens such as `/a2ui` are blue and bold in the composer but become plain text after submission. This change preserves the same highlighting in user messages, including reopened conversations, while keeping original text, clickable URLs, and reference chips intact.

## Why it's needed

The visual distinction should remain available when reading the conversation. Host-parsed text fragments are combined before highlighting so splitting `/review` across fragments does not lose part of its styling. Highlighting remains a syntax cue, matching the composer; it does not claim a command exists or executed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Submit a line-leading slash token with arguments and reopen the conversation. The token should remain blue and bold, while arguments stay plain. Check multiline commands, URLs, reference chips, and a slash mentioned within an ordinary sentence. Narrow screens should wrap long command names without horizontal overflow. Host-provided parsers may split a command or a line break across adjacent text fragments without changing the result.

Validation: 78 focused message/link tests passed; the new highlight assertions failed before the fix. Independent code review passed. On Node 22, all 11,649 Web Shell tests passed across the full package run and the two loopback HTTP files rerun with socket permissions. Final browser validation passed all four light/dark × 1440px/390px scenarios, including submission and history replay.

The complete `npm run preflight` was run but did not pass under the standalone shell's default Node 25.8.2: CLI tests and Web Storage tests failed. Unmodified upstream reproduced the Node 25 storage/environment/TLS failures. With explicit Node 22.22.2, both baseline and this branch gave the same result for the original 14 CLI failures: 13 passed and one unchanged macOS `/var` versus `/private/var` temporary-directory failure. The previously timed-out Git cleanup suite passed on the unmodified baseline (72 passed, one skipped). The three failed scripts checks passed when rerun with Node 22. The final `check:serve-fast-path-bundle` packaging gate passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The same history message replayed in the released Web Shell and the local built Web Shell. Screenshots are hosted on the personal fork's independent `assets` branch and pinned to an immutable commit; no image binaries are included in this PR:

| Before | After |

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve settlement through journal repair
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves the exact prompt settlement that the live path intentionally withholds when a live-journal repair targets the same terminal, then publishes that settlement only after the repaired transcript has been applied successfully. Ordinary replayed history keeps the existing local-admission gate, so loading history does not start emitting settlements for unrelated prompts.

## Why it's needed

A terminal received live for a prompt this Web Shell client never admitted is normally publishable. When the same terminal also triggers live-journal repair, the live path correctly withholds it until the repaired projection is available, but the repair reload previously handed settlement publication to the replay path, whose stricter local-admission gate rejects that prompt permanently. The repair could therefore turn a settlement that should have been delivered into one that never arrives. Issue #12230 documents and independently verifies that asymmetry and recommends carrying the one withheld settlement through the repair episode.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the named regression in `packages/web-shell/client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx`: `withholds the live settlement while a journal repair targets the same prompt`.
2. Confirm the test blocks the repair reload, observes zero settlements while repair is pending, releases the repaired projection, and then receives exactly the original `completed` / `end_turn` settlement for `prompt-live`.
3. Run the complete `DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx` file.
4. Run Web Shell typecheck, lint, and format checks.
5. Run literal repository `npm run preflight` on the exact candidate tree.

Exact immutable validation: [run 35954932633](https://github.com/dijedontahiri/qwen-code/actions/runs/35954932633), attempt 1, completed successfully. The validator checked out upstream `e39d2390fc633107bfb8bdb7d8c9fbbf5a137cbd`, established the intended failing baseline assertion before the production change, ran the named regression and complete affected test file, Web Shell type/lint/format checks, literal root `npm run preflight`, exact two-file scope checks, and a final source/hash audit. The published product branch was reconstructed byte-for-byte from that validation artifact and fast-forwarded by [run 35974570418](https://github.com/dijedontahiri/qwen-code/actions/runs/35974570418); its product commit is `aec6623e184a3d58502f712c8cc6b9e2af54bb77` with exactly two changed files. Current `main` has advanced since the validation base, but neither target file changed between that base and the pre-publication `main` drift check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: with the live-journal truncation marker present, the repair reload runs but the never-admitted prompt remains at zero published settlements after repair because the replay admission gate filters it out. After: the same deterministic regression keeps publication at zero while repair is pending, then receives exactly one settlement after the repaired transcript is applied. N/A for screenshots/video: this is provider event-ordering correctness rather than a visual/TUI rendering change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner, Node.js 22.16.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Validation used the repository's locked dependency install and literal root preflight.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: settlement publication is now tied to successful completion of the repair that caused it to be withheld; the settlement remains withheld if that repair itself cannot produce the repaired projection.
- Not validated / out of scope: no manual macOS/Windows run and no visual demo; ordinary replay admission semantics are intentionally unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12230

## AI-assisted development disclosure

Investigation, implementation, regression-test design, validation analysis, branch publication, and PR preparation were performed with AI assistance. The evidence above refers to executed hosted checks on the cited immutable source; no independent human review or testing is claimed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当 live-journal 修复命中同一个终态事件时，live 路径会有意暂扣该 prompt 的 settlement。本 PR 保存这条原始 settlement，并且只在修复后的 transcript 成功应用后再发布。普通历史 replay 仍保留现有的本地准入门，因此加载历史不会开始为无关 prompt 发布 settlement。

## 为什么需要

对于本 Web Shell 客户端从未准入过的 prompt，如果终态事件通过 live 路径到达，它本来可以正常发布 settlement。但当同一个终态同时触发 live-journal 修复时，live 路径会正确地先暂扣 settlement，等待修复后的投影可用；此前修复 reload 后却把 settlement 发布交给 replay 路径，而 replay 路径更严格的本地准入门会永久拒绝这个 prompt。因此一次修复可能把本应送达的 settlement 变成永远不送达。#12230 已记录并独立核实这个不对称行为，并建议在修复 episode 中携带这一条被暂扣的 settlement。

## 评审人验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 运行 `packages/web-shell/client/daemon/session/DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx` 中名为 `withholds the live settlement while a journal repair targets the same prompt` 的回归测试。
2. 确认测试会阻塞修复 reload，在修复未完成时观察到零条 settlement；释放修复后的投影后，只收到一条原始的 `prompt-live`、`completed` / `end_turn` settlement。
3. 运行完整的 `DaemonSessionProvider.test.tsx`。
4. 运行 Web Shell 的 typecheck、lint 和 format 检查。
5. 在精确候选树上运行仓库字面命令 `npm run preflight`。

精确不可变验证：[run 35954932633](https://github.com/dijedontahiri/qwen-code/actions/runs/35954932633)，attempt 1，已成功完成。验证器检出 upstream `e39d2390fc633107bfb8bdb7d8c9fbbf5a137cbd`，先建立预期失败的基线断言，再执行生产修复；随后运行命名回归、完整受影响测试文件、Web Shell type/lint/format、根目录字面 `npm run preflight`、精确两文件范围检查，以及最终源码/哈希审计。发布的产品分支由该验证 artifact 逐字节重建，并通过 [run 35974570418](https://github.com/dijedontahiri/qwen-code/actions/runs/35974570418) 快进；产品提交为 `aec6623e184a3d58502f712c8cc6b9e2af54bb77`，且仅修改两个文件。验证基线之后 `main` 已继续前进，但在发布前的漂移检查中，这两个目标文件都没有发生变化。

### 前后证据

修复前：存在 live-journal 截断标记时，修复 reload 会运行，但从未在本客户端准入过的 prompt 在修复完成后仍然发布零条 settlement，因为 replay 准入门将其过滤。修复后：同一个确定性回归测试在修复等待期间仍保持零条发布；修复后的 transcript 应用完成后，恰好收到一条 settlement。截图/视频 N/A：这是 provider 事件顺序正确性问题，而不是可视化/TUI 渲染变更。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

GitHub 托管 Ubuntu runner，Node.js 22.16.0，仓库固定 pnpm 11.24.0。验证使用锁定依赖安装和根目录字面 preflight。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：settlement 现在与导致其被暂扣的 repair 成功完成绑定；如果 repair 自身无法生成修复后的投影，该 settlement 仍保持暂扣。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未手工运行 macOS/Windows，也没有可视化 demo；普通 replay 的准入语义刻意保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12230

## AI 辅助开发披露

调查、实现、回归测试设计、验证分析、分支发布和 PR 准备均使用了 AI 辅助。上述证据仅指在所引用不可变源码上实际执行的托管检查；不声称存在独立人工评审或测试。

</details>
