prs.title: fix(ci): recreate runner Git metadata in the open-PR recheck workflows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the `Recreate runner Git metadata` step — the same one #14017 introduced for the other Linux lanes — immediately before the `Checkout` step of the `recheck` job in `.github/workflows/sdk-java-flyway-open-prs.yml` and `.github/workflows/sdk-java-contract-open-prs.yml`, so those two workflows start from fresh runner-local Git metadata instead of the workspace `.git` a previous job left behind. It also extends `scripts/tests/qwen-runner-checkout-workflow.test.js` to cover both `recheck` jobs, so the omission this PR closes cannot reopen silently.

## Why it's needed

Both workflows select the same maintainer runner as `sdk-java.yml`, which #14017 fixed: `runs-on: '${{ (github.repository == ''QwenLM/qwen-code'' && vars.MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED != ''true'') && fromJSON(''["self-hosted", "linux", "x64", "ecs-qwen"]'') || fromJSON(''["ubuntu-latest"]'') }}'`. On that shared pool they receive a reused workspace whose `.git` can still carry the previous job's shallow boundary and object state, which is the state that makes the depth-1 fetch die with `fatal: pack has N unresolved delta` (#13951). #14017 added the reset to `ci.yml`, `sdk-java.yml`, `qwen-autofix.yml` and `qwen-triage.yml`, but these two files were left out, so the failure surface stays open on exactly the two lanes that re-check open PRs — and they run on `push` and on a `schedule`, i.e. unattended, with no author watching the run.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Parse both workflows and assert the step is present, carries the self-hosted guard, and is immediately followed by `Checkout`: `node -e "const {parse}=require('yaml');for(const wf of ['sdk-java-flyway-open-prs','sdk-java-contract-open-prs']){const {steps}=parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/'+wf+'.yml','utf8')).jobs.recheck;const i=steps.findIndex(s=>s.name==='Recreate runner Git metadata');console.log(wf,i,JSON.stringify(steps[i].if),steps[i+1].uses)}"` — expect `2 "${{ runner.environment == 'self-hosted' }}" actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10` for each file. Then run the extended suite on Linux, where it is authoritative: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-runner-checkout-workflow.test.js` — the two new cases are `sdk-java-flyway-open-prs / recheck` and `sdk-java-contract-open-prs / recheck`, and both execute the extracted step body against a fixture workspace that starts with a malformed `.git/shallow`, then assert `.git` is gone, that a freshly initialised repo reports `is-shallow-repository=false`, and that a symlinked `.git` is not followed. Finally `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`, which must exit 0.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the base commit, both files contain the pre-checkout sweep but no reset — `grep -c "Clean stale .qwen before checkout"` is 1 and `grep -c "Recreate runner Git metadata"` is 0 in each (the sweep sits at L78/L81 and `Checkout` at L162/L165). After, the count is 1 and the step lands exactly where #14017 puts it elsewhere:

```yaml
       - name: 'Recreate runner Git metadata'
         if: "${{ runner.environment == 'self-hosted' }}"
         run: |-
           rm -rf -- "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git"
```

`git diff --stat` against the base is `+5` per workflow and `+6` for the test file, with no other line touched. Because the suite cannot be executed on this host (see Environment), the step body was extracted from the YAML and run against the same fixture the suite builds, in both files, with these results: a malformed `.git/shallow` is rejected by git (`fatal: bad shallow line`) — confirming the fixture really is the broken state; the step exits 0; `.git` is removed; the re-initialised repo reports `is-shallow-repository=false`; a symlinked `.git` is not followed, so the external file survives intact; and the sibling `node_modules` is preserved, so the reset is scoped to `.git` alone.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22.2 with Git Bash on Windows. The Windows ✅ covers the shell fixture above, not the vitest suite: `scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts` excludes `scripts/tests/qwen-*-workflow.test.js` on `win32` because those suites spawn `git` and `bash`, and forcing the file back in makes all sixteen cases — the fourteen pre-existing ones included — fail with `spawnSync git EBUSY`, which is why the equivalent fixture was run as a shell harness instead. The Linux row is ⚠️ because nothing here executes on that host; that lane is where the suite actually runs and is the one that should be trusted. No local runtime is involved: this is a CI workflow change whose step is POSIX shell.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each `recheck` run now discards the workspace `.git` and re-clones at depth 1 instead of reusing the inherited object store, which costs one clone per run. The alternative is leaving a lane that fails identically on all three of `actions/checkout`'s internal retries, since the state it retries against never changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the underlying mechanism is not proven here — #14017 states the same thing, and this PR deliberately does not re-litigate it. Neither the damaged state nor the failure was reproduced locally; there is no access to a reused `ecs-qwen` workspace. This change only closes the coverage gap in #14017, and #13951 should stay open as the recurrences tracker rather than be auto-closed by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Hosted runners are unaffected — the step is gated on `runner.environment == 'self-hosted'` and a fresh hosted runner has no `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git`. Both files stay inside their recorded `.size-baseline` entries (9751 and 9555 bytes) by well under the 4096-byte allowance, so no baseline bump is required.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13951 — follow-up to #14017, which fixed the other Linux lanes but not these two.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 #14017 为其他 Linux lane 引入的 `Recreate runner Git metadata` 步骤，补加到 `.github/workflows/sdk-java-flyway-open-prs.yml` 与 `.github/workflows/sdk-java-contract-open-prs.yml` 中 `recheck` job 的 `Checkout` 之前，使这两个工作流从全新的 runner 本地 git 元数据开始，而不是复用上一个 job 留下的工作区 `.git`。同时扩展 `scripts/tests/qwen-runner-checkout-workflow.test.js`，让它覆盖这两个 `recheck` job，使本 PR 所关闭的这个遗漏不会静默复发。

## 为什么需要

两个工作流选用的是与 `sdk-java.yml`（已由 #14017 修复）相同的维护者 runner：`runs-on: '${{ (github.repository == ''QwenLM/qwen-code'' && vars.MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED != ''true'') && fromJSON(''["self-hosted", "linux", "x64", "ecs-qwen"]'') || fromJSON(''["ubuntu-latest"]'') }}'`。在那个共享池上，它们拿到的是复用工作区，其 `.git` 可能仍带着上一个 job 的 shallow 边界与对象状态——正是让 depth-1 fetch 以 `fatal: pack has N unresolved delta` 失败的那个状态（#13951）。#14017 已把重置加进 `ci.yml`、`sdk-java.yml`、`qwen-autofix.yml` 和 `qwen-triage.yml`，却漏了这两个文件，于是故障面恰好留在了两个「重新检查开放 PR」的 lane 上——而且它们由 `push` 与 `schedule` 触发，即无人值守，没有作者在看着那次运行。

## 评审者验证方案

### 如何验证

解析两个工作流，断言该步骤存在、带自建 runner 守卫、且紧随其后就是 `Checkout`：`node -e "const {parse}=require('yaml');for(const wf of ['sdk-java-flyway-open-prs','sdk-java-contract-open-prs']){const {steps}=parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/'+wf+'.yml','utf8')).jobs.recheck;const i=steps.findIndex(s=>s.name==='Recreate runner Git metadata');console.log(wf,i,JSON.stringify(steps[i].if),steps[i+1].uses)}"` —— 两个文件都应得到 `2 "${{ runner.environment == 'self-hosted' }}" actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10`。然后在 Linux 上运行扩展后的套件（那里才是它的权威环境）：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-runner-checkout-workflow.test.js` —— 两个新用例是 `sdk-java-flyway-open-prs / recheck` 与 `sdk-java-contract-open-prs / recheck`，它们都会把抽取出的步骤正文跑在一个起始状态为畸形 `.git/shallow` 的 fixture 工作区上，然后断言 `.git` 已消失、重新初始化的仓库报告 `is-shallow-repository=false`、以及被符号链接的 `.git` 不会被跟随。最后执行 `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`，必须 exit 0。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前，在 base commit 上两个文件都只有 checkout 前的清理步骤而没有重置——每个文件里 `grep -c "Clean stale .qwen before checkout"` 为 1、`grep -c "Recreate runner Git metadata"` 为 0（清理步骤在 L78/L81，`Checkout` 在 L162/L165）。改动后计数为 1，且步骤落在与 #14017 在其他文件中完全相同的位置：

```yaml
       - name: 'Recreate runner Git metadata'
         if: "${{ runner.environment == 'self-hosted' }}"
         run: |-
           rm -rf -- "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git"
```

相对 base 的 `git diff --stat` 为每个工作流 `+5`、测试文件 `+6`，没有触碰任何其他行。由于该套件无法在本机执行（见「环境」），步骤正文被从 YAML 中抽取出来，对着与套件完全相同的 fixture 在两个文件中各跑了一遍，结果如下：畸形的 `.git/shallow` 被 git 拒绝（`fatal: bad shallow line`）——确认该 fixture 确实是那个坏状态；步骤 exit 0；`.git` 被移除；重新初始化的仓库报告 `is-shallow-repository=false`；被符号链接的 `.git` 未被跟随，外部文件完好无损；同级的 `node_modules` 得以保留，说明重置的作用域仅限 `.git`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

Windows 上的 Node 22.22.2 + Git Bash。Windows 的 ✅ 指的是上面的 shell fixture，而不是 vitest 套件：`scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts` 在 `win32` 上排除了 `scripts/tests/qwen-*-workflow.test.js`，因为这些套件要拉起 `git` 与 `bash`；强行把该文件放回来会让全部十六个用例（包括十四个既有用例）都以 `spawnSync git EBUSY` 失败，所以改为用等价的 shell harness 执行。Linux 标 ⚠️ 是因为本机没有任何东西在那台主机上执行；那才是套件真正运行、也才是应当被信任的 lane。不涉及本地运行时：这是一处 CI 工作流改动，其步骤是 POSIX shell。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每次 `recheck` 运行现在都会丢弃工作区 `.git` 并以 depth 1 重新 clone，而不是复用继承来的对象库，代价是每次运行多一次 clone。另一种选择是保留一条会在 `actions/checkout` 三次内部重试上完全同样失败的 lane，因为它重试所面对的状态从未改变。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：底层机制并未在此被证明——#14017 也是同样的表述，本 PR 有意不去重新争论它。坏状态与故障本身都没有在本地复现，因为没有访问复用 `ecs-qwen` 工作区的途径。本改动只是补上 #14017 的覆盖缺口，且 #13951 应当作为复发跟踪 issue 保持开启，而不是被本 PR 自动关闭。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。托管 runner 不受影响——该步骤以 `runner.environment == 'self-hosted'` 为门，而全新的托管 runner 在 `Checkout` 之前根本没有 `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git`。两个文件都仍在其记录的 `.size-baseline`（9751 与 9555 字节）之内，远低于 4096 字节的允许增长量，因此无需 bump 基线。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13951 —— 本 PR 是 #14017 的后续；#14017 修好了其他 Linux lane，但漏了这两个。

</details>

prs.title: feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the ACP/daemon wire (refs #13785)
prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell keeps that path on the subagent panel name as a `title` tooltip only — no visible path chip ships in this slice (`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`; pinned by `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip`). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`team-sink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), without a new peer runtime. Team-binding approval retirement now uses one private, versioned `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` notification on the existing SDK 0.14.1 connection; it adds no daemon REST route or public mediator API. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `3499b027c4faa`, 2,106 focused cases, targeted ESLint/Prettier, five affected workspace typechecks and integration typecheck passed on the exact committed candidate. Approval retirement, status identity, activity isolation and canonical START behavior were mutation-checked. A serialized ACP component probe verified old-binding cancellation and replacement approval at cap 1; a local macOS browser rendered the real transcript pipeline with injected protocol frames without splitting leader output or taking its usage. Main was synchronized to supply the current CI budget helper; obsolete assistant-activity handling was removed, and the rebuilt transcript's size ceiling was **raised** from 1,338,000 (main) to 1,340,000 in `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` — merged with main the entry measures 1,338,274 UTF-16 units, past both main's ceiling and the 1,338,500 this branch carried. See the [current repair report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587) for build results and verification limits. No real-provider or full daemon/browser E2E was run for this repair. The [real-model report and screenshots at `df760052100d1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209) and the runtime observations below are historical evidence, not current-head acceptance. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on (earlier runtime acceptance) | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. Mailbox consumption and model-visible delivery are not transactional; crash-safe redelivery after process/session destruction remains follow-up work, and reversible-close retention does not provide that guarantee. - Breaking changes / migration notes: identity fields are additive. Approval retirement requires this CLI/bridge pair; older bridges that ignore the new private notification retain the previous stale-approval behavior. No new daemon REST routes, public mediator APIs, dependencies or persisted formats. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 本片只把该 path 挂在 subagent 面板名字的 `title` tooltip 上，不渲染可见的 path chip（`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`；由 `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` 的 `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip` 钉住）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`team-sink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），不增加 peer runtime。队绑定审批回收新增一条私有、版本化的 `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` 通知，走既有 SDK 0.14.1 连接；不添加 daemon REST 路由或 public mediator API。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `3499b027c4faa` 的精确提交候选通过 2,106 条聚焦用例、定向 ESLint/Prettier、五个相关 workspace 的类型检查和 integration 类型检查；审批回收、status 身份、活动隔离与 START canonical 行为做过变异反证。真实 ACP 串行化组件链路以 cap 1 验证旧绑定取消和新绑定审批；本地 macOS 浏览器通过真实 transcript 流水线渲染注入的协议帧，leader 答案与 usage 未被活动切断或夺走。已同步 main 补齐当前 CI 预算脚本，并删除旧 assistant 活动路径；重建 transcript 的体积阈值是**上调**的——由 main 的 1,338,000 提到 `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` 里的 1,340,000，因为与 main 合并后该 entry 实测 1,338,274 UTF-16 单位，同时超出 main 的阈值和本分支此前携带的 1,338,500。构建结果与验证限制见[本轮修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587)。本轮未跑真实模型或完整 daemon/browser E2E。[`df760052100d1` 的真实模型报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)及下方真机记录仅为历史证据，不作为当前 head 验收。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on（较早版本的真机验收） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。mailbox 消费与模型可见投递不是事务；进程崩溃或会话销毁后的安全重投递留到后续，可逆 close 时保留队列不构成这一保证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：身份字段为 additive。审批回收需要本轮配套 CLI/bridge；忽略新增私有通知的旧 bridge 仍保留此前的陈旧审批行为。不添加 daemon REST 路由、public mediator API、依赖或持久化格式。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。

prs.title: feat(acp): surface retry and model-fallback progress to daemon clients
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The ACP turn loops used to drop provider recovery progress on the floor: a scheduled retry and a fallback-model switch were consumed for bookkeeping but never announced, so VS Code, the daemon HTTP API and Web Shell showed a bare spinner while the core was backing off (up to 60 s before the first rate-limit retry). This PR carries both events across the ACP boundary. The session emits `qwen/notify/session/retry` and `qwen/notify/session/model-fallback` vendor notifications from the four turn loops that consume the stream, mirroring the fields the interactive and headless front ends already render (attempt, maxRetries, delayMs, message; fromModel, toModel, statusCode, fallbackIndex). The bridge validates and rebroadcasts them as session-scoped `retry_scheduled` / `model_fallback` SSE frames with the current turn metadata, and the TypeScript SDK learns the two frame types so its event validator keeps them instead of dropping them as unknown.

Two scope notes. The passthrough stream wrapper that re-yields these events emits nothing itself, because the final consumer of the stream announces them; emitting in both places would double-notify. And rendering in Web Shell or the VS Code webview is deliberately left out: both consumers already ignore unknown frame types, so they can adopt the new frames in their own time.

## Why it's needed

From #12020: all front ends share the same retrying core, but only the CLIs tell the user about it. During the first 60 s rate-limit backoff, a daemon or IDE user sees nothing and reasonably concludes the session hung, then cancels and loses the eventual answer entirely.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: the new tests in the three packages pin each layer. The session test drives a stream yielding a retry event with `retryInfo` through `session/prompt` and asserts the notification payload (including that the `skipDelay` function never reaches the wire); sibling cases cover the bare-retry silence and the fallback payload. The bridge tests cover translation, optional-field omission, malformed-payload drop, and the no-live-session drop. The SDK tests cover narrowing, guard rejection, and the reducer no-op.

Live level: run the daemon, subscribe to a session's SSE stream, and drive a prompt against a model endpoint that fails once mid-stream with a rate-limit-shaped SSE error chunk (e.g. an `error_finish` chunk whose content carries `{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_error",...}}`, the DashScope/gateway shape; a tiny local proxy can inject it). Note that a request-level HTTP 429 status does NOT reach this path: `retryWithBackoff` wraps stream establishment and retries it silently, so the frame only fires for the mid-stream shape (measured on head: HTTP 429 -> turn recovers with zero frames). The stream should show a `retry_scheduled` frame with the attempt, budget and delay before the turn resumes, where before this change nothing appeared between the prompt and the resumed chunks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon/ACP wire change; covered by unit tests on all platforms in CI).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only)

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: two new wire literals enter the daemon SSE vocabulary. They are additive; older SDK versions drop unknown frames silently, and Web Shell's mapper already ignores them.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell and VS Code webview rendering; the bridge drops the notifications for sessions with no live entry rather than buffering them, since retry progress is only meaningful mid-turn.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12020 (first slice; rendering follow-ups stay open).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

ACP 回合循环此前会把供应商恢复进度直接丢掉：计划中的重试和回退模型切换只被用于内部簿记，从不对外通告，于是核心层在退避等待时（限流首次重试前最长 60 秒），VS Code、daemon HTTP API 和 Web Shell 只能显示一个没有任何文字的转圈。本 PR 把这两类事件带过 ACP 边界：会话层在消费流式的四个回合循环里发出 `qwen/notify/session/retry` 与 `qwen/notify/session/model-fallback` 厂商通知，字段与交互式和 headless 前端已展示的一致（attempt、maxRetries、delayMs、message；fromModel、toModel、statusCode、fallbackIndex）；bridge 校验后把它们转播为会话级 `retry_scheduled` / `model_fallback` SSE 帧，并带上当前回合元数据；TypeScript SDK 学会这两个帧类型，事件校验器不再把它们当未知帧丢弃。

两点范围说明：负责透传重抛这些事件的流式包装层自己不发通知，因为事件的最终消费者会发，两边都发会重复；Web Shell 和 VS Code webview 的渲染刻意不在本 PR 内，两个消费方本就会忽略未知帧类型，可以各自择期接入。

## 为什么需要

来自 #12020：所有前端共享同一个会自动重试的核心层，但只有 CLI 会把这件事告诉用户。在首次 60 秒限流退避期间，daemon 或 IDE 用户什么都看不到，合理结论就是"挂了"，于是取消，结果连同最终答案一起丢掉。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

单元层面：三个包的新测试各自钉住一层。会话测试让携带 `retryInfo` 的重试事件流过 `session/prompt`，断言通知载荷（包括 `skipDelay` 函数不会上线）；同组用例覆盖无 retryInfo 时的静默和回退载荷。bridge 测试覆盖转译、可选字段省略、畸形载荷丢弃和无存活会话丢弃。SDK 测试覆盖类型收窄、guard 拒绝和 reducer 空操作。

实际层面：启动 daemon，订阅某会话的 SSE 流，对一个在流式中途返回限流形态 SSE 错误块的模型端点发起 prompt（如 content 携带 `{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_error",...}}` 的 `error_finish` 块，即 DashScope/网关形态；本地小代理注入即可）。注意请求级 HTTP 429 状态码不走这条路径：`retryWithBackoff` 只包建流阶段并静默重试，实测该形态下回合恢复且 0 帧；只有流内错误形态才会触发该帧。在回合恢复前应能看到带 attempt、预算和延迟的 `retry_scheduled` 帧，而本改动之前 prompt 和后续 chunk 之间什么都没有。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（daemon/ACP 线缆协议改动；CI 在各平台跑单元测试）。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### 环境（可选）

N/A（仅单元测试）

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：daemon SSE 词汇表新增两个线缆字面量。均为增量；旧版 SDK 会静默丢弃未知帧，Web Shell 的映射器本就会忽略。
- 未验证 / 范围外：Web Shell 与 VS Code webview 渲染；bridge 对无存活条目的会话直接丢弃通知而不缓冲，因为重试进度只在回合进行中才有意义。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #12020（首个切片；渲染跟进项保持 open）。

</details>

## What this PR does

Localizes the remaining nine Companion command titles using VS Code's existing English and Simplified Chinese catalogs, and includes both catalogs in the extension package. All twelve resolved English command titles, command IDs, menus, keybindings and settings remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Nine command titles remain English under a Chinese VS Code display language. In addition, the packaging whitelist excludes both existing catalogs: the installed vsce 3.9.2 file list contains neither before this change. Adding translations alone would therefore leave the installed extension untranslated.

This is the manifest-command slice invited by the maintainer in #13967. It leaves notifications, configuration descriptions, additional locales, webview language precedence and shared CLI translation sources for follow-up.

### How to verify

With a Simplified Chinese VS Code display language, command titles such as Open, Focus Chat View and New Conversation should resolve to Chinese. With English, the titles should remain exactly as before. Command execution, keybindings and menu visibility should remain unchanged. Confirm that both translation catalogs are present in the packaged VSIX.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: nine titles are hardcoded English; neither NLS catalog appears in `vsce ls --no-dependencies`.
- After: all twelve titles resolve in English and Simplified Chinese; both catalogs are listed and included byte-for-byte in a real vsce-generated VSIX.

prs.title: feat(core): support per-model auto-compaction thresholds
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds optional `generationConfig.autoCompactThreshold` to model provider entries. A valid model-level ratio in `(0, 1]` takes precedence over the global `context.autoCompactThreshold`, with the existing `0.85` default as the final fallback.

The override follows the selected model and endpoint across model switches, child agents, runtime restoration, and request context snapshots. Compaction timing can be configured without reducing the model's real context window or output budget.

## Why it's needed

A single global ratio cannot suit models with substantially different context windows. With a global ratio of `0.85`, a 1M-token model waits until 850K tokens to compact. Lowering its declared context window to compact earlier also reduces the available output budget. A model-specific ratio allows earlier compaction while preserving the real capacity.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a global ratio of `0.85`, a 1M-token model with a model-level ratio of `0.25`, and a 262144-token model without an override. Verify that their auto-compaction thresholds are 250000 and approximately 222822 tokens respectively.
2. Switch between models and use child agents with different models or endpoints. Verify that each uses its own override or the global/default fallback, including same-name models at different endpoints.
3. Verify that missing or invalid model ratios fall back correctly, and that the 1M-token context window and 64000-token output budget at a 250000-token prompt remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the independent acceptance probe failed because the 1M-token model used the global `0.85` ratio despite its configured `0.25` override.
- After: the actual compression service skips compression at 249999 tokens and triggers it at 250000. Switching to the smaller model restores the global ratio; switching back restores `0.25`.
- Docker Linux validation passed 1608 targeted tests, 3 independent acceptance tests, and 8 settings-to-compression service scenarios. The built CLI also passed startup smoke testing.
- Build and bundle passed. Workspace typechecks passed; integration typechecking initially exhausted the default Node heap, then passed when rerun with a 4 GiB heap.

The service scenarios use real settings loading and compression logic with controlled token counts and summary responses.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Docker, ARM64 |

### Environment

macOS with Node.js 22.22.0; Docker Ubuntu 24.04.5 ARM64 with Node.js 22.23.3. Both use pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Linux dependencies were installed independently with the frozen lockfile, and tests ran as a non-root user.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: carrying an override into another model or endpoint. Regression coverage includes model switches, child agents, runtime snapshots, OAuth updates, and same-name endpoint changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-provider long conversations, interactive TUI rendering, provider-side truncation, and unrelated context-window inference issues.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing configurations retain their global/default behavior, and the existing threshold formulas and safety ceiling remain unchanged.

Design: [English](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14395

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为模型提供商条目新增可选的 `generationConfig.autoCompactThreshold`。有效范围为 `(0, 1]`，模型级比例优先于全局 `context.autoCompactThreshold`，最终回退到现有默认值 `0.85`。

覆盖值在模型切换、子代理、运行时恢复及请求上下文快照中跟随实际模型和端点。用户可以独立调整压缩时机，同时保留模型真实的上下文窗口和输出预算。

## 变更原因

单一全局比例无法同时适应上下文窗口差异较大的模型。全局比例为 `0.85` 时，100 万 token 的模型需要等到 85 万 token 才压缩。通过调小声明的上下文窗口提前压缩，又会减少可用输出预算。模型级比例允许提前压缩，同时保留真实容量。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 将全局比例设为 `0.85`，为 100 万 token 的模型配置模型级比例 `0.25`，另配置一个窗口为 262144 token、没有模型级覆盖的模型。确认自动压缩阈值分别为 250000 和约 222822 token。
2. 在模型之间切换，并让子代理使用不同模型或端点。确认各自使用自己的覆盖值或全局／默认回退值，包括名称相同但端点不同的模型。
3. 确认模型比例缺失或无效时正确回退，并确认 100 万 token 的窗口以及输入为 250000 token 时的 64000 token 输出预算保持不变。

### 修改前后证据

- 修改前：独立验收用例失败，100 万 token 的模型虽然配置了 `0.25`，实际仍使用全局 `0.85`。
- 修改后：真实压缩服务在 249999 token 时不压缩，在 250000 token 时触发压缩。切换到较小模型后恢复全局比例，切回后恢复 `0.25`。
- Docker Linux 验证通过了 1608 项定向测试、3 项独立验收测试和 8 个从配置加载到压缩服务的场景。构建后的 CLI 启动冒烟测试也通过。
- 构建和打包通过。工作区类型检查通过；集成测试类型检查首次耗尽 Node 默认堆内存，改用 4 GiB 堆内存重跑后通过。

服务场景使用真实配置加载和压缩逻辑，token 数和摘要响应采用受控输入。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Docker，ARM64 |

### 环境

macOS 使用 Node.js 22.22.0；Docker Ubuntu 24.04.5 ARM64 使用 Node.js 22.23.3。两者均使用项目锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0。Linux 按冻结锁文件独立安装依赖，并以非 root 用户运行测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：覆盖值被带入其他模型或端点。回归测试覆盖模型切换、子代理、运行时快照、OAuth 更新及同名模型端点变化。
- 未验证／范围外：真实提供商长对话、交互式 TUI 渲染、提供商侧截断及其他上下文窗口推导问题。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。现有配置保留全局／默认行为，现有阈值公式和安全上限保持不变。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/model-auto-compaction-threshold.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关闭 #14395。

</details>

prs.title: fix(memory): budget the index title against the line cap
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` a real bound on the emitted index line instead of a bound on the hook alone. `docIndexLine()` now budgets the title and the link target against the 150-char cap before rendering, so a long title is truncated with `…` rather than pushing the line past the limit that names it.

The title yields to the cap, but only down to a floor: `MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS` (24, mirroring the existing `MIN_INDEX_HOOK_CHARS`) is clamped with `Math.max`, and the link target is never shortened. Once the encoded target passes 120 characters — the budget minus the `- []()` wrapper and that floor — no title length can bring the line back under the cap, so the target is kept whole and the line runs long, with the title clamped at the floor instead of collapsing to nothing.

## Why it's needed

Part of #13910. `docIndexLine()` (`packages/core/src/memory/indexer.ts`) rendered the entry as

```js
const link = `- [${title}](${encodeIndexPathTarget(doc.relativePath)})`;
```

and then budgeted **only the hook** against `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` (150). The hook branch was safe, because `truncateIndexField(description, room)` made that line land exactly on the cap. The no-hook branch returned `link` unchanged, so the emitted line was bounded only by `MAX_INDEX_FIELD_CHARS` (120) plus the path length — up to ~197 chars for a 120-char title on a 71-char path, matching the 182/189 the issue measured on real stores. The read path then re-measures that line against its own cap, so the writer's own constant was silently not the limit it names.

The fix is to make the title share the line budget instead of escaping it:

```js
const target = encodeIndexPathTarget(doc.relativePath);
const titleLimit = Math.max(
  MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS,
  MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS - INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS - target.length,
);
const title = truncateIndexField(sanitizeIndexField(doc.title) || doc.type, titleLimit);
const link = `- [${title}](${target})`;
```

`INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS` is the `- [`, `](` and `)` wrapper spent around title + target (6 chars), so `link.length <= MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` whenever the path leaves room for `MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
$ cd packages/core
$ npx vitest run src/memory/indexer.test.ts src/memory/prompt.test.ts
# Test Files  2 passed (2)
#   src/memory/prompt.test.ts  (45 tests)
#   src/memory/indexer.test.ts (38 tests)
```

`npx tsc --noEmit` reports no error under `src/memory/`, and `eslint` reports no new violation — the 7 pre-existing `vitest/no-conditional-expect` errors in these two test files are unchanged in count.

Local note, stated so it is not mistaken for a clean sweep: on this Windows host 4 of the 48 files in `src/memory` fail, for reasons unrelated to the change. `team-memory-sync.test.ts` hits `spawnSync git EBUSY` (Windows file locking), `recall-scan-latency.test.ts` asserts a 100 ms wall-clock ceiling the host misses, and `forget.test.ts` / `memoryLifecycle.integration.test.ts` hit hook timeouts. Running those same four files against the parent commit `4cd30565b2` fails identically (`2 failed | 2 passed` both sides), so nothing here is caused by — or masking — this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| case | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 120-char title, 71-char path | 197 chars | ≤ 150, target intact |
| long title + long path, no hook | over the cap | ≤ 150, title truncated with `…` |
| long title, short path | hook kept | hook kept (non-regression) |
| short title + hook | unchanged | byte-identical |

The added tests each fail if the change is reverted, rather than merely passing alongside it. The three later additions are mutation-checked too:

| mutation | test that goes red |
| --- | --- |
| `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS - INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS - target.length` → `… - doc.relativePath.length` | `budgets the title against the encoded target, not the raw path` |
| the title budget removed (title rendered whole) | `runs long as soon as the encoded path passes 120 chars, not only past the whole budget` |
| `truncateIndexField` over-truncating the title | `still ships a hook when the title leaves room for it` |

The run-long band is now tested on both sides of its edge: a 120-char encoded target emits exactly 150, and 121 emits 151.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js v24.18.0, vitest run from `packages/core`. Unit tests only; macOS and Linux are left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an encoded target longer than 120 characters — the whole budget minus the `- []()` wrapper and the title floor — lets the line run over the cap, with the title clamped to `MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS`. That is deliberate — the link target is never truncated, because a resolving long link beats a short dead one — but it means the cap is a bound on `- [title](target)` only while the target leaves room for the title floor, not a bound on every line.
- Not validated / out of scope: the writer/reader mismatch the issue mentions is already absent on `main`, because `prompt.ts` interpolates the writer's own `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS`, so no reader-side change was needed. The naming point still stands as a naming point: `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` is the target every line is budgeted against, and lines past the 120-char target threshold are allowed to exceed it, so the constant is a limit with a documented exception rather than an absolute.
- Not covered: the second cost named in #13910 — an entry whose title fills the line budget still drops its description hook — is out of scope here, and tracked separately in #14455. The line-length half is what this diff fixes; keeping the closing keyword would have closed the only tracker for both. The stale comment in `indexer.ts` that called the description "the only optional part" is corrected, since the title is capped too.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none that need user action, but not "no effect on existing stores" either. `rebuildManagedAutoMemoryIndex` and `rebuildTeamAutoMemoryIndex` re-render the whole index from every scanned topic file, so the first rebuild after upgrade re-truncates every existing long-title entry, not just new ones. For a private index that is invisible. For the team index it means a one-time churn commit in `.qwen/team-memory/MEMORY.md`, because the byte-identical-rewrite skip no longer fires; it is benign — the file is generated, never hand-edited, and ordering is code-unit deterministic so collaborators converge — but it is a real commit, one per team store.
- Fixture note: `packages/core/src/memory/prompt.test.ts` needed an adjustment — its long-line fixture is tuned to land just over `MAX_INDEX_CHARS`, and shorter lines made it fall under. The path's space run grew from 250 to 288 and is now split across two components (250 + 37), because a single component is capped at 255 bytes (`NAME_MAX`) — which the 14 sibling components already sit on exactly.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13910

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` 成为对输出行真正生效的上限，而不再只是对 hook 生效。`docIndexLine()` 现在会在渲染之前，把标题与链接目标一起纳入 150 字符的预算，因此过长的标题会以 `…` 截断，而不是把整行顶过这个以它命名的上限。

标题会让位于上限，但只让到一个下限：`MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS`（24，与既有的 `MIN_INDEX_HOOK_CHARS` 对应）通过 `Math.max` 进行兜底，链接目标则永不缩短。一旦编码后的目标超过 120 字符——即整行预算减去 `- []()` 包裹与上述下限——任何标题长度都无法把该行拉回上限之内，因此路径整体保留、该行允许超出上限，标题则被夹在下限处，而不是塌缩为空。

## 为什么需要

修复 #13910。`docIndexLine()`（`packages/core/src/memory/indexer.ts`）此前这样渲染条目：

```js
const link = `- [${title}](${encodeIndexPathTarget(doc.relativePath)})`;
```

然后**只把 hook** 纳入 `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS`（150）的预算。hook 分支是安全的，因为 `truncateIndexField(description, room)` 让该行恰好落在上限上。但无 hook 分支会原样返回 `link`，因此输出行仅受 `MAX_INDEX_FIELD_CHARS`（120）加上路径长度约束——120 字符标题配 71 字符路径可达约 197 字符，与 issue 在真实存储上测到的 182/189 一致。读取路径随后又会用自身的上限重新度量该行，因此写入方自己的常量其实并非它所声称的那个限制。

修复方式是让标题共享行预算，而不是逃逸出去：

```js
const target = encodeIndexPathTarget(doc.relativePath);
const titleLimit = Math.max(
  MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS,
  MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS - INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS - target.length,
);
const title = truncateIndexField(sanitizeIndexField(doc.title) || doc.type, titleLimit);
const link = `- [${title}](${target})`;
```

`INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS` 是包裹在标题与目标之外的 `- [`、`](` 与 `)` 共 6 个字符，因此只要路径给 `MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS` 留出了空间，就有 `link.length <= MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS`。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

```
$ cd packages/core
$ npx vitest run src/memory/indexer.test.ts src/memory/prompt.test.ts
# Test Files  2 passed (2)
#   src/memory/prompt.test.ts  (45 tests)
#   src/memory/indexer.test.ts (38 tests)
```

`npx tsc --noEmit` 在 `src/memory/` 下无报错；`eslint` 无新增违规——这两个测试文件中既有的 7 个 `vitest/no-conditional-expect` 错误数量不变。

本地说明，写出来以免被误读为全部通过：在本机 Windows 上，`src/memory` 的 48 个文件中有 4 个失败，原因与本次改动无关。`team-memory-sync.test.ts` 报 `spawnSync git EBUSY`（Windows 文件锁），`recall-scan-latency.test.ts` 断言的 100 ms 挂钟上限本机达不到，`forget.test.ts` 与 `memoryLifecycle.integration.test.ts` 则是 hook 超时。把这 4 个文件在父提交 `4cd30565b2` 上重跑，结果完全一致（两侧均为 `2 failed | 2 passed`），因此没有由本次改动引起、也没有被它掩盖的失败。

### 证据（改动前后）

| 场景 | 改动前 | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 120 字符标题 + 71 字符路径 | 197 字符 | ≤ 150，目标完整 |
| 长标题 + 长路径，无 hook | 超出上限 | ≤ 150，标题以 `…` 截断 |
| 长标题 + 短路径 | 保留 hook | 保留 hook（非回归） |
| 短标题 + hook | 不变 | 逐字节一致 |

新增的测试在回退改动后都会失败，而不是仅仅与之并存通过。后补的三项同样经过变异校验：

| 变异 | 变红的测试 |
| --- | --- |
| `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS - INDEX_LINK_AFFIX_CHARS - target.length` → `… - doc.relativePath.length` | `budgets the title against the encoded target, not the raw path` |
| 去掉标题预算（标题整体渲染） | `runs long as soon as the encoded path passes 120 chars, not only past the whole budget` |
| 让 `truncateIndexField` 过度截断标题 | `still ships a hook when the title leaves room for it` |

"超长"区间现在两侧边界都有测试：编码后目标 120 字符时该行恰好 150，121 字符时为 151。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

Windows，Node.js v24.18.0，在 `packages/core` 下运行 vitest。仅单元测试；macOS 与 Linux 交由 CI 把关。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：当编码后的目标超过 120 字符（即整行预算减去 `- []()` 包裹与标题下限）时，该行仍会超出上限，标题被夹在 `MIN_INDEX_TITLE_CHARS` 处。这是有意为之——链接目标永不截断，因为可解析的长链接优于短而失效的链接——但这意味着该上限只在目标为标题下限留出空间时，才是对 `- [title](target)` 的约束，而不是对每一行的约束。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：issue 提到的写入方/读取方不一致在 `main` 上已不存在，因为 `prompt.ts` 插值的正是写入方自己的 `MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS`，因此读取侧无需改动。命名问题仍只是命名问题：`MAX_INDEX_LINE_CHARS` 是每一行据以预算的目标值，而超过 120 字符目标阈值的行允许超出它，所以该常量是一个带明文例外的上限，而非绝对上限。
- 未覆盖：`#13910` 所列的第二项代价——标题吃满行预算的条目仍会丢掉 description hook——不在本次范围内，另由 #14455 跟踪。本 diff 修的是行长那一半；若保留关闭关键字，就会把两者的唯一追踪项一起关掉。`indexer.ts` 中「description 是唯一可选部分」的过时注释已一并更正，因为标题同样被行预算截断。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无需用户操作，但也不是"对既有存储无影响"。`rebuildManagedAutoMemoryIndex` 与 `rebuildTeamAutoMemoryIndex` 会依据扫描到的每个主题文件重新渲染整份索引，因此升级后的首次重建会重新截断所有既有的长标题条目，而不只是新条目。对私有索引而言不可见；对团队索引而言，这意味着 `.qwen/team-memory/MEMORY.md` 会出现一次性变更提交，因为"逐字节相同即跳过重写"不再成立。它是无害的——该文件由代码生成、从不手工编辑，且排序按代码单元确定，协作者会收敛到同一结果——但它确实是一次真实提交，每个团队存储一次。
- fixture 说明：`packages/core/src/memory/prompt.test.ts` 需要一处调整——它的长行 fixture 原本刚好落在 `MAX_INDEX_CHARS` 之上，行变短后落到了下方。路径中的空格串从 250 增至 288，并拆成两段（250 + 37），因为单个路径组件上限为 255 字节（`NAME_MAX`）——而上面 14 个兄弟组件恰好都卡在这个上限上。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #13910

prs.title: fix(core): keep sed anchors inside groups and alternations
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The simulated `sed -i` substitution now keeps `^` and `$` as anchors at group and alternation boundaries in basic regex, the same as GNU sed. `^` stays an anchor right after `\(` or `\|`, and `$` stays an anchor right before `\)` or `\|`. Everywhere else they are still escaped as literal characters, including after an even run of backslashes (`\\(^` is a literal backslash, not a group). `$` before a raw `)` or `|` is also an anchor, as in GNU sed.

Where a JavaScript regex cannot reproduce GNU sed exactly, the parser now declines and the real `sed` runs instead: a live anchor inside an alternation (JavaScript picks the leftmost branch, POSIX the longest, e.g. `s/\(^a\|ab\)/X/` on `ab`), and an anchored group repeated by `\+` or a variable interval with lower bound <= 1 (e.g. `s/\(^#\)\{1,2\} */# /`).

## Why it's needed

The converter from sed basic regex to a JavaScript pattern escaped every `^` that was not the first character and every `$` that was not the last one. GNU sed also treats them as anchors inside a group or next to `\|`. So an edit like `sed -i 's/\(^foo\)/Z/' f.txt` searched for the literal text `^foo`, matched nothing, and the file was written back unchanged, while real sed replaces the line that starts with `foo`. The same miss happened for `s/\(foo$\)/Z/`, `s/\(^foo$\)/Z/`, `s/foo\|^bar/Z/` and `s/foo$\|bar/Z/`. Extended regex (`-E`) was already passed through unchanged and was not affected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run packages/core/src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts` (or `npx vitest run src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts` from `packages/core`). The cases `anchors BRE ^ and $ at group boundaries`, `anchors $ before a raw ) or |` and `keeps $ literal before a backslash that does not escape ) or |` compare simulated output with GNU sed 4.9; `declines a live anchor inside an alternation` and `declines an anchored group closed by an unsafe quantifier` check that those patterns fall back to real sed. For reference, `printf 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' | sed 's/\(^foo\)/Z/'` prints `xxfoo` and `Z`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `applySedSubstitution("xxfoo\nfoo\n", parseSedEditCommand('sed -i "s/\(^foo\)/Z/" f.txt'))` returns `"xxfoo\nfoo\n"` (no change), and the new test fails with `expected 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' to be 'xxfoo\nZ\n'`.

After: it returns `"xxfoo\nZ\n"`, matching GNU sed, and the file passes (43 tests, including decline cases checked against GNU sed 4.9). Prettier and ESLint are clean on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only)

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: low. Only `^` directly after `\(`/`\|` and `$` directly before `\)`/`\|` change from literal to anchor, which is what GNU sed does; all other positions keep the current escaping. Patterns JavaScript cannot match exactly (anchors inside an alternation, anchored groups under `\+` or a variable interval) are declined and run through real sed.
- Not validated / out of scope: other BRE differences between sed and JavaScript regex.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

模拟执行的 `sed -i` 替换现在在基本正则（BRE）里，会把分组和 `\|` 边界处的 `^`、`$` 当作锚点，和 GNU sed 一致：`^` 紧跟在 `\(` 或 `\|` 后面时是锚点，`$` 紧挨在 `\)` 或 `\|` 前面时是锚点。其它位置仍按普通字符转义，包括前面是偶数个反斜杠的情况（`\\(^` 是字面反斜杠，不是分组）。`$` 在裸 `)` 或 `|` 前面也是锚点，与 GNU sed 一致。

对于 JavaScript 正则无法和 GNU sed 完全一致的情况，解析器现在会拒绝模拟，改由真实 `sed` 执行：分支（`\|`）里带生效锚点的模式（JavaScript 选最左分支，POSIX 选最长分支，例如 `s/\(^a\|ab\)/X/` 作用于 `ab`），以及被 `\+` 或下界 <= 1 的可变区间重复的带锚点分组（例如 `s/\(^#\)\{1,2\} */# /`）。

## 为什么需要

把 sed 基本正则转换成 JavaScript 正则时，原来的逻辑会转义所有不在开头的 `^` 和所有不在结尾的 `$`。但 GNU sed 在分组内或 `\|` 旁边也把它们当锚点。所以 `sed -i 's/\(^foo\)/Z/' f.txt` 这样的编辑会去找字面文本 `^foo`，什么都匹配不到，文件原样写回；而真实的 sed 会替换以 `foo` 开头的那一行。`s/\(foo$\)/Z/`、`s/\(^foo$\)/Z/`、`s/foo\|^bar/Z/`、`s/foo$\|bar/Z/` 也有同样的问题。扩展正则（`-E`）本来就原样透传，不受影响。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run packages/core/src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts`（或在 `packages/core` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts`）。用例 `anchors BRE ^ and $ at group boundaries`、`anchors $ before a raw ) or |`、`keeps $ literal before a backslash that does not escape ) or |` 会把模拟结果和 GNU sed 4.9 的输出对比；`declines a live anchor inside an alternation` 和 `declines an anchored group closed by an unsafe quantifier` 检查这些模式会退回真实 sed。参考：`printf 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' | sed 's/\(^foo\)/Z/'` 输出 `xxfoo` 和 `Z`。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：`applySedSubstitution("xxfoo\nfoo\n", parseSedEditCommand('sed -i "s/\(^foo\)/Z/" f.txt'))` 返回 `"xxfoo\nfoo\n"`（没有变化），新测试失败：`expected 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' to be 'xxfoo\nZ\n'`。

修改后：返回 `"xxfoo\nZ\n"`，与 GNU sed 一致，该文件全部通过（43 个测试，含与 GNU sed 4.9 对照的拒绝模拟用例）。改动文件的 Prettier 和 ESLint 检查通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

不适用（仅单元测试）

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：低。只有紧跟 `\(`/`\|` 的 `^` 和紧挨 `\)`/`\|` 的 `$` 从普通字符变为锚点，这正是 GNU sed 的行为；其它位置的转义不变。JavaScript 无法精确匹配的模式（分支内的锚点、被 `\+` 或可变区间重复的带锚点分组）会拒绝模拟，改由真实 sed 执行。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：sed 与 JavaScript 正则之间其它的 BRE 差异。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #12511

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

新增一个只读请求，一次获取 1–20 个显式选定、已注册 workspace 的完整会话运行状态快照。每个 workspace 独立返回规范化身份、目录版本及成功或错误结果。新请求与单 workspace 接口共用快照生成和目录缓存校准逻辑。独立 capability 和 TypeScript SDK 方法支持客户端按能力接入，并支持取消与超时。

## 为什么需要

同时展示多个 workspace 的客户端目前每次刷新都要逐 workspace 发起运行状态 HTTP 请求。近期增加的批量会话目录可能读取持久历史，不适合高频查询执行状态。新接口让客户端通过一次请求获取同样的权威内存状态，保留原单 workspace 路由和逐会话 SSE。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

启动包含 primary workspace 的本地 daemon，注册可信的 secondary workspace，再用一次批量请求查询两个 ID 和一个未知 selector。预期按输入顺序得到两个完整快照和一个明确的 `workspace_not_found` 成员，响应包含 `Cache-Control: no-store`。确认无效请求体返回 HTTP 400，不可信或过渡中的 workspace 只影响自身成员，且 capability 已公布。在目录版本不变时使会话在运行、等待和空闲之间切换，每次快照都应反映当前状态。确认 SDK 只发送一次带鉴权的原生 REST 请求，并保留取消与超时行为。旧 daemon 的调用方应预检能力，继续使用单 workspace 路由。

### 前后证据

不适用（HTTP 与 SDK 改动，无 TUI 变化）。本地 daemon 实测一次 POST 返回两个 workspace 快照及一个未知 workspace 的明确错误。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 构建、类型检查、打包、聚焦测试和本地 HTTP E2E 通过；大型 server 测试文件出现无关的间歇性失败 |
| 🪟 Windows | 本地未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64：锁文件安装/构建/打包、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon HTTP E2E 均通过 |

### 环境

在 macOS arm64 和 `dev` Linux x86_64 上使用 Node 22.23.1，各自启动使用动态 loopback 端口的隔离 daemon。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，无法进行改动前 CLI dry-run；已从当前基线源码确认该路由不存在。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：批量结果不保证跨 workspace 原子性；每个成功成员上限为 512 KiB，超限会返回明确错误。
- 未验证或范围外：Web Shell 在后续客户端迁移前仍逐 workspace 轮询；HTTP E2E 未创建由模型驱动的运行会话；未在本地运行 Windows 测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。客户端预检 `workspace_session_live_state_batch`，旧 daemon 保留现有单 workspace 路径。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #12511

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Conversation rewind links visible messages, model entries and recorded boundaries through source identity, or refuses before mutation. A recovered legacy conversation key cannot authorize file restore.

Retry, resume and JSON history rollback preserve that identity. Daemon-backed interfaces additionally associate checkpoints with the existing admitted prompt identity: `turnIndex` remains the raw snapshot position, not a visible-turn ordinal. WebShell and VS Code select uniquely associated messages; rewind notifications remove that message and its suffix. Optimistic messages bind to their exact admitted block.

## Why it's needed

Legacy placeholder-shaped prompts could disappear visibly while remaining in model context. Retry snapshots and invisible ordinary turns could also shift a recorded cut. The identity filter introduced a further regression: snapshots can be at raw positions 0/2 while the UI shows only A/B. Neither raw position nor eligible-list rank safely identifies the displayed message after retry or compression.

This is #9437's source-identity follow-up. #13729 separately handled #11408 and is merged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume legacy `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, `world` and their replies. Rewind the second prompt: visible, next-request and cold-restored histories should retain only `hello` and its reply. Recovered keys must not restore files.
- Fail A, retry it successfully, then submit B. Edit B and resend: A remains, old B/reply disappear and edited B appears once. Check raw 0/2 checkpoints still refer to their original positions while B's admitted identity matches its checkpoint and notification. Repeat with recording disabled.
- Check a retained target after a compressed prefix, an invisible ordinary image turn, and JSON history echo. Unique source associations must still resolve; missing or duplicated associations must refuse without selecting a different turn. Rewind metadata must not reach the model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The [current real-producer report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6139059338) compares `4c0d03fcde` with `f71ff86f4febeb0b353a005da6b6b826a8cd485b`: browser composer admission → actual source daemon/ACP → recorder or recording-disabled association → checkpoint catalog → rewind notification → next model request. It reproduces the post-retry edit failure before and successful identity-backed edit after. Read-only SDK state logging observes optimistic block binding; the harness does not supply association fields.

Earlier [Ink/tmux and ACP evidence](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6077085058) remains revision-pinned historical evidence, not a fresh final-head execution. The [eligible-rank experiment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6137596597) was withdrawn and is not used as fix evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ current real WebShell/daemon/ACP chain; historical Ink/tmux |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2, Chromium/Playwright, isolated profiles and loopback controlled OpenAI endpoint. Root build and workspace/integration typecheck pass; changed-file lint/format and focused regression tests pass. No full test suite or CI wait. See the report for exact source pins and counts.

## Risk & Scope

- Compatibility is deliberately fail-closed. Old unassociated ACP histories and persisted custom slash/skill invocation rows may refuse conversation rewind. Updated daemon interfaces require a unique association; older producers lacking it cannot authorize an edit by ordinal. Legacy numeric notifications retain their old interpretation for older senders.
- The catalog/notification additions reuse an already persisted daemon identity. No new identity counter, transcript schema, dependency, route or setting. Raw numeric ACP targets and snapshot creation are unchanged. The prior unconditional pre-send identity mark is preserved.
- `44 files, +1934/-1044: implementation26 +446/-207; regression16 +1357/-814; existing bilingual designs2 +131/-23`. The larger file surface is the necessary producer-to-consumer repair of R3-1, not a new feature/refactor. Remaining Suggestions stay in #13869; #13794 remains separate maintenance. The real collector fixture incidentally strengthens item12's coverage, without adding its proposed predicate refactor.
- Not validated: native model-driven compression, actual VS Code webview UI, Windows/Linux, unwired OpenTUI, every slash-entry timing, changed-file byte restoration or full native CI-review engine. Compression and VS Code mapping have focused source regression checks. No approval, merge, release or issue closure is claimed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #9437; separate from merged #9466 and #13729. No issue is auto-closed.

- 明确采用失败关闭兼容边界。无关联的旧 ACP 历史及持久化自定义 slash/skill 调用行可能拒绝对话回退。更新后的 daemon 界面要求唯一关联；缺少该字段的旧发送方不能凭轮次授权编辑。旧数字通知仍按原语义兼容旧发送方。
- 检查点/通知新增字段复用已持久化的 daemon 身份。不新增身份计数器、transcript schema、依赖、路由或配置。原始数字 ACP 目标、快照创建和此前无条件的发送前身份标记保持不变。

prs.title: fix(cli): emit headless results before draining memory
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Deliver the terminal `result` in headless JSON formats before waiting for tracked managed-memory tasks. The invocation normally waits for those tasks before returning, including structured-success, error, and TEXT paths; stream-JSON EOF memory waiting is subject to the shared deadline described below. A rejected memory task does not replace the turn's outcome.

Cancellation and run-budget exhaustion stop that wait without cancelling the underlying memory tasks. They retain exit codes 130 and 55 respectively; recoverable session interruption returns 130 without terminating the session. A result already written is not emitted again. Optional debug-file messages report task counts and the wait outcome without adding stdout or stderr messages.

If a TEXT loop error has already been printed, cancellation during memory settlement preserves that diagnostic and prints only the usual cancellation line. Regression tests retain signal handlers through all five terminal-helper await sites. Document the earlier usage/statistics snapshot, the distinction between terminal output and invocation completion in every format, and the separate lifecycle of metadata migration.

## Why it's needed

With managed auto-memory enabled, SDK consumers could wait for a completed answer's final result while extraction or dreaming continued. This addresses the [ordering problem confirmed in #13851](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13851#issuecomment-6099578021). Keeping the wait inside the invocation protects ordinary one-shot shutdown; removing it entirely could let the process exit before memory work finishes.

Review identified cancellation and ownership regressions in the post-result wait. Headless waits now take a non-destructive snapshot and remove only observed settled promise identities. An interrupted waiter leaves unfinished work tracked for a later turn or normal EOF shutdown while the process remains alive. Normal stream-JSON EOF starts one shared 5000 ms memory-wait deadline before awaiting pending processing, covering both an in-turn wait and the final wait. Real session cancellation still stops the wait. The TUI keeps its existing destructive consumer; no tasks are requeued or notification events added. The design is recorded in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987/docs/design/headless-memory-task-ownership.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987/docs/design/headless-memory-task-ownership.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a one-shot invocation or with stream-JSON stdin kept open, hold memory work pending after the answer completes. Confirm one terminal result and one successful-result callback, while invocation completion still waits. Settle the tasks individually, including one rejection; confirm the original outcome remains intact.
2. Cancel while memory remains unresolved, both before and during error handling and after successful output. Confirm ordinary cancellation exits 130, a run-budget overrun exits 55, and recoverable interruption returns 130. Confirm no duplicate result and no requirement to release the memory task first. In TEXT loop/error paths, confirm exactly two stderr writes: the original diagnostic, then `Operation cancelled.`; stdout remains untouched.
3. Interrupt a stream-JSON turn while its memory is pending. Submit another ordinary turn or close stdin directly. With stdin kept open, confirm the next invocation waits for the original task to settle; a second model request may run after recoverable interruption. At normal EOF, confirm memory waiting ends when the tasks settle or the single 5000 ms deadline expires, including an active in-turn wait and the final wait, without a second grace period. Unfinished promise identities remain tracked only while the process lives. Cancel during the EOF wait and confirm cleanup completes promptly with existing cancellation behavior preserved. Also check normal serialized turns and interrupted-turn continuation separately.
4. In both JSON formats, record memory usage before the result and again afterward. Confirm the emitted totals include the earlier record and remain unchanged after later settlement. Successful JSON includes statistics; stream-JSON results do not.
5. With debug-file logging enabled, inspect task counts and settlement or abandonment messages. Confirm protocol output remains parseable and contains none of these diagnostics. Final debug-file writes are best effort during termination.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original ordering regression failed before the fix: assistant output and `message_stop` were present, but no result appeared while memory remained pending. The same regression passes after the fix.

The cancellation regression was also reproduced before remediation. A built CLI emitted one successful result, then remained alive with extraction held after two SIGINT signals; a bounded 1.2-second observation ended with explicit cleanup SIGKILL. Five deterministic cancellation assertions failed before production changes.

The TEXT diagnostic follow-up was reproduced on unchanged `669a684`: the loop arm wrote three stderr lines, including `This operation was aborted`, while the already-reported API-error control correctly wrote two. With the fix, both write exactly two. Removing the marker restores the three-write failure.

Current-head validation for `958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987` is recorded in the [published R4-2 evidence](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13885#issuecomment-6171070341): **1,156 targeted tests passed, zero failed, one pre-existing skip; all 12 mutation checks and 10 real-CLI scenarios passed.**

The broader workspace run before this head reported **102,698 passed, 30 failed, 309 skipped**, plus six CLI RPC errors. It was not rerun at `958a4adb`; full preflight is not claimed green. The published evidence retains the build/static-check details and the original-checkout TUI guard limitation.

Historical local validation for `36761eb8941df2f83be16dde67e72beccaacce1c` (not the current head):

| Check | Observed result |
| :-- | :-- |
| Focused and downstream suites | **1,117 passed, one existing skip:** headless 211 passed/one skip, Session 44, run-budget 76, full core client 497, and existing TUI hook file 289. Final CLI and core suites were rerun after lint corrections. |
| R3 reproduction and mutations | Two stateful real-runner cases failed before the fix. Acknowledging unfinished snapshot entries fails three CLI cases; clearing the current queue fails two core identity/count tests; skipping EOF settlement fails both Session cases. Mutated sources were restored before final checks. Earlier R1/R2 mutation evidence remains historical and was not rerun this round. |
| Build and static checks | Full build/bundle/typecheck passed; changed packages were rebuilt, rebundled, and workspace/integration types checked after formatting. Changed-file formatting, repository-wide ESLint, commit hooks, and diff checks passed. |
| Actual SDK baseline on old R2 bundle | After a protocol interrupt, next-turn/EOF and direct EOF naturally exited 0 with the original extraction unreleased: the ownership regression reproduced. |
| Actual fixed SDK next turn and EOF | Next-turn process remained pending at 922 ms, then exited 0 at 972 ms after release. EOF-only remained pending at 714 ms, then exited 0 at 769 ms after release. One successful result per turn; empty stderr. |
| Actual fixed cancellation and TEXT controls | EOF wait cancelled with SIGINT exited 0 at 777 ms without release, preserving Session shutdown behavior. Ordinary one-shot SIGINT exited 130; wall budget exited 55, each with one result. TEXT wrote exactly one plain answer and exited 0 after release. |

The six CLI replays for that historical head used the rebuilt bundle and were independently audited against raw protocol, process events, stderr, and debug files. SDK cancellation targets the worker with relaunch disabled. An earlier supervisor-targeted cancellation attempt timed out and was preserved as an inconclusive harness failure; this PR does not change launcher signal behavior. The budget replay still lacks its final best-effort debug-file entry before exit.

Queue tests check promise identity, mixed fulfillment/rejection/pending entries, tasks appended after a snapshot, idempotent removal, one-time positive TUI count delivery, and listener cleanup. The existing TUI consumer is unchanged; its 289-test file passed, but no rendered memory_saved event E2E is claimed. Exact TEXT loop diagnostics and terminal awaits use real-runner tests with mocked streams. External SDK inputs are ordinary turns and a protocol interrupt; continuation remains separately unit-tested. Local provider replays establish lifetime and ordering, not live-model latency or durable memory-file contents.

Historical full-suite failures remain disclosed. The original Node 22 workspace preflight reported **100,095 passed, 107 failed, 274 skipped**, plus a worker timeout. Of those failures, 102 reproduced on unchanged parent `543f03e` with matching signatures. The remaining five HTTP failures passed in focused runs; a serialized comparison passed all 259 tests on both sides, although an intermediate parallel rerun produced two different connection errors. Repository script checks initially reported 2,904 passed, two failed, 75 skipped; restoring the required CRLF checkout form without changing committed content resolved those two failures, and the affected suite passed 131 with 11 skips. **The full workspace suite was not rerun for the `36761eb894` remediation and is not represented as green.**

These are local results. External-contributor test workflows may require maintainer approval; administrative checks and automated review do not establish test execution. The cross-package ownership API and headless accounting/invocation-lifetime contract require maintainer agreement before merge. CI status is reported separately for the exact pushed head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 27.0.1, arm64 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Current-head validation used the existing Node.js 24.7.0 runtime. Historical `36761eb894` validation used Node.js 22.23.3 and pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Mock-provider checks used fresh temporary settings, workspace, and runtime directories, a dummy API key, a restricted child environment, and a loopback-only connection guard. No paid model calls or real user settings/history were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: receiving a result does not mean memory has finished. One-shot invocation completion and the next serialized turn with stdin kept open can still wait for tracked memory work; neither has an added memory-wait deadline. Normal stream-JSON EOF uses one shared 5000 ms memory-wait deadline. Expiry stops memory waiting without cancelling foreground work or changing an emitted result; real cancellation and run-budget aborts retain their existing outcomes. Stopping the wait does not itself cancel the tasks. Unfinished promise identities remain tracked only while the process lives: there is no durable queue or automatic resumption in a later process, and process exit may abandon unfinished writes. Neither result delivery nor deadline expiry guarantees write completion. The deadline is not a total-process exit cap; foreground work and other cleanup can take longer.
- Accounting: result `usage` and successful JSON `stats` can include memory usage recorded before their snapshots and omit later records. Settlement does not revise the emitted totals. Earlier reporting does not imply lower model cost or complete invocation accounting.
- Not validated / out of scope: memory scheduling changes, forced termination, additional timeout policies for one-shot invocations or stdin-open sessions, live-provider latency, and newly written memory contents. Standalone metadata migration is outside the tracked wait and is cancelled during configuration shutdown. Session-turn-cap exits retain their existing behavior and can abandon memory work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: message schemas and settings are unchanged, but result timing and the completeness of reported usage/statistics change. Consumers must distinguish result delivery from invocation completion and check the invocation outcome or exit status for cancellation after a result. This behavior change needs owner agreement.

This contribution is AI-assisted. Reproductions, local test results, mutation checks, and validation limits are reported above.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the headless result-ordering problem in #13851.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在等待已跟踪的托管记忆任务之前，先输出 headless JSON 格式的最终 `result`。通常情况下，调用返回前仍会等待这些任务，包括结构化成功、错误和 TEXT 路径；stream-JSON EOF 的记忆等待受下述共享期限约束。记忆任务失败不会替换回合原本的结果。

取消和运行预算耗尽会停止这段等待，但不会取消底层记忆任务。两者分别保留退出码 130 和 55；可恢复的会话中断返回 130，而不终止会话。已经输出的结果不会再次输出。可选的调试文件日志记录任务数量和等待结果，不向 stdout 或 stderr 添加消息。

TEXT 循环错误已经输出后，记忆收尾期间发生取消会保留该诊断，并且只额外输出通常的取消提示。回归测试验证全部五个终止辅助流程 await 位置在等待期间保留信号处理器。文档说明更早的用量与统计快照、各种格式下终止输出与调用结束之间的区别，以及元数据迁移的独立生命周期。

## 为什么需要此改动

启用托管自动记忆后，即使回答已经完成，SDK 使用方仍可能在记忆提取或整理期间等待最终结果。本 PR 处理 [#13851 中已确认的顺序问题](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13851#issuecomment-6099578021)。将等待保留在调用内部，可以保护单次进程的正常关闭；完全移除等待可能让进程在记忆工作结束前退出。

评审发现结果输出后的等待存在取消和任务所有权回退。Headless 等待现在读取非破坏性快照，只按 promise 身份移除已经观察到结束的条目。进程存活期间，中断后未完成工作继续被跟踪，供后续回合或正常 EOF 等待。正常 stream-JSON EOF 在等待待处理工作之前启动一个共享的 5000 ms 记忆等待期限，同时覆盖回合内等待和最终等待；真实会话取消仍会停止等待。TUI 保留现有破坏性消费者，不重新入队，也不增加通知事件。设计说明：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987/docs/design/headless-memory-task-ownership.md)、[中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987/docs/design/headless-memory-task-ownership.zh-CN.md)。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 在单次调用中，或保持 stream-JSON stdin 打开时，回答完成后保持记忆工作未结束。确认最终结果和成功输出结果的回调各出现一次，而调用仍在等待。逐个结束任务，其中一个以失败结束；确认原本的回合结果保持不变。
2. 记忆仍未完成时发起取消，覆盖错误处理前、错误处理期间和成功输出之后。确认普通取消退出 130，运行预算超限退出 55，可恢复中断返回 130。确认没有重复结果，也无需先释放记忆任务。TEXT 循环和错误路径恰好向 stderr 写入两次：原始诊断和 `Operation cancelled.`，stdout 不被调用。
3. 在记忆尚未完成时中断 stream-JSON 回合，再提交普通回合或直接关闭 stdin。stdin 保持打开时，确认后续调用等待原任务结束；可恢复中断后第二个模型请求可以先运行。正常 EOF 时，确认记忆等待在任务结束或同一个 5000 ms 期限到达后停止，覆盖正在进行的回合内等待和最终等待，不再额外给予第二段宽限期。未完成 promise 的身份仅在进程存活期间保留。EOF 等待期间取消应及时完成清理，并保留现有取消行为。另行检查正常串行回合及中断回合续接。
4. 在两种 JSON 格式中，分别于结果输出前后记录记忆用量。确认输出总量包含先前记录，并在后续任务结束后保持不变。成功 JSON 结果包含统计；stream-JSON 结果不包含统计。
5. 启用调试文件日志后，检查任务数量以及等待完成或放弃的消息。确认协议输出仍可解析，且不含这些诊断消息。终止过程中的最后一条调试文件写入不保证完成。

### 改动前后证据

原始顺序回归在修复前失败：assistant 输出和 `message_stop` 已出现，但记忆未完成时没有 result。相同回归在修复后通过。

取消回归也在修复前复现。构建后的 CLI 输出一个成功结果后，在提取响应持续暂扣、收到两次 SIGINT 的情况下仍保持存活；有界的 1.2 秒观察最终通过明确标记的清理 SIGKILL 结束。修改生产代码前，五个确定性取消断言失败。

TEXT 诊断跟进在未修改的 `669a684` 上复现：循环检测分支向 stderr 写入三行，包含 `This operation was aborted`；已报告 API 错误的对照分支正确写入两行。修复后两者均恰好写入两次。移除错误标记后恢复三次写入的失败。

当前提交 `958a4adb42ae8e940203d71ff6aa07bc09b09987` 的验证见[已发布的 R4-2 证据](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13885#issuecomment-6171070341)：**1,156 个定向测试通过、零失败、一个原有跳过项；12 项变异检查和 10 个真实 CLI 场景全部通过。**

此前的全量工作区运行报告 **102,698 个通过、30 个失败、309 个跳过**，另有六个 CLI RPC 错误；未在 `958a4adb` 重跑，不声称完整 preflight 全绿。已发布证据保留构建与静态检查详情，以及原检出目录的 TUI 检查限制。

历史提交 `36761eb8941df2f83be16dde67e72beccaacce1c` 的本地验证（并非当前 head）：

| 检查 | 实际结果 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 定向及下游套件 | **1,117 个通过，一个原有跳过项：** headless 211 个通过/一个跳过，会话 44、预算 76、完整 core client 497、现有 TUI hook 文件 289。Lint 修正后重跑了最终 CLI 和 core 套件。 |
| R3 复现与变异 | 修复前两个有状态真实 runner 用例失败。移除未完成快照条目使三个 CLI 用例失败；清空当前队列使两个 core 身份/计数用例失败；跳过 EOF 收尾使两个 Session 用例失败。最终检查前恢复变异源码。历史 R1/R2 变异证据保留，本轮未重跑。 |
| 构建与静态检查 | 完整构建、打包、类型检查通过；格式调整后重新构建相关包、打包，并通过工作区/集成类型检查。改动文件格式、全仓 ESLint、提交 hooks 和 diff 检查通过。 |
| 旧 R2 bundle 实际 SDK 基线 | 协议中断后，下一回合/EOF 及直接 EOF 均在原提取响应未释放时自然退出 0，复现所有权回退。 |
| 修复后实际 SDK 后续回合与 EOF | 后续回合进程在 922 ms 仍等待，释放后于 972 ms 退出 0。直接 EOF 在 714 ms 仍等待，释放后于 769 ms 退出 0。每回合一个成功结果，stderr 为空。 |
| 实际取消和 TEXT 对照 | EOF 等待收到 SIGINT 后于 777 ms 退出 0，无需释放，保留会话关闭行为。单次 CLI SIGINT 退出 130，墙钟预算退出 55，均只有一个结果。TEXT 恰好输出一个纯文本回答，释放记忆后退出 0。 |

该历史提交的六次 CLI 重放使用重新构建的 bundle，并独立核对原始协议、进程事件、stderr 和调试记录。SDK 取消测试禁用 relaunch，将信号发给 worker。早期一次向 supervisor 发信号的尝试超时，作为无结论的夹具失败保留；本 PR 不修改 launcher 信号行为。预算重放仍未观察到退出前最后一条尽力写入的调试记录。

队列测试验证 promise 身份、成功/拒绝/未完成混合条目、快照后新增任务、幂等移除、TUI 正计数仅交付一次及监听器清理。现有 TUI 消费者不变，其 289 个测试通过，但不声称进行了渲染 memory_saved 的 E2E。确切 TEXT 循环诊断和终止 await 使用真实 runner 配合模拟流验证。外部 SDK 输入为普通回合和协议中断，续接另有单元测试。本地服务重放验证生命周期及顺序，不验证真实模型延迟或持久化记忆文件内容。

仍披露历史全量套件失败。原始 Node 22 工作区 preflight 为 **100,095 个通过、107 个失败、274 个跳过**，另有一个 worker 超时。其中 102 个失败在未修改的父提交 `543f03e` 上复现，错误特征一致。剩余五个 HTTP 失败在定向运行中通过；串行对比中双方均通过全部 259 个测试，但中间一次并行重跑出现了另外两个连接错误。仓库脚本检查初次为 2,904 个通过、两个失败、75 个跳过；恢复要求的 CRLF 检出格式、且未改变提交内容后，这两个失败消失，受影响套件为 131 个通过、11 个跳过。**`36761eb894` 的该轮修复未重跑全量工作区套件，也不将其描述为通过。**

以上均为本地结果。外部贡献者测试工作流可能需要维护者批准；管理检查及自动评审不能证明测试已执行。跨包所有权 API，以及 headless 统计和调用生命周期契约，需要维护者在合并前确认。CI 状态另按准确的推送提交报告。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 27.0.1，arm64 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

当前提交使用现有 Node.js 24.7.0 运行时验证。历史提交 `36761eb894` 使用 Node.js 22.23.3 和固定版本的 pnpm 11.24.0 验证。模拟服务检查使用全新的临时设置、工作区和运行时目录、虚拟 API 密钥、受限子进程环境，以及仅允许回环连接的防护。未调用付费模型，也未使用真实用户配置或历史。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：收到结果不代表记忆已经完成。单次调用结束，以及 stdin 保持打开时的下一个串行回合，仍可能等待已跟踪的记忆工作；这两种情况均未增加记忆等待期限。正常 stream-JSON EOF 使用一个共享的 5000 ms 记忆等待期限。期限到达只停止记忆等待，不取消前台工作，也不改变已输出结果；真实取消和运行预算中止保留现有结果。停止等待本身不会取消任务。未完成 promise 的身份仅在进程存活期间保留：没有持久化队列，也不会在后续进程自动恢复，进程退出可能放弃未完成写入。收到结果或期限到达均不保证写入完成。该期限不是整个进程退出的时限，前台工作及其他清理可能耗时更久。
- 统计口径：结果 `usage` 和成功 JSON 的 `stats` 可能包含快照前记录的记忆用量，而不包含后续记录。任务结束不会修订已输出总量。更早上报不代表模型费用降低，也不保证完整的调用用量统计。
- 未验证或不在范围内：记忆调度改动、强制终止、为单次调用或 stdin 保持打开的会话增加其他超时策略、真实服务延迟和新写入的记忆内容。独立元数据迁移不属于已跟踪的等待范围，并在配置关闭期间被取消。会话回合数上限退出保留原有行为，可能放弃进行中的记忆工作。
- 兼容性与迁移：消息结构和配置项不变，但结果输出时点以及用量、统计的完整性发生变化。使用方必须区分结果交付和调用结束，并检查调用结果或退出状态，以识别结果输出后的取消。这一行为变化需要负责人确认。

本次贡献使用了 AI 辅助。复现、本地测试结果、变异检查和验证限制均如上报告。

## 关联 Issue

处理 #13851 中的 headless 结果输出顺序问题。
